cetana.zh:
[event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName]内掀起了一场新的宇宙风暴。

与我们已知的一切均不相同，我们对这个现象的一切扫描都是徒劳的。它的深处是否潜藏着什么东西呢？
cetana.en:
A novel galactic tempest is raging in [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName].

Utterly unlike anything we have encountered before, our attempts at scanning the phenomenon have proven futile. What, if anything, lies within its mysterious depths?

the-shroud.zh:
就像暗室里低沉的轻语般，虚境从内心召唤我们。那是时间开始运转的伊始便存在的由纯粹灵能构成的原生领域。所有被赐予灵能能力的生物都能用某种方式，即使只是潜意识地，从虚境汲取能量。

自从我们升格之后，我们开始更清晰地看到虚境。其中有些图案，即使是我们最强大的通灵者看到的也只是毫无格式的漩涡状能量。在虚境那边，也有一些……其他的存在。一种灵体样的存在，从另一边凝视着我们，有时怀着好奇，有时怀着善意……有时也怀着恶意。

我们还在进一步学习我们这新得力量的延展面，但我们还是有可能和这些灵体交流的，这需要我们最强大的通灵者们
the-shroud.en: Like a muffled whisper in a dark room, the Shroud calls to us from within our minds. It is a primordial realm of pure psychic energy that came into being at the dawn of time. All creatures that have been gifted with psionic abilities tap into the Shroud in som

origin_unplugged.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源

与同化他们的机器被切断联系之后，这个新生的文明为了在星系中确立自身地位而进行了顽强的斗争。
origin_unplugged.en: Abruptly severed from the Machine that assimilated them, this nascent civilization has fought fiercely to establish its own presence in the galaxy.

origin_treasure_hunters.zh: 怀揣着对冒险的渴望，这个文明已经准备好踏上他们最伟大、最具挑战性的探险之旅。他们只手持一张神秘的地图，现在正跨越星辰，去争夺传说中的海盗宝藏。
origin_treasure_hunters.en: Instilled with a thirst for adventure, this civilization is ready to set forth on their greatest and most challenging expedition. Armed only with a mysterious map, they now race across the stars to secure a legendary pirate treasure.

origin_legendary_leader.zh: 在暴力和苦难中，这个文明在一位领袖的领导下走向了统一。通过压制较弱的派系来巩固权力，他们现在成为了科学和技术进步的坚定倡导者。在这之后，是一段不稳定的和平的时期。但和平终究是一种短暂的状态。
origin_legendary_leader.en: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace h

origin_shroud_forged.zh: 虚境实体的引导是有代价的。独立的自动机开始在这个网络社会中自由运行。从机械智能中脱离后，这些单位的需求正在与日俱增。
origin_shroud_forged.en: The guidance of a Shroud entity comes with a cost. Independent automata have started to operate freely among this networked society. Cut off from the Machine Intelligence, the demands of these units are ever-increasing.

shroudwalker-divination.zh: 虚境在战栗。它在那一刻似乎一言不发，但又诉说了一切。时间的无限之织缕从此时此刻延伸开来，进入了汇合之流。此处，这个地方，前方的道路逐渐明了。预知仪式已经开始了。
shroudwalker-divination.en: The Shroud shivers. It speaks without voice and in all voices at once. The infinite strands of time that extend from this moment now enter into confluence. Here, in this place, the path ahead grows clear. The rite of divination has begun.

origin_toxic_knights.zh: 几个世纪前，这个物种的母星被一位毒性神祗造访。接踵而至的生态灾难几乎摧毁了这个星球，但是幸存者们怀着对毒圣的崇敬之情，草草地统一了起来。他们创立了一个骑士教团来搜寻毒圣，尽管后来很多事情变了，但是这份试炼依旧保留了下来。
origin_toxic_knights.en: Centuries ago, this species' homeworld was visited by a Toxic Entity. The ecological catastrophe that followed ruined half the world, but allowed an early unification of the survivors in their reverence for the Toxic God. An Order of Knights has been created t

horizon-signal.zh: 一名细心的通讯官识别出了这些模糊的信号，在伽马射线的干扰下，它们从黑洞抵达这里时已经几乎不可识别——这信号虽然微弱，但明显不是自然产生的。这个现象引起了科学家们对其的更多兴趣。
horizon-signal.en: An alert communications officer has identified what appears to be a faint signal, almost lost in the gamma-ray flashes from the black hole here - faint, but unmistakably artificial. This raises intriguing possibilities for our scientists.

origin_broken_shackles.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源

这个文明始于一艘奴隶船上的发起的兵变，现在由多种多样的前超光速物种组成。
origin_broken_shackles.en: This civilization began as a mutiny aboard a slaver vessel, and is made up of a diverse group of pre-FTL species.

origin_mindwardens.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
警告：禁用['concept_psionic_ascension']。

这个文明的祖先受到入侵心灵的超自然力量的困扰，这促使他们投入巨量人力物力来开发反灵能技术。

他们的古老装置仍然可以使用，但尚未对来自星系更远处的灵能威胁进行测试。
origin_mindwardens.en:
WARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient dev

origin_payback.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
这个文明曾被一个异星帝国造访过，这个帝国强行启蒙了他们，之后奴役了他们。如今他们击退了入侵者，但那些入侵者有朝一日还会回来吗？
origin_payback.en: This civilization has been visited by an alien empire who forcibly enlightened and enslaved them. They have repelled their invaders, but will they return?

origin_fear_of_the_dark.zh: 一个世纪以前，在帝国的母星系，其中的一颗行星被一颗古怪的小行星摧毁了。一些人认为这是某个外星物种的恶意攻击。其他人则把这些担忧当作纯粹的妄想症。两类人之间的关系变得愈发紧张，最后无可奈何之下，帝国将一个新近完成地形改造的星球给予这些恐宇派。
origin_fear_of_the_dark.en: A century ago, one of the planets in this empire's home system was destroyed by a freak asteroid. Some believed this was a malicious attack by an alien species. Others brushed off these concerns as mere paranoia. The tension between the two groups grew so grea

event-bio-1.zh: 自然选择和基因漂变再也不能阻止我们主宰生物学规律。作为一个文明，我们正在重塑物种未来的门槛前。[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]如同黏土，而我们将会是自己的雕刻家。
event-bio-1.en: Natural selection and genetic drift no longer stand between us and biological dominance. As a civilization, we are on the verge of redefining the future of our species. Our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] is clay, and we are its sculptor.

contingency.zh:
我们检测到有一股非常微弱的快子信号正向整个星系进行发送。该信号经过了特殊处理，在多个隐蔽的中继站之间来回跳跃，因此我们的技术人员无法追踪到信号的源头。

除了在某些在特定的亚空间频率段进行的超光速通讯产生些微底噪，该信号似乎不会造成明显的影响。我们已经尽力追踪这些中继站，但是在此之前我们必须学着和这个幽灵信号共同生活，毕竟它已经被闻风而动的媒体添加了很多无中生有的东西。
contingency.en:
We have detected a very faint tachyon signal being continuously transmitted across the entire galaxy. Our technicians are unable to trace the signal to its source, as it is being bounced between several hidden relay stations.

Aside from adding a small amount

first-league.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！如果没错的话，这个文明应该是由不同的种群建立的联盟，他们称呼自己为“第一联盟”。这些种群在两百万年前相对和平地在这片星域共存着。

虽然[From.GetStarName]坐落在他们核心范围内，在飞船上的文物中找到的一张局部地图表明，第一联盟陨落前已经统治了我们星系很大部分。
first-league.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! If what we have learned from these artifacts is correct, this civilization was some sort of confederation that consisted of many different alien races. They called themselves the

origin_shoulders_of_giants.zh: 在不知名的过去，有一位神秘的施恩者为这个文明在他们的恒星系藏了一点惊喜。
origin_shoulders_of_giants.en: This civilization has hidden boons in their solar system, placed there in a distant past by a mysterious benefactor.

vultaum.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于远古外星文明的文物！从这些遗物的年代来看，他们应该是在大约1200万年前活跃在这一区域的文明。
 
从我们所能拼凑起的情报中，科学家总结出这是一种自称为“沃陶姆恒星议会”的外星物种，他们长得像蠕虫的环节动物，大约3-4米长，彼此主要借助体节传递的振动进行交流。
vultaum.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! They must have been active in this region of space approximately 12 million years ago, judging by the age of the artifacts.

From what they have been able to piece together, our

event-paragon-3901.zh:
我们成功地恢复了[gateway_system.GetName]星系中远古星门的供能！尽管年代久远，这座装置还是形成了一条完全可以供通行的稳定亚空间通路。

我们还检测到了异常的、类似于进出星门时的能量读数，但没有任何船只过境的迹象。
event-paragon-3901.en:
We have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

We're also detecting unusual energy readings, similar to those that

galactic-nemesis.zh:
历经一段相当长的时间，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终于知晓了自己注定要肩负大任的事实，知晓了我们的使命要比这片星海自身的命运更加崇高的事实。

在知道了虚境的存在以及其中蕴含的无限可能性之后，这种使命感与日俱增。

毋庸置疑，[Root.GetAdj]的社会正在迎来剧变。星系还没准备好接受，但[Root.GetName]已经准备好了统御星系。认知低下者无法理解，将会成为我们的绊脚石。当然，我们势不可挡。
galactic-nemesis.en:
For a long time we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have known that we are meant for greater things - that our destiny was nothing less than the fate of the universe itself.

Since becoming aware of the Shroud and the myriad of potential found within, this notion h

irassian.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！从我们目前对其语言的破译来看，这些外星人称他们自己为“伊拉斯协约国”。他们是一个在一百万年前掌控着星系的这片区域的星际政权。

这些外星人似乎是六肢的哺乳动物，有多处文献交叉印证了一种叫“贾沃疹”的流行病席卷了他们的帝国，带来了灾难性的后果甚至直接导致了他们的毁灭。
irassian.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! From what we have translated so far of their language, we have learned that these aliens called themselves the "Irassian Concordat." They were an interstellar power that held swa

cybrex.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于某个远古外星文明的文物！难以置信的是，这个自称“赛博勒克斯”的文明其实是通过某种集体意识连接在一起的机器组成的。遗物的年代表明他们活跃在60万年前，至少在这片星系里如此，我们还不了解他们的起源。

根据我们的科学家提取的数据碎片，出于未知的原因，赛博勒克斯曾在某一时刻发动了一场全面战争来消灭宇宙中所有有智慧的有机体。
cybrex.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! Incredibly, this civilization, which apparently referred to itself as the "Cybrex," seems to have been made up of machines that were linked together in some sort of collective co

yuht.zh:
我们发现了和在[From.GetName]上的外星文明有关的文物！我们的科学家认为他们在六百万年前居住在这片星系，这些外星人自称“尤特”人。他们体型巨大且看起来像扁平的节肢动物。

这一物种成年之后体长接近百米，显然鲜有一艘飞船上能够有两名甚至三名尤特人乘客。
yuht.en: We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! Our scientists think they inhabited this region of stars roughly six million years ago, based on the age of the artifacts. The aliens called themselves the "Yuht" and appear to h

archaeology-incidents.zh: 一场甲烷爆炸事件夺去了科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]及其他几位工作人员的性命。原因是一个失控的钻头使得发电机组过载并引发火灾引发爆炸。失控的火灾点燃了剩余的甲烷并炸倒了一堵墙，结果使得一个由许多厅室和隧道组成的建筑系统重见天日。考古学家们确信这些遗址曾经属于一位藏有大量的珍奇珠宝和文物的富人。
archaeology-incidents.en: A methane gas explosion has injured Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and several of the crew. The blast set off when a malfunctioning drill overcharged the generators which then caught fire. Before the fire could be contained it ignited some residual metha

origin_endbringers.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
警告：禁用除['concept_psionic_ascension']以外所有飞升路线。

该文明长久以来都一直沉迷于一场将邻近的星球变成荒凉的虚境星球的神秘灾难。如今他们初涉星海，终于得以一探究竟，以及确定是否会有相似的命运降临在自己头上。
origin_endbringers.en:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can fi

behemoth-fury.zh:
我们与自己的生物载体共生共存，但某些至关重要的东西一直虚无缥缈……

更巨大的虚空造物启发了我们，让我们开始了最野心勃勃的工程：培育出一头最强大的太空生物。这种“噬天巨兽”将会是全新的存在，是被雕凿出来而非盲目演化出来的最巅峰的生命形式。

我们的第一项挑战是产出一颗巨大的卵，大到足以孵化出一头史无前例的巨兽。除了其所需的营养外，我们还需要卵壳能吸收环境光、热能，以及将气体处理成补充物质。
behemoth-fury.en:
We exist symbiotically with our biological vessels, yet something vital has always eluded us...

Inspired by the greater voidbornes, we embark on our most ambitious endeavor: birthing the biggest of them all. This "Behemoth" will be something new, an apex life

event-shroud-4199.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你最近对灵督城邦的袭击不合情理。无论以何种身份，继续留在你的领土内工作，在道德和伦理上都站不住脚。我强烈建议你们停止这种毫无意义的敌对行动——但是，无论你们将来作何选择，我都不会留在这里坐以待毙了。”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.
event-shroud-4199.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"Your recent attack upon a Mindwarden Enclave is unconscionable. Working within your territ

cosmogenesis.zh:
众所周知，科学能为进步铺平道路。如果想要发挥出我们真正的潜力，那就别无他法。我们对技术的掌握不言而喻，但还是有太多超出我们理解的事物：失落帝国之道，星神兽之力，还有灵能洞见之谜……

想要一窥现实深层的意义，我们需要一种新的科学、一种新的计算机。突触凝练机正代表通往无限知识之旅最重要的第一步。
cosmogenesis.en: It is an axiom that science paves the way for progress. If we wish to fulfill our true potential, there can be no other path. Our technological mastery is self-evident, but far too much remains beyond our comprehension: the ways of the Fallen Empires, the powe

curators.zh:
您好，星际旅行者，我们是策展人。

我们遵从的古训自万古之前便由星系中的支配力量所制定。我们献身于保存世间所有的知识，来避免星系再次陷入荒蛮与死寂的黑暗时期。

但我们失败了。

我们只留下了很少的幸存者，但相比我们的前辈，我们完成自己神圣使命的决心丝毫没有动摇。我们有意与你分享一些我们的知识……当然，这不是无偿的。
curators.en:
Greetings, star travelers. We are the Curators.

Our ancient order was established eons ago by the various galactic powers in ascendancy at the time. We were dedicated towards the preservation of all knowledge, in an effort to safeguard the galaxy from descend

baol.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员们兴奋地报告称他们在[From.GetName]上发现了一处古代太空文明的遗迹，其似乎于七百万年前定居于这一行星！

尽管这些自称古茹努尔的物种离开[From.GetStarName]星系的原因尚不明确，我们的科学家已经在这颗行星上分离出了一处很有发掘价值的考古遗址。

也许进一步的研究会找到更多线索。
baol.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew are eager to report they have uncovered the remains of an ancient space-faring species on [From.GetName], who appear to have inhabited the planet some seven million years ago!

While it is unclear why this species, who called themselves

event-shroud-2750.zh: 我们的最早期数据集中，有些单元记录了拥有非凡能力的[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——他们能入侵机械和有机体的思想，用意念举起重物，或者表演各种各样的超自然的壮举等等。
event-shroud-2750.en: From our earliest datasets, some of our units have recorded [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wielding extraordinary powers - hacking into the minds of both machines and organics, manipulating objects by internal processing alone, or performing a range of other impr

event-paragon-3100.zh:
刚一进入[From.GetName]恒星系，我们的传感器就发现了来自[event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName]行星的一个微弱信号。

它具有短促而重复的模式，看起来好像是在求救。然而，由于信号太过微弱，我们估计定位出其来源会相当困难。也许到时候就来不及伸出援手了。
event-paragon-3100.en:
On entering the [From.GetName] system our sensors detected a faint signal originating on planet [event_target:exakeides_planet.GetName].

A short and repeating pattern, it appears to be a call for aid. However, given the signal's weakness, we expect that locat

origin_sacred_path.zh: 这些游牧的唯心主义者遵循其祖先圣典的指引，穿梭于一条神圣化的路线。随着技术的进步以及对星系理解的演变，朝圣之旅是否仍将是他们的使命所在？
origin_sacred_path.en: These nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?

origin_storm_chasers.zh:
没有他们不敢面对的挑战，没有他们不愿追逐的线索，也没有他们会视若罔闻的风暴。

从本质上来说，这是一个追求刺激的文明。即有好处也有坏处。
origin_storm_chasers.en:
There is no challenge they will not face, no lead they'll fail to chase - and no storm they will ignore.

At its core, this is a civilization seeking thrills. To its benefit, and to its detriment.

shroudwalker-enclave.zh:
啊哈！一位来访者。欢迎欢迎。

我们是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]。在这个自虚空诞生的舱室里，我们的女巫集会谈论着凡人所费解的力量。我们思索着潜藏梦境中的秘密、探寻着原始灵能的贮藏地、凝视着驱动整个文明的无形齿轮……虚境对于聆听者，揭示良多。

此时此刻，我聆听于你。什么风把你吹来了？你已知否？
shroudwalker-enclave.en:
Ah! A visitor. Welcome.

We are the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Within this void-borne hull, our coven communes with forces incomprehensible to most mortal minds. We contemplate the secrets that lie hidden in dreams, reservoirs of untapped potentia

event-paragon-200.zh:
有人尝试与我们建立通讯。

我们听到了远处湍急的流水、小型飞禽发出呱噪的叫声又扑棱扑棱地飞走。这份通讯似乎来自一个非常繁茂的生物群系。
event-paragon-200.en:
Someone is trying to establish contact with us.

We hear the rush of flowing liquid in the distance, and the squawking and wing-flapping of tiny avians taking flight. The transmission seems to be coming from a thriving biome.

prethoryn-scourge.zh: 我方的几处跟踪站都截获了一种奇怪的亚空间回声。声音来源于其他星系。回声刚开始时较弱，但后来逐渐变强，似乎有什么正在靠近我方星系……
prethoryn-scourge.en: Several of our tracking stations have picked up peculiar subspace echoes coming from somewhere in intergalactic space. The echoes are faint but getting stronger, and they seem to be approaching our galaxy...

event-colony-50.zh:
许多报告说[Root.GetName]有无法解释的地层活动。整个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]都能感受到震动，许多殖民点都因此受损。对地震进行调查时，科学家发现了庞杂的地下洞穴网络。

洞穴最深处栖居的是某种本土原始文明，它们正在挖掘通往地表的隧道！它们的行为可能是由殖民地的活动诱发，但我们无法确定。我们也无法预计它们与殖民者碰面之后会采取何种行动！
event-colony-50.en: There have been many reports of unexplainable seismic disturbances on [Root.GetName]. Tremors can be felt across the [Root.GetPlanetMoon], and many of our settlements have suffered damage. While investigating the earthquakes, our scientists discovered a vast n

event-country-1000.zh:
[Root.GetName]研究部门的首席科学官失踪了。

他们的私人赞助的科研船试验机也不见了。

[Root.Capital.GetName]科学界一片哗然。
event-country-1000.en:
The Head of the [Root.GetName]'s Research Department has gone missing.

Along with their privately-funded, highly experimental prototype Science Ship.

The incident has the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] in an uproar.

event-crime-50.zh: [Root.GetName]的犯罪问题仍然没有得到解决，而现在各种犯罪组织已经在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]扎根落脚。许多地区不是堕落为法外之地，就是彻底沦陷在犯罪组织的掌控之中。
event-crime-50.en: Crime continues to be a problem on [Root.GetName], and an extensive criminal underworld has now taken root on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Some areas have descended into lawlessness or been taken over completely by criminal organizations.

event-nomads-150.zh:
啊，一位熟悉的老对手回到了演播室！但你是否带上了什么新式武器？

我们的观众和星系竞技场都在拭目以待！
event-nomads-150.en:
Ah, a familiar contender returns to the Broadcast! But are you packing any new heat?

Our audience, and the galactic arena await!

unbidden.zh: [extradimensional_system.GetName]星系出现了巨大的空间裂缝！虽然我们还不知道原因，但这似乎是另一个次元的单向传送门。奇怪的飞船从裂缝中蜂拥而出，无论见到什么都大肆攻击。这似乎预告着一场大型进攻宣战的来临。我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
unbidden.en: A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system! We aren't certain what caused it, but the tear acts as some kind of one-way portal from another dimension. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, att

enigmatic-fortress.zh:
我们发现了一些静静漂流在[fortress_system.GetName]恒星系的十分巨大的太空建筑。尽管初步扫描显示它们已经很古老了，但是能量识别特征还是非常强烈。在主体建筑周围还能看到漂浮着的几个较小的建筑，所有这些似乎都是全副武装。

如果我们想要了解这个古代遗迹的真实面目，或许我们需要以武力突破其防御…
enigmatic-fortress.en: We have detected some kind of utterly massive space installation drifting quietly at the edge of the [fortress_system.GetName] system. Although preliminary scans show it to be very old, the structure has an intense power signature. Several smaller structures c

event-syndaw-400.zh: 我们的科学家报告称，在我们的多个研究用超级计算机集群中，中央处理器的时钟周期发生异常增长。奇怪的是，最初减少受影响的单位时钟频率的尝试全部失败了。有人猜想，这种计算能力的激增可以增强我们的研究能力。但是，这也需要适度增加中央处理器的能源消耗。
event-syndaw-400.en: Our scientists report a recent unexpected rise in CPU clock cycles in several of our research-dedicated supercomputer clusters. Oddly enough, initial attempts at reducing clock frequency in affected units have proven unsuccessful. It has been posited that the

mercenary-enclave.zh:
欢迎！[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]向我们的客户提供最尖端的安全服务。我们与许许多多星球签订了民间协约，包括个人安保或执法部门训练。

不过对于我们的高级客户，我们致力于提供最极致的服务。舰队、陆军、军事顾问……你可以有许多用于维系和平的选项。当然，价格合理。
mercenary-enclave.en:
Welcome! [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] offers state of the art security services to our customers. We have civil contracts across multiple worlds, ranging from personal security details to training drills for enforcers.

But for our high profile clients,

origin_here_be_dragons.zh: 自远古以来，这个文明就与一条强大的龙共享同一恒星系。这个神秘生物的行为在冷淡的仁慈和傲慢的漠视之间摇摆不定。随着行星居民迈入星辰大海，这种关系将如何演变还有待观察。
origin_here_be_dragons.en: Since time immemorial, this civilization has shared its star system with a formidable dragon. The mysterious creature's behavior sways between distant benevolence and haughty indifference. How this relationship will evolve as the planet dwellers take to the st

site-site-weathermanipulators-coordinate.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了[From.Planet.GetName]。地表的废墟绵延无尽，显然这颗行星曾经拥有许多庞大的城市中心。这很可能是数百万年前因内特贸易体的公民居住的地方。为什么这些坐标要被安全地存储在一个风暴庇护所里仍需调查。
site-site-weathermanipulators-coordinate.en: One of the three coordinate sets found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to [From.Planet.GetName]. Given the extent of the ruins, it's clear that this planet once boasted many sprawling urban centers. This is likely where the citizens of the Inetian Trad

zroni.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]上存在一座古老的废弃殖民地遗址。从轨道上的观测情况来看，并没有明显的迹象显示发生过灾难导致大量居民丧生或者迫使他们逃离殖民地。如果我们想要找到答案，一场地面调查行动势在必行。
zroni.en: [From.Planet.GetName] contains the remains of an ancient, abandoned colony. From orbit there are no obvious signs of disaster which would have killed the inhabitants or compelled them to flee. If we want answers, an expedition to the surface will be required.

event-situation-2000.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是[capital_scope.GetName]突然关停，城市内的每个光源都被熄灭。而[capital_scope.GetName]的居民所经历的更糟糕：车辆变成了路障，工厂停止运转，医院设备处于无响应的状态。这是一次全球性的突然停电，突如其来，莫名其妙。

当寂静和阴影笼罩着我们的星球时，奇怪的光芒在天空中绽放，将我们的首都恒星系包围在万华镜般的迷雾中。这两个事件无疑是相关的，但我们的[root.GetTechnicianPlural]仍然在抓瞎——是的，字面意义上的抓瞎。
event-situation-2000.en: What our people saw from orbit was [capital_scope.GetName] shutting down, every light source within the city snuffed out at once. What people on [capital_scope.GetName] experienced was much worse: vehicles reduced to road blocks, factories grinding to a halt,

great-khan.zh:
自上古之初以至今日，[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大大小小的部落第一次停下狂热内战，空前团结在一位万汗之汗下。这位统帅以超世之才与坚忍不拔之志，在战士阶级中崭露头角，并最终完成难以置信的统一大业。尽管这些部落不过是由一群狡诈、迷信又好战的物种组成，这位新近加冕的伟大可汗还是赢得了所有[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]部落的忠诚与爱戴。

既然他们已经熄灭内斗的烽火，那[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]便会
great-khan.en: For the first time in recorded history, the warring factions of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have united under a single Great Khan. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has emerged from their warrior caste

pre-ftl-plague.zh:
一种全新的人畜共患疾病已经出现在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上。由于没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。

我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是当这些人受苦的时候，我们真的可以袖手旁观吗？
pre-ftl-plague.en:
A novel zoonotic disease has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Without the medical technology required to combat the infection, the population is quickly succumbing to misery and death.

Our policy is to never interfere with [owner.GetPreFTLLower

the-sentinels.zh: 队员们清理了[Root.GetName] 上的雨林后，无意中有了一个不寻常的发现，在一丛古老枯萎的树林下覆盖着一处[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] 似乎从未涉足的地方，九个巨型雕像，在其下的景物上投下了冰冷而高大的阴影。这些雕像带有羽翼而又通体苍白，散发着来自异世界的气质。它们并不像这颗行星上的任何生命形式。或许它们是依某种早被遗忘的神祗或偶像的形象建造的。
the-sentinels.en: The crew clearing the jungle on [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon an unusual find. Previously obscured deep within a tangle of old withered trees, where it would seem no [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] has ventured before, are nine massive statues, casting dark, ta

trader-enclaves.zh: 雪拉企业不会对任何客户抱有偏见。毕竟我们何德何能去对您的道德准则品头论足呢？
trader-enclaves.en: We do not discriminate against prospective buyers here at XuraCorp. Who are we to judge the morals of your star nation?

event-anomaly-5007.zh: 你好！我们种群自到来后数量上已经翻了四翻，你知道了一定很高兴！刚到达星球时，大家都欢欣雀跃，如今甚至有点狂欢的势头。顺利殖民伯达拉克之后，一些勇敢的拓荒者想前往另一个巨型气态行星，他们让我求求你看看行不行。我们已经看中了一个有前途的候选行星，很适合殖民；而且它就在你们管辖的领域之内。你怎么看，朋友？
event-anomaly-5007.en:
Hello again! You will be pleased to learn that our species has quadrupled in number since we arrived! Many of us were swept up in a festive mood when we made planetfall, and things got a bit frisky to say the least.

After the positive experience we had coloni

event-shroud-11000.zh:
我们知道许多虚境中的声音；他们的回响数量众多无处不在。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在最近的出神中汇报了一个非常独特的实体——繁多的嘈杂渗透到虚境的最中心。

使用足够的灵能能量，我们可以依照踪迹追踪到这个强大的实体，在我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们中称之为[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]。
event-shroud-11000.en:
We know many voices within the Shroud; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a manifold thrum permeating the very center of the Shroud.

With suf

defenders-of-the-galaxy.zh:
我们的星系比看起来更脆弱。危险从四面八方逼近：捕食者潜伏于虚空，海盗盘踞在无主恒星系，傲慢和恐惧也在引发着战争。而那些有能力行动的人却常常保持沉默。

而我们不会袖手旁观。这并非宣称统治，而是承诺守护。通过审慎的行动和共同的目标，我们将确保星系拥有值得守护的未来。
defenders-of-the-galaxy.en:
Our galaxy is more fragile than it appears. Dangers press in from every direction: predators lurking in the void, pirates in forgotten systems, wars born of pride and fear. And too often, those with the power to act remain silent.

We will not stand idle. This

origin_primal_calling.zh:
草叶婆娑，夜静如尖啸。猎户之志，冷锐如星光。

这个文明与荒野有着原始的联系。他们把自己看作是当地各种致命野生动物的管家，现在又把目光投向了苍穹。他们善于管理和牧养动物，这种与动物群的联系是根据他们的思潮发展起来的。而这种联系将如何在星系尺度上演变还有待观察。
origin_primal_calling.en:
The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...

This civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to the

artisan-troupe.zh: 艺术家联盟拒绝回应我们的招呼。
artisan-troupe.en: The Artisan Troupe won't respond to our hails.

dessanu-consonance.zh:
成功了！我们的技术人员移除了位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门的维护机制。

我们将是这亿万年来第一批从我们的星系进入L-星团的人！L-星门刚刚启动，我们就收到了来自另一侧的信号传输。
dessanu-consonance.en:
Success! Our technicians managed to abort the maintenance cycle, and the lockdown has been removed from the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system.

For the first time in eons, the L-Cluster can now be accessed from our galaxy! As soon as the

event-fallen-machine-empire-10.zh: 监护者协议625-1已启动。附带信息：有机文明请注意。在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]人口中普遍检测到生物性弱点。为了确保你们的种族在监护者计划中的可行性，所有主要人口聚集地都需要进行接种。生物注入单位已做好准备，将在正面肯定这条信息后前往你们的空间。等待回应。
event-fallen-machine-empire-10.en: Custodian protocol 625-1 activated. Message follows: Attention, organic civilization. Widespread biological vulnerabilities have been detected in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population. In order to ensure your species' viability for the Custodian Project, all maj

origin_red_giant.zh:
这个文明正站在命运的十字路口：其恒星系中央的红巨星正在持续升温，炙烤着他们的家园。

在找到原因并解决之前，他们是否能适应这恶劣的环境？或选择拥抱这股炙热之力，将那诡异、甚至可能不自然的变化化为己用？
origin_red_giant.en:
This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.

Can they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strang

event-country-200.zh:
几个世纪前，[Root.Capital.GetName]上几个激进的宗教领袖带着狂热的追随者出走，并组建了自己的教派。这些极端分子自称[radical_cult.GetName]，是多年以来多起破坏事件的罪魁祸首。

虽然在现代，他们保持低调克制，但我们最近获悉，他们的许多特工渗透进了我方。这些叛徒将我们的资源秘密转移到了隐藏在[Root.Capital.GetName]的小型星际舰队建造项目中！当他们的背叛行为被揭发时，这些异教徒乘船冲进了轨道，然后逃向了[hijacked_fleet_planet.GetNam
event-country-200.en: Centuries ago, a group of radical priests and their devoted followers on [Root.Capital.GetName] broke away from the established religions to form their own church. These extremists called themselves the [radical_cult.GetName], and have been responsible for man

event-namarian-3.zh:
愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚一直伴你左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们是[contact_speaker_leader.GetName]。我们代表游牧舰队，逐浪者舰队上所有的纳马里安之魂发声。

你不必对我们心存恐惧，我们的舰队无意对天体进行争夺。我们只要求受到尊重，旅程不受到妨碍。
event-namarian-3.en:
Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We are [contact_speaker_leader.GetName]. We speak on behalf of all the Namarian souls aboard the collected ships of the Pursuing Waters, our nomadic fleet.

You have nothing to fear from u

origin_cosmic_dawn.zh: 这不是一个崛起的文明，而是一个被释放的文明。当休眠仓开启，他们醒来时，早已物换星移，故土难寻。但他们的过去并未湮灭，而是埋藏在星系尘土与废墟之下，静候再次被发掘。
origin_cosmic_dawn.en: This civilization did not rise; it was released. As the stasis pods unlocked, they awakened to a world aged beyond recognition. Yet all is not lost. Scattered beneath dust and ruin across the galaxy, their past endures, waiting to be rediscovered.

origin_cybernetic_creed.zh: 这个帝国追求一种神圣的使命，即高尚身体与神圣的义体技术的融合。强化改造便是一种崇拜。
origin_cybernetic_creed.en: This empire pursues a divine calling, the fusion of exalted body and holy cybernetics. Augmentation is worship.

astral-formless.zh:
这个虫洞的另一边似乎把我们带到了……星系的中心？

我们不应该存在于这里，更别说整个恒星系了。也许有一些维度操控在起作用吗？

我们没有太多时间来调查，因为我们正在接收来自一个未知实体的传输信号。
astral-formless.en:
The other side of this wormhole seems to have taken us to... the center of the galaxy?

It should not be possible for us to exist here, let alone an entire system. Is there perhaps some dimensional manipulation at play?

We have little time to investigate, as

event-grand-archive-10000.zh: 我们对[From.GetShipCategoryName]的克隆工作取得了基因突破。将这些生物独特的解剖结构与我们在基因操控方面的专业知识结合起来，或许可以创造出一种独特的变异体。
event-grand-archive-10000.en: Our [From.GetShipCategoryName] cloning efforts have resulted in a genetic breakthrough. It might be possible to combine these creature's unique anatomy with our expertise in gene manipulation to create a unique type of Mutation.

event-country-50.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地获悉，一个繁荣的生物圈并不是[Root.Capital.GetName]独一无二的景色。无论是科学界还是政治圈，都迫切地想去了解整个星系各式各样的外星生命形态。

我们已经开始投入精力对遇到的一切生命形态进行归类，但是我们的异星生物学家强调，我们应当把主要精力放在对可宜居的、能支撑生命的星球的调查。
event-country-50.en:
We already knew without a doubt that a thriving biosphere is not something unique to [Root.Capital.GetName]. Both the scientific community and the public at large are eager to learn more about the various forms of alien life found throughout the galaxy.

Effor

origin_galactic_doorstep.zh: 这一文明在它们的家园星系有一座休眠状态的星门——是潜在的科技优势，抑或是高悬头顶的达摩克里利斯之剑？
origin_galactic_doorstep.en: This civilization has a dormant Gateway in their home system - potential technological benefit, or a looming menace?

site-rubricator-digsite.zh: 在誊录仪已知最后出没的位置我们发现了一颗宜居星球，其表面大部分被——至少我们是这么认为的——某种定居设施覆盖。这些定居设施由许多状若堆垛的高塔组成，甚至从太空中也清晰可见。考古学家们现在迫不及待地想要展开发掘工作以寻找誊录仪。
site-rubricator-digsite.en: At the coordinates for the Rubricator's last known location we have discovered a habitable planet with what we believe may be some form of settlement covering a large portion of its surface. The settlement consists of tall pile-like towers, visible all the way

event-colony-100.zh: 自殖民[Root.GetName]以来，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生物圈异象不断。生态系统十分不稳定，而且生物的进化程度也不符合范式。科学家猜测是有外部的干扰，而猜测已被证实！几个殖民者发现了庞大的地下改造装置，应该有数千年的历史了。装置在改造进程中就失去了动力，使得[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的生物圈处于未完成的现状。只要提供足够的能源，应该就能重启装置。但谁也不知道会发生什么……
event-colony-100.en: Since our initial settlement of [Root.GetName], several anomalies in the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s biosphere have been discovered. The ecosystem is unstable and has not developed according to projected models for a world of this type. Our scientists suspect outsi

event-distar-13080.zh:
我们在[gateway_system.GetName]星系附近发现了一座远古亚空间传送门。它似乎是一系列相似的星系网络站点的一部分，当它们可运作时，将允许使用者近乎瞬间地从星系的一处转移到另一处。

在其初始建成之后的某个时间点，它与网络的其余部分间的连接被切断了。它现在只能指示出一个有效的目的地——一片位于我们星系外的未经探索的星域，其被我们的天文学家命名为L-星团。更耐人寻味的是，这座星门完全是由某种未知设计的微型纳米机器人建造的。

虽然星门散发着微弱的能量特征，但它被故意锁定在某种维护循环中，以防止其被激活
event-distar-13080.en: We have located what we believe could be an ancient subspace Gateway near [gateway_system.GetName]. It appears to have been part of a galaxy-wide network of similar stations which, when operational, allowed for near-instantaneous travel from one part of the ga

event-game-start-1.zh:
在我们掌握超光速航行技术前，[Root.Capital.GetName]派出的一些亚光速探测器以近相对论速度前往临近的星系进行探索。开发探测器的科学家天真地在存储内核中输入了我们文明的敏感信息作为向外星文明的问候。

现在，人们终于意识到这些信息可能被用来对付我们。我们必须趁早追回那些探测器，以免落入那些对我们虎视眈眈的外星生物之手。
event-game-start-1.en: Before we developed faster-than-light travel, several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] at near-relativistic speeds towards nearby systems. The scientists who developed the probes naively included sensitive information abo

infinity-machine.zh:
当[Root.GetName]接近[Root.GetStarName]黑洞时，他们发现自己并非孤身一人。一个巨大的完美球体结构屹立在黑洞事件视界的边缘，反射着被吸入黑暗裂隙的、群星所散发的光芒。

我们没有收到任何来自它的信号，我们发出的信号也没有得到任何回应。它就静静地呆在深渊的边缘。等待着。
infinity-machine.en: As the [Root.GetName] approaches the [Root.GetStarName] black hole they find that they are not alone. At the edge of the event horizon it soars, reflecting light from the stars being drawn into the dark, gaping hole. A gigantic construction in the shape of a p

origin_fruitful.zh: 这个郁郁葱葱的文明与太空生物群形成了独特的协同作用。通过向这些生物提供果实，他们吸引种子传播者来帮助它们进行殖民。
origin_fruitful.en: This verdant civilization has developed a unique synergy with spaceborne fauna. By offering their fruits to these creatures, they entice the seed dispersers to aid their colonization efforts.

origin_synthetic_fertility.zh: 这个物种曾有一个繁荣的社会，但是由于一种新型遗传病让其无法再生育。在灭族的命运面前，人们没有其他的选择，只能寄希望于数字化的救赎。
origin_synthetic_fertility.en: Once a thriving society, a novel genetic disease has left this species unable to reproduce. Running out of options and facing extinction, they place their hope in digital salvation.

event-country-1100.zh:
我们向[Root.Capital.GetName]之上的虚空迈出的第一步并不单单只是受到好奇心或征服欲的驱使，更是一种必要之举。

[Root.Capital.GetName]的生物圈经历了剧烈的变化。科学家们警告大灭绝将很有可能发生，这种周期性的生物灭亡是这个宇宙中行星生物的自然规律。

我们制定了一个研究项目，对象是几颗因重大天文灾害而变得不宜居行星。通过还原这些灾难性事件，我们预期可以避免[Root.Capital.GetName]和[Root.GetSpeciesName]一族重蹈覆辙。
event-country-1100.en:
Our first steps into the void beyond [Root.Capital.GetName] were driven not just by curiosity or conquest but by necessity.

The biosphere of [Root.Capital.GetName] has rapidly changed, with scientists warning of a potential mass extinction event, a cyclical p

event-distar-5054.zh:
一个管状外星实体已经进入了[Root.GetName]的轨道，而毫无预警或解释。它似乎不靠任何引擎或是推进器就能移动，完全无声地在虚空中滑行，其圆柱体不祥地旋转着。

尽管它没有表现出任何敌意，但也并未回应我们的呼叫。我们的军团顾问警告说，它可能会对下面的居民造成严重威胁，并恳求我们动手将它消灭。但我们的科学家则请求研究这一非凡的科技。
event-distar-5054.en:
A tubular alien entity has entered orbit of [Root.GetName], with no warning or explanation. It appears to be moving without engines or thrusters, gliding in complete silence through the void of space, cylinders rotating ominously.

Though it has yet to display

event-first-contact-250.zh: 短暂的冲突之后，我方付出了数人伤亡的极小代价，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]探索船的船员们——我们现在知道他们是[This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass][This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass]物种——向我们的接舷小队投降。我们现在同时扣押了它们的舰船，以及船员作为人质，可以进行审问工作并学习它们的科技。
event-first-contact-250.en: After a brief struggle in which we sustained minimal casualties, the crew of the exploratory vessel of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] - who we now know to be [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetAAnSpeciesClass] [This.ContactCountry.Species.GetClass] species - s

origin_clone_army.zh: 一种寿命短且不能生育的克隆人士兵，在战争方面异常精通，现在他们没有主人，亦不了解自己被设计出来的目的，以及他们那不确定的命运。
origin_clone_army.en: A species of short-lived and infertile soldier clones exceptionally proficient in matters of war, left masterless and alone to question their engineered purpose and uncertain fate.

pre-ftl-ages.zh: 这个文明正逐步迈进全新的科技纪元。
pre-ftl-ages.en: This civilization is progressing to a new technological age.

anomaly-debris-gasgiant-category-temp.zh: 一座巨大的远古船骸围绕[From.GetName]漂浮。
anomaly-debris-gasgiant-category-temp.en: A massive shipwreck of ancient design circles [From.GetName].

event-marauder-1.zh:
数月间，我们零星收到了少量外星佣兵与海盗在我们边境活动的报告。他们自称为[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，并且似乎是一群流放者，来自[marauder_system.GetName]恒星系的拥挤空间站上的一个游牧战士文明。

他们平安无事地路过我们的边境，但警告我们不要冒犯[marauder_system.GetName]。[From.GetSpeciesName]没有所谓的集中政体，但他们有着不同的派系，相互之间不断争斗，并经常攻击相邻的恒星系。鉴于其庞大的成员数量与空间站造船能力，如果他们
event-marauder-1.en: For several months now, we have received scattered reports of small numbers of alien mercenaries and privateers operating on the frontiers of our space. They call themselves the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and are apparently exiles from a nomadic warrior cult

event-marauder-100.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]的弱者们，我们的战士们正准备去进攻你们的星系，要么勇敢的面对他们、要么像懦夫一样躲起来眼睁睁的看着我们的战士抢走你们的财富。

当然了，你们也可以现在就进贡，如果贡品价值足够的话，我们可以考虑不攻击你们……
event-marauder-100.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName] weaklings, our warriors are on their way to plunder your systems. Face them in battle if you can muster the courage, or cower in fear until they have had their fill of your riches.

You can, of course, offer tribute now to spare yourselve

event-operation-3000.zh: 我们已经编纂了一份列表，上面包含对[root.target.GetName]友好的帝国。我们的特工会在这些帝国直接制造裂痕。
event-operation-3000.en: We have compiled a list of those empires who appear friendliest to the [root.target.GetName]. Our operatives will drive a wedge between these empires.

precursor-assistance.zh: 我们从一队独立勘探者处截获的通讯表明，他们最近在[precursor_planet.GetName]发现了与远古先驱文明相关的物品。出于迷茫，他们并没有染指[precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]，因此他们发现的东西现在应该还在原处。
precursor-assistance.en: Intercepted communications from a group of independent prospectors indicate that they recently found something relating to an ancient Precursor civilization on [precursor_planet.GetName]. Superstition compelled them to leave the [precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon

salvager-enclave.zh:
很高兴与您相识！我谨代表[salvager_enclave_country.GetName]，欢迎您莅临鄙邦简陋的星际工坊。

诶呀…我在哪儿都能认出龙骨上的那些东西——制作的很精致。我们有着跟踪星系中飞船设计的习惯，试着同当地风潮保持一致。不过我刚刚讲到哪儿…？

啊，对了：欢迎您！请问我们要如何满足您打捞和回收的需求？
salvager-enclave.en:
Pleased to make your acquaintance! On behalf of the [salvager_enclave_country.GetName], I welcome you to our humble, interstellar workshop.

Say... I'd recognize those keel fixtures anywhere - some fine work. We make a habit of keeping up with what's flying in

anomaly-distar-robo-cat.zh: 探测器发现在[From.GetName]的地表有着异常高的对称性。
anomaly-distar-robo-cat.en: Scanners indicate an unusually high level of symmetry on the surface of [From.GetName].

event-first-contact-1.zh: 我们已成功与[This.System.GetName]星系的神秘外星人建立第一次接触。从今开始至知悉更详细的信息为止，我们将其代称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]。如果他们具有语言，我们必须进行破译才能建立交流。
event-first-contact-1.en: We have made first contact with mysterious aliens in the [This.System.GetName] system. For now, we have code-named them [This.ContactCountry.GetName], until we can find out more about them. If they possess a language, we must decipher it in order to establish

lcluster-gray.zh: [From.GetName]荒芜的地表上传来一道奇特的能源信号。
lcluster-gray.en: A strange energy signature emanates from the barren and lifeless surface of [From.GetName].

origin_scion.zh: 一个失落帝国在数千年间干预了这一文明的发展进程，引领他们走上了失落帝国所选择的道路。
origin_scion.en: A Fallen Empire has meddled in the development of this civilization for thousands of years, guiding them onto a path of their choosing.

event-colony-1.zh: [Root.GetName]表面覆盖有茂盛的植被，巨大的树形植物生长至数百米高。殖民者发现几乎所有的这些植物都有不同程度的迁移能力。森林会缓慢的向养分更充足的区域移动，迁移的周期似乎与[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的运行周期有关。不幸的是，殖民地的基础建设工程会受到极大的阻碍。迁移的植物们会切断供能线路，摧毁建筑和道路。
event-colony-1.en: The surface of [Root.GetName] is covered in lush forests, with massive tree analogues rising hundreds of meters into the air. Interestingly, our colonists have found that nearly all of the flora is mobile to various degrees. Forests stretching for miles will s

event-emperor-150.zh:
结束了！叛乱基本已经被粉碎，而全帝国忠诚的子民们则在欢庆我们的胜利。

现在那些叛徒们已经束手就擒，我们得想想怎么料理他们。我们是要对他们网开一面还是让他们得到应有的惩罚呢？
event-emperor-150.en:
It is done! The rebellion has been utterly crushed, and loyal citizens throughout the Imperium are celebrating our victory.

Now that the traitors have been brought to heel, we must decide how to deal with them. Should we show leniency or are they to be punish

origin_starlit_citadel.zh: 该文明的母星系边缘，一个神秘的传送门赫然耸立，危险的实体从中汨汨涌出。这些入侵者不请自来，让人无处可避，迫使人们只能仰依赖他们最杰出的科技杰作——深空擎天堡。
origin_starlit_citadel.en: A mysterious portal looms at the edge of this civilization's home system, a gateway from which hostile entities emerge in relentless waves. These invasions are as unpredictable as they are inevitable, forcing the people to rely on their greatest technological

pre-ftl-singularity.zh:
[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的探险家在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上发现了一种以前未曾见识过的软体类物种。就其本身而言，这些生物中的每一个都只能勉强算得上是有智慧的。然而，当两个或更多的生物个体通过身体接触结合在一起时，它们会形成一个半意识的节点。理论上，这些节点应该能够在认知能力方面有指数级的增长。

简单地说，[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]的人们偶然发现了一种生物思维机器。假以时日，这一发现可能预示着有机奇点的
pre-ftl-singularity.en: [from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] explorers on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] have discovered a previously unknown species of molluscoid. On its own, each of these creatures barely qualifies as sapient. However, when two or more are joined through physical contac

war-in-heaven.zh: [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]再次君临整片星系的消息似乎没有被别的失落帝国无视。[From.GetSpeciesName]对这一消息的不安尤为强烈。这两位先祖文明是亘古的宿敌，尽管由于某些原因他们的仇恨在漫长的历史中稍有褪色，然而[FirstSleeper.GetName]的突然觉醒点燃了古老的仇恨并激起了对抗行动。[From.GetName]已从沉睡中醒来，他们将以整个星系为战场延续远古的对决。
war-in-heaven.en: The return of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] to the galactic scene has not gone unnoticed by the other Fallen Empires present in our galaxy. The [From.GetSpeciesName] in particular appeared most agitated at the news. It seems that these two proud nations ar

anomaly-distar-lost-cat.zh: 在[From.GetName]的上层大气中发现有东西在移动，好像是一艘舰船在云层中高速穿梭。
anomaly-distar-lost-cat.en: There is movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName], as though a ship was gliding hurriedly through the clouds.

event-central-2.zh: 一个强大的信号从通常被认为是没有生命的星系中心发出，传向星系。没过多久，我们又收到了来自同一地点的信号传输。
event-central-2.en: A powerful signal is bounced through the galaxy from the center, a place often thought to be empty of life. Shortly afterwards, we received a transmission from the very same location.

event-colony-9820.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰停止运转，观测分析子例程汇报了一件怪事。这些入侵者的舰船外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停止生产的型号别无二致。而且，这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的信号交换协议……不过是10年前的版本。
event-colony-9820.en: As the last corvette is rendered inoperable, observation analysis subroutines report something abnormal. The invader ships are similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped producing years ago. Additionally, the ships lack FTL drives and are equi

event-distar-230.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员报告称，在[From.GetName]星系附近发现了腐朽的轨道空间站与多个死寂星球。某个曾殖民于[From.GetName]星系的星际文明似乎很久以前就毁灭了。[ratling_planet_tar.GetName]星球简直就像个垃圾场，上面满是辐射弥漫且锈迹斑斑的建筑废墟，基础设施与载具。未侦测到高等生命的存在。

我们或许可以勘察该星系与邻近星系中的类似星球，来获知更多关于这一失落文明的情报。
event-distar-230.en: The [Root.GetName] crew have reported the presence of decaying orbital stations and multiple tomb worlds near the [From.GetName] system. Whatever interstellar nation once inhabited the [From.GetName] system appears to have collapsed into ruin long ago. [ratlin

event-fircon-1210.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]研究后得知，这位客人扭曲触手的动作其实是一种复杂的语言形式。

于是乎我们沮丧地了解到这个生物正因为衣不蔽体而感到尴尬，正在反复地请求合适的衣物以遮蔽其赤裸的躯体。

在得体地遮蔽躯体后，我们的研究者建造了一台多肢机器以便与这个生物交流。
event-fircon-1210.en:
Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] has determined the wriggling tentacle motions of our guest are a form of sophisticated sign language.

To our dismay, we thus learned that the creature is embarrassed about its lack of clothing and has been repeatedly asking for

event-subject-1100.zh:
我们注意到一些舰队指挥官和领袖之间的分歧和争论有所增加。如果[admiral_democracy.GetName]认为我们应该干点什么，可以肯定[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]将对着干。

起初，这似乎只是对手之间的良性竞争，但最近气氛变得越来越令人不快，充满火药味，我们看到他们的同僚也开始站队了。
event-subject-1100.en: We have seen a rise in disagreements and arguing between some of our commanders and leaders. If [admiral_democracy.GetName] thinks we should go through with something, you can be sure that [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] will argue that we should do the opposite.

origin_doomsday.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
这一文明的母星高度不稳定，走向爆炸只是时间问题。他们唯一的希望是在为时太晚前在其他地方寻觅到避难之处。
origin_doomsday.en: This civilization's homeworld is highly unstable, and it is only a matter of time before it explodes. Their only hope is to seek refuge elsewhere before it is too late.

event-galcom-62.zh: 根据[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]宪章第19条C款，只有一个会员国可以主办泛星系贸易市场。因此，市场在[galactic_market_station_system.GetName]星系的总部已经被拆除。最后一位交易员在今天不情愿地放弃了他们的岗位，哀叹这一戏剧性的——在他们看来——不必要的步骤对星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的贸易董事会已提出陈词对该事态表示
event-galcom-62.en: According to article 19C of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s charter, only a member state may host the Galactic Market. As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The

project-whisperers-in-the-void-fc-projec.zh:
我们知道许多虚境中的声音；他们的回响数量众多无处不在。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在最近的出神中汇报了一个非常独特的实体——繁多的嘈杂渗透到虚境的最中心。

使用足够的灵能能量，我们可以依照踪迹追踪到这个强大的实体，在我们的[GetTelepathPlural]们中称之为[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]。
project-whisperers-in-the-void-fc-projec.en:
We know many voices within the Shroud; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a manifold thrum permeating the very center of the Shroud.

With suf

event-ancrel-6150.zh: 最近的调查显示，[From.GetName]被包围在了一个拥有难以置信的强度并反射所有探测手段的护盾之中。这个星球护盾似乎是从这颗星球附近的卫星中产生的。
event-ancrel-6150.en: As confirmed by its recent survey, [From.GetName] is surrounded by an incredibly strong energy field that deflects all attempts to scan it. The field appears to be generated from the planet's nearby moon.

event-distar-5000.zh:
[From.GetName]核心内部有什么东西开始稳定地脉动，定期使地面产生轻微的颤动。那像是心跳一般的声音几乎令人感到宽慰。

但我们担心那声音可能变得越来越大。地质学家正在密切监测星球，留意危险的地质运动。
event-distar-5000.en:
Something deep within the core of [From.GetName] has begun to pulsate at a steady pace, sending gentle ripples through the ground at regular intervals. It gives off a soft almost soothing sound, similar to that of a heart beating.

Concerns have been raised, h

event-fircon-6000.zh:
即使在会面之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然拒绝接受外星人存在的事实。他们宣称我们并非星际访客，而是穴居人，想要从地上的某个洞穴里面钻出来占领行星的地面。他们的行星，[non_believers_planet.GetName]，被认为是中空的，并且他们坚信我们使用自己的宇宙飞船在中央的空穴中飞来飞去。

这些令人困惑的信仰阻碍了我们的外交工作。任何我们说的或者做的都遭到了彻底的怀疑。
event-fircon-6000.en: Even after meeting us, the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to accept the existence of extraterrestrial life. They claim we're not interstellar visitors, but subterranean dwellers who climbed to the planet's surface through a hole in the gro

event-first-contact-480.zh: 从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号中读取的信息让我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]及其兴奋。尽管这其中没有一个音节是我们能够识别的，但不可否认的是，声音本身是有韵律的，而且听起来莫名地令人感到舒缓。虽然我们无法确定，但[Owner.GetLinguists]坚信这是一首诗歌，对方是在友善地回应我们。
event-first-contact-480.en: The readings from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] signals have caused our [Owner.GetLinguists] a great deal of excitement. While not a single syllable is intelligible, the sounds themselves are undeniably rhythmical, and indeed curiously soothing. Although w

event-grand-archive-3010.zh:
我们的一艘科研船在[cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName]调查一颗奇怪的小行星时失去了联系。

在他们最后失踪的地点探测到了微弱的应急信号，我如果要找回这艘失踪的舰船就需要进一步调查。
event-grand-archive-3010.en:
Contact has been lost with our Science Ship while investigating a strange asteroid in [cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName].

We are detecting weak emergency signals from their last known location, and should investigate further if we intend to recover

origin_imperial_vassal.zh: 第一次飞出母星的经历是一段痛苦的回忆，一眨眼的功夫，我们就惨遭征服并跪倒在其脚下。不过现在我们终于得以展望未来，一个不必处在他国阴影之下的未来。
origin_imperial_vassal.en: Our first endeavor beyond our home planet was a painful one, suddenly and brutally subjected to the whims of a foreign galactic power. Now we look towards a future in which we no longer live in the shadow of another empire.

site-site-ice-trauma.zh: [from.planet.GetName]上辽阔的冰冻荒原曾一度遍布汪洋，水面之下处处是深海火山峡谷。尽管其环境已经无法继续支持生命，我们还是在一处靠近地表的冰封堑道内发现了一些年代久远的水下定居点。
site-site-ice-trauma.en: The vast, frozen wastelands of [from.planet.GetName] were once seas, spread atop an abundance of deep volcanic canyons. Though the environment is no longer capable of supporting life, we have detected the ruins of ancient submarine settlements in icebound tren

event-ancrel-6098.zh: 在[tomb_planet.GetName]——我们领土内一颗没有生命存在的[tomb_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地表上，一些古老的建筑物隐藏在某种隐形能量场之下。偶然有一颗小行星在撞击[tomb_planet.GetPlanetMoon]时发生了偏转并被旁经的货船监控到，我们这才发现了它的存在。
event-ancrel-6098.en: A chameleon energy field of some sort concealing an ancient structure was recently exposed on the surface of [tomb_planet.GetName], a lifeless [tomb_planet.GetPlanetMoon] inside our space. Only a chance asteroid impact which was deflected off the field while t

event-anomaly-142.zh: 在发现神秘的未叙尊者的小行星古龛之后，首席科学官认为可能还有其他关于我们——或者自以为是我们——供奉的古神宫殿存在于附近的恒星系中。
event-anomaly-142.en: After the discovery of the mysterious asteroid-shrine to the Untold, top scientists have proposed that there may be additional shrines dedicated to our - or what we believed was only our - pantheon, in neighboring systems.

event-anomaly-3095.zh:
一群自称为“星际绑架者”的海盗关押了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]私人运输飞船的船员。

我们想在海盗们提出条件之前就救出他们。
event-anomaly-3095.en:
A band of pirates calling themselves the "Ransomeers" have kidnapped the crew of a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] private transport vessel.

We intend to free them before the pirates can make any demands.

event-country-250.zh:
秋菊号的姐妹船风信子号，本应该在我们的地球祖先抵达这个星团后三年到达这里。根据抵达时的发展状况，他们的任务是支援我们的殖民地或建立新的殖民地。

若该飞船确实已从地球出发，那就说明她未能与[Root.Capital.GetName]取得联系。如果风信子号进入了我们周边的星系，那么我们最好搜索一下附近星系并寻找其踪迹。
event-country-250.en: We have found no traces of the four arkships that passed through the wormhole before the Chrysanthemum arrived at [Root.Capital.GetName]. One ship, the Hyacinth, was scheduled to make the passage after us, and the Chrysanthemum's long-range sensors reported a

event-emperor-50.zh:
创建一支防卫星海帝国的无敌舰队已经被签署成为法令。新建立的帝国海军将从整个帝国的成员国中征召船员和后勤队伍，但其大部分军官仍由[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]组成。

这一舰队直接听令于[gal_emperor.GetName]，所有的新兵将被要求宣誓效忠[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]。
event-emperor-50.en: The creation of a grand fleet for the defense of the Galactic Imperium has been signed into law. This new Imperial Armada will conscript its ship crews and support personnel from within all the members of the Imperium, but a majority of its officer corps will

event-federations-10400.zh:
星海共同体的特使们撰写了一封措辞强烈的文章，声称[Root.GetName]违反了星系法，并警告我们不遵守星系法可能带来的严重后果。

我们是否要改变自己的政策，以迎合这一要求？
event-federations-10400.en:
Envoys from the Galactic Community have compiled a list of articles that the [Root.GetName] are in violation of, and warn of possible consequences should we not make ourselves in alignment with Galactic Law.

Should we change our policies and accede to their d

event-nomads-1590.zh:
最近，塞拉伦涅的脑海中开始浮现出模糊的回忆，那是一种她也无法解释的熟悉感。据她描述，方舟号上的某些走廊让她觉得似曾相识，而星图中的某些星象布局也勾起了一种出人意料的联结感。

“我不明白为什么这些地方会吸引我，但我标注出了那些感觉……重要的地方。如果我们前往那里，或许能找回更多的记忆。”

她标出了几处与她深藏的记忆产生共鸣的坐标——这些地点本身可能也值得调查。
event-nomads-1590.en: Lately, faint recollections have begun returning to Seralune, a sense of familiarity she cannot explain. She reports that certain corridors of the Arkship feel as though she has walked them before, and star patterns in our charts evoke an unexpected sense of c

event-situation-150.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民者汇报了一个奇怪的现象：在他们一个主要殖民定居点外，“雪”开始聚集起来。

好吧，“雪”只是他们用来描述这种物质的代名词。显而易见的是这肯定不是真正的雪，因为[Root.GetName]可是一颗沙漠星球，即使在两极地区温度也极少降到冰点以下。而且，也没有任何人目击到这些东西从天而降。不过，初步的扫描显示这种物质确实主要由冰冻的水构成，至于为什么不会融化仍不清楚。我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]希望能进一步研究它的性质，而另一些人则认为它会带来危险，
event-situation-150.en:
Our colonists on [Root.GetName] report a strange phenomenon: snow has begun gathering outside of one of their main colonial settlements.

Well, "snow" is the term they have used to describe it, anyway. It would seem implausible that it is real snow, given that

origin_forever_cruise.zh: 这艘永恒巡游舰穿梭于星辰之间，专为追逐奇观与极致体验而生。旅客们只要安坐于恒星观测甲板的日光躺椅上，便能亲眼见证星云在真空中孕育与诞生的全过程。舰上配属的专职船员与服务系统昼夜运转，迎合着每一位乘客一切心血来潮的诉求。
origin_forever_cruise.en: The Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.

origin_heirs_of_the_khan.zh: 这个部族曾是汗国的顺位继承人，却因背叛而被推翻。被他们视为亲人的人背叛后，他们现在以游牧民的身份游荡在超空间航道上，积蓄力量，以求有朝一日报仇雪恨。
origin_heirs_of_the_khan.en: Once the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

anomaly-time-loop-world.zh: 出于未知的原因，[Root.GetName]笼罩在一道不可穿透的护盾内，而且护盾正在开裂。
anomaly-time-loop-world.en: For reasons unknown [Root.GetName] has been enclosed within an impenetrable shield and the shield is cracking.

event-distar-211.zh:
一个传奇的生物游动于[Root.GetStarName]星系的气态巨行星之间，它比已知的任何缇扬奇都要大，简直就是一头无比巨大的太空巨鲸。这个族母的触须比[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的战列舰还要长，其皮肤闪着亮光，在黑暗的太空中异常的耀眼。她的历史十分悠久，身上的伤疤说明她已历经无数次战斗。

族母的背上有个巨大的未爆炸的鱼雷。星系中的破碎舰船残骸提醒着我们不要轻易靠近她，否则必会被这巨物毁灭。
event-distar-211.en: A creature of legend swims languorously between the gas giants in the [Root.GetStarName] system. Larger than any Tiyanki on record - indeed, larger than any of our projections could have allowed for, a space whale of impossible proportions seems to have made h

event-fircon-5000.zh:
[From.GetName]少了几颗星球。

所有的计算都表明应该还有几个天体存在，但在这个星系中却找不到它们的踪迹。传感器已经重新校准，数字也重新核对过，但得出的结论被现实所推翻。我们已经在自己的星图上标记出了失踪小行星的位置。

或许再靠近些扫描这个星系会得到更多信息。
event-fircon-5000.en:
[From.GetName] is missing planets.

All calculations point to the existence of several more celestial bodies, yet they are nowhere to be found in the system. Sensors have been recalibrated and numbers rechecked, but the theory stands disproven by reality. We h

event-first-contact-1120.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]停靠在我们舰队边上，广播着重复的信号。

翻译这些信息颇具挑战，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们是在邀请我们派出一位代表去往他们的舰船上参加一场持续多日的文化交流活动。
event-first-contact-1120.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] drew alongside our fleet, broadcasting a repeating signal.

It was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange

pre-ftl-new-world-order.zh:
在[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上出现了一位魅力非凡的领袖，宣扬激进的行星统一主义。现在，只有一小群装备相对落后的叛军在反对多数派统治。

我们的政策是永远不去干涉[owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球，但是我们真的能够什么都不做，只在一边看着吗？
pre-ftl-new-world-order.en:
Preaching a radical doctrine of planetary unification, a charismatic leader has appeared on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Now, only a small and relatively ill-equipped band of rebels stands opposed to majoritarian rule.

Our policy is to never interfere

rift-crystal.zh:
在裂隙的另一边有什么东西控制住了球体使我们的回收装置失效了。

我们收到的第一批数据难以理解，但随后的传输让这些信息慢慢拼凑到了一起。我们推测，在这条裂缝的另一边，时间的流动要快得多，事实上，我们正在接收来自裂缝另一边的实时通信。

结果加是每天处理大约一个单词。以下是我们目前收到的报告。

“我们观测……”

“道歉……方法……恶劣……”

“紧急……”

“理解……”

这些简短的信息几被严重的噪音和无法解读的数据几乎淹没了。

谁都不知道裂隙探球的[Explorer.GetCrew]究竟处于何等的危险之中。
rift-crystal.en:
Something on the far side of the Rift has taken hold of the Sphere and disabled our retraction device.

The first parcels of data we received were unintelligible, but subsequent transfers are slowly piecing these messages together. We speculate the flow of tim

rift-tower.zh:
到达不久后，我们着陆在一个岩石基座上，它的尺寸恰好与裂隙探球相合。事实上，这个位置与我们的需求吻合到说是巧合也未免太勉强了。

一片广阔而灿烂的天空在我们的四面八方伸展开去。初步扫描显示，我们正坐在一座巨大的塔顶，塔底被涌动的云层挡住了视线。

在底座的边缘有一位孤独的生物。它穿着一件破烂的、满是灰尘的长袍，显然在等着迎接我们。
rift-tower.en:
Soon after arrival, we touched down on a stone pedestal that conforms perfectly to the dimensions of the Rift Sphere. In fact, the location is so obviously suited to our needs that the idea of it being a coincidence has been rejected out of hand.

In all direc

site-site-ancient-robot-world.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系笼罩着诡异的光芒。[Root.GetName]突然出现在星系的某个区域，我们确信这里此前数代人甚至数千年间从未被星系文明造访过。

但等一下，我们的传感器发现了一个能量信号！该信号主要集中在星系中的第一颗行星上，这颗行星似乎不太可能支持生命，毕竟它距离中子星如此接近。但好像还有其他信号正在移动。它们直奔[Root.GetName]而去，武器随时准备开火！
site-site-ancient-robot-world.en:
An eerie glow lies over the [From.GetName] system. The [Root.GetName] has emerged in a sector of the galaxy surely not visited by any galactic civilization for generations - for millennia... if ever.

But wait - our sensors are reporting energy signatures! Mos

site-site-grand-herald.zh: 即使不依靠仪器，也可以很容易地看到[From.Planet.GetName]上存在着庞大的城市集群遗迹。显然，曾有一个高度发达的文明居住在那里，但现在已检测不到生命迹象，也不能收到符合技术社会特征的电磁信号。这颗行星似乎陷入了死寂。我们需要着陆去了解更多情况。
site-site-grand-herald.en: Even without instruments, one can readily see the remains of vast conurbations down on [From.Planet.GetName]. Clearly a highly advanced civilization once dwelt there, but today there are no life signs nor electromagnetic signals consistent with a technological

anomaly-ast-debris-field-1-cat-2.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
anomaly-ast-debris-field-1-cat-2.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

anomaly-distar-phase-cat.zh: [From.GetName]附近有非常奇特的能源信号，好像整个星球都在时隐时现一样。
anomaly-distar-phase-cat.en: Enigmatic energy readings surround [From.GetName], as though the entire planet is wavering in and out of existence.

astral-rift-in-space.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的细缝发生了失稳，打开了一道通往其他时空的裂隙。

我们应当小心应对。
astral-rift-in-space.en:
The dimensional scar in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system has destabilized, opening a rift into another place and time.

We should approach with caution.

event-colony-9050.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的地质勘探揭示了这颗行星远比我们之前预想的更加富有矿藏。在调节了我们的传感器以后它便可以扫描更深的地下，发现了许多大有前景的矿场。我们应该委派更多的人力物力进行勘探，或许可以发现更深处的有用矿脉。
event-colony-9050.en: Geological surveys on [Root.GetName] have revealed that the planet is richer in minerals than we thought. After calibrating our sensors to penetrate deeper into the ground, we have discovered several promising mining sites. Should we direct additional resource

event-custodian-499.zh:
终于，星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，我们被任命为星海共同体监管人。

作为同侪之首，我们负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。我们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
event-custodian-499.en:
At last, the Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In an official ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, we were appointed Custodians of the Galactic Community.

As the first among equals, we have been

event-first-contact-375.zh:
这种噪音——听起来杂糅着恐怖的轰鸣声和金属刮擦的声音——喧嚣了数秒钟，又以一声兀然的嚎叫般的噪音结尾，让在场的所有人都打了个寒颤。

正当[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]觉得这可怕的声音沉寂下去以后，它们又变本加厉地开始了。[This.Leader.GetSheHe]强忍着不适关闭了接收器。[This.Leader.GetSheHeCap]转向了聚在一起的官员们，他们中的一些甚至吓得躲到了椅背后面。
“豁，好家伙……”[This.Leader.GetSheHe]无
event-first-contact-375.en:
The noises - a mixture of threatening booming noises and what sounds like the grinding of metal on metal - continued unabated for several minutes, punctuated occasionally by a howling noise that sent a chill through everyone who heard it.

Just as [This.Owner.

event-grand-archive-4135.zh:
随着我们继续在这个星球上净化那些肮脏的异星渣滓，我们的[GetCollectionRewardCategory]战利品收集愈发充盈。

希望这些展品能成为这个污秽星系的残骸，进一步激励我们履行誓言。
event-grand-archive-4135.en:
As we continue our efforts to cleanse this world of filthy xeno scum, our collection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trophies has grown.

May these exhibits serve as the carcass of this contaminated galaxy and further inspire us in our sworn mission.

event-grand-archive-6005.zh:
我们在[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]内探测到了一个微弱的信号。基于初步的破译结果，我们相信这是某个失踪已久的海盗珍宝藏库。

尽管要费很多功夫，但相信我们能够发掘出其中的秘密。
event-grand-archive-6005.en:
We have detected a faint signal from somewhere on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]. Based on the rudimentary cryptography, we believe this to be from a long-lost pirate's Treasure Trove.

It will take some effort, but we're confident we would be ab

origin_riftworld.zh: 一道巨大的时空裂隙高悬于该文明母星的穹顶。在研究这一现象近千年后，最近的星舰科技进展使其终于可以靠近他，并且发掘潜藏其中的秘密。
origin_riftworld.en: A massive rift in space and time looms near this civilization's homeworld. After studying the phenomenon for millennia, recent advances in starship technology will allow them to finally reach out and discover what secrets it might hold.

origin_star_slingshot.zh: 曾几何时，该文明的天空短暂地被流星所照亮，紧接着就陷入了长久的黑暗。此后他们试图冲出天际以寻求答案，并在第一次太空征程中发现了一座休眠中（并且早已被遗弃）的量子弹弓单阵列。
origin_star_slingshot.en: Once, the skies above this civilization were illuminated by shooting stars; then came a long season of darkness. Taking to the heavens in search of answers, the first offworld explorers discovered a dormant (and long abandoned) Quantum Catapult Single Array.

rift-microverse.zh:
在球体穿过裂隙时，我们经历了一阵剧烈的加速。

这个宇宙的巨大引力把我们拉了进去。在经历了一段不舒服又危险的旅程后，我们发现自己漂浮在一个密集的星系群中，每一个星系都在我们球体有限的传感器范围内。据我们所知，这似乎构成了整个宇宙。

初步报告还指出这里的暗物质的含量很高；更重要的是，质量还在不断增加。直接的结果是，随着时间的推移，引力正在增强。
rift-microverse.en:
As our Sphere passed through the rift, we experienced a wild burst of acceleration.

The tremendous gravity of this universe was pulling us in. After an uncomfortable and dangerous ride, we found ourselves floating within a dense cluster of star systems, every

shroud-tunnels.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中潜藏着什么东西：从时空织构中裂出的一个隐秘通道，它的视界泛着灵能的涟漪。探测器的数据飘忽不定，我们的科研船的船员报告了奇怪的干扰：内心深处藏着疯狂的幻境，一种被持续监视的感觉，断断续续的幻觉……

尽管我们很可惜地缺乏有效的遥测手段，但似乎很显然，我们偶然发现了一条通向未知事物的隧道。这是一条危险的路径，但回报可能非常丰厚；在隧道的另一端则连接着星系中一个非常遥远的角落。
shroud-tunnels.en: Something waits in the [From.GetName] system: a veiled passage, cut from the fabric of spacetime, its horizon rippling with psionic energy. Sensor data is erratic, and the crew of our science vessel reports strange disturbances: wildly visceral dreamlike visio

site-site-lesser-messenger.zh: 对[From.Planet.GetName]详细的调查揭示了一些属于曾经遍布整个行星的文明的微弱信号。
site-site-lesser-messenger.en: A closer look at [From.Planet.GetName] shows small signs of a civilization that once populated the planet.

event-cara-333.zh: 行商联盟欢迎您光临绰尔的罗盘，这里是星际行商的起源地。您没有听错。
event-cara-333.en: The Caravansary Caravan Coalition welcomes you to Chor's Compass, ancestral home of disparate galactic caravans and gambling. You heard that right.

event-cstorms-1310.zh:
我们从[This.GetName]星系接收到了一些奇怪的报告。显然，上一场在该星域肆虐的宇宙风暴把一艘不知来处的舰船卷了出来。这艘船没有呼号，它不知怎么地穿过了暴风雨，仿佛完全没受周围风暴的影响。

这艘船没有回应我们的呼叫，风暴消散后，它也消失得无影无踪了。这可能是由于风暴对仪器的干扰，但是肉眼观测却毋庸置疑地表明了真相。

这其中可能潜藏着极为先进的科技，还是说发生了某些不祥的事情？我们会时刻盯着这艘神秘舰船，直到它再次出现。
event-cstorms-1310.en: We are receiving strange reports from the [This.GetName] system. Apparently, the last cosmic storm raging in that sector revealed a ship of unknown origin. Bearing no call sign, it somehow cruised through the tempest as if entirely unaffected by the surroundin

event-infernals-10.zh:
长期以来，我们认为[capital_star.GetName]是一颗典型红巨星，但近期分析显示，其体积和辐射排放持续增长，已对气候产生明显影响，导致人口日益恐慌。

当前趋势毫无停止迹象，为了我们物种的存续，必须查明这一现象的成因。
event-infernals-10.en: We have long thought of [capital_star.GetName] as a typical red giant, but recent analysis indicates that its size and radiation emissions are increasing. These changes are already having a measurable effect on our climate and the population is growing alarmed

event-nomads-9010.zh:
风信子号的远程接收器在“尤利西斯计划”的紧急频率上截获了一段广播。

这个信号非常古老——至少有一个世纪之久——但信息十分清晰。尤利西斯计划的第五艘“秋菊号”在失散中幸存了下来。殖民者们发现了一个世界，他们将其命名为“联合星”。

广播不断重复着：“秋菊号殖民地呼叫所有尤利西斯计划的船只。我们已在一个宜居世界登陆。这颗星球非常美丽。我们正在这里建设新的家园。回家吧。”

从这里无法确定信号的源头，但用于传输该信号的中继浮标应该是可追踪的。对附近星系进行勘测或许能找到其中一个。
event-nomads-9010.en:
The Hyacinth's long-range receivers have intercepted a broadcast on Ulysses Initiative emergency frequencies.

The signal is old - at least a century - but the message is clear. The Chrysanthemum, the fifth Ulysses Initiative arkship, survived the scattering.

event-shroud-12000.zh:
我们的通讯阵列被一阵难以理解的信号狂潮淹没。在这片混沌中，一个声音开始穿透而出。

终于，你来了。不算准时，但也不算太迟。无需畏惧，我能看穿这个被我们称为现实的物质牢笼的狭隘边界。祭品已然献上，我的道路清晰可见。
event-shroud-12000.en:
An incomprehensible flurry of signals floods our communications array. Amid the chaos, a single voice begins to pierce through.

At last, you've come. Not punctual, but not too late either. Fear not, I see beyond the narrow bounds of this physical prison we ca

event-uplift-6000.zh:
[Root.GetName]发现有个体型智慧生命居住在[from.GetName]。考虑到缺乏共生智能的指导，这种[presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass]物种已经达到了对环境的显著控制程度。

我们会继续密切关注这种生物的发展，也许有一天将其并入我们。这些生物的出现预示着[from.GetName]觉醒的潜质。
event-uplift-6000.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered individualistic, presapient life dwelling on [from.GetName]. This [presapient_species.GetSpeciesClass] species has achieved a remarkable degree of mastery over its environment already, considering the lack of a Mutualistic Int

event-utopia-80.zh:
我们已开始着手庞大的科学枢纽的建设。基座已就位，主轴已准备。对突破性科技的允诺以及对大胆设想的超越都将等待着我们。路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。

宇宙无尽的谜团最终都能被我们所掌控吗？
event-utopia-80.en: We have now begun the massive undertaking of constructing a Science Nexus. The foundation is in place and preparations are underway to add the main hub. The promise of new groundbreaking technologies and the realization of ideas beyond our wildest imaginations

gray-tempest.zh:
我们的技术人员设法解除了[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]附近的L-星门的锁定，但刚刚与L-星团建立了永久连接，我们就侦测到一波巨大的亚空间波动！我们设法限制这一潜在的侵略者使用我们的星门，同时确保我们自己仍可使用。

不幸的是，这一波动被导向了星系中的其它L-星门。由纳米机器组成的奇怪舰船正从这些完全启动的星门中涌出，攻击目所能及的一切！

与这些机器进行沟通的尝试全都失败了。在它们通过L-星门后，我们侦测到来自L-星团的一个不断重复的亚空间信号传输。
gray-tempest.en: Our technicians managed to lift the lockdown from the L-Gate near [candidate_gateway_system.GetName], but as soon as a permanent link was established to the L-Cluster, a massive incoming subspace surge was detected! We were able to restrict this potential inva

site-site-tiyanki-graveyard.zh: 整个[From.Planet.GetName]的地表遍布死亡缇扬奇的遗骸。我们的传感器没有检测到生命的信号，然而这些尸体仍然在不停地蠕动，仿佛有什么看不见的力在驱动这些尸体一样。
site-site-tiyanki-graveyard.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered in the remains of dead Tiyanki. Our sensors detect no signs of life, and yet the corpses still writhe and squirm, as if animated by some inscrutable force.

stellar-devourer.zh: [Root.GetName]驶入[From.GetName]恒星系时，发现这里似乎有些不合常理。这里的恒星，曾经被标记为一颗普通的矮星，现在似乎发生了萎缩，其质量正在以惊人的速度减少，恒星系内的行星随之进入了冰河时代。
stellar-devourer.en: As the [Root.GetName] enters the [From.GetName] system something seems awry. The sun, previously registered as an ordinary dwarf star, appears to have shrunk, having lost mass at an alarming rate. The planets in the system have as a result recently entered ice

the-oracle.zh:
队员们清理了[Root.GetName]上的雨林后，有了惊人的发现——在丛林的深处，茂密的植被覆盖下有一座巨大的外星空间站。他们的建筑学令人震惊，建造技术远远领先于我们，简直是一件艺术品。

空间站似乎是坠落在行星表面，多亏其非同寻常的防护机能才挺过了撞击，我们的科学家迫切想要调查这个空间站。遗憾的是如果进行考古发掘，则在工作完成前我们将无法利用这块土地。
the-oracle.en: The crew clearing the jungle on [Root.GetName] has made a spectacular discovery - deep within the forest, overgrown and obscured by the lush plant life is a colossal alien space station. Architecturally stunning and built with technology far superior to our ow

event-action-1.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与[From.From.GetName]建立了联络。现在可以开启交流频道，所有的敌对行为都被终止了。
event-action-1.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the [From.From.GetName]. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities have been terminated.

event-action-150.zh: 我们向帝国屈服，我们别无选择了……
event-action-150.en: We yield to the Imperium. You have left us little choice...

event-colony-150.zh: [Root.GetName]殖民者发起的地质勘探发现了位于山脉内部的巨型避难所。所有证据都指出这个辐射避难所的建造者就是在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]发起古代核战的种群。避难所已封闭了数个世纪，但勘探仪器显示内部发出了微弱的信号。科学家们迫不及待想打开避难所大门，看看后面藏着什么。
event-colony-150.en: Geological surveys conducted by our colonists on [Root.GetName] have revealed a massive vault buried deep inside a mountain range. All evidence points towards this being some kind of fallout shelter built by the same species that perished in the [Root.GetPlane

event-emperor-499.zh:
这是崭新秩序的黎明。腐朽的星海共同体已经被解散，取而代之的是[Root.GetGalEmpireName]的崛起。在宣布我们对这一新的泛星系政权有无可置疑的地位之后，我们现在又被称为[Root.GetName]。

在一个面向全星系广播的极具奢华的加冕仪式上，在[Root.Capital.GetName]，[ruler.GetRegnalName]被加冕为[Root.GetRulerTitle]，于是一个新的帝国王朝开始了。

[Root.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！
event-emperor-499.en:
It is the dawn of a New Order. The old Galactic Community has been dismantled, and in its place the [Root.GetGalEmpireName] has risen. After claiming our rightful place on the throne of this new pan galactic state, we are now known as the [Root.GetName].

In a

event-first-contact-200.zh: 我们成功骇进了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的网络系统，并获取了他们数据库的权限一段时间。尽管我们利用权限进行操作没有持续多久，我们依然对大批量的数据进行了拷贝并且希望——它不仅能帮助我们迅速破解对方的语言，也能评估对方的科技水准。
event-first-contact-200.en: We were successfully able to hack into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and gained access to their databanks for a time. Although our period of access was brief, we were able to make copies of a considerable body of data that should - h

event-operation-2000.zh: 一小队精挑细选的特工在经过严密伪装之后出发前往[target.owner.GetName]境内。每一个人都会装作一名求职者。一部分人将会携带推荐信，找和关键设施运营相关的工作；其他人则要在背地里试试运气。
event-operation-2000.en: A small and select group of operatives has departed for the [target.owner.GetName] under tight aliases. Each will pose as a worker seeking employment. Some are carrying statements of recommendation and will seek work close to key facilities; others will try th

event-utopia-2000.zh:
我们现在准备开始这项史诗工程，环绕[From.From.GetName]星系的恒星来建造未来环形世界的初始框架。

这个框架所需的资源与矿物是史无前例的，我们成百上千最优秀的工程师准备好开始拆解恒星系内的行星，将这些物质用于环形世界建造。
event-utopia-2000.en:
We are now ready to begin the colossal task of building the initial frame of our future Ring World around the primary star of the [From.From.GetName] system.

The amount of resources and materials required to build this skeletal frame will be immense, and hund

event-utopia-4000.zh: 掌控恒星的能量一直是[Root.GetAdj]工程师们的梦想，从粗劣的燃烧到拙劣地模仿恒星聚变，而现在我们要实现这个梦想。在[From.From.GetName]星系坐落着我们的脚手架，而我们即将在那建造戴森球，将[From.From.GetName]包裹并独占恒星强大的能量。
event-utopia-4000.en: Harnessing the power of the stars has been a dream of [Root.GetAdj] engineers throughout history - from crude combustion to the pale imitation of solar fusion - and we now stand ready to realize this dream. In the [From.From.GetName] system sits the scaffold u

event-utopia-4100.zh:
群星的光芒暗淡，虚空的黑暗消失，只有我们学会超越光速之后，我们才知道光揭示的只是真相的一角。

今天我们将终结我们的黑朦，我们准备在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系建造的哨兵阵列将成为坚实的全景监狱，我们的双眼将紧盯着每一颗恒星。
event-utopia-4100.en:
The light of suns blinds and the darkness of the void hides; only when we learned to travel faster than light did we learn just how little the light reveals.

Today, we begin to end this amaurosis of ours. The Sentry Array we prepare to build in the [From.sola

hive-asteroids.zh:
[hiver_system.GetName]恒星系是一种具有独特性质的异常密集小行星环带的家乡。一些大型的小行星表面覆盖着突出的结晶，似乎是非常丰富的矿物矿藏。

然而，远程传感器正在追踪几个小型的、无法识别的可能是宇宙飞船的物体的零星运动，它们位于环带中的密度较大的区域。我们无法准确对其定位，但我们已经确定了至少两个被摧毁的采矿站的碎片，它们漂浮在一些较大小行星附近的太空中。
hive-asteroids.en:
The [hiver_system.GetName] system is home to an unusually dense asteroid belt with unique properties. Several of the larger asteroids are covered in crystalline outcroppings that appear to be extremely rich mineral deposits.

However, long-range sensors are tr

origin_evolutionary_predators.zh: 该物种受自己都无法完全理解的直觉所驱使着，永远都在追猎最独特的生物。他们独有能整合猎物基因的能力，因此演化成了母星上最顶级的猎手，应有尽有地吸收了所有的优势基因。如今，这种渴望又将他们带向了群星。
origin_evolutionary_predators.en: This species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage a

site-site-ebb-and-flow.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]行星的表面没有任何生命。然而，有迹象表明这里先前存在繁荣的生物圈，加之此处有趣的地壳活动，我们需要对其进行更深入的调查。
site-site-ebb-and-flow.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is devoid of all life. However, there are indications of a previously thriving biosphere, and some interesting tectonic activity which may warrant a closer look.

site-site-phoenix-collective.zh: 我们的调查船扫描了[From.Planet.GetName]并探测到一些值得进一步观测的人造结构。令人不安的是，那里没有任何人口存在的迹象。
site-site-phoenix-collective.en: Our survey ship has scanned [From.Planet.GetName] and detected some artificial structures worth a closer look. Unnervingly, there are no signs of any population down there.

site-site-polaris-seed-vault.zh: 在勾陈一的最后一个侵略者倒下后，我们的舰船在返回港口之前完成了对恒星系的最后一次扫描，并发现了一些奇怪的东西。在勾陈一 II 的星球上，我们的传感器显示有重金属被排列成了人造结构。有趣的是，这些构造中中似乎只有一个漂浮在行星海洋上，而其余的则在海面以下。我们怀疑这是外星生命的杰作。
site-site-polaris-seed-vault.en: After the last of the aggressors in Polaris fell, our ships completed a final scan of the system before heading back to port and discovered something curious. On the world of Polaris II, heavy metals are arranged in artificial structures on our sensors. Intere

site-site-ruins-of-shallash.zh: 显然，[From.Planet.GetName]曾是一个高度发达的文明的家园。该星球等距环绕着的六颗卫星就足以证明这一点。但是行星目前已经化作一片废墟，整个恒星系都有着各种各样争斗的痕迹。这里到底发生了什么？
site-site-ruins-of-shallash.en: [From.Planet.GetName] was clearly once home to a highly-advanced civilization; its six moons with orbits at equidistant intervals are evidence enough of that. However, the planet is in ruins and the entire star system shows signs of an extraordinarily violent

anomaly-distar-flare-cat.zh: 虽然[From.GetName]这颗星球上缺乏大气，但地表上有人造设施的遗迹，说明过去这里曾有文明。
anomaly-distar-flare-cat.en: Despite the planet's lack of atmosphere, there is evidence of some kind of artificial structures on [From.GetName] that may indicate a past civilization.

astral-crystal-sphere.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的裂隙探球技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
astral-crystal-sphere.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the Rift Sphere technology we have developed that allows us to explore other dimensions.

It may present a signific

ether-drake.zh:
在[From.GetName]星系遇到的这种生物不同于[Root.GetName]以往遇见的任何其他生物。

它们具有极强的攻击性与攻击能力，守护着一颗初步扫描发现蕴藏有大量资源的小行星。
ether-drake.en:
The creature observed in the [From.GetName] system is unlike anything the [Root.GetName] has previously encountered.

Highly aggressive and with destructive capabilities to match, it guards a planetoid that initial scans indicate is exceptionally resource-rich

event-anomaly-3115.zh:
千年之前，某舰队里的成员背弃了盟约，将枪口对准了彼此。在知己知彼的情况下，盟友的飞船顷刻之间就被消灭了，只留下了失去压力的飞船外壳。

我们收集了足够的信息，可以对这些舰队残骸在宇宙中缓慢漂移的过程进行建模。
event-anomaly-3115.en: Millennia ago, treachery saw a fleet of allied ships turn on each other. With swift strikes to critical systems and known weak points in the hull designs, the formerly allied crews were wiped out with ruthless efficiency, supposedly leaving the depressurized h

event-arkship-155.zh:
方舟舰的高级官员之一，[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]，对我们最近接触到的文明产生了一种超乎寻常的热情——如果一定要用语言形容的话。

无论是我们的仪器所能捕捉到的每一份文化记录，还是每一抹艺术或哲学的残片，都被其悉数吸收：

“我已经见识了足够多的东西，足以明白这里有着某种非凡的存在。让我去把剩下的补全吧。让我站在他们的世界里去学习。”
event-arkship-155.en:
One of the Arkship's senior Officials, [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], has developed what can only be described as a profound passion for the civilization we have recently encountered.

Every cultural record, every scrap of art or philosophy ou

event-cara-1010.zh:
行商联盟认证的行商，范格利集团向您致以问候！为你们奉上来自星系边陲的独家商品（由舰载工厂仿制），保证物美价廉。

穿过你们的领地时，我们将提供诱人独家交易。你们不必立马答应，在我们离开之前联系都可以。注意，来电将会转接到行商联盟。
event-cara-1010.en:
Greetings from the Vengralian Trium, certified caravaneer traders of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition! We bring you exclusive products from the farthest corners of the galaxy (as reproduced by our shipboard factories) at affordable prices.

We will offer you

event-cara-2010.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，吾等卑躯现身于此不胜惶恐。我们是拜金教团，一群信奉财富女神奴玛的卑微商人。我们因贪婪而被逐出天国，因此我们现已洗心革面抛弃所有世俗的物质追求。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
event-cara-2010.en:
Apologies for our blighted presence in the universe, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order, humble merchants serving Numa, the goddess of fortune. Cast out from the heavens for our greed, we have forsaken all earthly possessions.

Our fleets t

event-cara-3010.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]！欢迎你们。我们是拉奇工业公司的操作员，从属于行商联盟。

我们穿越于无垠的宇宙。我们捕捉每一丝星光。我们收集。我们交易！

我们带着和平的愿景来到了你们境内，我们仅仅只是想做点买卖，嘶！，我们将提供给你们上好的货物，合乎心意的交易。我们走之前会再见面的。

如果您对我们有何要求，行商联盟一定随叫随到。
event-cara-3010.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]! We greet you. We are operators of Racket Industrial Enterprise, a member of the Caravansary Caravan Coalition.

We travel the stars. We view all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to s

event-colony-mod-2.zh: [Root.GetName]的当地生命体型庞大，远远超出了所能设想的生物体型极限。研究人员思索：“为什么它们这么大？对我们可有益处？”进一步详细研究原生生物的建议书蜂拥而至。
event-colony-mod-2.en: The native life of [Root.GetName] is built on an epic scale, far larger than anyone previously thought was possible for biological life. The question now in the minds of our researchers is "What is their secret, and can we benefit from it?" Proposals to study

event-fircon-2600.zh:
天气条件：完美无瑕
核热火箭：燃料齐全
飞行计划：已优化

今天，当[pre_ftl_country.GetName]启动首次行星际任务时，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的所有广播都在播放这些指示。这些为了这项任务经过多年训练的航天员，于当地时间的今天早上登上了火箭。现在他们已经翱翔于那片我们和他们共享的天空。让我们追随他们的征程吧。
event-fircon-2600.en:
Weather Conditions: Flawless
Nuclear Thermal Rocket: Fully Fueled
Flight Plan: Optimized

These were the indicators broadcast all over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] launched its first interplanetary mission. The astronauts who

event-first-contact-critters-25.zh:
当我们进入[This.System.GetName]时，传感器获取了一个奇怪的数据。一开始把它们当成发光的小行星而忽视了，但后来当发现它们会对太空中的移动物体哪怕距离很远都会做出一定的进攻性反应，事情就变得有趣了起来。

建议最好从安全的距离上观察这些东西。
event-first-contact-critters-25.en:
Upon entering [This.System.GetName] our sensors picked up strange readings. Dismissed at first as glorified asteroids, things quickly changed when it was discovered that these entities reacted aggressively to movement in space - even at great distance!

Observ

event-first-contact-critters-35.zh: 我们之前用[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指称的不规则物体看起来一定程度上由晶态物质组成。有趣的是，它们可以在虚空中推进，并能在必要的时候保护自己，说明他们应该是具有生命的。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]正在做进一步的调查。
event-first-contact-critters-35.en: The irregularity we had designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appears to be made of some sort of crystalline material. Curiously, it seems to be able to propel itself across the void and protect itself when necessary, indicating that it may be alive. Our

event-galactic-features-387.zh:
生活在[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]星系的缇扬奇的行为与该物种的已知行为模式并不一致。缇扬奇通常是迁徙性的，而这群缇扬奇却紧紧守在一颗满是他们同类尸体的行星周围。

它们遮天蔽日的触手阻碍了对这个坟地的研究，除非我们将它们引走或者处置掉，否则进一步的调查难以进行。
event-galactic-features-387.en: The actions of the Tiyanki inhabiting the [tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName] system do not match known behavior patterns for their species. While Tiyanki are usually nomadic, these herds remain stationed around a planet entirely covered in the carcasses of the

event-galcom-1.zh:
随着越来越多的太空文明彼此间建立了正式的关系，星系之中愈发生机盎然。为了避免国家间出现悲剧性的误解，越来越多的外交人士呼吁设立一个新的泛星系组织——如果愿意的话也可以称为共同体，在那里星系中的各帝国可以召开会议，共商星系大事。

[Root.GetName]应该承诺支持星海共同体的创立吗？
event-galcom-1.en: As more and more spacefaring civilizations establish formal relations with one another, the galaxy is becoming a vibrant and lively place. To avoid tragic misunderstandings between nations, an increasing number of diplomats have called for the establishment of

event-grand-archive-4500.zh:
我们位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的博物天枢被[from.GetName]摧毁。

不幸的是，有部分高价值标本无法取回。
我们捕获的一部分太空兽群被野放，它们大多处于困惑而富有攻击性的状态。

我需要在另一个恒星系中重建博物天枢让标本展览得以继续。
event-grand-archive-4500.en:
Our Grand Archive in [fromfrom.GetName] has been destroyed by [from.GetName].

Unfortunately, we were unable to recover some of our valuable Specimens.
Some of our captive Space Fauna have been released into the wild. Many are in a confused and aggressive stat

event-infernals-2500.zh:
定向扫描发现[root.capital_scope.GetName]地表下埋藏着精密设施，且越靠近核心处，设施的规模越大，复杂度越高。它们的材质和能量特征与我们首次苏醒时的休眠舱一致。

这些必定是我们前文明的遗迹。若能进入这些设施，或许解答关于我们过去的最大谜团：我们是谁？经历了什么？
event-infernals-2500.en: Targeted scans have found evidence of sophisticated facilities buried beneath the surface of [root.capital_scope.GetName], increasing in size and complexity as they approach the core. Their material and energy signatures match those of the stasis chamber where

event-mega-9006.zh:
星际集会第一阶段最关键的特征的就是基座了。一个复杂的黑洞全息影像，它被用来召唤星系中心潜伏的引力深渊：那整个星系旋转的支点。

等到建成之后，这个地方也将会成为某些事务的轴心，那些能驱使整个星河旋转的静默外交与软实力博弈将会紧紧围绕着它。
event-mega-9006.en: The most crucial feature of the initial stage of the Interstellar Assembly is the Locus. A sophisticated holographic projection of a black hole, it is meant to evoke the gravitational chasm that lurks in the galactic core: the fulcrum upon which the galaxy tur

event-mega-9010.zh: 为了对[From.GetName]进行开采，我们首先需要一个安全基地才能开始建造其他。星锚已经在黑洞事件视界的最边缘处建造完成，并且已经由一个重力重定向引擎牢牢稳定住，通过逆转[From.GetName]自身产生的重力去抵抗巨大的引力。
event-mega-9010.en: To extract matter from [From.GetName] we first need a secure base to build the facility on. The Anchor has been built on the very edge of the event horizon and is held in place against the immense gravitational pull by an advanced gravity redirection engine, w

event-operation-1020.zh: 我们的特工已经确保了我们在[root.target.GetName]受邀出席的在一次星际科学会议上的方便。我们的工作重点仅是侦察[root.target.GetAdj]代表团。
event-operation-1020.en: Our operatives have secured attendance at an interstellar, scientific conference to which the [root.target.GetName] have also been invited. Our efforts are focused on scouting only the [root.target.GetAdj] delegation.

origin_wilderness.zh: 这个实体无异于一个拥有智慧的生态圈：众多不同的生命形式早已融合成一个行星尺度的格式塔意识。
origin_wilderness.en: This entity is nothing less than a sapient ecosphere: a multitude of diverse lifeforms which long since coalesced to form a gestalt consciousness on a planetary scale.

site-omnirelic-site.zh: 整个行星都被巨大的建筑物所覆盖着，这个遗落的大都会星肯定有秘密等待发掘。
site-omnirelic-site.en: An entire planet covered in vast structures, this fallen megalopolis surely has secrets to be unearthed.

site-site-cut-to-fit.zh:
在我们迄今的探索中，[From.Planet.GetName]表面的情况完全没有先例。从山脉到整个大陆般广袤的地质区域突然被切割成各种几何形状，其规整程度远非自然形成所能及。原本自然的环境被突然破坏，变成完全平坦的平面、完美的三角形和尖锐的锥形。

目前，对这一令人困惑的现象的任何解释都只是纯粹的猜测。
site-site-cut-to-fit.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is utterly without precedent in all our exploration to date. Vast geological areas, from mountain ranges to entire continents, are suddenly cut by shapes far too geometrically regular to be natural in origin. The otherwise

site-site-deja-vu-dig.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]扫描揭示了地底深处的一间人工密室——其用途和来源未知。放大后发现了一座从地表通往地下拱顶的挖掘井。

欲进行进一步的分析，需派遣一支探险队前往[From.Planet.GetName]的表面。
site-site-deja-vu-dig.en:
Scans of [From.Planet.GetName] uncovered an artificial chamber deep beneath the surface - its purpose and origin unknown. Magnification revealed an excavated shaft leading from the surface to the subterranean vault.

Further analysis will require sending an ex

site-site-fossilized-jellyfish.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]轨道上的科学船已经探测到遍布这个海洋星球表面的圆形岛屿群。从地质的角度来看，它们非常不寻常：其表面看起来很自然，没有人造结构，但它们都呈圆形，且几乎是完美的圆。我们需要前往那里收集更多数据。
site-site-fossilized-jellyfish.en: The Science Ship in orbit around [From.Planet.GetName] has detected clusters of small, round islands dotting the ocean planet. From a geological standpoint they are highly unusual: the surface appears natural, with no artificial constructions, yet they all app
