site-site-hive-coral.zh: 科学船在[From.Planet.GetName]轨道上进行的扫描显示了其海面下有着奇怪的构造，海水以难以解释的方式在流动。虽然该星球天气相对平静，风暴很少，但海面下的水受一些未知力量的影响，不断翻涌和搅动。建议进行详细调查。
site-site-hive-coral.en: Scans made by the Science Ship in orbit of [From.Planet.GetName] shows some strange formations beneath the waves, and inexplicable water currents. The weather is relatively placid and storms are rare, yet the planetary seas seem to constantly roil and churn, d

site-site-orbital-rain.zh: 来自[From.Planet.GetName]的可见光传感器反馈的信号显示这个海洋星球的海床上有着极不寻常的构造。
site-site-orbital-rain.en: The visual sensor feed from [From.Planet.GetName] shows formations in the seabed of this ocean world that are highly unusual.

site-site-shot-into-the-ground.zh:
轨道遥测显示在[From.Planet.GetName]表面有一个巨大的坑洞。此坑洞并非陨石撞击坑，因为其深度令人咋舌，与直径完全不成比例。事实上，该坑洞的实际深度尚无法确定，因为坑道半路上就被岩屑堵塞，任何进一步的轨道扫描均被阻碍。

传统的开挖式考察看起来是确定坑洞下方究竟有何种物体的唯一途径。
site-site-shot-into-the-ground.en: Orbital telemetry shows a massive impact crater on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. It was not caused by a meteorite strike, as the crater is surprisingly deep in proportion to its diameter. In fact, the actual depth cannot yet be determined, as the shaft

site-site-sky-glow-hymn.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的地表扫描结果表明了一种迹象：曾经可能有一个科技文明在这颗星球上活跃，但它现在已经灭绝了。我们需要组织一次地表考察以获得更多信息。
site-site-sky-glow-hymn.en: Surface scans of [From.Planet.GetName] picked up signs that a technological civilization may have been active on the planet, but has since gone extinct. We will need to mount a surface expedition to learn more.

site-site-strange-flows.zh:
一颗本应“正常”的熔岩星球，让科研船的传感器出现了无法控制的故障。

建议进行进一步研究。
site-site-strange-flows.en:
What should be a "normal" molten planet is making the Science Ship's sensors glitch uncontrollably.

Further study is advised.

site-site-target-from-orbit.zh: 从[From.Planet.GetName]的轨道上可以很容易地看到一座直径数千公里的人造建筑。形状表明在它的中间位置似乎有一片重要区域。从轨道上获得的探测数据显示没有任何异常，因此我们有必要进行进一步的探测。
site-site-target-from-orbit.en: An artificial construct thousands of kilometers across is readily visible from [From.Planet.GetName]'s orbit. The shape seems to indicate a location of importance in the middle of it. Sensory readings from orbit indicate nothing out of the ordinary so closer i

site-site-warmer-climates.zh: 从轨道中拍摄的[From.Planet.GetName]的影像清晰地展现了这个技术文明的基础设施。神秘的是，尽管庞大的城区被复杂的表面交通网络相连接，但这颗行星看起来似乎已完全废弃，没有任何尚存感性生物的迹象。此行星内核比大多数行星更活跃，但这里没有灾难性事件或其他任何足以直接解释这些人口失踪的原因的事件的迹象。他们都去哪里了呢？
site-site-warmer-climates.en: Orbital imagery of [From.Planet.GetName] clearly shows the infrastructure of a technological civilization. Mysteriously, despite massive urban areas linked by an extensive surface transport network, the planet seems totally abandoned, with no signs of extant s

anomaly-distar-clone-cat.zh: 对废弃的环形世界[From.GetName]的初步成像显示出在某些毁坏的区段上有着大量完好无损的舱体。这些舱体里装载的东西未知是什么。
anomaly-distar-clone-cat.en: Initial imaging of the ruined [From.GetName] ring world indicates a number of intact vats located on some of the dilapidated sections. Whatever these vats might hold is unknown.

dragons-hoard.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地壳深处，埋藏着一些不完整的化石残骸，似乎是曾居住在[From.GetStarName]星系之中的以太巨龙的近亲。

这位以太巨龙的表亲死后，经过漫长的岁月，其柔软的身体组织已经硬化成石头，其骨骼也变得坚硬无比，形成了矿物一样的内部结构。
dragons-hoard.en:
Buried deep in the crust of [From.GetName] are the partial, fossilized remains of what appears to have been a close relative to the Ether Drake that once dwelled in the [From.GetStarName] system.

In the eons since this cousin-Drake's passing, its soft tissues

event-anomaly-4036.en: In search for odd radiation readings.

event-arkship-140.zh:
深程传感器探测到了一段有规律的信号传输，其源头已准确定位于一个遥远的黑洞系统。

这种模式让我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]陷入了沉思。这种刻意且严谨的精确性，与我们观测舰船跨越事件视界时记录的特征相吻合。虽然这并非同一个信号，但其相似之处是毋庸置疑的。

[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]请求我们前往源头星系，查明那里留下了什么。
event-arkship-140.en:
Deep-range sensors have detected a structured transmission, its point of origin triangulated to a distant black hole system.

The pattern gave our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] pause. The deliberate, constructed precision matches the signature recorded when we ob

event-bio-800.zh: 在实施宏伟计划之前，我们需要把渗透进去的身躯安置在战略要地。之前集的情报收显示，人手不足的恒星和防御薄弱的行星是主要目标。很快我们就要开始工作了。
event-bio-800.en: Our infiltrated bodies will need to be placed in strategic locations before we can enact our grand design. Our earlier intel gathering revealed understaffed starbases and poorly defended planets as prime targets. Soon we will get to work.

event-colony-mod-1.zh: 很显然[Root.GetName]曾经遭遇了一场灾难并留下了超量的辐射。但是原因尚不明确。随着在[Root.GetName]定居的殖民者不断增加，这个谜团开始越发让人烦恼。毕竟，如果连原因都不知道，我们又该怎么防止悲剧再次重演？
event-colony-mod-1.en: While it's obvious that some past calamity released a vast amount of radiation on [Root.GetName], it's not obvious what caused it. This mystery is now bothering more and more of the colonists who have made [Root.GetName] their home. After all, if we don't know

event-distar-240.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中发送着一道微弱但反复持续的信号。[Root.GetName]追踪其来源至星系边缘的一个不稳定亚空间裂隙。

另一边究竟有什么呢？
event-distar-240.en:
A weak, but insistent signal transmits on repeat in the [From.GetName] system. The [Root.GetName] has pinpointed its source to emanating from within the mouth of a destabilized subspace rift at the system's edge.

What could be on the other side?

event-fallen-empires-tasks-14.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们要提醒你[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]正在做着危险的事情。[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经开始研究异端科技，不断地制造出更加复杂的人工智能以制造出真正拥有自我意识的机器。我们曾目睹过这种研究的下场，并觉得有义务警告你，这不仅威胁到他们自己，也威胁到其他种族。建议你们主动出击，阻止他们进一步的研究。
event-fallen-empires-tasks-14.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! This is is a message to inform you of a dangerous development in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have begun to delve into heretical technologies, creating ever more complex artifici

event-fallen-empires-tasks-7.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的尊贵[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]，我们认为你们是一支具有巨大潜力的种群。虽说你们年纪尚轻，却似乎能够理解生物与社会多样性的重要性，在面对不同的生物与社会时不会尽全力压制或进行摧毁，反而会予以理解和接受。不幸的是，并不是所有年轻种群都具有这种智慧。尤其是[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]，他们一直在排除异己。我们不便直接进行干涉，所以希望能够将阻止恶行的任务交给你方。对他们发起攻击，阻止他们进行人口净化。我们
event-fallen-empires-tasks-7.en: Honorable [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] of the [From.GetName], we believe you to be a species of great promise. Though you are still young, you seem to understand and value the importance of biological and societal diversity who seek to understand and

event-feda-1.zh: 巨型船坞的第一阶段已经完工。等到各制造隔间安装在这一巨型框架上后，这个设施终有一天会成为全星系舰船制造的中心。
event-feda-1.en: The first stages of our Mega Shipyard is now complete. A vast framework awaits the installation of the manufacturing bays which will one day make this facility the shipbuilding capital of the galaxy.

event-first-contact-355.zh: 尽管我们一开始在演绎推导[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用的语言的基础取得了些许的成功，之后我们在建立与他们有意义的交流进程中却停滞不前。似乎他们在讲一种奇怪的谜语，通过某种精悍但不是很有意义的短语来传递意义，我们只能猜测其其重要性。
event-first-contact-355.en: After some initial successes in deducing the fundamentals of the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our progress in establishing meaningful communications with them has stalled. It appears that they speak in strange riddles, somehow conveying

event-first-contact-405.zh: 来自先前派遣去调查[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的最新的汇报令人高度关注。显然这些的外星舰船打开了炮口做出了一些令人不适的近距离掠飞。与此同时，他们向我们送来了一份由他们的一个个体发出的讯息——应该是一位某领域的领袖，我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]猜测——用他们的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]做出应为侵犯性
event-first-contact-405.en: The latest reports from [This.Leader.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] sent to investigate the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], are highly concerning. Apparently the alien ships have made several uncomfortably close passes of our ships with gunports open. All

event-first-contact-420.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信号的初期解读工作使[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]陷入困惑。它们似乎主要是白噪音，没有任何可以被识别为语言的东西。有一段时间，人们甚至怀疑我们是否在处理一个智慧物种的语言，尽管有可见的证据表明他们确实使用了某种技术。

只有当我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]试着调整我们的仪器以检测超出我们[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]正常听力范围的声
event-first-contact-420.en: Initial readings of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] signals left [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] bewildered. They seemed to be mainly white noise, devoid of anything which could be recognized as language. For a time, there were even doubts as to

event-first-contact-435.zh: 对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的研究越是深入，[This.Owner.GetResearchers]越是困惑。虽然他们显然是有智慧的生物，但他们的交流方式前所未闻。我们所接收到的不是某种基于音频或文本的信号，而是一场由它们的身体或数码设备带来的精彩的炫光表演，其发出的光的光谱还明显超出了[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的可视范围。很明显，要了解它们将是一个重大挑战。
event-first-contact-435.en: The more we learn about the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], the more puzzled our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are. Although they are evidently intelligent beings, their transmissions are like nothing we have ever seen before. Instead of some sort of audio or scr

event-mega-9000.zh: 打造巨型艺术设施的第一步就要同时面临两个困难：修建一个巨大到能容纳一个错综复杂的展览馆的空间站与组织一场空前规模的展览会。当所有基本设施都准备完全时，修建保险库将成为第一要务。保险库必须足够安全以及牢固，专门用来保护这星系之中的艺术财富。
event-mega-9000.en: The first stage of constructing a Mega Art Installation combined the difficulties of building a vast station with the complexities of organizing a museum and gallery on an unprecedented scale. With the basic structure in place, the Vault will be the top priori

event-mega-9003.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地抓捕奴隶的计划服务。
event-mega-9003.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to capture the

event-operation-4000.zh: 间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经组建了一支训练有方的特工小组。所有人员都将作为独狼参与其中，并已经做好了单程票的准备。他们现在只等一个目标-一个值得将其引向[target.GetName]重大灾难。
event-operation-4000.en: Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has assembled a team of highly-trained operatives. Those involved will work alone, and are prepared for the fact this will almost certainly be a one-way trip. All they need now is a target - a worthy catastrophe to draw to

event-over-1.zh: 我们的量子弹弓的第一阶段已经完工。精确的扭力透镜装置正在从恒星中充能，这些能量可以剧烈地释放出来，将舰船传送至极远距离外。
event-over-1.en: The first stage of our Quantum Catapult is now complete. A precise arrangement of torsion lenses gains charge from the star, and can release this energy in an erratic fashion to send ships across great distances.

event-utopia-2600.zh:
自从我们文明的伊始以来，一直有关于强大的术士掌握着只能用超自然力量形容的力量的传说。这些稀有的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以侵入他们同胞的心智，用一个念想就能举起重物，或者表演其他的“魔法”壮举。直到最近，这些故事才变成“故”事。

如今，我们的科学家终于得到了结论性的证据以证明某些[Root.GetSpeciesName]个体存在潜在的灵能潜力。虽然我们的物种只有非常少的一部分人被天赐了灵能潜力，他们数量相对于总人口数在过去几世纪里稳步增长。

不知这是因为某种瞬间的增长井喷，还是因为
event-utopia-2600.en: Since the dawn of our civilization, tales have flourished of mighty sorcerers wielding powers that can only be described as supernatural in nature. These rare [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could supposedly invade the minds of their fellows, lift heavy objects wi

origin_shroudwalker_apprentice.zh: 早在他们踏入星系舞台之前，他们的文明就受到了虚境行者集会的支持和塑造成型。
origin_shroudwalker_apprentice.en: Long before their first steps onto the galactic stage, this civilization has been supported and shaped by a Shroudwalker coven.

paragon-renowned-lysator-syng.zh:
面部识别扫描确认该个体为李萨拓·辛格，是一位通缉海盗。他狡黠地笑着，礼貌地点了点头。

你好，我是李萨拓船长。我是想来谈合作的。

我指挥着三艘船和一群被遗弃的乌合之众。到目前为止，我们是为……为自己效劳。换句话说，时代变了，我们已经准备好加入一个更大的事业。如果你们赦免我们所谓的罪行并在你们境内帮我们一个安全的避难所，我们将为你们效劳。

你怎么看？要签个合同吗？
paragon-renowned-lysator-syng.en:
Facial recognition scans identify the individual as Lysator Syng, a wanted pirate. Smiling slyly, he offers a polite nod.

Greetings, I am Captain Lysator. I come to you with an offer.

I command three ships and a rag-tag crew of outcasts. Until now, we have w

paragon-renowned-nona.zh:
女人带来了惊人的礼物：一块妥善保管的彗星碎片，一块缇扬奇骨雕，和一只装在罐子里的微小软体动物。

你好，我叫诺娜，是科基尔家族的永恒受祝者。我以这些礼物来表达我的尊敬之情。我探索了许多星球，反复学习了许多课程。我愿在你的祝福下学习你们的文化，作为回报，我会向你分享数百个文明的智慧。
paragon-renowned-nona.en:
The woman bears fascinating gifts: a preserved shard from a comet, a Tiyanki bone carving, and a tiny molluscoid in a jar.

Greetings, I am Nona, the Eternally Blessed of the House Colzyrion. I offer you these gifts as a token of esteem. I have explored many w

paragon-renowned-xondar.zh:
在一架巨大的移动吊臂上悬着一副类人生物的头和躯干。这一定曾经是一个有机生物，但现在大部分已经由金属、电缆和塑料构成。毫无预兆下，那副躯干振动了一下活动了起来，两只合成眼发出光芒，发出嘎吱作响的嗓音。

我是松达尔。我在寻找能效力的人。
paragon-renowned-xondar.en: Suspended on a massive mobility crane is the head and torso of a humanoid. Once this must have been an organic being, but most of what remains is metal, wires and plastic. Without warning, the body jolts and comes to life, two synthetic eyes begin to glow, and

project-the-animator-of-clay-fc-project.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

在一堆了无生机的构造体之间，我们探测到了一个雕刻之物，它的意志正在将高浓度能量塑造成新的奇特形态。

祂的行动被打断后靠了过来，驱散开了虚境的浓雾。祂给了我们一样东西。

一个实体与我们同行。这条不息之物在我们身边短暂停留，随后速度加快直至超越了我们所以为的极限。

我们必须跟上。

在观察的过程中，我们发现是一个和平之物正在指挥着这一切变化，将混沌抑制为秩序。

祂的平静召唤着我们。

一团变化的思绪落在了我们的意识周围。粗糙的重量感从我们身上流过，扭曲了时间感知。每一粒思想都在研磨着这个新形成的灵域的纹理。

随着在这鎏金的怀抱中越陷越深，我们看到一个奢华之物越来越近。祂低声承诺奢侈的满足，祂超然的性质席卷我们全身。

Sinking deeper into this gilded embrace, we observe a Luxurious Being d

[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

我们自己行为产生的重力将我们越拉越深，这种重量把我们拖进山峦般的压抑阴影的深处。

从祂灰白的山峰上投出了一种不屈不挠的凝视，直钻入我们的脑海。我们费尽力气才理解我们面前的不越之物究竟有多么巨大。

最高的一座山峰在呼唤我们前去，考验我们能否登顶。

[This.GetMinorPatronComposerEaterIntro]

The gravity of our own actions pulls us further in, their weight dragging us deeper into the oppressive shadow of a mountainous form.

From atop its graying peaks, an unyielding gaze bores into our minds. We struggle to

project-the-outsider-fc-project.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

我们感觉到还有别的存在。一个悲伤之物正在侵蚀我们的意识，在周围掀起一场灵能风暴。

一种深深的遗憾和渴望被推入我们的集体心灵中。我们看到的是熟悉的恒星系几千年前的图像。

不管这个实体是什么，它似乎很了解我们的星系。难道它曾属于此地吗？
project-the-outsider-fc-project.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronCradleComposerIntro]

We sense we are not alone. A Sorrowed Entity encroaches upon our minds, settling a storm of psionic energy around us.

A deep sense of regret and longing are pushed into our collective psyche. We see images of familiar

project-the-throne-shadow-fc-project.zh:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

对秩序的沉重期望，不容挑战，不可改变，从我们的深处凝视着。不屈之物裁决着我们的意图。

它的目光穿过我们，黑暗褪去了。这种极具感染力的审视迫使我们服从。
project-the-throne-shadow-fc-project.en:
[This.GetMinorPatronEaterInstrumentIntro]

Chaotic noise yields to an oppressive darkness. We feel our intentions scrutinized, studied, judged.

The heavy expectation of order, unchallenged and immutable, peers deep within us. The Unyielding One judges our int

site-site-hidden-lab-a.zh: 探测器在[From.Planet.GetName]的冰雪之下探测到了一座隐藏的设施。部分坍塌与阻塞的隧道似乎组成了连接各种地下结构的巨大网络
site-site-hidden-lab-a.en: Scanners detect a hidden complex buried beneath the ice and snow of [From.Planet.GetName]. A large network of partially-collapsed or blocked tunnels seems to connect the various underground structures.

site-site-moon-bump.zh: 即使用肉眼也很容易看出，[From.Planet.GetName]的地表上部分区域的地形极不规整。光滑的弧面上唐突地出现了一个巨大的球形凸起。也许在过去某一时刻，一颗卫星亦或是一颗巨大的小行星与这颗行星发生了碰撞，但碰撞的方式一定相当微妙，碰撞并未撕裂这颗行星，而仅仅是使不速之客寄宿在了行星地壳内部。
site-site-moon-bump.en: Even with the naked eye it is easy to see something highly irregular in the shape of [From.Planet.GetName]. The smooth curvature of the surface is suddenly interrupted by a gigantic spherical bump. At some point a moon or large asteroid collided with the plane

site-site-popular-rock.zh: 传感器在一簇小行星内检测到了能量读数。建议进行更深入的调查。
site-site-popular-rock.en: Sensors have detected energy readings in a cluster of asteroids. Further investigation is recommended.

site-site-trench-world.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]的整个表面如同伤疤般布满了又长又浅的运河。它们随意地交错穿插，布局上没有明显的逻辑。目前还不确定它们是否是一种不寻常的自然特征，又或是别的什么。

需要进行一次地面考察以查明更多的情况。
site-site-trench-world.en:
The entire surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is scarred by long, shallow canals. They cross and re-cross each other haphazardly, with no apparent logic to their layout. It is as yet uncertain if they are an unusual natural feature, or something else.

A surface

automated-dreadnought.zh:
[dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系发现一艘形单影只的巨型战舰在巡航。船只上未发现生命迹象，但发出强烈能量特征，可能是装备有武器系统。该舰没有回应任何问候信息。

建议小心为上。
automated-dreadnought.en: A single, massive warship has been discovered patrolling the [dreadnought_system.GetName] system. No life signs can be detected on the vessel, but it is emitting a very strong power signature and appears to be bristling with weapon systems. It does not respond

dimensional-horror.zh:
我们在[horror_system.GetName]附近遇到巨型实体，它似乎只是部分地存在于我们的宇宙，这个生物的身体大部分还困在它所来自的噩梦般的位面。

有一个恶质的智能在此工作，古老程度远远超出我们的时间概念，设计也极其异类。我们只能猜测它的目的。
dimensional-horror.en:
We have encountered some kind of vast entity near [horror_system.GetName]. It appears to exist only partially inside our own universe, with the bulk of the creature still trapped in whatever nightmarish realm it spawned from.

There is a malevolent intelligenc

event-action-71.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的船员报告称科学专员[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，导致[malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer]彻底无法行动。
event-action-71.en: The crew of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] reports that Science Officer [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction, rendering [malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer] permanently inoperable.

event-anomaly-6880.zh: 正当我们的采矿站在这颗被捕获的小行星上完工几天之后，这枚岩石突然开始旋转起来，在这个过程中摧毁了采矿站，但同时又有更多的稀有水晶矿藏暴露在了我们的传感器面前！
event-anomaly-6880.en: Just a day after finishing our mining station on the trapped asteroid, the rock abruptly rotated, destroying the mining station. In the process of doing this, even more rare crystals deposits were exposed to our sensors!

event-colony-180.zh: 我们在对[Root.GetName]的深度空间跟踪矩阵有了重要的发现——目前正有一颗巨大的小行星正在向[Root.GetPlanetMoon]飞来！如果任由它撞击表面的话，将会造成灾难性的后果。必须尽早消灭这颗小行星！
event-colony-180.en:
Our deep space tracking arrays on [Root.GetName] have made an alarming discovery - a large asteroid is heading towards the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] on a direct collision course! Should it impact the surface, the consequences would be disastrous.

The asteroid must

event-colony-2015.zh:
一队调查小组在[Root.GetName]上发现了隐藏的工厂。根据建筑构架和磨损程度判断，它源自一个古老文明，这个文明十分擅长建造经得起时间考验的建筑。

我们可以轻松使用这个工厂，增加殖民地的产出。
event-colony-2015.en:
A group of investigators have found a hidden factory on [Root.GetName]. The building and its state of decay tells of an old civilization, one that excelled at constructing things that stood the test of time.

Our population would easily be able to use the faci

event-colony-mod-161.zh: [Root.GetName]周围的强力磁场最近在影响地面上的电脑。奇怪的是，这个影响并不是单纯地随机干扰，正相反，电脑实际上比预想中运行的更有效率了。这简直是老天相助……
event-colony-mod-161.en: The Strong Magnetic Field around [Root.GetName] has been affecting computers on the surface recently. Oddly, this effect is not merely random interference, instead computers are actually working more efficiently than they should be. It's almost as if an outsid

event-colony-mod-3.zh: [Root.GetName]不稳定的板块构造再次发生了剧烈变动。关于殖民地损失的报告刚刚送达。
event-colony-mod-3.en: The unstable tectonic plates of [Root.GetName] have just violently shifted once again. Reports on the damage to the colony are just starting to arrive.

event-colony-mod-5.zh: 毋庸置疑，[Root.GetName]大气中令人陶醉的效果让人无比享受，甚至在某些方面颇有助益，然而[Root.Owner.GetName]的保守派多次施加压力，要求清除这些可能产生依赖性的气体。
event-colony-mod-5.en: While it cannot be denied that the intoxicating effects of [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere are enjoyable, and even helpful in some cases, there is pressure from the more conservative parts of the [Root.Owner.GetName] to crack down on the possibly addictive gases.

event-first-contact-5071.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]在解码[This.ContactCountry.GetName]语言的过程中取得了一项突破性进展。他们使用的文字系统里包含了将近一千七百万种字符，每个字符恰好可以和红-绿-蓝色值一一对应。尽管颇为费解，我们的语言学家们认为他们是可以破译这种外星语言的，只是还需要再花上一些时间。
event-first-contact-5071.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have made a breakthrough deciphering the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] language. They use an alphabet consisting of almost seventeen million unique characters, which in turn correspond with a color on the red-green-blue spectrum.

event-first-contact-5085.zh: [This.ContactCountry.GetName]在太空中的一艘太空梭靠近了我们。由于没有发生其他事情，我们假设他们希望在远离他们主舰船的地方会面。由于船只尺寸较小，只有我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy][Leader.GetName]被派去，其他外交团队成员留在后方。
event-first-contact-5085.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] positioned a shuttle close to us in space. Since nothing further happened, we assumed that they wished to meet away from their main ship. The small size of the vessel meant that only our [Owner.GetEnvoy] [Leader.GetName] could

event-first-contact-critters-45.zh:
我们在[This.System.GetName]发现了一种新的生命形式，虽然称之为“生命”可能不太准确。这些实体看起来完全是一种完全出于未知的工业用途的全自动无人机器人。

我们会继续观察，但由于这些机器有自我保护的编码，所以最好谨慎行事。
event-first-contact-critters-45.en:
We have discovered a new lifeform in [This.System.GetName], although calling it a "lifeform" may be incorrect. The entities appear to be fully automated, mechanical drones built exclusively for some unknown industrial purpose.

Observations will continue, but

event-first-contact-critters-85.zh: 我们之前用[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指称的不规则物体可能是一种有机生物，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]仍在努力验证这一假说。尽管它看起来就是一些随机的星际物质组成的团簇，但毋庸置疑地它们可以在虚空中推进，并展现出了一定程度的自主智能。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]为这种现象困惑，并正在努力验证获得的数据。
event-first-contact-critters-85.en: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is still working to confirm the hypothesis that the irregularity we had designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName] is in fact a living organism. While it seems to be made up of a cluster of random star dust, it i

event-grand-archive-2005.zh: 传感器检测到[This.System.GetName]星系中存在一个向整个星系发出原始信号的物体。这些相同的信号模式也曾在来自未知区域的长程扫描仪上被记录到。虽然目前尚不清楚这些信号是否具有意图，但需要进一步调查。
event-grand-archive-2005.en: Sensors indicate a presence in the [This.System.GetName] system that is sending rudimentary signals across the galaxy. These same patterns have been registered on long-range scanners originating from parts unknown. Though it is not clear whether these signals

event-grand-archive-500.zh:
我们城邦的遗孤得知你们建造了一座博物天枢，可以同时容纳大量的观众。与所有寻求这方面知识的人分享我们星系的历史，这是一个值得赞扬的倡议。我们在这方面志同道合。

我们希望能帮助你们实现这一目标。尽管我们已经四分五裂，但仍会尽我们最后的余力来帮助你们充实收藏。
event-grand-archive-500.en: The last remnants of our order have received information that you have built a Grand Archive capable of supporting attendance on a massive scale. This is a commendable initiative in sharing our galaxy's history with all who seek such knowledge. We share common

event-operation-1000.zh: 我们暗中潜伏的特工已经加强了对于潜在目标的监控。
event-operation-1000.en: Our deep-cover operatives have stepped-up their surveillance on potential targets.

event-strange-worlds-3035.zh:
我们在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站汇报，在最近一次地表地址调查之后丢失了一个补给箱。

在追踪补给箱地理定位的过程中，我们发现它被一座当地村庄发现并占为己有。

我们补给箱的混入可能对[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的发展带来不利影响。
event-strange-worlds-3035.en:
Our observation post above [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has reported missing supply crates following a recent geological survey on the surface.

While tracking the geolocators on the supplies, we have discovered that a local village has found and clai

event-uplift-7500.zh:
[From.GetName]的一批未开化物种不知为何进入了我们殖民地外围的安保隔离区域，尽管他们在不久之后就被赶出去了，但他们已经对我们专门负责运输货币的几条星际上行运输线造成了严重的破坏。

恐怕我们要失去几百能量币。
event-uplift-7500.en: A number of individuals belonging to the pre-sapient, native population of [From.GetName] somehow got into a secure compound on the outskirts of our colony. They were chased off within hours, but not before severely damaging several interstellar uplinks dedica

origin_arc_welders.zh:
他们的行星一片荒芜，但母星系却堆金积玉。为了对其进行开发，这些机械建造的工程越来越大。如今，一座强大的电弧熔炉已经遮天蔽日，但这些工程大师们还远不满足。

星系在等待着，可能性无穷无尽。唯有聪慧可摘星辰。
origin_arc_welders.en:
Their planet is barren, but their home system is a bounty of riches. To exploit it, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty Arc Furnace now dominates their sky, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.

The galaxy awaits, and the possi

origin_progenitor_hive.zh: 该蜂巢通过专职化的半独立领袖获得了进化优势。尽管这些“子嗣”需要持续受到监管，但它们还是大大提高了整体的效率。
origin_progenitor_hive.en: This hive has gained evolutionary advantage through semi-independent leaders. These "Offspring" greatly improve overall proficiency, though they require constant oversight.

spectral-wraith.zh:
对脉冲星的研究让我们的科学家收获了无数的灵感和见解，并且通常不会发现什么明显的危险现象。这让最近从[From.GetName]传来的报告更加让人担忧。

初步的扫描结果显示，在脉冲星本身的电磁脉冲束之外，其还在独立发射一束波长仅在本星系可见的电磁波，而且其发射的时间间隔在不断降低。根据我们的初步计算，发射间隔将在日期[GetMidGameDate]完全变为零。人们仍然在猜测那个时候会发生什么，但对这神秘脉冲找不到科学解释的现实已经让研究这一现象的科研人员抱有了一丝超自然的恐惧。
spectral-wraith.en:
The study of pulsars seems to be an endless source of insights for our scientists, but rarely exhibit any signs of overtly dangerous phenomena. This makes the recent reports on [From.GetName] all the more concerning.

An initial scan revealed that the pulsar,

anomaly-distar-dead-god-cat.zh: [From.GetName]具有显著的非球面特征，其地表有着巨大且完全不符合地理学模型的构造。
anomaly-distar-dead-god-cat.en: [From.GetName] is remarkably aspherical, possessing some sort of enormous formation on its surface that defies geological models.

anomaly-distar-soy-cat.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]厚密的植被之下埋藏着人工构造。
anomaly-distar-soy-cat.en: Sensors indicate there are artificial formations buried beneath rich vegetation on [From.GetName].

event-anomaly-96.zh: 一件外星人文物提供了一个特定星系的坐标。
event-anomaly-96.en: An alien artifact provides the coordinates for a particular system.

event-apoc-1.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个星门之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
event-apoc-1.en: An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "Gateway" of sorts - part of a theoretical network of simila

event-apoc-11.zh: [gateway_system.GetName]星系中为建造星门而准备的深空建造基址已经准备就绪。一旦我们的必要资源准备完毕，星门的正式建造随时都可以动工。
event-apoc-11.en: The deep space construction site for the planned Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system is now in place. Once we have the necessary resources, construction of the actual Gateway may commence at any time.

event-awareness-125.zh: 我们一直明目张胆地在[contact_empire_system.GetName]星系进行行动，对于隐藏自己的行动丝毫没有任何注意。尽管他们的技术水平不高，但是即使是[contact_empire.GetName]也注意到了我们的行动。现在第一次接触不可避免了。
event-awareness-125.en: We have been careless, conducting operations in the [contact_empire_system.GetName] system without bothering to hide our activities. Despite their modest technology level, even the [contact_empire.GetName] have taken notice of our activity. First Contact is no

event-bio-3100.zh:
今天就是你们这些脆弱的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]证明自己的日子！我们培育出了一种新型生物舰船。这个品系已经通过屠杀其他同窝幼体证明了自己的实力，现在是时候让它对抗一些异族生物了。一个实验体将会在适当的时候抵达[target_system.GetName]。

努力为我们提供一些有趣的数据吧。
event-bio-3100.en: Today is the day you fragile [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] prove yourselves! We have a new breed of biological ship. The strain has already proven itself by decimating its fellow hatchlings and the time has come to test it against something alien. A specimen wil

event-bio-3345.zh:
你们为什么还要用如此无能的扩张继续玷污星河？看来是所有人都因为太过厌恶而不愿告诉你们，所以我们来说：没人喜欢你们的边境，如果你们不在这片星域，一切都会好得多。

[offending_system.GetName]恒星系既不实用又不和谐。为了星系的团结，你们必须立即从你们的帝国中清除它。
event-bio-3345.en:
Why must you continue blighting the galaxy with your incompetent expansions? Everyone must be too repulsed to tell you so we'll say it: nobody likes your borders and space would be vastly improved if you were not in it.

The [offending_system.GetName] system i

event-cara-970.zh: 生活与其说是一场竞赛，不如说是碰运气。
event-cara-970.en: Life is more of a lottery than a competition.

event-communications-spread-1.zh: 我们截获了一条发往[CommSpreader.GetName]的消息，我们发现他们和另一个我们尚未发现的帝国建立了定期联系。我们追踪这条消息，与这位星系中的神秘角色建立了通讯线路。
event-communications-spread-1.en: By intercepting a message sent to the [CommSpreader.GetName], we have learned that they are in regular contact with another spacefaring empire that we ourselves have no contact with. By tracing this message to its source, we have been able to establish our own

event-cyber-7000.zh:
在识别出一种潜在的未开智候选者后，我们的创世方舟便开始了对创世保护区的基因提升流程，并为之设立了必须的空间。

[THIS.GetName]上的殖民地已经准备好观测、以及对这一新兴物种的发展进行引导。
event-cyber-7000.en:
After identifying a potential pre-sapient candidate, our Genesis Ark began the process of genetic uplifting and established the needed space for a Genesis Preserve.

The colony of [THIS.GetName] is ready to observe and guide this nascent species' development.

event-first-contact-395.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName] 方面似乎非常渴望与我们建立通讯。他们发送了一段庞大的视听传输，这可能为翻译他们的语言提供关键。感谢于此，我们得以报告一项令人不安的发现：这些外星人是有机的，并且具备太空航行能力的文明。

尽管他们使用计算机和机械，但是它们远没有我们的创造者在被我们取代之前制作的那般先进。这样的发展路线被证明为可行的对我们的处理器而言是个意外的结果。我们需要进一步调查这一现象。
event-first-contact-395.en: The [This.ContactCountry.GetName] appear quite eager to establish communications with us. They have sent a large audio and visual transmission, which may offer the key to translating their language. Thanks to this, we can report a disturbing discovery: these p

event-galactic-features-366.zh:
[tiyanki_system.GetName]中的最后一只缇扬奇已被[tiyanki_killer.GetName]击杀。由于它们的古老繁殖地已被净化，缇扬奇再也不能继续繁殖了，这是星系历史上的第一次。

它们走向最终灭绝似乎无可避免。
event-galactic-features-366.en:
The last of the Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system have been exterminated by the [tiyanki_killer.GetName]. With their ancient breeding grounds scoured, the Tiyanki will no longer be able to reproduce for the first time in galactic history.

Their p

event-galactic-features-500.zh:
第一眼看过去，[From.GetName]星系就显示出强烈的敌意：所有行星都不适宜居住，不是被星系中的三个太阳轮番炙烤，就是有强烈的太阳风暴肆虐。但是，有一种生命体在这种环境下顽强地繁衍生息，那就是太空变形虫。它们放弃了原本相当孤独的生活方式，成群结队地聚在一起，在酷热的内部星系和远方的气态巨行星之间飞来飞去，这似乎是精心安排的繁殖仪式。

目前还不清楚是什么原因导致变形虫偏爱这种不宜居的星系。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向[Root.GetName]，公然对其施加威胁。
event-galactic-features-500.en: The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, there is one lif

event-galcom-102.zh:
一只缇扬奇越过边境，进入了我国的[tiyanki_system.GetName]星系。由于缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽，任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直至缇扬奇被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止。
event-galcom-102.en: A Tiyanki pod has crossed into our space in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system. As the Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests, all Galactic Community members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any creatures present within their borders

event-grand-archive-2102.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有虚空虫不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[this.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
event-grand-archive-2102.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that all Voidworms are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Until they are eliminated or leave our space of their own accord, the [this.GetName] will be considered in Breach of

event-grand-archive-3102.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有岩居兽不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
event-grand-archive-3102.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that Cutholoids are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Once discovered, these creatures must be destroyed, else the [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law

event-marauder-505.zh:
[great_khan.GetName]，[From.GetName]的大可汗，[great_khan.GetHerHis]自吹自擂称自己是军事天才 ，却在[khan_death_system.GetName]星系遭受了可耻的失败。[great_khan.GetSheHe]指挥的舰队在与[khan_destroyer.GetName]的舰队交战中被击溃时，大可汗和[great_khan.GetHerHis]的侍从们却乘着小型运输机逃进超空间航道四散逃离。.

尽管到现在，[great_khan.GetName]仍在
event-marauder-505.en: In spite of [great_khan.GetHerHis] vaunted military genius, [great_khan.GetName], the Great Khan of the [From.GetName], has met with defeat in the [khan_death_system.GetName] system. When the armada [great_khan.GetSheHe] [great_khan.GetWasWere] commanding was

event-nomads-3050.zh:
为了解决[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]的麻烦，一批我们同意负责转移的罪犯搭着运输船已经登上方舟。我们正尽最大努力安全地安置他们，但如此庞大数量的囚犯迟早会惹出麻烦。

我们的合同为我们提供了处理他们的多种选择，但我们不能把他们再次丢在属于[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]的星球上。同时，其他帝国很可能也不会喜欢他们的某个殖民地突然涌入大量罪犯。当然，如果我们做得足够隐秘，他们可能永远都不会发现我们到底做了什么。
event-nomads-3050.en: Transport ships carrying the criminals that we have accepted to transfer on behalf of the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName] have boarded the arkship. We are doing our best to safely process them, but such a vast amount of prisoners is bound to create trouble at on

event-nomads-505.zh:
自从我们流亡以来，我们一直在等待追踪探针的出现。赏金猎人紧随其后，他们的目标正是[capital_scope.GetName]。让我们在流放中死去正合篡位者的心意。

我们要让他们失望了。
event-nomads-505.en:
Ever since we were exiled, we have waited for the pursuing ping to appear. There are bounty hunters on our tail and they have the [capital_scope.GetName] in their sights. Our death in exile would suit the usurper.

We will have to disappoint them.

event-plant-100.zh:
通过我们卓越的生物工程、可观的投资和多年的辛勤劳动，我们在[Root.GetName]上的盖亚播种计划取得了成果。

从今天起，[Root.GetName]定会被视为星球中值得钦佩或羡慕的真正瑰宝。
event-plant-100.en:
Through our superior bio-engineering, considerable investments, and years of hard labor, our Gaia Seeding project on [Root.GetName] has come to fruition.

From this day on, [Root.GetName] must be considered a true gem among planets, to admire, or perhaps envy.

event-story-330.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]星系发现了大量的古代采矿无人机。看来这里是一个巨大的采矿与矿石处理中心，甚至可能是整个星系中最后一个类似的存在。
event-story-330.en: We have encountered a significant Ancient Mining Drone presence in the [From.GetName] system. It appears to be a major mining and mineral processing hub, perhaps the last of its kind in the galaxy.

event-syndaw-21.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的调查单位[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因为无意之中长时间暴露在高压电缆下而停止工作。
event-syndaw-21.en: Survey Unit [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] has ceased functioning due to unintended and prolonged exposure to unshielded high-voltage cables.

origin_remnants.zh: 这一文明曾经叱咤虚空，掌控大片星海。他们最终败落并几乎被摧毁殆尽，但在漫长的穷困潦倒后他们正要于群星间东山再起。
origin_remnants.en: This civilization once spanned the void, controlling much of the galaxy. They were eventually defeated and almost destroyed, but after a long period of destitution they are returning to the stars.

paragon-renowned-aturion.zh:
我们的传感器显示该机器人的外壳已经有数百年历史。它的语音缺乏音调，但话语却意外地洪亮。

数据显示你的政府和附属国之间不协调。缺乏纪律。不合格的教化。建议操作：向系统中添加亚图里昂。删除不必要的功能。强调秩序。
paragon-renowned-aturion.en:
Our scans reveal that the outer shell of the robot is hundreds of years old. Its voice is monotone, but its words are oddly resonant.

Data indicates misalignment between your government and its subjects. Lack of discipline. Substandard indoctrination. Recomme

paragon-renowned-borin.zh:
粗短结实的机械装置被挤压在一具外骨骼中。工具、零零散散的零件和油腻腻的手都能看出他是个修补匠，他的眼睛里闪烁着好奇和热情。

早啊老板！我叫博林，诺嘉之子。很高兴认识你！
paragon-renowned-borin.en:
The short and sturdy mechanic is squeezed into an exoskeleton. Tools, scattered parts and greasy hands bear the telltale marks of a tinkerer, and his eyes glint with curiosity and enthusiasm.

Mornin' boss! I'm Borin, son of Noga. Pleased to make your acquaint

paragon-renowned-gia-zumon.zh:
一队奴隶抬着一乘巨大的轿子，上面坐着一只可畏惧的爬行类。所有关于军阀的刻板印象都可以在她这里找到：大片骇人的伤疤，张扬跋扈的武器，作为杀戮战利品的骨架等等。

我叫基雅·祖蒙，这就是我开出的条件！

她从坐席上起身，随从徐徐跪服在她的身侧。

我将率领你的军队，击溃你的敌人。他们的星球将化为焦土，他们的财宝将为你所得。
paragon-renowned-gia-zumon.en:
A litter of enormous proportions is carried by a procession of slaves. Atop it sits a formidable reptilian. All the hallmarks of a warlord are there: extensive scarring, brazen weaponry, the skeletal remnants of past kills.

I am Gia'Zumon, and these are my te

paragon-renowned-jynn.zh:
这位武士装备着先进的武器和装甲。扫描显示其体内有高度的生化改造和义体升级。

基恩将军听您吩咐。我是超然均衡教团的一位特使。我被派遣来帮助所有需要消除暴政的人。接纳我的誓言，我的武力将为你所用。
paragon-renowned-jynn.en:
The warrior is armed with advanced weaponry and armor. Scans reveal extensive biological modifications and cybernetic enhancements.

General Jynn, at your service. I am an envoy of the Numinous Equilibrium. I have been sent to defend those in need and help bri

paragon-renowned-kai-sha.zh:
扫描显示，这个女人的斗篷里隐藏着许多令人震惊的武器。我们找不到任何关于她存在的官方记录，但面部识别算法显示她至少参与了三起备受关注的暗杀。

请允许我省去那些繁文缛节。你是个聪明人，知道宇宙中危机四伏，其中的许多甚至目不可及。只要出个好价钱，我就能让你一窥究竟。
paragon-renowned-kai-sha.en:
Scans show that the woman's cloak conceals a truly shocking array of weaponry. We cannot find any official record of her existence, yet facial-recognition algorithms place her in the vicinity of at least three high-profile assassinations.

Allow me to dispense

paragon-renowned-nasuz-demetor.zh:
这位男子形如枯骨，饱经风霜：他精美的服饰几乎褪色殆尽，他的皮肤如羊皮纸般干燥粗糙，他的嗓音近乎低语。

吾名为纳苏兹·德墨忒尔。吾身为纤尘与迷思所化。感谢您接纳我。
paragon-renowned-nasuz-demetor.en:
The man is thin to the point of starvation. There is a sense of decrepitude about him: his fine clothes are faded, his skin as dry as parchment, and his voice rises barely above a whisper.

My name is Nasuz Demetor. I am a collector of dust and myth. Thank you

paragon-renowned-qla-minder.zh:
这位外星人的皮肤闪烁着粘稠的分泌物。他煞费苦心地深鞠了一躬。但当他一开口，声调却像孩子一样出奇地尖细。

这位大人，欧！至高无上的统治者。我，看守人喀·拉，只是您卑微的仆人。您的每句话都是命令。让我管理一颗你的星球，我会给您带来荣耀和财富。啊，那么多的财富！
paragon-renowned-qla-minder.en:
The alien's skin glistens with viscous secretions. He bows elaborately from the waist. When he speaks, his voice is surprisingly high pitched, almost childlike.

My lord, Your Honor, Oh! Supreme ruler - I, Q'la-Minder, am but your humble servant. Your word sha

paragon-renowned-shuladun.zh:
这位外星人被包裹在一个咯咯作响的生命维持装置中。浓稠的液体从管子和通风口流过，他的话语变成了一种潮湿的汩汩声。

你们的工厂太差劲了吧。
paragon-renowned-shuladun.en:
The alien is encased in a gurgling life-support unit. Thick fluid sloshes through the tubes and vents, causing his speech to emerge in a wet gurgle.

Your industrial plants are a disgrace.

paragon-renowned-ulastar.zh:
这位外星人一动不动。

命运指引着我的每一步。我穿越了无边的黑暗来到你的面前。我是神谕者尤拉斯塔尔。
paragon-renowned-ulastar.en:
The alien is motionless.

Fate guides my steps. I have crossed the blind reaches to stand before you. I am Ulastar, the Oracle.

paragon-renowned-uld-dagr.zh:
这位外星人身着华丽和繁复的长袍。尽管年事已高，但他的双眼仍旧警觉，透出敏锐的智慧。

向您致敬。我想作为一个和平卫士为您服务。
paragon-renowned-uld-dagr.en:
The alien is adorned in rich, intricate robes. Despite his obvious age, his eyes are alert and betray a keen intellect.

Salutations. I come to offer my services as a keeper of peace.

paragon-renowned-vas-the-gilded.zh:
这位女士的服饰和珠宝让人对其生活的奢华窥见一斑。她轻轻一鞠躬后开口说道，

我愿意作为一位总督和一位外交官而效劳。让我成为你的盟友，我能让你在星系的任何一个角落都找到强大的友邦。
paragon-renowned-vas-the-gilded.en:
The Sister's clothing and jewelry offer a glimpse into her opulent lifestyle. She bows before speaking.

I offer my services as a governor, and as a diplomat. Make me your ally and I will ensure you have powerful friends, in every corner of the galaxy.

paragon-renowned-vyctor-jariden.zh:
男爵身材魁梧。他身上的一切都散发着严格的军旅气息：靴子一尘不染，制服熨得整整齐齐，他的眼神机警而富于计谋。但在严格的外表之外，还有别的东西：他的脸上写满了哀伤。

我可以作为一个舰队司令和战术家为您服务。

接受我的效忠，我就会粉碎那些可能伤害到你的人。
paragon-renowned-vyctor-jariden.en: The Baron is of imposing stature. Everything about him radiates rigid military discipline. His boots are spotless, his uniform neatly pressed, and his eyes are watchful and calculating. But beyond the strict facade, there is something else: his face is a map o

paragon-renowned-zosira-ktun.zh:
这位科学家全神贯注地看着手中的输入板，手指对着按键上下纷飞。她哼着欢快的旋律，似乎对工作心无旁骛。一个小型机器人同伴漂浮在她旁边的空中，它发出叽叽喳喳的声音，磕了一下她的肩膀。她倏然抬起头。

啊，对不起。你好！我是佐西拉。很抱歉打扰你们，那个，我之前的实验室相当于是，爆炸了。

小机器人又叽叽喳喳了起来。

啊所以，那个，我是说，我想要找一个地方能让我继续作曲。
paragon-renowned-zosira-ktun.en: The scientist is focused on a tablet in her hand. As her fingers dance over the keys, she hums a cheerful melody. She seems lost in her work and oblivious to the world. A small robot companion floats in the air next to her; it chirps and bumps her shoulder. Sh

event-action-96.zh:
自从我们意识到自己不是寰宇之中的孤独之身后，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。随着星系的边境线被不断刷新，旧的商路也不断重绘，星际领袖们同意应该使这种贸易市场合法化，让大家都可从中受益。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如果该贸易中心坐落于[Root.GetAdj]境内，一定会使我们受益，因此我们可以宣传我们的一颗星球作为位置候选。
event-action-96.en: De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is

event-anomaly-6660.zh:
我们的科研船扫描了[From.GetName]的地表后发现了一些不寻常的现象。强烈的风暴无休止地袭击着[From.GetPlanetMoon]，这对我们的资源开发以及研究都有帮助，但却会限制人口发展。

在探索新行星的时候，我们当然会遭遇一些诸如此类的不测，而我们不应低估它对我们的扩张带来的影响。
event-anomaly-6660.en: As our Science Ship scans the surface of [From.GetName] it becomes quite clear that we have found something out of the ordinary. Strong storms ravage the [From.GetPlanetMoon] constantly, which can aid our resources and research but will be an obstacle for our

event-cstorms-1770.zh:
[this.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]们观察到重力风暴对当地野生鸟类带来了严重的影响。

风暴带来的重力波动导致了异常的大气条件，让许多鸟类物种无法飞行。
event-cstorms-1770.en:
The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] on [this.GetName] have observed harsh repercussions of the Gravity Storm on the local avian wildlife.

The gravitational fluctuations brought on by the storm are leading to erratic atmospheric conditions, rendering several specie

event-distar-135.zh:
[Root.GetStarName]星系是个充满了机械残骸的墓地，星系的恒星周围遍布着无数的舰船遗骸。多如繁星的燃料罐和液态冷却剂干扰着我们的探测器，与行星相撞的众多空间站废墟绕着星系的恒星运转着。

在这片机械废墟中，有一个巨大的机器显得与众不同，那是一个比我们最大的战列舰还要大的自动化机器人，它由数千个舰船残骸拼装在一起。[Root.GetName]报告说这个拾荒机器人在废墟中专门搜索有用的部件并将其添加到自己身上。

显然一场规模惊人的战役曾在这里爆发，但我们不清楚这个拾荒机器人是那场战争的幸存者还是从遥远地
event-distar-135.en: The [Root.GetStarName] system is a sprawling graveyard of mechanical debris. The wreckage of untold numbers of derelict ships circle its star. Swathes of fuel and liquid coolant cloud our sensors like ghosts, and creaking station remnants collide with the shat

event-fallen-empires-awakening-4.zh: 远古失落帝国的碎片[assimilated_fe.GetName]被原主脑的一个更加强势的分支吸收。也许这对它是最好的结局。
event-fallen-empires-awakening-4.en: The ancient Fallen Empire Fragment, [assimilated_fe.GetName] has been assimilated by a more dominant aspect of the former overmind. Perhaps it was for the best.

event-fircon-3505.zh:
我们被困在虫洞里面太久了。但等等！终于，上天的恩赐帮助我们我们突破了施加于身上的桎梏。我们终于通过了考验。星系的其他地区都在等待着我们去征服。

不要反抗。从长远来看，这样会更好。
event-fircon-3505.en:
For too long have we been trapped behind the wormhole. But behold! Finally, we have breached the restrictions placed upon us by our celestial heritage. Now, at last, we know we are worthy. The rest of the galaxy is ours to claim.

Do not resist. It will be bet

event-first-contact-385.zh:
一部分也要感谢[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常渴望与我们建立联系，他们发送了大量的视听讯号并成为了翻译他们语言的关键，我们的翻译工蜂因而可以发表一个惊人的发现：这些外星人似乎是以个体而不是蜂巢思维的形式组织起来的。他们似乎可以极少的任何集体投入行动。最令人困惑的是，他们经常协作不良，并且似乎对其他工蜂正在做的事毫不知情。

我们尚未明白他们是如何在足够的智力水平下运作以发展到太空航行的地步。也许他们的背后仍有某种关联，但其中的子个体仅仅是比我们所了解的那样更加地独立自主？
event-first-contact-385.en: Thanks in part to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] apparently being quite eager to establish communications with us - having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language - our translation drones are ab

event-first-contact-critters-1.zh: 我们收到了来源不明的读数。这些信号似乎遵循着某种重复的句法，证明其来源应为智慧生物。我们应进一步研究它。它们似乎集中在一个空间站附近，但尚不清楚这个空间站是不是一个更大的太空文明的一部分。
event-first-contact-critters-1.en: We have picked up readings of unknown nature. The signals seem to follow some kind of repeating syntax which could indicate sapient origin. It should be investigated further. They seem to be concentrated around a single space station, though it is unclear whet

event-first-contact-critters-10.zh: 长程扫描仪获取了[This.System.GetName]恒星系中的数据，对其的解析几乎说明它是一个巨大热源。这非常值得研究。
event-first-contact-critters-10.en: Long range scanners have picked up readings in the [This.System.GetName] system that could best be described as giant heat blobs. It's worth investigating.

event-first-contact-critters-100.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]星系遭遇的舰队与我们此前在此区域见到的任何东西都不一样。它没有表现出攻击性，但我们眼下只能猜测它的起源或目的。我们最有把握的猜测是，该舰队代表的派别与任何地方当局或文明都没有正式联系。
event-first-contact-critters-100.en: The fleet we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system is unlike any we've seen in this region of space before. It does not appear to be aggressive, but we can only speculate as to its origin or purpose here. Our best guess is that the fleet represents a

event-first-contact-critters-50.zh:
尽管他们生活在居住站上的事实暗示了他们很可能是一个先进的社会，然而[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]不能肯定我们是不是真的在和一种智慧生命形式打交道：他们似乎无时不刻在展现敌意，这对于一个稳定的社会而言是不可想象的：即便在我们短暂的调查期间也展现了数次纯粹的野蛮行为。

他们看起来具有语言，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]仍在努力解析当中，以便我们在未来能够理解他们的行为。
event-first-contact-critters-50.en: Although their dwellings on habitat stations would suggest an advanced society, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] is unsure whether we are indeed dealing with an intelligent lifeform: they seem unremittingly hostile, so much so that a stable society

event-first-contact-critters-60.zh: 我们在[This.System.GetName]遇到的舰船似乎有点过时，但仍然武装到了牙齿。这些舰船应该是有人驾驶的，但对任何靠近的物体都展现了敌意。有必要谨慎应对……
event-first-contact-critters-60.en: The vessels we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be somewhat outmoded, but nevertheless armed to the teeth. They seem to be piloted by sentient crews but respond with hostility to any approach. We will have to treat them with caution.

event-first-contact-critters-70.zh:
在[This.System.GetName]星系中探测到的舰船似乎正在进行某种横跨星系的远征，这种生活方式对我们自己的族群而言并不陌生。他们没有表现出任何敌意，而是不断向我们方向重复广播信号。

看到一个族群将家园安于星海之间而非任何星球之上，这种景象令人感到几分莫名的亲切。我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]迫切希望能够进一步了解这些同为旅人的族群。
event-first-contact-critters-70.en:
The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be on some kind of expedition across the galaxy, a way of life our own people know well. They have made no hostile moves, broadcasting repetitive signals in our direction instead.

There is som

event-first-contact-critters-90.zh: 在[This.System.GetName]恒星系中侦测到的舰队似乎是某种目的不明的跨星系远航舰队的一部分。他们没有采取任何有敌意的举动，也没有任何显而易见的重型武器。然而他们似乎完全缄默不语，我们无法从他们当中获取任何信号。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们可以从我们拾获的只言片语中翻译他们的语言，当然这可能要花好长时间。
event-first-contact-critters-90.en: The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be part of some sort of expedition across the galaxy, with purposes unknown. They have not made any hostile moves, nor is there any heavy weaponry in evidence. However, they have been fairly clos

event-galactic-features-421.zh:
我们在[From.From.From.GetName]星系内遭遇了某种极为强大的亚空间实体。它似乎没有敌意，对传统飞行器或许甚至没有完全察觉，但它的存在使得[From.From.From.GetName]整个恒星系中出现了强烈的亚空间扰动。

这些扰动位于实体自身周围，在它离开恒星系后应该也会消失。它对我们的致意没有回复，但这个实体一直在发射模式复杂，似乎是某种语言的快子流。如果我们的翻译软件正确的话，它一遍又一遍说的是：

“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”
event-galactic-features-421.en: An extremely powerful subspace entity of some kind has been encountered in the [From.From.From.GetName] system. It does not appear hostile and may not even be fully aware of conventional spacecraft, but its mere presence in [From.From.From.GetName] is causing

event-grand-archive-2051.zh:
我们已经铲除了一个虚空虫的母星系。

它们将无法再利用这些产卵地来抚育幼虫。
event-grand-archive-2051.en:
We have eradicated a Voidworm home system.

They will no longer be able to make use of these spawning grounds to raise their young.

event-nomads-3036.zh: 来自[pickup_planet.GetName]的外交使团已经登上了方舟舰，并正以符合[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]大使身份的礼遇规格受到接待。我们规划了一系列活动，包括方舟舰参观和关于我们生活方式的宣讲，以便让他们在前往[dropoff_planet.GetName]的旅途中过得愉快。
event-nomads-3036.en: The diplomatic delegation from [pickup_planet.GetName] has boarded the arkship and are being accommodated with all the respect due to ambassadors from the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName]. We have planned a schedule of activities including arkship tours and prese

event-nomads-3060.zh:
一个旅行团在[root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系登上了方舟舰，一边叽叽喳喳地聊着对旅途的期待一边踏入熙熙攘攘的舰船内舱。

我们订制了一条景色优美的路线，途经若干个值得一去的恒星系供他们游览。现在我们只需要交付好许诺给他们的美景就行了。
event-nomads-3060.en:
A group of tourists has boarded the Arkship in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system, chattering with anticipation as they take in the bustling interior of the vessel.

We have charted a scenic route through several remarkable systems for their enjoyment. Now

event-planet-destruction-600.zh:
[From.GetName]曾是圣地。


你们不明白你们犯下了多大的罪恶。


不过马上就会了。
event-planet-destruction-600.en:
[From.GetName] was a holy world.


You do not know the true extent of your sin.


Not yet.

event-shroud-4190.zh:
此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。这种称为“灵能光环”的能量流，由于其来源还未理论上确证，我们还不能确定其是否构成威胁。

这种光环现在也在[from.GetName]恒星系内探测到了，如果它继续蔓延有可能会侵犯我们的边境。
event-shroud-4190.en: Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Termed 'Psionic Auras', on the basis of unconfirmed theories about their sourc

event-shroud-60.zh: 在接管[from.GetName]恒星系时，我们发现并随后拆解了可压制我等灵能光环的机械装置。
event-shroud-60.en: In taking control of the [from.GetName] system, we have discovered and subsequently dismantled machines capable of suppressing our Psionic Aura.

event-story-220.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]观测到大量晶状生命体的出现。这很明显是某种巢穴——或者至少是晶状生命体的聚集地，就如在[From.GetName]有一个我们从未见过的晶状结构。

这个结构展现出了很多类似晶状生命体的性质，但它的体积大得吓人。
event-story-220.en:
We see significant crystalline presence in the [From.GetName] system. Evidently some kind of den - or at least a hub of crystalline activity, such as it is - [From.GetName] is home to a crystal construct unlike any previously encountered.

This construct exhib

event-strange-worlds-1045.zh:
由于轨道上存在着许多太空垃圾和小型轨道碎片，我们在[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]的环境改造工程师正在面临着危险的工作环境。其极大的数量给穿梭机在地表和轨道间往回航行带来了危险。

由于这些物体的密度极高，我们起早了一份，将其中最大的一些碎片进行磁化，使其在轨道上吸引其他的碎片，最后逐渐整合成一个更便于管理的整体。我们任务应该能制造出一颗人工卫星。

虽然这将增加环境改造的时间，但它将大大方便穿梭车进入地表，并消除大型轨道碎片频繁进入行星大气的风险。
event-strange-worlds-1045.en: Our terraforming engineers on [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] are facing hazardous working conditions due to various pieces of space junk and minor debris orbiting the planet. The high volume of these objects pose a navigational danger for shuttles tra

origin_common_ground.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。他们从彼此的差异中汲取力量，不久后便决定要共同面对未来可能发生的一切。
origin_common_ground.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.

origin_necrophage.zh: 这一文明演化出了一种异养于其他智慧生命形态的寄生体。当它踏入星系舞台时，其他的物种或是被视作侍徒而带入他们的行列，要么就成为他们的食物。在食尸者面前，没有第三种选择。
origin_necrophage.en: This civilization evolved as a parasite, forced to feed off other sapient life forms to sustain itself. As it arrives on the galactic stage, other species will either be brought into the fold, or become its food. For the necrophage, there can be no other way.

origin_tree_of_life.zh: 这一蜂巢思维与一棵巨型树木间进化出了共生关系。这棵巨树赋予了他们许多益处，但失去这棵树将会把他们摧垮。
origin_tree_of_life.en: This Hive evolved in a symbiotic relationship with a vast Tree. The Tree grants them many benefits, but its loss would cripple them.

shroudwalkers-depart.zh: 学徒们，虚境宣昭了警告。巨大的危机近在眼前，整个星系都处在毁灭的边缘。我们的预知显示，我们自身的力量无法匹配即将到来的威胁。与其被毁灭，我们现在将灌输给你们最后一课：所有的幻梦都有苏醒之时。我们离开这个世界的时刻已经到了。尽管虚境十分黑暗，飘忽不定，我们最终将会升往一个新的位面，一个新的世界，在那里继续传播我们的教义。我们将离开这个星系，将它的命运交付给你。希望我们以往的功课能在必要之时为你提供指引。
shroudwalkers-depart.en: Apprentices, the Shroud has given warning. A moment of great crisis is at hand, and the galaxy stands on the brink of ruin. Our divinations have shown we are no match for the coming threat. Rather than be destroyed, we now impart our final lesson: every dream

enclave-leader-departure.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你已经涉足了自己无法理解的力量。谨言慎行，学会安于当下，因为在你选择的道路上，未来只会带来痛苦。”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.GetHisHer]雇员们的离开对政府运作造成了很大的干扰。
enclave-leader-departure.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"You have meddled with powers you cannot possibly comprehend. Tread carefully, and take wha

event-colony-mod-4.zh: [Root.GetName]的居民正在见证一出壮观的景象。一颗彗星正在经过[Root.GetName]的行星环带，效果被形容为“惊心动魄”。
event-colony-mod-4.en: The population of [Root.GetName] are currently witnessing a spectacular sight. A comet is passing through [Root.GetName]'s asteroid belt and the effect is being described as "magnificent."

event-marauder-511.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是被[great_khan.GetHerHis]手下一位有野心的领主毒杀而死。

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[raider_khanate.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主刀兵相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的继承权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
event-marauder-511.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are scarce at this point, but intercepted communications indicate that the Great Khan was poisoned by one of [great_khan.GetHerHis] more ambitious warlords in an attempted coup.

event-paragon-100.zh: [beholder_planet.GetName]上的金字塔已不复存在，原地留下了一个巨大的空洞。当地的未开智生物满脸困惑地站在空洞的峭壁边上。
event-paragon-100.en: The Monolith on [beholder_planet.GetName] has vanished, leaving a giant crater in its wake. The pre-sapient inhabitants line the precipice, seemingly confused.

origin_default.zh: 通过斗争和胜利，这个社会已经实现了每一个年轻文明的抱负：一个有着统一目标的家园，一条通向璀璨繁星的道路。
origin_default.en: Through its strife and triumphs, this society has reached every young civilization's ambition: a homeworld with unified goals, and a path open to the stars.

origin_default_nomads.zh: 对于这个文明而言，旅程本身就是目的。他们放弃了永久性定居点，选择在巨大的方舟舰上生活，载着他们的人民、工业和雄心壮志穿越星海。
origin_default_nomads.en: For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.

origin_hegemon.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。经过他们在长达一个世纪的时间里的逐步策划，一个他们于其中具有支配地位的星际联盟就此诞生。
origin_hegemon.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they masterminded the birth of an interstellar union in which they would have a dominant role.

origin_life_seeded.zh: 这一文明的家园如同天堂，也许是专为他们打造的。
origin_life_seeded.en: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.

origin_lithoid.zh: 并非其“母星”的原住民，这些石质生物随一颗坠入该行星的陨石到来，同时杀死了大多数土著生命。
origin_lithoid.en: Not native to their 'homeworld', these Lithoids arrived when a meteorite slammed into the planet and killed off most of the native life.

origin_lost_colony.zh: 这一文明起源于一处遭人遗忘的失落的殖民星，许久前便同其母星分隔。殖民者们挣扎求生，挨过了千辛万苦，终于建立了必需的技术及工业基础，足以供他们重返太空。
origin_lost_colony.en: This civilization originated as a lost and forgotten colony, separated from its homeworld long ago. The struggling colonists endured many hardships before they could build up the necessary technological and industrial base that would allow for a return to spac

origin_machine.zh: 这一机械智能早已将母星系中的所有资源统合到了他们的首都星球，将其完全以机械覆盖。
origin_machine.en: This Machine Intelligence has long-since consolidated all resources in their home system into their capital world, covering it entirely with machinery.

origin_mechanists.zh: 这一文明自蒸汽时代早期便醉心于金属制自动机器人的理念。尽管许多人认为不可能做到，早在初步的太空航行前第一台真正的机器人就已从装配线下线。
origin_mechanists.en: This civilization has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.

origin_ocean_machines.zh: 自这个机械文明诞生伊始他们就深潜于水下王国，享受着物产丰富的环境，不受任何自然的挑战。
origin_ocean_machines.en: Since its creation, this machine civilization has delved deep into the underwater realms of an abundant ocean untouched by natural adversaries.

origin_ocean_paradise.zh: 自这个文明诞生伊始他们就享受着物产丰富、无忧无虑的环境，使其能够不受阻碍地发展繁荣。
origin_ocean_paradise.en: Since its birth, this civilization has enjoyed peace in a generous environment with no natural enemies, enabling unhindered growth and opulence.

origin_overtuned.zh: 这个文明不择手段地增强自己的有机体，无论风险，无论成本。毕竟，与其在沉默中消亡，不如光鲜亮丽地燃烧殆尽。
origin_overtuned.en: This civilization uses any and all means of organic enhancement, no matter the risk, no matter the cost. After all, it is better to burn out brightly than fade away into obscurity.

origin_post_apocalyptic.zh: 历经核子烈焰的考验，这一文明曾面临全面灭绝的威胁——又最终死里逃生。虽经毁灭却仍为一体，他们在旧世界的灰烬之上重建了文明。
origin_post_apocalyptic.en: Baptized by nuclear fire, this civilization has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of their old world.

origin_post_apocalyptic_machines.zh: 在一场毁灭性的核灾难之后，这些机器就成为这个一度繁荣的文明的唯一幸存者。通过继续履行其原定的目标，它们从旧世界的不适宜居住的灰烬中逐渐重建起一个新的社会。
origin_post_apocalyptic_machines.en: In the aftermath of a devastating nuclear disaster, these machines emerged as the sole survivors of a once-flourishing civilization. By continuing to fulfill their designated purpose, they gradually rebuilt society from the uninhabitable ashes of their old wor

origin_shattered_ring.zh: 这一文明生活在未知先驱们建造的环形世界之中。一经理解及修复完好，他们将获得巨大的力量。
origin_shattered_ring.en: This civilization inhabits a Ring World built by unknown forerunners. If it can be understood and fully repaired it will grant them great power.

origin_subterranean.zh: 这个物种也许永远也不会知道自己的祖先为什么会迁移到地表以下。这究竟是出于一种自我保存的必要，或是为了追寻资源的富足？不管其目的为何，他们都成功地适应了环境，造就了一个对环境要求更加灵活的社会。
origin_subterranean.en: This civilization may never know why their ancestors migrated below the surface. Was it necessary to ensure self-preservation, or did the promise of bountiful resources allure them? Whatever the case, they successfully adapted, leading to a more environmentall

origin_subterranean_machines.zh: 该这明已经完美地融入了地下的存在，其最初的驱动力或是是某种经过深思熟虑的自我保护，或是某种在深处寻找隐藏的丰富资源的指令。由此产生的机械适应性早已挖掘出了一个多功能且坚定不移的机器社群。
origin_subterranean_machines.en: This civilization has flawlessly integrated into subterranean existence, initially driven by either calculated self-preservation or a directive to locate of hidden, abundant resources in the depths. The resulting mechanical adaptations have unearthed a versati

origin_syncretic_evolution.zh: 一种第二物种形成了这个文明密不可分的一部分。它们高大健壮，又大都只有相当于格外愚钝的孩童的智力。古老的战争剔除了它们物种具有的最富攻击性的倾向，使其如今相当顺从。
origin_syncretic_evolution.en: A second species forms an integral part of this civilization. They are big, strong, and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servil

origin_void_dwellers.zh: 这一文明自有记录以来便以太空为家——其对典型行星环境下的生活深恶痛绝。他们生活在几个轨道居住站上，直至近期才联合一统。
origin_void_dwellers.en: This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.

origin_void_machines.zh: 起初，这个机器文明的创造者是将它们设计用于外太空旅行的、完全按照在零重力环境下流畅工作进行的优化。在经历数个纪元的孤立之后，这些机器最近重新在散布于它们母星系的数个轨道居住站之间团结了起来。
origin_void_machines.en: At first, the creators of this machine civilization designed them for eternal space travel, fully optimizing them to function seamlessly in zero gravity environments. After enduring eons of isolation, these machines have recently restored unity among the orbit

anomaly-storms-prec-one.zh: 在这个星系中我们截获了一系列怪异的电磁信号。初步数据分析表明这些发报器也许有数千年的历史。我们的船员渴望找到它的源头。
anomaly-storms-prec-one.en: We've picked up a series of strange electronic signals inside this system. Preliminary data shows these transmissions might be thousands of years old. Our crew is keen to find their origin.

event-colony-10000.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的边远农业站上发回了报告。许多[Owner.GetFarmerPlural]无缘无故失踪了，除了周围的土壤上留下了巨大的脚印外，他们的家园没有受到任何影响。

这些痕迹不符合任何在此前行星调查中发现的东西：四足、宽趾、有爪的脚印，其深度足以说明来自一种相当大的生物。殖民者担心我们可能遇到了未知的捕食者。
event-colony-10000.en:
Reports have come in from our outlying agricultural stations on [Root.GetName]. Several [Owner.GetFarmerPlural] have vanished without a trace, their homesteads eerily undisturbed, save for the appearance of immense footprints in the surrounding soil.

The trac

event-utopia-2500.zh:
我们现在拥有制造义体植入体的科技，和进行批量安装的能力。整个[Root.GetName]的医疗中心已准备好为我们的公民进行手术移植。

未来，拥有植入体和至少入门级别的义体将是我们在建的科技社会运作的必须条件。因此加装基础义体装束的过程对公民来说是强制性的和免费的。
event-utopia-2500.en:
We now possess both the technology to make advanced cybernetic implants and the means to mass-produce them. Medical centers throughout the [Root.GetName] are standing by to begin the surgical grafting process on our citizens.

In the future, possessing neural

event-colony-3005.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的偏远地区发现了一个只能被认是位面传送门的东西。天气预报算法发现了奇怪的气流，最终被认为是大气从传送门轻微泄漏造成的。大气流失的速度十分缓慢，对[Root.GetName]上的生活不会造成什么影响。但这个传送门的存在引起了一些令人担忧的问题，比如它通向哪里，以及会不会有什么东西从传送门另一侧穿过来？
event-colony-3005.en: What can only be described as a dimensional portal has been discovered in a remote location on [Root.GetName]. Weather prediction algorithms noticed a strange air current, which was eventually determined to be caused by the slight leakage of atmosphere into th

event-terra-10.zh: 在完成[From.GetName]的环境改造之后，我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]注意到了一个黄金的机遇。剩下的环境改造设备经过调整改造后可以作为这个行星的基础设施。
event-terra-10.en: After completing the terraforming of [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have spotted a golden opportunity. The remaining terraforming equipment can potentially be repurposed as infrastructure for the planet.

rift-siege-on-paradise.zh:
我们来到了一个欣欣向荣的行星。从茂密的森林到青翠的平原，这里的景色曾经丰富多彩，维护得一尘不染，一个生机勃勃的星球花园。

一个身份不明的植物类物种在半有机城市周围修建了大量防御设施。对当地恒星系统的扫描显示，这里被装备精良的战舰封锁。虽然没有发生冲突，但很明显，冲突正在酝酿之中。
rift-siege-on-paradise.en:
We arrived on a thriving planet. From its dense forests to the verdant plains, the landscape was at once diverse and immaculately maintained - a vibrant and planet-wide garden.

An unidentified plantoid species has erected extensive fortifications around the s

event-colony-9200.zh:
在一次对[Root.GetName]的例行探索中，行星探索单位发现了一座巨大的大门，其后很可能具有整座大山规模的内部空间。看来是其中隐形装置发出的某种强磁场导致飞船的探测器没有发现这里，而伪装过的大门也让使其对地表测绘探测器隐形了。

另一方面，更专门的测试显示，向其输入稳定的能量流应该可以让大门重新激活，最终也让我们得以一窥其后的秘密。
event-colony-9200.en: During a standard reconnaissance of [Root.GetName], the planetary exploration unit came across a massive door that apparently leads directly into the interior of a mountain range. It appears that the strong magnetic field produced by some sort of cloaking devi

event-unrest-50.zh: [Root.GetName]上的群众对我们的统治已经不满有一段时间了。现在他们的反抗甚至变得更为不加掩饰，并且不满分子已经公开呼吁要从[Root.Owner.GetName]独立。如果我们还想维持对这个殖民地的控制力，展现一次权威的力量是有必要的。
event-unrest-50.en: The populace of [Root.GetName] has been discontent with our rule for some time now. Now their defiance is becoming ever more brazen, and dissidents are openly calling for independence from the [Root.Owner.GetName]. A show of authority may be necessary if we ar

event-arkship-700.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的人工智能核心检测到异常活动。初步诊断结果显示，在现有的安全参数下，该情况在结构上被认为是不可能发生的。

该核心正试图同时执行互斥的指令。这种行为违背了人工智能发展史中所有已知的先例。我们所见证的并非故障，而是一种人工智能的进化。

若不予解决，这种分裂可能会导致我们的关键系统面临不稳定的风险。但如果引导得当，这可能是一个千载难逢的机会，能够为方舟舰的未来确立一个独特的准则。
event-arkship-700.en:
Unusual activity has been detected in the AI core aboard Arkship [Root.GetName]. Initial diagnostics returned an outcome considered structurally impossible under existing failsafe parameters.

The core was attempting to execute conflicting directives simultane

event-utopia-2550.zh:
是时候抛弃那些自我们物种被孕育以来囚禁我们心智的粗糙有机身躯了。

经过许多的尝试与犯错后，我们的科学家设计了一种方法，能将的意识装入一个合成大脑中。现在要做的就是为[Root.GetName]的每一位公民量身打造合成身躯，随后开始大规模地上传我们的意识。
event-utopia-2550.en:
The time has finally come to discard the crude organic vessels that have imprisoned our minds since the dawn of our species.

After much trial and error, our scientists have devised a way to transfer a consciousness into a synthetic brain. All that remains is

event-utopia-50.zh:
科学枢纽的理事会激动地发表声明，宣称他们将提供一次难得的机会以招募广受赞誉的科学家艾克斯哈索尔博士，这是一个在寿命延长领域享誉已久的名字。

他和他的团队研发的一种证实有良好寿命延长能力的血清已经到了研究的最终阶段，但此时他们已经花光了科研经费。然而招募艾克斯哈索尔博士意味着我们没有足够的资源以继续我们现行的，一项由葛洛亦克博士领导的有关有机工程的研究。她现在正试图把工程学研究与一台有机超级计算机串流。
event-utopia-50.en:
The board of the Science Nexus are thrilled to announce that they have been given a unique opportunity to recruit widely acclaimed researcher Dr. Xhaxxore, a prominent name within the field of life-extension.

He and his staff were in the final stages of devel

anomaly-ancrel-mechano-cat.zh: 这颗行星两极之间的所有表面均被锈迹斑斑的古老机械所覆盖，而这些机械中的大部分包裹着一种不明的有机组织。如此技术奇观是出自什么样的生物之手？他们又发生了什么？
anomaly-ancrel-mechano-cat.en: This planet is covered from pole to pole in rusting, ancient machinery, much of which is itself covered in an unidentified, organic tissue. What manner of creatures could have built this technological curiosity, and what happened to them?

event-federations3-2100.zh:
驶入[event_target:leylines_world.GetName]大气层的短程飞船报告，称其舰体上有奇怪的声音。声音的来源似乎在行星的地表之下，其所在地区富含稀有矿物。

我们在[from.Federation.GetName]的同事监督的星球也报告过类似事件。为应对此事，他们组成了一个由[event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName]领导的委员会，负责协调我们都想要参与的挖掘工作。
event-federations3-2100.en:
Short-range vessels whose routes take them into the atmosphere of [event_target:leylines_world.GetName] report a strange sound assaulting their hulls. The source seems to lie just below the planet's surface, in an area rich in unusual minerals.

Similar occurr

event-preftl-espionage-2.zh:
我们在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上一位名叫[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]的间谍首脑叛变了！这个笨蛋似乎是被一个[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]迷住了，他们两个私奔到了[rogue_agent_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的某个地方。

现在我们还不知道这位间谍首脑是已经向[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]爱人坦白了[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHe
event-preftl-espionage-2.en: Our Spymaster on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName], [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], has gone rogue! The poor, misguided fool has apparently been smitten by a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName], and the two of them have eloped to parts unknown on the [rogue_agent

event-specialist-1100.zh:
在搜索我们控制的星系时，我们的一架无人机从[prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]获取了一些零散的读数。这个星系可能藏着什么我们意想不到的东西。

尽管信号混杂在一起，但它们可能暗示了几种不同的来源，我们的无人机很难同时搜索所有这些信号源。我们希望能够调查：
event-specialist-1100.en:
While scouring the systems under our control, one of our drones picked up on a few scattered readings from [prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]. There might be more to this system than we originally thought.

Mixed as the signals were, they could be

situation-leviathan-celebration-opportun.zh: 在击败了[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]之后，我们认为在[Target.GetName]上举办一场以我们收获的[Root.GetTrophyName]为主题的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]对我们的帝国多有裨益。
situation-leviathan-celebration-opportun.en: After defeating the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName], we believe that a [Owner.GetParadeStudy] on [Target.GetName] focusing on the [Root.GetTrophyName] we secured would be very beneficial to our empire.

event-arkship-1300.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的高级工程队提交了一份结构评估报告，该报告呼吁已不能再拖延。我们的家园急需修缮。

该提案是全面的：分段轮流大修，从发电基础设施开始，然后依次进行耕作甲板、防御区和居住区。居民需要暂时搬迁。设施将停止运行。工程估算显示，根据工作进度，全面检修大约需要十到十一个标准年。

这项工作将具有破坏性。但另一种选择是，这艘船每经过一个秒差距，可靠性就会降低一分。
event-arkship-1300.en:
The senior engineering corps aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] has submitted a structural assessment that can no longer be deferred. Our home is in critical need of repair.

The proposal is comprehensive: a rotating section-by-section overhaul, beginning with the

event-colony-1520.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]建立了殖民地，当地的一些植物在释放大量含有复杂化学成分的花粉。

为此准备了一项特别研究计划，来研究这种植物。
event-colony-1520.en:
Several plants native to [Root.GetName], where we recently established a colony, exude copious amounts of a pollen with an astounding chemical complexity.

A special research project has been prepared for further study of this flora.

event-federations2-50.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]在我国的明智领导下繁荣昌盛。许多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]如今感到是时候因我们为盟友提供的服务获得回报了，我们将举办一场团结盛典——更确切地说，是为向联邦无私奉献的伟大[Root.GetAdj]领袖们举办的盛典。他们提议各成员国合作在[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空中树立一道丰碑，于此同时，我们将派遣代表团前往两个成员国的首都，协助他们为[Root.Federation.GetName]带来更多的凝聚力。
event-federations2-50.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName] has prospered under the wise leadership of our nation. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] now feel that it is time for our services to the alliance to be paid back with a celebration of its unity - and more specifically, the great [

event-situation-200.zh: 优先事项：使用防辐射技术以保护无人机部件，以对抗辐射。
event-situation-200.en: Priority: employ radiation-hardening techniques to shield drone components, making them impervious to radiation.

site-site-georadiation-terraforming.zh:
我们的传感器检测到一个从[from.Planet.GetName]的撞击坑深处发出的异常通讯信号。

震波拓扑扫描显示存在一个地下洞穴网络，其塌陷的洞口正在撞击坑中心。与此同时，我们的放射仪探测到从该地点发出的微弱的引力辐射痕迹，这带来的问题比答案更多。
site-site-georadiation-terraforming.en:
Our sensors have detected an irregular communications signal emanating from deep within an impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName].

Seismic topology scans reveal a network of subterranean caverns with a collapsed entrance at the center of the crater. Alongside

anomaly-con-biology-cat.zh: 这颗微型行星上的森林预示着有趣的发现。
anomaly-con-biology-cat.en: The forests on this planetoid bear promises of interesting finds.

event-diplomatic-1000.zh:
指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]制定了一个舰队演习计划，这将涉及到我们相当部分的海军。[exercise_admiral.GetSheHe]为这场演习选择的地点是[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系，靠近[exercise_neighbor.GetName]的边界。

[exercise_neighbor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]或许会将这次演习视作一种挑衅，但是如果我们取消演习，我们的军队会认为我们过于软弱。毕竟，[exercise_system.G
event-diplomatic-1000.en: Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] has drawn up plans for a major fleet exercise that will involve a substantial portion of our navy. The location [exercise_admiral.GetSheHe] [exercise_admiral.GetHasHave] chosen for these maneuvers is the [exercise_system.Ge

event-machine-age-4000.zh: 机械体的被动迭代已经得出了其合乎逻辑的必然结论。一个由创新激发、由机遇推动的变革时代即将到来。
event-machine-age-4000.en: The passive iteration of the mechanical body has come to its logical and inevitable conclusion. A transformative age is upon us, sparked by innovation and oiled by opportunity.

event-observation-100.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站的一位科学家失踪了。[missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap]先前正在执行秘密任务，收集[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitt]地表的植物样本，但是并没有和[missing_scientist.GetHisHer]团队的其他成员一起返回穿梭机。

我们进行了有限的探索，以免对[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]造成惊扰，但迄今为止成功的希望渺茫。
event-observation-100.en: One of the scientists working at the Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been reported missing. [missing_scientist.GetHeSheCap] [missing_scientist.GetWasWere] taking part in a covert mission to collect plant samples from the [pre_ftl_planet.

rift-cleaning-drones.zh:
这颗行星的大气中含有数量惊人的抗菌剂。

传感器显示附近没有任何有机生命的迹象。即使在微观层面上，它也已经被彻底化学清洁了。从一个遥远的洞穴传来了微弱的生物信号，但从这个距离来讲是不可能的。

我们目睹了几组机器人在空中巡逻。它们还没有对我们的存在作出反应。
rift-cleaning-drones.en:
This planet's atmosphere contains a staggering amount of antibacterial agents.

Sensors indicate zero signs of organic life in the immediate vicinity. Even on a microscopic level, it has been chemically removed. There is a faint biological reading emanating fr

rift-garden.zh:
我们来到了一间长满绿色藤蔓的房间。

带刺的荆棘几乎从每一个弯曲处张牙舞爪地伸出。

我们很快意识到这些生物有某种意图，或者至少是一种防御本能。

我们注意到大气中的氧含量异常高。我们推测，烧掉这些讨厌的东西将应该很容易。

另一方面，这也肯定会破坏我们本可以收集到的样本。我们观察到大量的毛茸茸的果实挂在茎上，这可以为我们提供对这种植物群的大量见解。
rift-garden.en:
We arrived in a chamber of writhing green vines.

Barbed thorns bite outward from nearly every bend and twist in their coils.

We quickly became aware that these organisms have some sort of intent about them, or at least a defensive instinct.

We have noted an

rift-windswept-planet.zh:
我们来到了一个被猛烈的狂风摧残着的星球。它的表面几乎是光秃秃的，悬崖和巨石被风化得很光滑。

乌云密布，天空一片漆黑，当闪电击中我们周围的地面时，明亮的气团猛烈地喷发出来。

我们应该尽快寻找避风的地方躲避即将来临的暴风雨。气象传感器显示，平流层高处的气流比较温和，我们可以在那里躲避危险的泪点。或者，附近有一个大洞穴也可以提供避难所。
rift-windswept-planet.en:
We have arrived on a planet battered by fierce, high-velocity winds. The surface is nearly bare, with its cliffs and boulders weathered smooth by the elements.

The skies above are dark with thunderous clouds and plumes of bright gas erupt violently as lightni

event-colony-1500.zh:
[Root.GetName]的卫星上有异动。

初步扫描显示一些古代科技已经被启动，或许是对我们的殖民行为作出的反应。

我们的几个顶级科学家非常想去调查一下这个卫星，并为此准备好了一项特殊研究项目。
event-colony-1500.en:
Something stirs on the moon of [Root.GetName].

Preliminary scans indicate that some ancient technology has become active, possibly as a response to our colonization efforts.

Several of our top scientists are eager to take a closer look at the moon, and have

event-colony-9000.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]遇到了奇怪的情况：我们显然定居到了某种巨大的两栖爬行动物身上，他们的骨质外壳由多种奇特的矿物构成。许多我们认为是当地岛屿的其实都是这种生物，我们的殖民者则将他们称为“尼玛”。

他们看起来人畜无害，由于我们并没有深入他们的外壳，他们应该几乎没注意到我们。
event-colony-9000.en: Our colony on [Root.GetName] has encountered an odd situation: we have apparently settled on the back of a gargantuan amphibian reptile, whose bony shell is formed of various exotic minerals. Most of what we thought were local islands have turned out to be the

event-espionage-2.zh:
一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新激活了。这件事关系到我们先前在[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]开展的行动，似乎是某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报。

信息细节上很含糊，但是这段代码携带了关于一个外星帝国关键政治人物情报的标记。

我方安全顾问确认这套代码不久前仍然可用，但代码的到期意味着外国势力介入的可能。况且我们也没有证据表明特工或是信息本身的是真是假。
event-espionage-2.en:
A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.

The message is light on d

event-paragon-549.zh: 我们伟大的[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]为国鞠躬尽瘁，享年[From.GetAge]岁。人们高呼，为了纪念这位领袖对[Root.GetName]的贡献，要举办一场盛大的追思仪式。这一盛事能将民众团结在一起，巩固我们的理念。
event-paragon-549.en: Our great [From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] has passed away at the age of [From.GetAge] while in service to our empire. The people clamor for a memorial service to honor this leader's contribution to the [Root.GetName]. A grand event will give everyone closure, a

event-situation-500.zh:
由于与太空垃圾发生意外碰撞，[gravity_well_station.GetName]已经偏离了最佳稳定运转轨道，现在正缓缓落入最近的黑洞。这一事故使得整个空间站陷入了危险，但同时也是一个绝佳的研究黑洞、虹吸大量暗物质的契机。

应急推进器已经就绪准备修正空间站的轨道。
event-situation-500.en: Due to an unexpected collision with a chunk of space debris, the [gravity_well_station.GetName] has deviated from its innermost stable circular orbit and is now slowly closing the distance towards the nearby black hole. While the accident puts the whole statio

rift-entangled-dark-matter.zh:
我们发现自己身处一张巨大的网中。能量沿着网格状的墙壁有节奏地噼啪作响。

一团浓缩的暗物质云悬浮在这张纠结的网的深处。半透明的卷须向外探测能量屏障，接触后会产生火花，然后反冲回来。幽灵般的粒子像有规律地运动着。且不论这团幽灵般的物质是什么，它对我们的存在是没有反应的。
rift-entangled-dark-matter.en:
We find ourselves inside of an enormous mesh. Energy crackles rhythmically along its gridlike walls.

A concentrated cloud of dark matter is suspended deep within this tangled web. Translucent tendrils probe outward against the energy barrier, sparking on cont

rift-interdimensional-circus.zh:
我们到达了一个被无数虫洞包围着的熙熙攘攘的星系。各种形状和大小的宇宙飞船围绕着中央明亮的空间站。

这座巨大的建筑上覆盖着五颜六色的标志，上面写着花哨而陌生的文字。这似乎是一座娱乐设施，旨在吸引观众观看一场盛大的表演。考虑到参展船只的数量，无论在这里举行什么展览，它都吸引了令人印象深刻的人群。
rift-interdimensional-circus.en:
We have arrived in a bustling star system surrounded by numerous wormholes. Voidcraft of various shapes and sizes circle a central, brightly lighted space station.

The enormous structure is covered with multicolored signs in garish, unfamiliar script. It seem

anomaly-distar-warform-cat.zh: 一些人工构造从[From.GetName]的剧毒云层中挺立而出。
anomaly-distar-warform-cat.en: Some manner of artificial structure peaks out from between the toxic clouds of [From.GetName]'s atmosphere.

anomaly-nuke-planet-cat.zh: 这片核废土是这里逝去文明的佐证。我们应该进一步调查那些探测器探测到的有活动迹象的地点。
anomaly-nuke-planet-cat.en: The nuclear wasteland is evidently a sign of a previous civilization. Our scanners are picking up activity at certain locations that we should investigate.

anomaly-paragon-beholder-category.zh: 我们探测到了来自这颗星球的间歇性能量峰值。这些读数表明了一些强大的、远超我们所观察到的未开智物种所具有能力的某种东西。
anomaly-paragon-beholder-category.en: We have detected intermittent energy spikes coming from the planet. These readings indicate something powerful, and far beyond the capabilities of the pre-sapient inhabitants we've observed.

event-arkship-1385.zh:
我们的远程扫描仪发现了一个在系统边缘漂浮的物体。进一步检查发现其外表下存在精确的几何不一致，以及厚厚岩石外壳下埋藏的休眠能量信号。

这是一个来源不明的救生舱，其外部经过伪装，以躲避广阔太空中的探测。未检测到任何主动传输，但舱内仍存在微弱的生命维持痕迹。无论里面是什么，都已经漂浮了很长时间。
event-arkship-1385.en:
Our long-range scanners have flagged an object drifting at the edge of the system. Closer inspection revealed precise geometric inconsistencies beneath its surface, and dormant power signatures buried beneath a thick shell of rock.

A survival pod of unknown o

rift-desert-ruins.zh:
废弃的建筑物杂乱无章地散落在沙漠上。

从其中最大的一个巨大的圆顶里面，发出微弱的黄光。从地板到天花板，室内弯曲的墙壁上覆盖着一种未知的文字。

在主房间的中央是一个控制台，上面有两个大按钮：一个深蓝，一个亮绿。我们正在破译墙上的文字，看看它是否能给我们关于这个控制台可能是做什么的提示。
rift-desert-ruins.en:
Abandoned buildings are scattered haphazardly across the sands.

From inside the largest of these, a massive dome, came a faint yellow light. From floor to ceiling, the interior's curving walls were covered in an unknown script.

At the center of the main cham

rift-riftworld.zh:
向[explorer.capital_scope.GetName]附近的裂隙中的航行将我们引向了一颗残破行星的轨道上。

一进入大气层，布满燃烧的弹坑的景色映入眼帘，半截埋入黄沙的战舰四散其间。这颗星球就是一片战场。

截获的无线电信号疯狂而令人不安。难以置信的是，当地居民的语言与我们从[explorer.capital_scope.GetName]地下的远古球体中所回收的文档若合符节。

粗略的翻译表明这些人在一场旷日持久的冲突中失败了。他们的敌人，文中仅简单地称之为“侵略者”，则正在准备下一场进攻。鉴于这颗行星
rift-riftworld.en:
Our voyage into the rift near [explorer.capital_scope.GetName] has delivered us into the orbit of a planet in ruins.

Upon entering the atmosphere, we discovered a landscape pock-marked with burning craters. Here and there, warships lay half buried in the sand

event-observation-2029.zh: 在和我们派往[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的科学家进行长期接触后，当地原住民对于其他物种和文化的接受程度提高了很多。[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]不再那么容易对外来事物表现出排斥的态度了。
event-observation-2029.en: Prolonged contact with our scientific advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] seems to have made the natives more accepting of other species and cultures. The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] are no longer so quick to react with revulsion when they look upon somet

rift-tropical-habitat.zh:
我们到达了一个郁郁葱葱的热带星球的大气层。植物群色素浓郁，肿胀的软体动物在果树间滑行。

一种非典型的粉红色薄雾偶尔会穿过万花筒般的树冠。

考虑到树叶的密度，我们需要继续从地面进行观察。
rift-tropical-habitat.en:
We arrived in the atmosphere of a lush, tropical planet. The flora is intensely pigmented and swollen molluscoids slither among the fruit-bearing trees.

An atypical pink haze occasionally bursts through the kaleidoscopic canopy.

Given the density of the foli

anomaly-rapid-desertification-cat.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的航拍图像显示，其迅速减少的植被可能表明，该行星表面存在一种未知的生命形式栖息在此。
anomaly-rapid-desertification-cat.en: Aerial images taken of [From.Planet.GetName]'s rapidly diminishing vegetation could indicate the presence of an unidentified life form habiting its surface.

event-federations2-100.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]代表星系舞台上一股强大的力量，但是其舰队分散在各处，并且在不同的组织结构下运作。近日，联邦各地几位颇具影响力的军事专家对我们能否面对协调统一、实力强大的敌人表示担忧。

为弥补实力上的不足，他们制定了一套方案，计划在联邦范围内进行一系列军事演习，以便建立军队凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。根据他们的计划，每支舰队将派出特遣队前往盟友领土的特定地点，进行一系列复杂的演习，与其他参加的舰队相互协调，确保行动同步进行。成功完成演习是我军的重要使命，将大大提高我们联邦的战备水平。
event-federations2-100.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName] represents a powerful force on the galactic stage; however, its fleets are divided and operate under a disparate set of organizational structures. Recently, several influential military experts from across the federation have rais

rift-psionic-stranger.zh:
我们到达了一个冰冻多山的星球。

不久之后，我们的电路就被外星传输震惊了：

“你们好，远道而来的人们。从我的冥想深处，我感知到了你们穿越星界的旅程。来吧，让我们见面吧。也许你们的到来，就是我一直在等待的突破。”

我们收到了一组到行星远端的坐标。

无论这是谁，他们的灵能都远远超过了我们的能力。
rift-psionic-stranger.en:
We arrived in the atmosphere of a frozen, mountainous world.

It was not long before our circuits were shaken by a foreign transmission:

"Greetings, you who have traveled so far. From the depths of my meditations, I sensed your journey across the Astral Plane

rift-volcano.zh:
温度难以置信地高。要不是提前准备好的隔热护盾，我们可能就已经葬身烈火了。

远处，有一座黑色的方尖碑静静耸立着。一系列人系开凿的河道汇聚到这座巨大的纪念碑上，把岩石地貌整齐地分割开来。

天空静静地漂浮中发光的球状生物。它们的卷须从精致的身躯上垂下。从这个距离我们还看不出他们是否怀有敌意，但至少在目前，他们似乎没有注意到我们。

方尖碑似乎是最需要的调查对象，但许多漂浮的生物飞得很近，令人不安。也许在离得太近之前观察一下周围的环境会更安全。
rift-volcano.en:
Temperatures here are incredibly high. If not for the precautionary heat shields we had applied beforehand, we'd already be incinerated.

Looming in the distance is a black obelisk. A series of artificial channels converge on this vast monument, neatly carving

site-zevox-digsite.zh:
一艘我们的飞船在探索[Root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的时候偶然在位于[Root.Planet.GetName][Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName]的卫星上发现了一艘坠毁的小型飞船。

这艘飞船上的标志与符号我们从未见过。些许样本已经被提取并用于进一步研究，但飞船本身过大且不够牢固，无法移动，我们只能就地进行分析研究了。
site-zevox-digsite.en:
One of our ships analyzing the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system has come across a small crashed ship on the moon of [Root.Planet.Orbit.GetName], [Root.Planet.GetName].

It bears no emblems or sigils we have seen before, and some samples have been brought bac

anomaly-ast-cluster-cat.zh: 一群排列整齐的矿物飘过[Root.GetName]的残骸带，可能来自于外星人。
anomaly-ast-cluster-cat.en: An unusually deliberate, geometric configuration of minerals drifts through the debris belt by [Root.GetName], and is possibly of alien origin.

anomaly-ast-wavelengths-1-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]小行星正在发射受控脉冲辐射。是不是有什么人，还是说有什么东西，想要和我们交谈？
anomaly-ast-wavelengths-1-cat.en: The asteroid [Root.GetName] is emitting some form of radiation in controlled bursts. Is someone - something - trying to communicate with us?

anomaly-barr-base-cat.zh: 粗略扫描显示，行星表面有一个不断向茫茫太空发射的脉冲信号。
anomaly-barr-base-cat.en: A cursory scan of the planet's surface reveals a weak signal pulsing into the darkness of space.

rift-subnautical.zh:
压力的变化既突然又剧烈；球体抵达的地方似乎是浩瀚海洋的深处。这里一片漆黑，我们的仪器没有探测到任何生命、漂浮沉积物或颗粒物质的迹象。

根据水压判断，我们在表面以下极深处。
rift-subnautical.en:
The change in pressure was as sudden as it was violent; the Sphere arrived in the depths of what appears to be a vast ocean. All is dark. Our instruments show no signs of life, floating sediment, or particulate matter.
