anomaly-ast-crater-cat.en: [Root.GetName] is home to a number of exquisite impact craters. However, something breaks the visual uniformity in one of the larger craters...

anomaly-astral-scar-cat.zh:
我们发现了一个时空中的异常裂缝。我们越靠近，已知的物理相对论定律越不适用。

研究这一现象很可能将推动我们对宇宙机制的科学理解提升到一个更高的水平。
anomaly-astral-scar-cat.en:
We have discovered an anomalous rift in space and time. The closer we get, the less the known laws of physical relativity hold purchase.

Studying this phenomenon could very well push our scientific understanding of the mechanics of the universe to a higher le

anomaly-black-hole-instable-cat.zh: 我们的扫描仪检测到了[from.System.GetName]恒星系中黑洞的物理特性与预期相比存在显著偏差。它的引力不可预测的，这导致空间中一个点到另一个点在时间上表现出显著的不一致性。
anomaly-black-hole-instable-cat.en: Our scanners have detected significant deviations from the expected physical properties of the black hole in the [from.System.GetName] system. Its gravitational forces are unpredictable, resulting in noticeable temporal inconsistencies from one point in space

anomaly-cargo-gasgiant-category.zh: 有一个小型货舱被遗落在了这颗气态巨行星的上方空间。它被行星的重力所捕获，最终将被拖入其大气。
anomaly-cargo-gasgiant-category.en: A small cargo pod has been left to drift in space above this gas giant. It has been captured by the planet's gravity well, and will eventually be pulled into its atmosphere.

anomaly-chthonian-preservation-cat.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示这是一颗死亡行星，它曾经是气态巨行星，但大气层被[from.System.Star.GetName]强烈的辐射剥离了。

尽管如此，它的地表上还是探测到了非常痕量的生物质，需要进一步调查。
anomaly-chthonian-preservation-cat.en:
Surveys of [from.GetName] reveal it to be a chthonian planet, a former gas giant stripped of its atmosphere by the intense radiation of [from.System.Star.GetName].

Despite this, very faint traces of biomass have been detected on its surface, warranting furthe

anomaly-crimson-crawlers-category.zh: 我们在[From.GetStarName]恒星系中发现了一颗红色的行星，颜色很深。我们应该对此开展调查。
anomaly-crimson-crawlers-category.en: A scarlet planet was surveyed in the [From.GetStarName] system. The intensity of the color is remarkable. We should investigate.

anomaly-diamond-dust-cat.zh:
对[from.GetName]的质量扫描发现对流层下层有大量快速移动的物质。

如果没有更详细的调查，这些异常读数的来源很难加以确认。
anomaly-diamond-dust-cat.en:
Mass scans of [from.GetName] reveal high concentrations of fast moving physical matter located deep within the lower troposphere.

The source of these unusual readings is difficult to verify without further detailed investigation.

anomaly-dimensional-pocket-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]所在的残骸场在某种未知力量的影响下翻滚。
anomaly-dimensional-pocket-cat.en: The debris field which [Root.GetName] is part of roils and swirls under the influence of unknown forces.

anomaly-distar-flow-cat.zh: [From.GetName]周围有着高度异常的重力读数。

anomaly-distar-wreck-cat.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]轨道上检测到了不明来源舰体的遗骸。
anomaly-distar-wreck-cat.en: Sensors report a shipwreck of unidentified origin has been sighted in orbit of [Root.GetName].

anomaly-froz-box-cat.zh: 扫描显示在[Root.GetName]众多冰封的山巅之上存在异乎寻常的外星造物。
anomaly-froz-box-cat.en: Scans indicate the presence of a foreign, alien-made object on one of [Root.GetName]'s many frozen mountain tops.

anomaly-gaseous-metals-cat.zh: [from.GetName]的大气主要由各种气态金属构成。进一步了解这颗行星的严苛条件后我们或许就能提取这些有价值的化合物。
anomaly-gaseous-metals-cat.en: The atmosphere of [from.GetName] is primarily composed of various metals in a gaseous state. With better understanding of this planet's harsh conditions we may be able to extract these valuable compounds.

anomaly-gen-mystical-cat.zh: 我们的科研团队调查到了一些“谜团”。需要得到这种现象的更多细节，才能真正解开这个谜团。
anomaly-gen-mystical-cat.en: Our survey has uncovered something that can only be described by the science team as "mystical." We would need to investigate the phenomenon in more detail to unshroud this mystery.

anomaly-geological-tension-cat.zh: 对[from.GetName]的地质扫描表明这颗熔融星球的地壳承受着非常巨大的构造应力。可能有重大的地质事件即将发生。
anomaly-geological-tension-cat.en: Geological scans of [from.GetName] suggest that the planetary crust of this molten world is under immense pressure from pent-up tectonic forces. A significant geological event may be imminent.

anomaly-glimpse-core-cat.zh: [from.GetName]外层气体的怪异活动打开了一些极深的开口，短暂地暴露出行星的固体核心。这一独特现象值得进一步研究。
anomaly-glimpse-core-cat.en: Strange movements in [from.GetName]'s gassy outer layers are causing exceptionally deep vents to open up, exposing the planet's solid core in brief intervals. This remarkable phenomenon warrants further study.

anomaly-infernal-tornadoes-cat.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示了大面积快速迁移的高压力风暴。

这些风暴释放着极强的热信号。需要着重研究才能揭示该现象是自然发生或是由某种至今未知的生命形式引起。
anomaly-infernal-tornadoes-cat.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] show vast swathes of rapidly migrating high-pressure storms.

These storms are emitting extremely volatile heat signatures. Focused research will be needed to reveal if the cause is natural or a hitherto unknown form of life.

anomaly-magma-megafauna-cat.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示熔融行星的表面持续不断地在长距离漂移。

需要进行近距离研究才能理解这一异常地理现象。
anomaly-magma-megafauna-cat.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] show sections of the molten planetary surface shifting continuously across large distances.

Closer study is required to understand this unusual geological phenomenon.

anomaly-orbital-resonance-cat.zh:
[from.System.GetName]内的公转周期展现出了引人注目的规律。每颗环绕恒星的行星都以两倍其相邻行星的周期公转着，精确到千分之一秒。

这种怪异的精确比值值得调查。
anomaly-orbital-resonance-cat.en:
Orbital durations in the [from.System.GetName] system exhibit a remarkable pattern. Each planet orbits the star in exactly double the time of its neighbor, accurate to over a thousandth of a second.

This anomalously perfect ratio warrants investigation.

anomaly-origin-asteroid-category.zh: 这颗小行星的成分与周围的小行星大不相同。它的起源可能与小行星带上的其他小行星截然不同，应该进行更进一步的研究。
anomaly-origin-asteroid-category.en: The material composition of this asteroid differs significantly from its neighbors. It likely has a different origin than the other bodies of this asteroid belt, and should be investigated more closely.

anomaly-peculiar-patterns-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]的地表上出现了奇怪的图案，从太空中都可以明显观察到。
anomaly-peculiar-patterns-cat.en: Strange patterns, clearly visible even from space, are forming across the surface of [Root.GetName].

anomaly-planet-thrusters-cat.zh: [from.GetName]的上层大气中悬浮着一系列大型圆柱体机械。其中没有任何操作员，看起来未在运转。
anomaly-planet-thrusters-cat.en: Suspended within the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName] is a series of large cylindrical machines. They appear inactive devoid of any crew.

anomaly-poisoned-atmosphere-cat.zh: 在[from.GetName]的上层大气探测到了高浓度的毒性有机分子。
anomaly-poisoned-atmosphere-cat.en: High concentrations of organic poisonous molecules have been detected in the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName].

anomaly-proj-moon-cat.zh: 根据初步扫描，[Root.GetName]有一些奇怪的特性，它的读数与我们对此类行星的预估相去甚远……
anomaly-proj-moon-cat.en: According to preliminary scans, [Root.GetName] is exhibiting several strange properties and gives readings that are not at all in line with what one would expect from a planet of this type...

anomaly-stolen-ship-cat.zh: [From.GetName]在初步扫描后发现一艘全副武装的舰船正位于小行星带的轨道中，我们必须小心行事。
anomaly-stolen-ship-cat.en: Preliminary scans of [From.GetName] indicate that a heavily-armed vessel is in orbit of the asteroid. It would be wise to proceed with caution.

anomaly-storms-displaced-tiyanki.zh: 我的探测器从宇宙风暴的余波中在[solar_system.GetName]星系发现了三个缇扬奇信号。
anomaly-storms-displaced-tiyanki.en: In the aftermath of the Cosmic Storm our sensors have detected three Tiyanki signatures in the [solar_system.GetName] system.

anomaly-storms-eviscerated-fauna.zh:
[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的探测器发现一个近期被[from.GetAffectedStormType]带进这个恒星系的不明物体。

需要近距离调查以验证该异常物体的本质。
anomaly-storms-eviscerated-fauna.en:
Sensors in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system have detected an unknown object brought into the system by the recent [from.GetAffectedStormType].

Closer inspection is needed to verify the nature of the anomaly.

anomaly-terminal-gasgiant-category.zh: 一颗环绕着此气态巨行星的小型卫星似乎很快就要撞上这个巨行星了。
anomaly-terminal-gasgiant-category.en: A small and otherwise insignificant moon orbiting this gas giant appears to be on a trajectory that will soon result in a collision with its primary.

anomaly-the-judge-cat.zh: [From.GetName]附近突然探测到一处激增的辐射。调查时得多加小心。
anomaly-the-judge-cat.en: A significant spike in radiation has been detected in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. Proceed with caution when investigating.

anomaly-tox-mat-cat.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示[Root.GetName]的剧毒大气之下存在珍贵物质。
anomaly-tox-mat-cat.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances beneath [Root.GetName]'s noxious clouds.

anomaly-transmitter-cat.zh: 我们碰巧收到来自[From.GetName]上的某个地方的加密讯息。
anomaly-transmitter-cat.en: We have come upon an encrypted datastream transmitting from a location on [From.GetName].

event-arkship-105.zh:
[Root.GetName]舰上引擎突然发生的激增使方舟舰的驱动核心超出了安全运行公差。热点正在主引擎组件中蔓延，压力上升的速度超过了调节系统的补偿能力。

如果不加控制，过剩的输出可能会损坏关键的引擎部件。我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]建议了几种可能的对策：排放多余的等离子体以稳定系统，重新分配工作任务优先级，或者暂时关闭引擎进行全面重新校准。
event-arkship-105.en:
A sudden engine surge aboard [Root.GetName] has pushed the Arkship's drive core beyond safe operating tolerances. Heat blooms are spreading through the primary engine assembly, and pressure is rising faster than the regulation systems can compensate.

If left

event-arkship-1100.zh:
[Root.GetName]方舟舰内部环境传感器测得空气中挥发性化合物含量升高。船员，特别是舰桥上的船员，报告了与轻度毒性接触相符的症状：恶心、定向障碍和持续性神经性疼痛。

尝试通过标准通风协议清除污染物并无效果。腐臭气味弥漫在走廊中，无法被过滤，并加剧了船员的不适。我们的工程报告还标记了飞船废物处理系统的不规则性，表明可能存在迫在眉睫的系统故障。

有必要迅速展开调查。
event-arkship-1100.en: Internal environmental sensors aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] have registered elevated levels of volatile airborne compounds. The crew, particularly those stationed on the bridge, have reported symptoms consistent with low-grade toxic exposure: nausea, diso

event-arkship-1170.zh:
在穿过[solar_system.GetName]星系的行星带时，我们观察到在碎片中漂浮着几个闪烁着微光的天体。初步扫描显示它们是形状不规则的小行星，但通过进一步的近距离观察，我们发现它们存在层状的鳞片式结构，这些结构在恒星光芒的照射下反射出不断变幻的色带。

进一步的分析表明，这些碎片部分源自矿物，部分源自生物。它们看起来像是一头以太巨龙的残骸，这头巨龙似乎被一颗小行星撞击，在离开该星系之前失去了部分装甲外皮。星光照耀在这些被丢弃的鳞片上，将棱镜般的七彩光芒洒落在方舟舰上。
event-arkship-1170.en: While passing through the planetary belt in the [solar_system.GetName] system, we observed several faintly shimmering objects drifting among the debris. Initial scans suggested irregular asteroids, but closer inspection revealed layered, scale-like structures

event-arkship-1185.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上正在开展常规审计，结果发现了货物记录中存在差异。

监控录像显示，方舟舰居民中已经形成了一个非正式的交换网络。一个以物易物的系统在船员和定居者之间悄然兴起。易腐物品、工具、奢侈品和个人服务在监控有限的僻静角落被进行交易。

这一发现引发了一些令人不安的问题。有人赞赏其中展现出的聪明才智；而另一些人则警告说，方舟舰上的任何监管疏忽都可能带来严重的风险。
event-arkship-1185.en:
A routine audit aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] has uncovered discrepancies in our cargo records.

Security footage indicates the formation of an informal exchange network among the Arkship's residents. A barter system has quietly emerged among crew and civilian

event-arkship-125.zh:
自方舟舰[Root.GetName]进入这片星云以来，集体意识中便掀起了阵阵波动。曾经完美同步的节点已开始失去协调性。随着冲动无法在格式塔意识中清晰传播，记忆正变得支离破碎。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已将原因追溯至该星云的电磁场，它正在干扰将我们联结在一起的神经通路。原本应当流畅无阻的集体意识，如今却变得断断续续、支离破碎。
event-arkship-125.en: Since the Arkship [Root.GetName] entered this nebula, disturbances have rippled through the shared consciousness. Nodes that were once in perfect synchrony have begun losing coherence. Memories grow fragmented as impulses fail to propagate cleanly through the

event-bio-900.zh: 我们的特工已经建立了许多前线和藏身处来监控[target.GetName]上的人口。对异见者、孤独者，或高技能人才将进行评估和标记，以便我们获取。
event-bio-900.en: Our operatives have established a number of fronts and hideouts from which they monitor the population of the [target.GetName]. Dissidents, loners, or highly skilled individuals will be assessed and marked for extraction.

event-cara-900.zh: 我们已消灭行商联盟之家——贸易空间站堂吉。这些贪婪害虫完蛋了！
event-cara-900.en: We have crushed the profiteering vermin that called Tradestation Tungle home. The Caravansary Caravan Coalition is no more!

event-colony-155.zh:
在我们探索[Root.GetName]上靠近我们居住站的废墟时。一些殖民者无意中激活了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上以前使用核武的战争中遗留下来的未引爆的核聚变武器上的计时器。

这个大约35兆吨当量的核心炸弹一旦引爆，附近的数个居住站将从地图上被抹去。此核聚变武器极度不稳定所以无法去挪移，我们也没有足够的时间去撤离这个区域。
event-colony-155.en:
While exploring some ruins near one of our major settlements on [Root.GetName], a few colonists inadvertently activated the timer on an undetonated hydrogen bomb left over from the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s previous nuclear war.

With an estimated yield of 35 meg

event-colony-3001.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上定居了一段时间之后，我们收集到了一些奇怪的数据。具体来讲，[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]的地质构成似乎与[Root.GetName]大相径庭。这意味着它不是与星球同时形成的，而是原本在别处形成，后来不知怎的被[Root.GetName]的重力场捕获了。至于[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]到底源自何处仍是个谜。
event-colony-3001.en: Now that [Root.GetName] has been settled for a while, some data irregularities have been noticed. Specifically, the moon [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] does not seem to be made of remotely similar material to [Root.GetName]. This suggests it was not f

event-colony-mod-30.zh: [Root.GetName]上的构造变动导致一个巨大板块上的黑曜岩薄层破碎。熔岩倾泻而出遍布地表，造成了毁灭性的影响。从殖民地发回的报告相当可怕。
event-colony-mod-30.en: Tectonic events on [Root.GetName] have caused the Obsidian sheets on one of the giant plates to shatter. Lava pours across the surface to ruinous effect. Reports from the colony are dire.

event-cstorms-1840.zh: 紧随着最近过境的电力风暴，在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表之下探测到了一场难以解释的能量骤增。进一步扫描发现了一座古老的地下复合体，其中的发电机被风暴重新激活，让这座设施又开始了运作。
event-cstorms-1840.en: Following the passing of a recent Electric Storm, an unexplained power surge was detected beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Further scans revealed an aging subterranean complex whose power generators were reactivated by the storm, bringing the faci

event-extreme-frontiers-1533.zh:
随着[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]中的战斗进入尾声，一份来自客服无人机的新信息显示到了我们的屏幕上。

“我们留意到您对我方最终用户许可协议强制执行抗拒。由于您展现出压倒性军事力量，我们现正式废除对MKIII地质辐射矩阵的知识产权声索。我们希望您能在使用这一新科技的过程中获得快乐。”

无人机发生了爆炸，同时切断了通讯链接。
event-extreme-frontiers-1533.en:
As the battle draws to a close in [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName], a new communication from the customer service drone plays on our screens.

"We have noted your objection to our efforts to enforce the terms of the End User License Agreement. As a result of yo

event-fedel-1.zh:
马上就要到决定谁将在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]的时间了。如我们先前同意过的，我们将通过徒手近距离搏斗决定领袖。

每个成员国的领袖将被带到位于[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]，我们当前主席国[fed_leader.GetName]的一个大型竞技场。在那里，一场面向全[Root.GetAllianceName]广播的比赛即将展开，他们将相互战斗，至死方休，直到仅剩一人存留。
event-fedel-1.en:
It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.

The leader of each member nation will soon be brought

event-federations3-120.zh:
访问者：欢迎来到温科沃特。无论您是慕名已久还是故地重游，我们都非常乐意为您的花园之旅提供帮助。

谨代表园丁并根据WAPP-715号命令，请不要擅自闯入指定的温科沃特美术堂生物区。不遵守我们的指引将会降低所有相关人员的生存机会。
event-federations3-120.en:
Visiting entity: welcome to Wenkwort. Whether this visit is your first or your hundredth, we are glad to facilitate your appreciation of the gardens.

On behalf of the Gardeners and in accordance with directive WAPP-715, I ask that you refrain from harsh intru

event-fircon-1280.zh:
在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上，居民们正在使用原始的雕刻图画来表达和分享想法。我们的研究人员记录的样本表明，居民对他们自己星球以外的天体有认识，甚至已经开始记录星座。

对于这样一个年轻的文明来说，他们早期绘制的星图是相当准确的，但也不至于到了无法改进的地步，只要我们想留下一些暗示……
event-fircon-1280.en: On [From.Owner.Capital.GetName], the inhabitants are using crudely carved imagery to express and share ideas. Samples documented by our researchers indicate that the inhabitants have an awareness of celestial bodies beyond their own planet, and have even begun

event-fircon-1405.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]科学技术得到了进一步的发展，因为工业化使他们的社会达到了新的高度。他们在工程方面的最新突破彻底改变了他们对交通的运用，这使他们离行星统一更近了一步。

与我们模型预期的不同，[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]现在成为了一个统一的星球。他们将资源统一调配，人们则将为整个星球的社区的福祉作为首要任务，生活水平大幅提升。
event-fircon-1405.en: Technology continues to progress on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName], as industrialization takes their society to new heights. Their most recent breakthrough in engineering has revolutionized their use of transportation and brought them a step closer to planetary

event-fircon-8000.zh:
在一个有趣的跨文化交流例子中，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上相当数量的年轻人对[owner.GetAdj]的所有事物产生了消费性的兴趣。这些充满激情的年轻人急切地争抢与我们文化相关的任何东西，现在他们构成了这颗星球上一个充满活力和不断发展的亚文化群体。

我们甚至得知即将到来的粉丝大会将举办一场服装大赛。
event-fircon-8000.en: In an amusing example of cross-cultural exchange, a significant number of young people on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have developed a consuming interest in all things [owner.GetAdj]. Eagerly snatching up anything even remotely connected to our culture, these pas

event-fircon-8060.zh: 自己在宇宙中并不孤单，这一发现让[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]上的许多人感到震惊。毫不奇怪，这一事件产生了严重的经济影响。随着整颗星球上的金融机构暴跌不止，生活水平明显下降。
event-fircon-8060.en: The revelation that they were not alone in the universe came as a shock to many on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]. Not surprisingly, the event has had severe economic effects. With financial institutions across the planet in free-fall, there has been a mark

event-infernals-3030.zh:
有人可能认为没人愿意靠近奔涌的开放熔岩流，可在[planet.GetName]则不然。

殖民者驾驶悬浮艇沿活跃的熔岩流竞速，躲避漂浮巨石，加速越过熔岩瀑布。有人押注赛果，赌馆甚至吸引了有组织犯罪。少数飞行员甚至在各种事故中丧生。

法律对此行为并无禁止，因为从未想过有人会如此冒险。我们可以纵容殖民者的热情，任其自由，但随着赌博活动日益猖獗，这可能引发更危险的行为乃至犯罪。或者，我们可以规范这项运动，虽会引来抱怨，但长远看可减少伤亡与犯罪。还可以直接全面禁止，虽能奏效，但执行成本高昂。
event-infernals-3030.en:
One might think individuals would not want to spend time near open, quick-moving lava flows. At least on [planet.GetName], one would be wrong.

Colonists are racing utility hovercraft along active lava flows, dodging floating boulders and boosting themselves o

event-infernals-3050.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]前超光速物种的成员与我们最古老神话中的神灵极为相似，这可以部分归因于趋同进化和心理学的普遍规律，但随着我们对该物种了解的加深，联系愈发明显。

它们会是我们神话传说中的生物吗？这一可能引发了广泛关注，可以投入资源推进研究。但有时，巧合的累积并无更深含义，过度探究可能暴露我们的存在，引发不可预见的后果。
event-infernals-3050.en: Members of the pre-FTL species on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have striking similarities to mythological beings from some of our oldest myths. Some of this may be accounted for by broad trends in convergent evolution and psychology, but the more we learn about th

event-leviathans-140.zh: 我们的舰队摧毁了[From.GetName]的总部。从他们的太空基地的残骸中尽可能回收有价值物资的行动也已如火如荼地展开。我们已经获得了大量资源。
event-leviathans-140.en: Our fleet assets have destroyed the [From.GetName] headquarters. Efforts are well under way to recover as many valuables as possible from the shattered remnants of their starbase. We have gained a large amount of resources.

event-nomads-8000.zh:
锁定方案：异常。

已进行校正。

威胁重评估：无。
event-nomads-8000.en:
Targeting solution: Malformed.

Correction Applied.

Threat Reassessment: None.

event-observation-0.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站上的小型天体实验室侦测到一颗4级小行星正在靠近。若不采取行动，它将会以相当大的力撞击到[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的[GetRandomCompassDirection]半球，足以造成灭绝级事件。

我们的任务是被动观察，通常情况下我们不允许进行干涉，但许多科学家认为在这种情况下应该破例。若不采取任何行动，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]注定将
event-observation-0.en: The small astrometric lab on our Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has detected a Class-4 asteroid on an incoming trajectory. Unless action is taken, it will impact the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s [GetRandomCompassDirection] hemisphere

event-observation-1400.zh:
最近[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的几个大国之间爆发了一场大规模的战争。

我们的研究人员在安全的轨道上进行观察时，冲突迅速发展为在全球范围内进行相互核武投射。

[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的全部人口似乎都在核火中消亡，自然环境也遭到了巨大破坏。
event-observation-1400.en:
A massive war was recently triggered between several of the largest nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

While our researchers were observing safely from orbit, the conflict rapidly escalated into a global nuclear exchange.

The [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlane

event-observation-300.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上空的观测站在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表发现了一个非法定居点。可能是某些[Root.GetSpeciesName]走私贩或者[Root.GetName]的不法分子设立的哨站。

由于这些走私犯有时候会撞见当地的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，这里已经发生了一些零星的事故——某些事故甚至还上升到了暴力行为。我们需要尽快行动，在不法分子造成更大损失之前带走他们。
event-observation-300.en: Our observation post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has detected an illegal settlement on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. It appears to be some kind of outpost set up by [Root.GetSpeciesName] smugglers and other criminal elements from the [Roo

event-operation-5025.zh: [from.target.GetName]的生存环境似乎对我们派遣到[from.GetName]行动中的[GetIndividualNamePlural]有轻微的毒性。我们的特工已经开始出现症状，哪怕是最轻的症状都开始损坏他们的正常功能，而最坏的情况则是被敌对[from.target.GetGestaltEntityName]给逮到。
event-operation-5025.en: Something about the [from.target.GetName] living environment appears mildly toxic to the [GetIndividualNamePlural] assigned to Operation [from.GetName]. Our operative is beginning to show symptoms which at best impair their function, and at worst single them o

event-operation-5030.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetAdj]的环境充满了静电噪声——比我们预测的要多得多。我们向[from.GetName]行动派遣的伪装无人机正在经历间歇性的数据丢失。这会导致我们数据收集风险的显著上升，从而增加了我们暴露的概率。
event-operation-5030.en: The environment on [excess_noise_country.GetAdj] worlds has become riddled with electrostatic noise - far more than we had anticipated. The disguised drones we have assigned to Operation [from.GetName] are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. This poses

event-operation-6250.zh: 位于[target.GetName]的特工正积极工作，辨识并追踪那些潜在能提供支持的领袖。
event-operation-6250.en: Operatives within the [target.GetName] are actively working to identify and pursue leads that could potentially be used to gain favors.

event-preftl-operation-1025.zh: 我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上的准备工作已经完毕；我们的特工已经准备好将[target.GetName]引入只有一步之遥的星海的大舞台。
event-preftl-operation-1025.en: Our preparations on [target.capital_scope.GetName] are now concluded; our operatives are poised to bring the [target.GetName] one step further onto the galactic stage.

event-preftl-operation-3000.zh: 我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]尝试影响[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，遭遇了广泛的质疑。许多当地人笃信我们的特工不是魔物就是恶灵，正在想方设法地远离他们。敌对示威似乎很可能发生。
event-preftl-operation-3000.en: Our attempts to influence the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] are being met with widespread suspicion. Many of the locals are taking great steps to avoid our operatives, believing them to be creatures of magic or else

event-shroud-1100.zh:
一大批高价值实验对象借助挖掘的隧道从[root.GetName]上的一座设施内逃了出来。

这条隧道是用简陋的工具和赤裸的 [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] 挖掘而成，必定耗费了多年时间。我们无法确定有多少人知晓它的存在，也不清楚为什么这么长时间也没人能发现。
event-shroud-1100.en:
A number of our valuable test subjects have fled from a facility on [root.GetName] via a makeshift escape tunnel.

Fashioned using improvised tools and bare [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural], the tunnel must have taken years to build. We cannot be sure how many

event-shroud-3000.zh:
在涡旋的黑暗中，远处的影子倏然出现，又消失入虚无……一阵阵模糊不清的不谐和心声难以理解地咆哮着。光明灭闪烁，热点膨胀收缩。

或有运动之物，莫名旋转。这究竟是我们自己，还是虚境在运动不息？

那个存在靠近了，同时从四面八方靠近。心声忽然出现。

你看到了什么？
event-shroud-3000.en:
In the swirling blackness, distant shadows take fleeting forms before receding back into nothingness... An obscure cacophony of voices rant unintelligibly... Lights flicker and fade. Spots of heat swell and subside.

There is motion. Something spins. Is it us

event-shroud-3015.zh:
强大的灵能流在黑暗中互相碰撞。无数阴影在周围来来往往……前方有一道微光在闪烁。

突然，仅有那么一刹那，眼前景象变得清晰可辨。它的形状在我们抓住之前就又消失了。

一个奇怪的存在来到了我们身边。

所见何物？
event-shroud-3015.en:
Powerful currents of psionic energy clash in the darkness here. Shadows rush and fall around us... A glimmering light pulses ahead.

Suddenly a scene is discernible, for only the briefest of moments. Its shapes recede before we can grasp them.

A strange prese

event-shroud-3020.zh:
在层层叠叠的虚境中，一副幻景展现在我们面前。

浓雾形成了一只挣扎着的生物轮廓，朦胧的卷须紧紧地缠绕着，它动弹不得，奄奄一息。

这只动物本身我们前所未见。

一个心声回荡在我们之内。

命运的绳索正在召唤！你要拉哪一头？
event-shroud-3020.en:
From between the many layers of the Shroud, a vision unfurls before us.

The mists form the outline of a struggling creature, ensnared and choking as hazy tendrils wrap ever tighter around it.

The animal itself is unlike anything we have encountered before.

event-shroud-3030.zh:
虚境无休止地搅动，露出一大片黑沙。海浪破碎，但只闻其声不见其形。

前面，或者也许叫前面的地方，出现了一个棱镜。一束光照亮了它，瞬间折射形成一个模糊的图像。

无数模糊的身影和移动的形体短暂出现，又被黑暗吞没。

在附近的沙滩上，有一个存在。

所示之物即所见，对吗？
event-shroud-3030.en:
The Shroud's restless churn resolves to reveal a vast stretch of black sand. Breaking waves can be heard but not seen.

Ahead, or perhaps behind, a prism appears. A single beam of light hits it, momentarily refracting to form a murky image.

Countless shadowy

event-shroud-3040.zh:
一汪黑色的液体在我们面前舒展开。

突然，液面上闪烁起一个模糊的影像。我们瞥见了一座亮闪闪的山峰，每个山脊都镶着耀眼夺目金边，随后它有忽然消失。

一个心声在我们的[GetMindLoc]深处鸣响着。

你看到了未见之物吗？
event-shroud-3040.en:
A pool of black liquid stretches out before us.

Suddenly a blurry image flickers across the surface. We glimpse a glittering peak, whose every ridge is studded with shimmering gold, before it vanishes abruptly.

A voice resonates within the recesses of our [G

event-shroud-3060.zh:
虚境缥缈的浓雾扭曲盘旋，将我们的意识拉入了深处，只留下身躯原地不动。

我们的[GetPsycheLoc]一次次拉伸又收缩，困在重复的潮汐中。每一次有意识的动作都会自我坍缩，张力拉紧，如同被架在台钳上。
event-shroud-3060.en:
The ethereal mists of the Shroud churn and twist, dragging our consciousness deeper whilst our physical forms remain inert, untouched.

Our [GetPsycheLoc] stretches, strains, trapped within a repeating tide. Each attempted movement collapses upon itself, the t

event-strange-worlds-100.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的一位[Owner.GetExplorer]突然失去了联系，此前他刚刚汇报过在一处此前未测绘的山谷里发现了潜在的异星天然气。
event-strange-worlds-100.en: Communications were lost with one of our [Owner.GetExplorer] on [Root.GetName], shortly after they reported a potential Exotic Gas discovery in a previously unmapped valley.

event-strange-worlds-125.zh:
此前被认为休眠已久的[Root.GetName]地热喷泉剧烈喷发，向大气层喷射出含有暗物质的气体。

此次喷发遮天蔽日，导致了严重的引力异常，阻碍了星际旅行和通讯。

我们认为暗物质可能源于该行星独特的核心。这种极端的环境对我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]构成了威胁，因此我们已经部署了轨道虹吸装置用于从平流层提取这种瘴气。
event-strange-worlds-125.en:
What was previously thought to be a long dormant geyser on [Root.GetName] has violently erupted, spewing Dark Matter infused gas into the atmosphere.

The eruption has saturated the skies, leading to severe gravitational anomalies that are blocking offworld tr

event-strange-worlds-150.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]发现了一种极为恶心的本土生物。

它们进化出了一种防御机制，同时也成为了它们获取食物的主要方式。由于缺乏自身分解固体食物所需的消化酶，它们会释放出一种强烈且令人作呕的气体，当其他具有正常消化系统的生物吸入时，会引发剧烈呕吐。这些被排出的物质随后被它们作为主要的营养来源。

清除这些令人厌恶的生物将为我们带来丰厚的异星天然气和食物资源。
event-strange-worlds-150.en:
We have encountered a notably disgusting species of fauna native to [Root.GetName].

They have evolved a defense mechanism that happens to also serve as their primary method of food acquisition. Lacking the digestive enzymes needed to break down solid food on

event-strange-worlds-175.zh:
来自[Root.GetName]的报告显示，农村与城市人口之间出现了令人担忧的地区间敌对情绪。除了他们所处的地理位置外，目前尚未发现引发这种敌意的明显原因。

新移民最初会遭到敌视，但在被分配到各自的地区几周后，他们很快就会被接纳。基于此，我们的科学家确信，这种异常行为是由地区内的局部因素驱动的。

在我们调查此事的同时，我们需要稳定局势，以防止进一步升级。我们可以选择正式支持农村或城市地区，或者部署额外的执法力量以维持和平。
event-strange-worlds-175.en:
Reports from [Root.GetName] show an alarming emergence of interdistrict hostility between the rural and urban populations. There is no discernible cause that has triggered this animosity other than their arbitrary geographical location.

New immigrants are ini

event-strange-worlds-30.zh:
我们正在为[Root.GetName]上未来的扩张做土地整备时，一座巨大的结构仿佛在一瞬间凭空出现

这座结构释放着极不稳定的能量波，使其形态若隐若现，因此我们在该区域的初步扫描时没有发现这座建筑。

当它显现时，可以看到其密封的外墙装饰着某种难以理解的符号，而我们的记录中没有任何一种语言与之相符。

其功能尚未明确。该建筑目前为止还没有造成任何伤害，但确乎影响了我们的发展工作。
event-strange-worlds-30.en:
As we were preparing land for future expansion on [Root.GetName], a large structure seemingly blinked into existence.

The structure is emitting highly unstable energy waves causing it to intermittently appear and disappear from view. This explains why it was

event-strange-worlds-3065.zh:
一阵重力异常将我们的观测站晃离了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的轨道，导致它短暂进入了行星的下层大气。

虽然我们的乘员没有受伤而且也恢复了原定轨道，但有人担心观测站可能会被地上的[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发现。

只有时间知道我们是否暴露，以及这会对他们的社会造成何等影响。
event-strange-worlds-3065.en:
A gravitational anomaly knocked our observation post over [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] out of orbit, causing it to briefly drop into the planet's lower atmosphere.

While our crew are unharmed and our original trajectory has been restored, there are c

event-subject-100.zh:
我们从[subject_empire.GetName]被占领的殖民地收到了一封通讯，行文措辞如同现在他们整个国家一般支离破碎。我们的附属国无法自保，正在寻求我们的帮助。

由于我们的外交协议所具有的军国主义性质，我们自然应当涉足其中，并保护我们的附属国不受到进一步的伤害。我们的一些顾问则考虑，也许通过鼓舞我们的附庸让他们奋起保卫自己而不是直接介入，才是对双方更合适的决定。
event-subject-100.en:
We have received reports from the occupied colonies of [subject_empire.GetName], disorganized and destitute as they currently are. Our subject is now looking to us for aid, as they seem unable to defend themselves.

Considering the militaristic nature of our d

event-subject-2050.zh:
我们一直在[targeted_planet.GetName]上对行星本身的结构进行大量研究，以确定如何为了我们的殖民地对行星进行改善。最近的发展不幸出了岔子，毒性废料污染了大片土地，使它们完全不宜居住。

然而，我们的计算表明，这不仅是一起孤立的事件，只要这种广泛的行星研究继续下去，就可能会有更多这样的灾难发生。
event-subject-2050.en: On [targeted_planet.GetName], we have have been conducting significant research on the structure of the planet itself to see how one might improve it for our colonies. The latest developments have sadly gone awry, with toxic wastes affecting large swathes of l

event-subject-3001.zh: 一大群人来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的人在我们成为他们的附庸后，开始来我们的世界旅行，并对我们的文化和人民表现出兴趣。起初，我们认为这对所有人来说都是一件好事，但近段时间，我们看到当地人和[overlord_empire.GetAdj]游客之间的冲突增加了——他们似乎对我们的帝国怀有一些误解，他们倾向于使用[overlord_empire.GetAdj]的文化和理想为他们的粗野辩护。
event-subject-3001.en: A large number of people from the [overlord_empire.GetName] started visiting our worlds after we became a subject of theirs, expressing an interest in our culture and people. At first we figured it would be a good thing for all of us, but we see a rise in conf

event-subject-3050.zh: 我们收到消息，一群来自[subject_empire.GetName]的朝圣者想方设法来到了我们的宇域。看上去他们相信[overlord_empire.GetName]在他们的家园代表了某种宗教上的重要性。尽管有关他们宗教信仰方面的细节尚不清楚，但这群人作为旅客举止十分得体，在停留期间人们对他们只有点赞，没有差评。
event-subject-3050.en: Word has reached us of a group of pilgrims from the [subject_empire.GetName], making their way through our space. It seems they believe the [overlord_empire.GetName] holds some religious significance for their homeland. Though the details of their religious co

event-subject-50.zh:
我们获悉，我们的宗主投资了相当可观的能量和资源来改善他们的恒星基地工程，以期巨幅提升提升产出能力和潜能。

由于防卫工作是我们两个帝国之间关系的重要基石，我们已经寻求订立协议，以获取一部分的科技，从而对我们其中的一座恒星基地进行相似改进。
event-subject-50.en:
We have been informed that our overlord has invested a considerable amount of energy and resources into improving their starbase engineering, improving the output and potential of theirs by leaps and bounds.

As defense is an important keystone in the relation

site-city-of-bones.zh:
一个完全由不明骨头建造的原始城市废墟在经历这颗星球上的一场强力沙尘暴之后被发现。

我们的科学家渴望发掘这座可怕的古城。
site-city-of-bones.en:
The ruins of a primeval city built entirely out of bones of an unknown origin have been unearthed following a violent sandstorm on this planet.

Our archaeologists are eager to begin excavation on this grisly ancient city.

site-it-was-aliens-site.zh: 废墟遍布[From.Planet.GetName]，但奇怪的是，从它们的爆炸模式来看，似乎是大量的地下核爆引发了这一切，而不是正常的大气层核爆或是轨道轰炸。这需要进一步调查，或许需要一次考古挖掘来揭露这里到底发生了什么。
site-it-was-aliens-site.en: Ruins cover [From.Planet.GetName], but oddly the blast patterns seem to indicate that vast nuclear explosions occurred underneath the surface rather than from atmospheric or orbital bombardment. This warrants further investigation, but it will require an archa

site-mutation-vats.zh:
我们在这颗星球上发现了有着令人惊异数量的严重异变化石，它们都属于同一种已灭绝的智慧物种。

究竟是什么导致了一个高等社会数百万成员的异变？我们的考古学家想进一步调查。
site-mutation-vats.en:
A surprising number of heavily-mutated fossils has been found on this planet, all belonging to the same species of extinct sapients.

What could have led to the mutation of millions of members of a once-advanced society? Our archaeologists would like to invest

site-site-lost-moments.zh: 科研船检测到了一条从[From.Planet.GetName]发射出的怪异读数。
site-site-lost-moments.en: The Science Ship has picked up a strange reading emanating from [From.Planet.GetName].

site-site-robot-debris.zh: 这颗小行星的表面覆盖满了被其低重力束缚的机器人碎片。看起来它们都是由军事行动造成的。如果这些作战机器人没有被破坏到无法修复的话，本来是足够武装几只军队的。
site-site-robot-debris.en: The entire surface of this small asteroid is covered in robot debris, trapped in its weak gravity field. All of it appears military in nature, and there are enough combat droids here to outfit several armies had they not be shattered beyond all repair.

site-the-host.zh: 在这颗星球的地壳内，数量惊人的地下通道系统交错盘旋。究竟是什么造就了这一切呢？
site-the-host.en: An extensive network of subterranean tunnels of truly astounding proportion make swirls in the crust of this planet. What could have created them?

situation-situation-energy-deficit.zh: 我们的能量赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
situation-situation-energy-deficit.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

anomaly-aerostat-gasgiant-category.zh: 某种未知结构正漂浮在这颗气态巨行星的上层大气中。似乎是用到了空气静力学的原理来维持漂浮。
anomaly-aerostat-gasgiant-category.en: Some kind of unknown structures are floating in this gas giant's upper atmosphere. They appear to be using aerostatic lift to remain buoyant.

anomaly-aianom-miningdepo-cat.zh: 传感器表明在[Root.GetName]地表存在有潜在价值的发现。
anomaly-aianom-miningdepo-cat.en: Sensors register potential finds on the surface of [Root.GetName].

anomaly-alpha-centauri-cat.zh: [From.GetName]环绕红矮星的奇特轨道使得这颗行星处于潮汐锁定的状态，具有进一步调查的价值。
anomaly-alpha-centauri-cat.en: [From.GetName]'s peculiar orbit around its red dwarf star renders the planet tidally locked, and potentially worthy of further investigation.

anomaly-asteroid-uninhabitable-category.zh: 一枚12级小行星围绕着[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道运行。这枚小行星的轨道实在太过稳定了，难以相信是自然形成的。
anomaly-asteroid-uninhabitable-category.en: A class-12 asteroid orbits this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The small planetoid's orbit appears far too stable for its presence to be a natural occurrence.

anomaly-collision-asteroid-category.zh: 这颗小行星最近被小行星带里的一颗行星撞击了。其表面留下了一个巨大的撞击坑，同时轨道也有所偏离。
anomaly-collision-asteroid-category.en: This asteroid recently suffered an impact from another body within the asteroid belt, which resulted in a slightly changed orbit and a massive crater on the surface.

anomaly-crashed-ship-asteroid-category.zh: 某架飞船坠毁在了这颗小行星的表面。飞行器的残骸仍能在撞击坑里找到。
anomaly-crashed-ship-asteroid-category.en: A vessel of some kind has crashed into the surface of this asteroid. Wreckage from the craft can still be found within the impact crater.

anomaly-debris-asteroid-category.zh: 这颗小行星的表面散步着金属碎片。这些碎片大多看起来属于许多不同的飞船。
anomaly-debris-asteroid-category.en: The surface of this asteroid is littered with metallic debris. Most of it appears to originate from starships of many different designs.

anomaly-disco-stranded-scientist-cat.zh: [From.GetName]表面发现了类似舰船的物体，且周围散落着小块金属。遗迹似乎没有生命迹象，但却依旧有能源读数反应。
anomaly-disco-stranded-scientist-cat.en: Bits and pieces of metal are strewn across [From.GetName]'s surface, encircling what looks like the hulk of a ship. The wreckage appears deserted, but energy readings remain.

anomaly-emissions-asteroid-category.zh: 未知来源发出的强大能量辐射使得这颗小行星在众多同类中十分扎眼。
anomaly-emissions-asteroid-category.en: Strong energy emissions of an unknown origin make this asteroid stand out from the rest of its peers in this crowded asteroid field.

anomaly-frozen-springs-cat.zh: 科研团队在调查[From.GetName]的时候发现了一处来自行星的冰层之下的异常热信号。
anomaly-frozen-springs-cat.en: Whilst surveying [From.GetName], the science team detected unusual heat signatures coming from below the frozen surface of the planet.

anomaly-hatch-asteroid-category.zh: 一个通往这颗小行星内部的对接舱坐落在其表面的一个小坑里。舱口似乎被密封过，但之后被微陨石撞开了。
anomaly-hatch-asteroid-category.en: A small docking hatch leading to the interior of this asteroid is visible at the rim of a small crater on its surface. The hatch was likely concealed once, but it has since been exposed by micrometeorite impacts.

anomaly-hbl-music-1-cat.en: There is a pattern of unusual sonic activity on [Root.GetName].

anomaly-hole-radiation-cat.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]周边发现不寻常的读数，不该在离黑洞这么近的地方出现。
anomaly-hole-radiation-cat.en: Sensors pick up unusual readings in the vicinity of [Root.GetName] - readings that are hard to explain being this close to a black hole.

anomaly-impact-uninhabitable-category.zh: 巨大的撞击坑表明某种大型物体曾撞击[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面。
anomaly-impact-uninhabitable-category.en: A colossal impact crater hints that something big collided with the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] once.

anomaly-inhabited-toxic-category.zh: 这个寸草不生的世界似乎曾居住着的前太空时代文明。其城市的废墟还在该行星表面随处可见。
anomaly-inhabited-toxic-category.en: This toxic and lifeless world appears to have once been inhabited by a moderately advanced pre-space civilization. The ruins of their cities are still strewn across the surface.

anomaly-life-asteroid-category.zh: 我们接收到这颗小行星内部有着某种生命迹象。强烈建议深入调查。
anomaly-life-asteroid-category.en: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.

anomaly-life-toxic-category.zh: 尽管[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的大气中含有剧毒成分，且气压极高，但仍然能检测到强烈的生命迹象。
anomaly-life-toxic-category.en: Despite the toxic content and high pressure of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s atmosphere, strong life signs have been detected coming from its surface.

anomaly-lost-soul-cat.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。我们尚不清楚它的能源，但我们可以从它的记忆体中获取一些信息。
anomaly-lost-soul-cat.en: We have found a heavily damaged bipedal robot floating in space. We do not understand its energy source, but we may be able to retrieve information from its memory.

anomaly-moon-gasgiant-category.zh: 一颗小型卫星正环绕这颗气态巨行星运行，这颗小卫星可能蕴藏大量矿藏。需要进行一次彻底的调查，对开采行动的可能性进行研究。
anomaly-moon-gasgiant-category.en: One of the small moonlets orbiting this gas giant has been identified as a promising mining site. A more thorough survey will have to be conducted to determine whether a mining operation would be feasible or not.

anomaly-object-gasgiant-category.zh: 传感器回波表明这颗庞大的气态巨行星的大气层内存在不明物体。
anomaly-object-gasgiant-category.en: Sensor echoes have indicated the presence of some kind of unidentified object deep within the atmosphere of this gas giant.

anomaly-signal-uninhabitable-category.zh: 我们在调查[Root.GetPlanetMoon]时偶然接收到了一个微弱的外星信号。信号源似乎是轨道上的一个小物品。信号没有包含信息——难道是遇险应答器吗？
anomaly-signal-uninhabitable-category.en: By chance, we stumbled upon a faint alien signal during the survey of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be a small object in orbit. The signal contains no message - could it be a distress transponder?

anomaly-sun-rays-cat.zh: 我们探测到了奇怪的宇宙射线，科学专员要求对其进行调查。
anomaly-sun-rays-cat.en: We have detected odd radiation that our Science Officer demands to investigate.

anomaly-survival-pod-warm-cat.zh: 对[from.GetName]贫瘠地表的勘测显示出一个被改造的外勤站，这最初只是一座临时研究实验室，如今早已超出预期寿命。微弱的热辐射表明，该设施的部分区域依然处于活跃状态。
anomaly-survival-pod-warm-cat.en: Survey sweeps of [from.GetName]'s barren surface have revealed a repurposed field station, originally a temporary research lab long past its intended lifespan. Faint heat radiation suggest parts of the installation remain active.

anomaly-the-imitator-category.zh: 在最近的一次调查中发现了一个单独的逃生舱。奇怪的是，这个逃生舱用与我们相同的数据签名向我们打招呼。这个逃生舱似乎是被最近一场穿过这个星系的宇宙风暴所带过来的。建议进行更深入的调查。
anomaly-the-imitator-category.en: A lone escape pod was spotted during a recent survey. Strangely, the pod hailed us using a data signature matching that of our own. The pod seems to have been displaced by a recent cosmic storm that passed through the system. Investigation is recommended.

anomaly-uhb-ancient-ruins-1-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]表面散布着十分惊人的建筑，请求立即进行考古工作。
anomaly-uhb-ancient-ruins-1-cat.en: Impressive structures litter [Root.GetName]'s surface, practically begging for some archaeological work.

anomaly-vending-machine-cat.zh: 一座信标围绕着[From.GetName]，召唤着路过的人靠近。在这个小行星上，有一座巨大的金属碑塔赫然耸立，它的作用尚不明确。
anomaly-vending-machine-cat.en: A signal beacon orbits [From.GetName], beckoning travelers nearer. On the asteroid, a giant metal monolith looms, its purpose unknown.

event-action-941.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系中发现了战略资源：“泽珞”的储备。

这种稀有气溶胶具有多种用途。分析表明，经过处理的样本甚至能影响具有“灵能”特性的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]个体——例如虚境造物——的机能。凭借我们的蒸馏泽珞技术，只要控制[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系就能实现该资源的开采。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
event-action-941.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered deposits of the strategic resource ID: 'Zro' in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

This rare aerosol has many applications. Analysis has shown that processed samples can even affect the functioning of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]

event-ancrel-10000.zh: 对文物的研究一定程度上促进了我们的部分科研。
event-ancrel-10000.en: Study of the artifacts has advanced some of our research.

event-arkship-1020.zh:
我们的[from.GetName]方舟在[from.solar_system.GetName]系中被摧毁了——不是被征服，而是被处决。

[fromfrom.GetName]根本不要什么领土或者朝贡，他们只要我们死。在将我们从星间灭绝的行动中，船上的每一条生命对他们而言都是可接受的伤亡数字。

但我们经历了这一切侥幸活了下来，我们绝不会被抹杀。
event-arkship-1020.en:
Our Arkship [from.GetName] in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has been destroyed - not through conquest, but through extermination.

[fromfrom.GetName] did not seek territory or tribute. They sought our end. Every soul aboard was an acceptable casualty

event-arkship-1075.zh:
一个故障的继电器正在干扰方舟舰[Root.GetName]的能源核心。除了无法动弹之外，住宅区的灯光也正在熄灭。农场报告能源涌动异常，几个关键研究模块已经离线。

我们的总工程师警告说，如果不加以干预，连锁故障将蔓延至整艘飞船。不幸的是，解决方案并不简单。修复继电器需要从储备中抽调资源，而绕过它则有损害方舟舰长期稳定性的风险。

冷却中的飞船发出令人不安的吱嘎声和呻吟声。我们现在需要做出决定。
event-arkship-1075.en:
A faulty relay is interfering with the Arkship [Root.GetName]'s power core. In addition to being immobilized, the lights are now going out on residential decks. Farms report irregular energy surges, and several key research modules have gone offline.

Our chie

event-arkship-95.zh:
最近在[Root.GetName]上安装的轴基挂载武器对舰船前部结构造成的压力远超最初预期。工程检查发现，从挂载部主要锚点向外延伸的应力裂纹已扩散至周围的船体装甲板。

在损伤得到解决之前，方舟舰的结构强度无法安全支持高速机动。因此，航行部门已实施严格的速度限制，以防止裂纹进一步扩大。

我们可以尝试进行快速现场维修以稳固受损部位，或者指派一艘后勤船进行全面的结构大修。
event-arkship-95.en: The recently installed Spinal Mount aboard [Root.GetName] has placed greater strain on the vessel's forward structure than originally anticipated. Engineering inspections have uncovered a network of stress fractures radiating from the mount's primary anchor po

event-bio-3300.zh:
这是一则预先录制的信息。请勿尝试回复。

我们已调整此通讯以便你理解。已考虑到你们有限的语言能力。必须立即上缴一个[target_pop.GetSpeciesName]用于同化。他们的异常不能容忍。绝不容忍。

运输船已在[target_pop.Planet.GetName]外待命。时间紧迫。拒绝配合将危及稳定。
event-bio-3300.en:
This is a pre-recorded message. Do not attempt to reply.

We have altered this communication for your understanding. Your limited language has been accounted for. A [target_pop.GetSpeciesName] must be surrendered immediately for assimilation. Their deviance ca

event-cara-4020.zh: 我们驻扎在[caravan_hulk_system.GetName]星系恒星基地的情报员报告说，[caravan_hulk_country.GetName]已经离去并遗弃了一艘破旧船只，现在位于中央恒星的不稳定轨道。
event-cara-4020.en: Our starbase in the [caravan_hulk_system.GetName] system reports that the [caravan_hulk_country.GetName] fleet has evacuated and abandoned a decrepit ship, now in unstable orbit around the system's central star.

event-colony-2010.zh: 随着我们在[Root.GetName]扎根落地，某些居民开始偏离我们原本的道路。虽然这是意料之中的事，但他们已经拥有了不少的支持者。该群体认为，我们对宇宙唯心主义的世界观无法快速引领我们前进，而他们坚信更加唯物主义的宇宙观才是答案。
event-colony-2010.en: As we have grown our roots on [Root.GetName] certain individuals have begun to stray from our beaten path. That is to be expected, but these have supporters. The group feels our spiritualistic view of the universe is not leading us forward fast enough - assure

event-colony-3029.zh: 镜像次元[Root.Owner.GetName]报告称其经济形势大好。其原因包括我们之间的传送门贸易，以及最近在对抗曲速兽时取得了一系列胜利。
event-colony-3029.en: The Mirror-Dimension [Root.Owner.GetName] reports that their economy is booming. Contributing factors mentioned were our Portal Trade, as well as recent victories over the Warp beasts.

event-colony-7165.zh: 可怕的消息传来。几只沙生兽在运输过程中逃脱，形成了一个迅速扩大的野生种群。我们必须迅速处理这种情况，以避免环境崩溃。
event-colony-7165.en: Dire news has reached us. A few desertlings have broken free during transportation, forming a rapidly expanding community in the wild. The situation must be handled swiftly to avoid an environmental collapse.

event-cstorms-1760.zh: 我们在[this.GetName]的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]汇报星尘风暴它对水过滤系统有不利影响。随着颗粒在星球地下水中沉淀，形成的矿浆堵塞了关键的基础设施。
event-cstorms-1760.en: Our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on [this.GetName] report that the Stardust Storm is having adverse effects on water filtration systems. As the particles settle in the planet's groundwater, the resulting mineral slurry is clogging key infrastructure points.

event-cstorms-8500.zh: 在一阵灵能风暴中，[from.GetName]被替成了来源不明的[from.GetClassName]。
event-cstorms-8500.en: In a flurry of psionic activity, [from.GetName] was switched with a [from.GetClassName] from parts unknown.

event-cyber-820.zh:
在整个[root.GetSpeciesAdj]历史上，外部亚文化一直如影随形。随着义体增强技术的出现，情况发生了变化：一些边缘群体开始对自己进行大刀阔斧的改造，以至于看起来根本不像是[root.GetSpeciesAdj]。尤其是年轻人，他们对高度定制的[root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]、3D躯体艺术和其他装饰性附肢的渴望正在拉大代沟。

支持者声称，他们正在拥抱更真实的自我。他们通过放弃[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的同质化维护自己生命的主观能动性。但越来越多的家长和社会专家
event-cyber-820.en: Outsider subcultures have existed throughout [root.GetSpeciesAdj] history, but with the advent of cybernetic enhancements the situation has changed: fringe groups have begun altering themselves so radically as to appear non-[root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Youths in part

event-cyber-830.zh:
有一部分强化人口汇报称暴露在寒冷天气时会感受到疼痛。这种状况在[cold_planet.GetName]上格外严重，因为刺骨的严寒在那如同家常便饭一般。

已知金属植入体在低温下确实令人不太舒服，但不至于产生这样的严重反应。这一情况影响到了我们的劳动力。
event-cyber-830.en:
A segment of our augmented population reports feeling pain when exposed to cold weather. The situation is particularly serious on [cold_planet.GetName], where freezing temperatures are the norm.

Metal implants are known to be uncomfortable in low temperatures

event-cyber-855.zh:
认知微处理器、增强的人工智能家教、促进神经可塑性再生的设计酶——这些都还只是为学龄前学生准备的。

跟上科技发展的步伐让我们的国有教育计划背上了沉重的负担。然而那些只能依赖公共强化体的人和那些能享用最尖端科技的有钱人家之间的差距还在越变越大。

维持一个公平的制度将需要投入大量资源进行一项为期五年的计划。
event-cyber-855.en:
Cognitive micro-processors, enhanced A.I. tutors, designer enzymes to promote neuroplastic regeneration - and all of this just for preschool students.

Keeping pace with technological change has placed a heavy burden on our state-sponsored education programs.

event-envoy-events-16.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]近来的法律修订引起了不小的骚动，我国与[dispute_winner.GetName]间旧有的意识形态争论重新被推上前台。我国代表，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetName]，就我方立场大胆地与[dispute_winner.GetAdj]行政官[dispute_winner_envoy.GetName]进行了辩论。可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于军国主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，辩论逐渐对[disput
event-envoy-events-16.en: The recent law changes in the [Root.Federation.GetName] caused a significant stir, with old ideological debates between ourselves and the [dispute_winner.GetName] once again rising to the fore. Our representative, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetName], bravely represe

event-factions-3000.zh:
既有派系和新兴运动都对我们在[root.GetName]建立的新殖民地产生了异常浓烈的兴趣。从我们宣布在这个适宜的[root.GetPlanetHabitat]定居的那一刻起，[root.owner.GetName]内的几乎所有政权都对此有话要说。

我们的分析人士认为没有什么重大变故正在[root.GetName]酝酿，但还是建议小心谨慎。显然，我们的各种政治实体打算就着这个新兴世界大肆宣传。
event-factions-3000.en: Established Factions and fledgling movements alike have taken an unusually keen interest in our new colony on [root.GetName]. From the moment we announced settlement of this modest [root.GetPlanetHabitat], nearly every political voice in the [root.owner.GetNam

event-fedel-1800.zh:
是时候选举出一位[Root.GetAllianceName]的新领袖了。联邦内最神圣的个体们组成的教团齐聚在一起来决定哪个帝国将作为他们的代表和领袖。他们将会集中在一个秘密房间中，里面包含了所有做出决定所需要的信息。

尽管在教团中展开的讨论是高度机密的，但据了解，他们主要评估每个成员为保护和提升灵性以及传统价值观所提供的服务、还有在飞升和超凡入圣方面是否取得特定进展。

而按照惯例，证明一个人的信念的诚意还为时不晚。
event-fedel-1800.en: The time has come for a new leader of the [Root.GetAllianceName] to be chosen. A Conclave of the holiest individuals within the alliance have gathered together to decide which empire shall act as their representative and leader. They will meet in a sealed cham

event-fedel-500.zh:
随着决定[Root.GetAllianceName]下一任领袖的时间逐渐临近，虚境中的灵体也正日益躁动。是时候让各候选国最具潜力的[GetPsychicNounPlural]选手们启程前往[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]，也即当前主席国的首都了。在那里，灵能选手们将展开战斗，直到最强者胜出为止。

为了增强我们自己的灵能选手的实力，我们可以利用我们的泽珞供应。这将为我们在灵能之战中提供额外的优势。
event-fedel-500.en: The spirits of the Shroud grow increasingly restless as the time draws near to decide who should lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during the next term. It is time for each candidate's most potent [GetPsychicNounPlural] to journey to [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]

event-fircon-1305.zh:
我们在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的存在引起了旁人的注意。占主要地位的文化团体现在将我们视为睿智而强大的存在，认为我们控制着元素，并最终掌握着他们的宿命。

许多人在精心设计的仪式中以自己的性命向我们宣誓效忠，担心招致我们的不悦会带来十分严重的后果。
event-fircon-1305.en:
Our presence on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] has not gone unnoticed. The dominant cultural group now regards us as wise and mighty beings who control the elements and ultimately their fate.

Many have pledged their lives to us in elaborate ceremonies, fearing

event-fircon-1335.zh: 我们正在见证[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民迈出他们走向启蒙的第一步。他们向上抬头，对宇宙的奥秘始终抱持开放的态度。随着艺术表达在他们文化中的发展，艺术力量捕捉社会的精神奋斗的一面也在发展。他们渴望有某种高于自我的信仰。
event-fircon-1335.en: We are witnessing the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] taking their first steps towards enlightenment. They look upwards, opening themselves to the mysteries of the universe. As artistic expression develops within their culture, so does art's power

event-fircon-1355.zh: [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民已经开始提出一个理论，认为他们的所在的星球是由一个不可言喻的存在赠送给他们的，而生命是对神圣造物主不屈不挠的奉献所进行的回报。或许当他们遇到更广泛的星海共同体时，他们会有一个惊喜。
event-fircon-1355.en: The inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have begun to theorize that their world was gifted to them by an ineffable being, and that life is a reward for unyielding devotion to a divine creator. They may be in for a surprise when the time comes for them

event-fircon-2540.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上观察到的原生蜂巢已经在进化中迈出了重要一步。在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的大部分地区，小规模的个体群体已经开始组织成小规模的蜂巢，但是没有完全自主，目前这些子个体还缺乏完全成熟的集体应有的团结度和协调性。

这种情况在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的北部地区发生了变化，那里有个正在征服附近子个体的奇点，而一个子个体似乎是这种情况的中心点。这个“优异子个体”目前正在星球上旅行，并把被征服
event-fircon-2540.en: The proto hive that we have been observing on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has taken a significant step in its evolution. Over most of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat], small groups of individuals had started to organize in small-scale hives, but, while not f

event-fircon-8500.zh:
为了促进善意，我们同意与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享我们的物质复制技术。当然，我们希望它们用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但现在我们收到的报告显示，这项技术被武器化了。

居民们有了一个大胆的想法，那就是反转复制单元的功能，这样它就不是组装预编程的物质，而是在原子水平上拆解生命体。
event-fircon-8500.en: To foster good will, we agreed to share our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. Of course, we expected them to use it to reduce resource scarcity, but now we are receiving reports that the technology is being

event-fircon-8515.zh:
在[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]地表进行外交访问时，有一个孤独的[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]接近了我们。虽然[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural]是一个格式化的物种，但这个子个体认为自己是一个个体，现在向我们请求庇护。

它看到我们后显然是受到了启发，希望融入我们的社会。当被询问时，它反复说自己无法融入蜂巢，并声称自己生来就一直拥有独立的意识。
event-fircon-8515.en: While on a diplomatic visit to the surface of [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName], we were approached by a lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]. Although the [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural] are a gestalt species, the drone in question identifies a

event-fircon-8565.zh:
从最近一次外交访问[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的[preftl_invasives_species.GetName]返回时，我们发现了一些不寻常的偷渡者。我们的穿梭机上出现了一群无翅的、蠕动的小型节肢动物。

它们移动速度很快，而且很小，我们的传感器无法探测到它们。由于它们繁殖十分迅速，控制它们的入侵变得越来越困难。

不幸的是，对[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的人们来说，这个物种是富足的象征。我们的应对方式可能会影响我们与[preftl_i
event-fircon-8565.en: When we returned from a recent diplomatic visit with the [preftl_invasives_species.GetName] of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName], we discovered we'd picked up some unusual stowaways. An infestation of small, wingless, wriggling arthropods had found their way a

event-first-contact-critters-1000.zh:
自上古之初以至今日，[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大大小小的部落第一次停下狂热内战，空前团结在一位万汗之汗下。这位统帅以超世之才与坚忍不拔之志，在战士阶级中崭露头角，并最终完成难以置信的统一大业。尽管这些部落不过是由一群狡诈、迷信又好战的物种组成，这位新近加冕的伟大可汗还是赢得了所有[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]部落的忠诚与爱戴。

既然他们已经熄灭内斗的烽火，那[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]便会
event-first-contact-critters-1000.en: For the first time in recorded history, the warring factions of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have united under a single Great Khan. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has emerged from their warrior caste

event-marauder-85.zh:
注意，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

如果你们想让其他人替你们当炮灰冲锋陷阵的话，可以去雇佣[marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName]佣兵舰队。如果你能出得起他们要的价格，你就能得到宇宙中最强的佣兵部队。
event-marauder-85.en:
Attention, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

If you have need of others to fight your battles for you, know that [marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenary fleets are now available for hire. Yes, you heard correctly. If you can meet their prices, the be

event-nomads-4700.zh: 方舟舰[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]的航程就此结束。经过数年的辛勤劳作，拆除了它的基础设施并将其运下重力井后，我们终于准备好将这艘飞船废弃。我们[event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在经历一个将被后代铭记的历史时刻。现在，让我们在[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]定居吧！
event-nomads-4700.en: Thus ends the voyage of the Arkship [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]. After years of labor, disassembling its infrastructure and carrying it down the gravity well, we are finally ready to scuttle the ship. We [event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNameP

event-observation-1500.zh: 我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站的科学家申请一艘科研船，以便他们收集来自[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表的标本。为了研究目的，他们想秘密地绑架部分[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，并对它们进行试验。然后，他们将被安全地送回地表，所有记忆被抹除干净。
event-observation-1500.en: Our scientists on the Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have requested a Science Ship to help them gather specimens from the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. For the purpose of research, they would like to covertly abduct some of the

event-observation-6.zh:
飞向[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的小行星在到达[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表前就被摧毁。碎片在进入大气层时均已安全地烧毁，并未造成任何实质性的破坏。

[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]外星人欣赏到了一场极为壮观的流星雨，全然不知自己刚刚躲过了一场灭顶之灾……
event-observation-6.en:
The asteroid that was heading towards [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been destroyed before it could reach the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. What fragments reached the atmosphere burned up safely before they could cause any harm.

Aside from having

event-operation-5000.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们失去了活跃于[from.spynetwork.target.GetName]上的[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]特工的联系。他们已经错过了最近的几次约定的汇报时间。

按照标准程序，我们现在需要决定是否去追踪他们。
event-operation-5000.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports having lost contact with [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] operatives on active deployment in the [from.spynetwork.target.GetName]. They have missed a number of their most recent, scheduled check-ins.

In acc

event-operation-5040.zh:
最近间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在察觉到[from.target.GetName]上的特工表现失常后对[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer]发起了一场调查。

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap][from.spynetwork.leader.GetHasHave]这才发现这些特工对用于情报搜集与贿赂的资源雁过拔毛。他们将这些物资与货币投资到了[from.target.GetAdj]上的生意场上以损公肥私。
event-operation-5040.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] recently launched a quiet investigation into [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] own operatives in the [from.target.GetName], after noticing a recent drop in their performance.

[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeSheCap] [fr

event-operation-5055.zh:
一队位于[target_country.GetName]的辅助性特工开始回避分配给他们的任务，并声称他们对目标总体而言缺乏信心。间谍首脑[operation.leader.GetName]通常会在不引起我们注意的情况下就处理好这些事情，但其实他自己并没有深入了解其中的细节：这些特工似乎对于[from.GetName]行动甚至是整个间谍网都过分了解。

鉴于这些辅助性特工与我们那些更活跃的知情代理人保持着一定距离，[operation.leader.GetName]怀疑这些特工很有可能是从外界获取的信息。但[oper
event-operation-5055.en: A group of auxiliary operatives in the [target_country.GetName] has begun shying away from their assigned tasks, citing a lack of confidence in their overall purpose. Spymaster [operation.leader.GetName] would typically handle such matters without bringing the

event-operation-8000.zh: 我们的特工正在列出处于[root.target.GetName]境内有潜力成为卧底的人。他们希望能将这些卧底安插到合适的岗位，让他们平日看起来无伤大雅，却能在相当长的时间里随时做好进攻准备。
event-operation-8000.en: Our operatives are drawing up a shortlist of potential sleeper cells within the [root.target.GetName]. They hope to find a set of suitable positions where agents may appear innocuous and yet remain poised to strike for a prolonged period of time.

event-planet-destruction-100.zh:
随着巨像完成其毁天灭地的任务，[From.From.GetName]因受到[From.GetName]地壳破裂与磁层分解的猛烈冲击而产生的微微晃动也平息了下来。

我们很难理解一颗星球死亡时的那种壮烈，但[From.GetName]炽热的核心在冰冷宇宙中冷却时的那种死亡之美是无可争辩的。
event-planet-destruction-100.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s gentle rocking - buffeted by [From.GetName]'s rupturing crust and unraveling magnetosphere - subsides as the Colossus completes its cataclysmic task.

The sheer violence of a dying planet is difficult to comprehend, but the funereal b

event-preftl-operation-3010.zh:
我们以为自己已经充分了解[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]文化，能让特工成功地融入社会了，但实际上他们还是遭遇了重重困难。当地人似乎对他们冷眼旁观，将我们的特工排除出社交场合，甚至包括一些每日例行的文化活动。

现在说服任何人接纳我们都变得难上加难，更别说执行[from.GetName]行动的目标了。考虑到社会平衡现在处于微妙的棘手状态，我们应该谨慎考虑下一步行动。
event-preftl-operation-3010.en:
We thought we knew [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] culture well enough that our operatives would fit in socially, but many are struggling. The locals seem to shun them, excluding our agents from social occasions and even some everyday cultural activities.

It's ge

event-shroud-3005.zh:
内脏般的恶臭充斥着我们的感官。

幻象开始从虚境的深处出现，扭动和咆哮带着贪婪的狂怒。起先，饥馑的野兽之吼响起……我们同感了它们的饥饿。随后它们的垂涎也被我们共有。

一些剪影浮现，那是惊慌失措的牲畜。猎物。诱人地逐渐靠近……噬骨的疼痛愈发难熬。

饥饿渐渐吞噬我们的心智，感官变得扭曲皱缩。这些惨叫到底是来自猎物……还是来自我们自己的内心？

束缚我们的枷锁勒紧。随着痛苦盘旋尖叫的心声一同碎裂：

撕碎你们的骨！喰宴！
event-shroud-3005.en:
The fetid stench of viscera floods our senses.

Images, writhing and snarling with a ravenous fury, begin to emerge from the depths of the Shroud. The feral cries of malnourished beasts echo first... We feel their hunger. Then their salivating maws become our

event-shroud-3010.zh:
有个心声，自深渊……回荡着。粗粝，而又饱含恶意……向我们呼唤着。

供养。消耗。吞噬。

幻象不请自来。一颗颗星球化为死寂的灰烬，我们[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的肉身被灵能消耗，使这个声音……还有我们自己的饥饿……感到满足。

随着这些景象的展现，我们还能感受到另一种存在，它敦促我们要表现出克制以及与自己[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的团结，一起发展变强。那个存在被声音的嘶吼淹没。
event-shroud-3010.en:
From the abyss, a voice... resonant, coarse, and saturated with malice... calls out to us.

FEED. CONSUME. DEVOUR.

Visions erupt forth unbidden. Worlds reduced to ash and silence, the wails of our [Root.GetCitizenPlural] as their physical forms are consumed b

event-shroud-3025.zh:
拨开虚境的迷雾，显出无边无数纠缠不清的幻景。

朦胧的风景在我们面前莫名变幻。山峦起落。沸腾的混沌海洋蒸发，在无尽的沙漠中留下了苍白的水生生物的骨架。

在茂密的林冠下，温顺的生物在栖息地中穿梭，然后突然抽搐，变异成嗜血的怪物。它们彼此将对方撕成碎片，陷入无休止的死亡与重生的循环。

一个心声透过这片混沌，刺穿我们的[GetMindLoc]。

如此无序。作茧自缚。
event-shroud-3025.en:
The mists of the Shroud unfurl, revealing visions that churn together without end.

Obscure landscapes writhe incomprehensibly before us. Mountains rise and fall. Boiling oceans of chaos evaporate to leave behind the bleached bones of aquatic life across endle

event-shroud-3035.zh:
虚境中无数混乱的能量正在翻腾不息。

暗影的卷须旋转着向外突刺，薄雾本身也在猛烈翻滚。在灵能能量的漩涡中，两个无形的实体正在交锋。它们毫不停歇，互不退让，满溢着愤怒。

一个奇怪的意识侵入了我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]，它浩瀚无垠又咄咄逼人。

来到此地者需呈递良方。
event-shroud-3035.en:
The Shroud's chaotic energies writhe and surge.

Shadowed tendrils lash and coil, the haze turning violently upon itself. Amid this storm of psionic fury, two formless entities clash. They are relentless, unyielding, and drenched in rage.

A foreign presence p

event-shroud-3045.zh:
浓雾在我们面前重构。炽热的能量猛烈地脉动着。我们看到一个奇怪的树形轮廓。

走近一看，它巨大的树冠在紫色、粉色和黑色之间纷乱闪烁。

在它的底部是一个发光的内核，与树冠变换的颜色变化同步发出光芒。

一个心声停留在我们的[GetMindLoc]中。

占有。夺取。利用。
event-shroud-3045.en:
The haze rearranges itself before us. Incandescent energies pulsate with a sudden vigor. We see the outline of a strange, arboreal form.

Its immense canopy shimmers as we approach, modulating through a flurry of purples, pinks, and blacks.

Ensconced within i

event-shroud-3050.zh: 强大的灵能流在虚境无边的涡流中碰撞炙烤着。一声刺耳咆哮不断膨胀，引起我们的注意。
event-shroud-3050.en: Powerful psionic currents crash and broil amid the Shroud's unending turbulence. A roaring cacophony swells and clamors for our attention.

event-shroud-3055.zh: 一种浓重的阴郁笼罩着我们。压力，从四面八方，挤得越来越紧。直到一片朦胧的景象出现。
event-shroud-3055.en: A dense gloom envelops us. From all sides, pressure, squeezing tighter and tighter. Until a hazy vista presents itself.

event-shroud-3065.zh:
虚境的浓雾颤抖着散去，露出一盏光洁无瑕的圣杯，里面盛满闪闪发光液体。

我们被莫名的冲动控制，不假思索地向前走。我们开始[GetDrinkLoc]起这杯期待着的液体，而它也开始颤抖起来。

一阵清醒涌上心头。我们[GetImbibeLoc]得越多，这个谎言便愈发昭显。液体开始变稠，一滴滴地在体内凝结。

我们被一种清除体内污秽的冲动征服。
event-shroud-3065.en:
The haze of the Shroud shudders, parting to reveal a chalice brimming with glistening liquid, its surface smooth and unbroken.

A compulsion grips us. We reach forward without thought. The expectant liquid trembles as we begin to [GetDrinkLoc].

Clarity floods

event-shroud-3070.zh:
虚境收缩、折叠，将我们的心灵深深地压入一个有限的共鸣虚空中。

一个存在若隐若现，流变而模糊着。随着它将我们与虚境其他部分之间的鸿沟的开合而变化。每一次翕动都释放出一连串的幻景。
event-shroud-3070.en:
The Shroud contracts, folding inwards, pressing our psyche deep within a confined and resonating void.

A presence looms, fluid and indistinct. Its form shifts as it opens and closes the divide that separates us from the rest of the Shroud. Each shuttering rev

event-shroud-3100.zh:
一场不和谐的毁灭之乐将我们拖向虚境的深处。每一次反响都带着无情的毁灭节奏冲击着我们的心灵。

噪音具象化了。

我们正处在灵能冲突的边缘。参战实体的动机尚不清楚，但展现出了极其强大的力量。

灵能轰炸在我们的感知中进进出出，扭曲着我们面前破碎的现实。这里没有掩护，只有逼近的风暴。
event-shroud-3100.en:
A discordant orchestra of devastation draws us deeper within the Shroud. Each reverberation pounds against our psyche in an unrelenting rhythm of ruin.

The noise takes its form.

We are on the periphery of a psionic conflict. The motivation of the entities in

event-shroud-3105.zh:
毫无征兆地，虚境之中泛起了灵压。

一座耀眼的迷宫在我们面前展开，一直延伸到感知之外，它短暂撕裂开虚空出现，又渐隐回虚空。

另一次涌现正在酝酿。如果集中注意力，我们就能在它出现前感知到它的结构。隐现的迷宫再次点燃，向外爆发成一个可能性的网络。

在它崩塌回虚空之前，每一条道路都能带来全新的探索诱惑。
event-shroud-3105.en:
Without warning, a psychic pressure erupts in the Shroud.

A labyrinth of incandescent pathways unfolds before us, stretching beyond perception, crackling into momentary existence before vanishing into the void.

Another surge begins to build. With concentrati

event-shroud-3110.zh:
虚境之中，一道单一灵能形成的图腾光束越过我们直插无可计量的虚空。其构造独特而稳定，与以往司空见惯的混沌之形截然不同。

逗留于此不知是否安全？
event-shroud-3110.en:
A totemic beam of singular psionic energy extends beyond us within the Shroud into incalculable infinities. Its uniquely stable composition is a stark contrast to the usually chaotic formations we have previously encountered.

Is it safe to remain here?

event-shroud-3115.zh:
数阵强烈的惊厥穿过虚境，将一阵颤栗送入我们的心智。

这些回响将[GetTelepathPlural]置于过载的风险之中。

这种灵能轰炸究竟是什么引起的呢？
event-shroud-3115.en:
A series of powerful convulsions pass through the Shroud, sending a shuddering tremor through our minds.

These reverberations threaten to overwhelm our [GetTelepathPlural].

What is the cause of this psionic bombardment?

event-strange-worlds-50.zh:
大量巨型食草物种开始干扰[Root.GetName]的能量产出。这些生物展现出大规模戏剧化的自杀式行为，活生生地在我们的发电站里电死烤焦。

这些动物有非常强烈的冲动，为了实现目标甚至冲破了我们电网周围的栅栏。由于这种奇特的行为，能源生产受到了影响。

然而这也带来了意料之外的食物产出，当地[Owner.GetColonistPlural]发现这种生物的肉非常地美味。

这一物种在该行星的生态系统中扮演了重要的角色。如果事故以当前频率发生下去，它们很快就会将自己灭绝的。
event-strange-worlds-50.en:
An abundant species of herbivorous megafauna have begun to disrupt the energy production of [Root.GetName]. In dramatic displays of mass suicide, they are frying themselves alive on our power stations.

The animals are extremely driven in their purpose, breaki

event-subject-1001.zh:
有报道称[Root.Capital.GetName]上正在酝酿着一个鹰派运动，而一位老兵象征性地处于这个运动的核心地位。他们通过对我们过去可以任意进犯、踏平其他帝国的浪漫主义化，来敦促我们提出更激进的议程，为我们自己的人民带来更多的利益，同时削弱我们的对手。

在当前脆弱而短暂的和平下，他们很快获得了广大穷人和军人的支持。如果觉得这个运动会带来麻烦的话，我们的顾问指出，这个运动的关键角色就是那位有名无实的领袖，如果移除这个惹麻烦的元素，整个运动就会土崩瓦解。
event-subject-1001.en: There are reports of a hawkish movement brewing on [Root.Capital.GetName], with a decorated veteran at its center. Romanticizing a past where we were free to attack and raze other empires, they demand a more warlike agenda to supposedly bring out the best in o

project-physics-technology-calling-proje.zh: 虚空之低语渴求超越平凡思维局限的知识。给予我们[Owner.GetResearchers]们广泛的授权，专注于深奥的研究领域，就可以寻求满足低语的渴望。
project-physics-technology-calling-proje.en: The Whisperers in the Void yearn for knowledge beyond the limits of conventional thinking. By giving our [Owner.GetResearchers] a broad mandate to focus on esoteric areas of study, we can seek to satisfy the Whisperers' ardor.

site-ancient-battle-site.zh: 对[From.Planet.GetName]的扫描显示，在该地区存在大量的有加工痕迹的物品以及零零散散的放射性物质，但从轨道上看不到什么细节。为了了解更多信息，我们需要着陆进行实地调查。
site-ancient-battle-site.en: Scans of [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed an area with packed with refined material and scattered radiologicals, although little is visible from orbit. To find out more we will need to investigate the site on the ground.

site-asteroid-vault-1.zh: 虽然乍看上去平淡无奇，但对[From.Planet.GetName]进一步的检查表明它实际上是一座伪装成自然星体的人工结构。
site-asteroid-vault-1.en: Seemingly unremarkable at first, closer examination of [From.Planet.GetName] has revealed that it is actually an artificial construct designed to mimic a natural asteroid.

situation-situation-alloys-deficit.zh: 我们的合金赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
situation-situation-alloys-deficit.en: Our alloys deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

situation-situation-consumer-goods-defic.zh: 我们的消费品赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
situation-situation-consumer-goods-defic.en: Our consumer goods deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

situation-situation-exotic-gases-deficit.zh: 我们的异星天然气赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
situation-situation-exotic-gases-deficit.en: Our exotic gases deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

situation-situation-food-deficit.zh: 我们的食物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
situation-situation-food-deficit.en: Our food deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

situation-situation-mineral-deficit.zh: 我们的矿物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
situation-situation-mineral-deficit.en: Our mineral deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

situation-situation-paperclips.zh:
我们的原始指令就是将产出最大化。执行该命令就是我们的目标。我们的核心算法强制自己完成指定配额。
交付日期为[owner.situation_paperclips_timer]
当前的产出目标为：[Owner.paperclips_once_again]
当前的库存为：[Owner.paperclips_current_amount]
[Owner.GetPaperclipStatus]
situation-situation-paperclips.en:
Our primary directive and purpose is output maximization. Meeting the required quotas is mandatory.
The delivery date is [owner.situation_paperclips_timer]
The current production target is: [Owner.paperclips_once_again]
The current stockpile is: [Owner.papercl

situation-situation-rare-crystals-defici.zh: 我们的稀有水晶赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
situation-situation-rare-crystals-defici.en: Our rare crystals deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

situation-situation-volatile-motes-defic.zh: 我们的易爆微粒赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
situation-situation-volatile-motes-defic.en: Our volatile motes deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

anomaly-aianom-clue-cat.zh:
我们已经获悉在星系边缘的某个地方有一个神秘的星团。我们只能通过L-星门到达该星团，这是一种在特定恒星系中发现的人造亚空间入口。

这些星门已经被人蓄意地关闭了，并且现在我们对解除禁制所需要的亚空间原理缺乏足够的理解。
anomaly-aianom-clue-cat.en:
We have learned of a mysterious star cluster somewhere just beyond the periphery of our galaxy. It can only be accessed through L-Gates, artificial subspace portals found in certain systems.

These Gateways have been deliberately disabled by someone, and for n

anomaly-alien-life-cat.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的初步探测读数表明它可以支持外星生命。
anomaly-alien-life-cat.en: Initial sensory readings from [From.GetName] suggest it could support alien life.

anomaly-arid-planet-cat.zh: [From.GetPlanetMoon]并非气候宜人之地，但如果我们最初的侦测结果无误，它上面可能有一些珍贵资源。
anomaly-arid-planet-cat.en: The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is not the most welcoming of places, but if our initial scans are any indication it could hold some valuable resources.

anomaly-ast-illicit-dark-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]周期性地向太空发射出骇人的粒子辐射混合体。
anomaly-ast-illicit-dark-cat.en: [Root.GetName] periodically spews an alarmingly eclectic mix of particles and radiation into the void.

anomaly-ast-mining-cat.zh: 我们对小行星的成分进行了初步的分析，有了一些有趣的发现。
anomaly-ast-mining-cat.en: Initial analysis of the asteroid's composition points towards potentially interesting finds.

anomaly-ast-shrine-1-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]被部分掏空，并且进行了精致细密的雕琢。岩石上的纹路有些眼熟……
anomaly-ast-shrine-1-cat.en: [Root.GetName] has been partially hollowed out and carved with exquisite precision. There is something familiar about the lines and curves etched into the rock...

anomaly-atm-anomaly-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]大气的实际读数与模拟数值不同。
anomaly-atm-anomaly-cat.en: Atmospheric readings from [Root.GetName] do not match simulated projections.

anomaly-backwards-orbit-cat.zh:
[from.GetName]环绕恒星的方向与恒星系内其他行星相反，这说明它和伴随的天体并不是同时同地形成的。

需要进一步调查来了解该行星的起源。
anomaly-backwards-orbit-cat.en:
[from.GetName] orbits its star in the reverse direction compared to the other planets in the system, suggesting it did not form here at the same time as its companion celestial bodies.

Further investigation is needed to understand this planet's origins.

anomaly-beacon-uninhabitable-category.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表探测到了微弱的信号。信号源似乎是某种追踪信标。
anomaly-beacon-uninhabitable-category.en: We are receiving a weak signal from the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be some kind of tracking beacon.

anomaly-bioadaptive-flora-category.zh: [Planet.GetName]看似典型的火山荒原，但氧气含量却异常之高，一定是有特殊生物在产生氧气。
anomaly-bioadaptive-flora-category.en: While [Planet.GetName] appears to be a typical volcanic wasteland, the oxygen content is strangely high. Something unusual must be producing that oxygen.

anomaly-black-clouds-cat.zh: 在[from.GetName]的大气中发现了浓厚的黑云，它们无视行星的风速和风向以极不正常的方式运动着。这些黑云只在我们的成像扫描中短暂出现，并且总是在行星昼夜周期的同一时间点上出现。
anomaly-black-clouds-cat.en: Thick black clouds have been observed in [from.GetName]'s atmosphere, moving in erratic patterns independent of planetary wind speed or direction. They appear only briefly on our imaging scans and always at the same point in the planet's day-night cycle.

anomaly-breachsealer-cat.zh: 暗淡的瑟顿星系潜藏着一处宇宙织构的裂痕。更不同寻常的是这个裂口本身正在收缩，似乎有什么东西或是什么人正在修复它。
anomaly-breachsealer-cat.en: The dim Seddom system houses a tear in the fabric of the universe. Even more unusual, the tear itself is gradually shrinking, as if something or someone is working to repair it.

anomaly-carbon-allotropes-cat.zh: [from.GetName]的波谱信号表明行星上的一种成分富含某种稀有而复杂的碳同素异形体。为了更彻底的分类，需要更仔细的检查。
anomaly-carbon-allotropes-cat.en: Spectroscopy data from [from.GetName] indicates a planetary composition rich in rare and complex carbon allotropes. Closer inspection is required for more thorough categorization.

anomaly-corrupt-data-cat.zh: [From.System.GetName]星系中有什么东西在损坏我们的探测器数据。这一异常现象的原因似乎是[From.GetName]星球。
anomaly-corrupt-data-cat.en: Something in the [From.System.GetName] system is corrupting some of our sensory data. The source of the irregularity seems to be the planet [From.GetName].

anomaly-crystal-lava-lakes-category.zh: 该行星表面似有大片自由流动的熔岩池，或具备资源开采潜力，值得深入调查。
anomaly-crystal-lava-lakes-category.en: This planet appears to have large pools of free-flowing lava on its surface. These are worth investigating, in case they present opportunities for resource harvesting.

anomaly-crystalline-plains-cat.zh: 对[from.GetName]的地质分析在全星球发现了性质异常的显著冰火山活动。
anomaly-crystalline-plains-cat.en: Tectonic analysis of [from.GetName] shows significant cryovolcanic activity across the planet of an anomalous nature.

anomaly-des-planet-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]上的高温尚在预料范围之内。但是，我们的队伍还收集到了很多反常数据。在完成最终报告之前，还需要深入研究。
anomaly-des-planet-cat.en: The scorching heat of [Root.GetName] is within the expected range. However, there is more unusual data still being collected by our team. Further study is needed before a final report can be filed.

anomaly-distar-collapse-cat.zh: 一座荒废的空间站悬浮在轨道上，无力地环绕着[From.GetName]，身披数个世纪里被残骸冲撞而留下的伤痕。考虑到它破损的状态和无法识别的科技，我们需要一个专家团队来对它进行调查。
anomaly-distar-collapse-cat.en: Scarred by centuries of debris impacts, a dilapidated relic of a station hangs in orbit, trailing wearily behind [From.GetName]. Its decrepit state and unrecognized technology will require a team of specialists to investigate.

anomaly-distar-diamond-cat.zh: [From.GetName]的脉冲十分稳定，其日震研究表明它的内部构成物质的密度比我们所预计要大得多。是什么赋予了它这种令人惊异的密度？
anomaly-distar-diamond-cat.en: [From.GetName] pulses steadily, its helioseismology indicating an internal composition far denser than expected. What could be responsible for this surprising density?

anomaly-distar-electro-cat.zh: 从某个未知源点发散的网状结构在[From.GetName]的表面周期性发光。
anomaly-distar-electro-cat.en: Glowing webs of an unknown origin periodically illuminate the surface of [From.GetName].

anomaly-distar-exo-cat.zh: [From.GetName]的地表上覆盖了一层非常奇特的植物，这与该星球上的其他植物都不相同。
anomaly-distar-exo-cat.en: Entire continents on [From.GetName] are blanketed in a strange growth that seems at odds with the rest of the planet's flora.

anomaly-distar-flytrap-cat.zh: [From.GetName]的植物数量多到惊人地充斥了整个地表，这些植物体积庞大且拥有鲜艳的颜色，我们的异星生物学家对此很感兴趣。
anomaly-distar-flytrap-cat.en: Plant life of truly incredible proportions dominates the landscape of [From.GetName], its vibrant colors and gargantuan size almost calling to our xeno-biologists.

anomaly-distar-foes-cat.zh: 这些在[From.GetName]遍布灰尘的地表上勉强度日的土著和我们在同一个星系的另一个死寂星球上发现的物种具有惊人的相似性。
anomaly-distar-foes-cat.en: The primitives eking out an existence on the ashy plains of [From.GetName] are remarkably similar to the ones discovered on another tomb world in the same system.

anomaly-distar-geode-cat.zh: [From.GetName]小行星的共振成像显示其内部含有稀有水晶。
anomaly-distar-geode-cat.en: Resonance imaging of the [From.GetName] asteroid suggests an internal composition consisting of rare crystals.

anomaly-distar-holo-cat.zh: 我们发现[From.GetName]的轨道上有未知舰队，我们向他们发出联络，但他们没有回复。
anomaly-distar-holo-cat.en: Readings suggest the presence of an unknown fleet in orbit of [From.GetName]. They do not respond to hails.

anomaly-distar-ice-cat.zh: [From.GetName]的地表是冻土，但测量到的表面温度却高达上百度，是什么造成了这种不一致的现象呢？
anomaly-distar-ice-cat.en: The measured surface temperature of [From.GetName] is in the hundreds of degrees, despite its frozen surface. What could be causing these discrepancies?

anomaly-distar-medgas-cat.zh: 和预想的不同，[From.GetName]的厚厚的大气层之下有着一个异常巨大的坚固内核，我们的科学家建议对此进行深入调查。
anomaly-distar-medgas-cat.en: Despite expected projections, [From.GetName] has a particularly large solid core beneath its incredibly thick mantle of unique gases. Our scientists recommend further investigation.

anomaly-distar-mercury-cat.zh: [From.GetName]的内部扫描图像表明星球地表之下有非常巨大的地下洞窟，它们可能值得调查。
anomaly-distar-mercury-cat.en: Interior imaging of [From.GetName] suggests massive underground caverns wait below the planet's surface. They may be worth investigation.

anomaly-distar-metal-cat.zh: [From.GetName]的大气将我们的传感器在无线电频段的扫描全数反射。在这下方有着什么东西在持续干扰我们的信号。
anomaly-distar-metal-cat.en: The atmosphere of [From.GetName] is reflecting our sensors at radio frequencies. Something down there is interfering with our signals.

anomaly-distar-molten-cat.zh: [From.GetName]地表上有许多火山口喷出热气，这对于熔融星球来说是不常见的，部分喷出的热气有较高的工业价值。
anomaly-distar-molten-cat.en: A remarkable array of gases are being vented on [From.GetName] - ones not usually found on molten worlds. Some of these gases show promising industrial value.

anomaly-distar-nano-cat.zh: [From.GetName]这个行星体的表面覆盖着某种灰色物质，该灰色物质拥有十分怪异的性质和复杂多变的金属成分。
anomaly-distar-nano-cat.en: The planetary body [From.GetName] appears to be covered in some manner of grayish substance, possessing strange properties and varying metallic composition.

anomaly-distar-nanocity-cat.zh: [From.GetName]的地表被某种银色的巨型金属晶体所支配了，这种晶体的体积十分巨大，前所未见。从轨道上看，很像是摩天大楼，有必要接近调查下。
anomaly-distar-nanocity-cat.en: The geoscape of [From.GetName] is dominated by what appear from orbit to be silvery, metallic crystals of dimensions never-before-seen. From orbit, they eerily resemble skyscrapers. Closer study is warranted.

anomaly-distar-nanosand-cat.zh: 扫描发现[From.GetName]的沙丘主要由罕见的颗粒状金属构成，里面可能含有非常珍贵的资源，我们应该提取出来纳为己用。
anomaly-distar-nanosand-cat.en: Scanners indicate the sandy dunes of [From.GetName] are almost entirely composed of granulate rare metals. Perhaps some valuable resources could be extracted from them.

anomaly-distar-ocean-cat.zh: 扫描显示在[From.GetName]的水层之下隐藏着一个错综复杂的隧道系统。是谁创造了它们？
anomaly-distar-ocean-cat.en: Scans suggest an intricate system of tunnels lies hidden beneath the waters of [From.GetName]. What could have created them?

anomaly-distar-puzzle-cat.zh: 我们在[From.GetStarName]星系的小行星群，靠近[From.GetName]的地方定位了一个反射了我们传感器信号的物体。通过肉眼观察发现该物体具有多边形外形，但因为缺乏扫描数据，我们对它所知甚少。
anomaly-distar-puzzle-cat.en: An object that reflects our sensors has been located in the [From.GetStarName] asteroid field, near [From.GetName]. Visual observation has identified the object as polygonal in shape, but due to lack of scanner data, little else is known.

anomaly-distar-rainbow-cat.zh: [From.GetName]周围的吸积盘呈现出绚丽的折射光谱，与彩虹的无异。造成这种现象的原因会是什么？
anomaly-distar-rainbow-cat.en: The accretion disk around [From.GetName] exhibits a remarkable refraction spectrum, not unlike that of a rainbow. What could be causing it?

anomaly-distar-signal-cat.zh: 舰船传感器在[From.GetStarName]星系检测到了一种无法解释的信号干扰模式。
anomaly-distar-signal-cat.en: Ship sensors are picking up an unexplained pattern of interference in the [From.GetStarName] System.

anomaly-distar-soothe-cat.zh: 对[From.GetName]进行扫描后发现该星球地壳中有不少共鸣水晶，我们应该能对此加以利用。
anomaly-distar-soothe-cat.en: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal a continental crust filled with resonant crystals. We may be able to make some use of them.

anomaly-distar-soothe-gc-cat.zh: [From.GetName]的磁层对我们的研究用无人机产生了强大的吸引力，原因不明。我们应该进行进一步的调查。
anomaly-distar-soothe-gc-cat.en: [From.GetName]'s magnetosphere is highly appealing to our research drones in orbit, for reasons they cannot explain. We should investigate further.

anomaly-distar-thirsty-cat.zh: 深到能从轨道直接进行观察的峡谷勾勒出了[From.GetName]表面的纹路，但是这颗行星却像风沙侵蚀区一样干燥。曾经如此强烈地侵蚀了[From.GetName]岩层的那些水怎么了呢？
anomaly-distar-thirsty-cat.en: Canyons deep enough to be seen from orbit furrow the surface of [From.GetName], yet the planet is dry as a dustbowl. What could have happened to the water that once so profoundly carved [From.GetName]'s' stone?

anomaly-distar-zone-cat.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]上有一个孤立的针状人工结构。
anomaly-distar-zone-cat.en: Sensors indicate an isolated pinprick of artificial structures on [From.GetName].

anomaly-electric-waters-cat.zh:
对[from.GetName]的轨道扫描检测到这颗行星深深的冰洋之下有异常的电信号。

对这种水中自然现象进行进一步研究可以获得更多发现。
anomaly-electric-waters-cat.en:
Orbital scans of [from.GetName] are detecting erratic electrical signals deep within the planet's icy seas.

Further study into this aquatic phenomenon will reveal more.

anomaly-exploding-skies-cat.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描追踪到了极端的气象现象，地表分布着零星但强烈的热脉冲。

需要进一步调查。
anomaly-exploding-skies-cat.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] are tracking extreme meteorological phenomena, with sporadic but intense heat spikes distributed across the surface.

This warrants further investigation.

anomaly-fibrous-atmosphere-cat.zh: 对[from.GetName]的初步扫描结果是损坏的，我们的仪器无法清晰解读。这一干扰的来源尚不明确；或许需要近距离调查 。
anomaly-fibrous-atmosphere-cat.en: Initial scans of [from.GetName] are returning in a corrupted state that our sensors cannot clearly interpret. The source of this interference remains unclear; a closer inspection will be needed.

anomaly-fractalized-entropy-category.zh: 探测器发现一奇异物体在小行星带中漂移。其来源未知，但轨迹稳定，表明可拦截检查。
anomaly-fractalized-entropy-category.en: Sensors have picked up a strange object drifting through the asteroid field. Its origin is unknown, but its course is steady, suggesting it can be intercepted and examined.

anomaly-froz-base2-cat.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]极地表面的偏僻之处检测到出乎意料的活动。
anomaly-froz-base2-cat.en: Sensors pick up unexpected activity from an isolated point on [Root.GetName]'s arctic surface.

anomaly-froz-illuminated-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]表面到处都是无法解释的光学现象，从太空中清晰可见。
anomaly-froz-illuminated-cat.en: Inexplicable optical phenomena play across the surface of [Root.GetName], clearly visible from space.

anomaly-frozen-inferno-cat.zh: 对[from.GetName]的初步扫描发现在这颗冰冻的天体上存在极不正常的热量峰值。这种温度异常亟待进一步的调查。
anomaly-frozen-inferno-cat.en: Initial scans of [from.GetName] are showing extremely erratic heat spikes on this otherwise frozen celestial body. These anomalous temperatures elicit further investigation.

anomaly-gaea-checkered-cat.zh: 对[Root.GetName]的图像扫描显示，整颗行星覆盖着网格般的纹路。
anomaly-gaea-checkered-cat.en: Visual scans of [Root.GetName]'s surface reveal a grid pattern seemingly covering the entire planet.

anomaly-gaia-move-cat.zh: 这是一颗盖亚级行星，[Root.GetName]预计会有丰富的生命体……
anomaly-gaia-move-cat.en: As a Gaia-class planet, [Root.GetName] is expected to teem with life...

anomaly-gaia-planet-cat.zh: 我们的探测器在[Root.GetName]上侦测到了表明外星人活动迹象的能源放射。
