anomaly-gaia-planet-cat.en: Our sensors are registering energy emissions indicative of alien activity on [Root.GetName].

anomaly-gas-cloudy-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]的大气特征在中等规模的气态巨行星中很不寻常。
anomaly-gas-cloudy-cat.en: The atmospheric patterns of [Root.GetName] are highly atypical for a gas giant of modest size.

anomaly-gas-zro-ice-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]缺乏氢和氦，无法被归为气态巨行星，而是冰冻巨行星。
anomaly-gas-zro-ice-cat.en: It seems [Root.GetName] is lacking the hydrogen and helium to be classified as a proper gas giant and is, in fact, an ice giant.

anomaly-gen-abandoned-ship-cat.zh:
对[Root.GetName]粗略扫描有了令人震惊的结果。

似乎有东西也在扫描我们……
anomaly-gen-abandoned-ship-cat.en:
A cursory scan of [Root.GetName] yields surprising results.

Something seems to be scanning us back...

anomaly-gen-playground-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]表面一小块地方散布着十分惊人的建筑，请求立即进行考古工作。
anomaly-gen-playground-cat.en: Impressive structures litter a small area on the surface of [Root.GetName], practically begging for some archaeological work.

anomaly-geocentric-experiment-cat.zh: 在[from.Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中探测到了许多怪异的重力读数，从内小行星带到恒星系中心的荒芜行星四处闪烁着这些信号。
anomaly-geocentric-experiment-cat.en: Strange gravimetric readings have been detected throughout the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system, pulsing from the inner astroid belt to the desolate planet at the heart of the system.

anomaly-great-blue-spots-cat.zh: [from.GetName]的地表分布着泾渭分明的两种色彩以极快的速度串联移动着，在太空中亦清晰可见。这些蓝色的结构相当有趣，值得进一步研究。
anomaly-great-blue-spots-cat.en: The surface of [from.GetName] features two distinctive discolorations, large enough to be visible from space and moving in tandem at great speeds. These blue-colored formations are interesting enough to warrant further study.

anomaly-hab-mat-cat.zh: 反向散射能谱传感器显示行星地壳中存在珍贵物质。
anomaly-hab-mat-cat.en: Backscattering spectrometry sensors indicate the presence of valuable substances in the planet's crust.

anomaly-infernal-oasis-category.zh: 令人震惊的[from.GetName]图像显示，一颗燃烧熔融星球上突然出现一片大陆大小的明亮绿色地带。这一罕见景象表明其地表存在极其异常的情况。
anomaly-infernal-oasis-category.en: Startling images of [from.GetName] show a burning, molten world interrupted by a startlingly bright, continent-sized swathe of green. This exceptional sight suggests something highly unusual on the surface.

anomaly-invisible-planet-cat.zh:
[from.GetName]的轨道路径上有一个反复出现的微小震荡。这表明它有规律地受到某种大型未知引力的影响。

建议对其周边环境进行进一步研究。
anomaly-invisible-planet-cat.en:
A small but recurring oscillation has been observed in the orbit path of [from.GetName], suggesting it is regularly subjected to some large unknown gravitational force.

Further study of the surrounding space is recommended.

anomaly-lava-whirlpool-category.zh: 对[Planet.GetName]的首次勘测发现，行星的主熔岩海洋中存在一种奇特的风暴状形态，极为罕见，值得深入研调查。
anomaly-lava-whirlpool-category.en: The first survey of [Planet.GetName] revealed a strange storm-like shape in the planet's main lava ocean. This phenomenon is highly unusual, and bears investigating.

anomaly-layered-atmosphere-cat.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描发现可燃气体在整颗行星上零星喷发，给远程观测带来了挑战。

需要进行近距离调查。
anomaly-layered-atmosphere-cat.en:
Scans of [from.GetName] have detected sporadic eruptions of combustible gases across the planet, presenting challenges for remote surveys.

A closer inspection will be needed.

anomaly-leveled-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]似乎有且只有一个有趣的地质特征……
anomaly-leveled-cat.en: [Root.GetName] seems to exhibit one, and only one, interesting geological feature...

anomaly-life-barren-category.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]贫瘠的不毛之地下方探测到了生命的迹象。到底是怎样的有机体才有可能生存在那里面呢？
anomaly-life-barren-category.en: We have detected life signs coming from somewhere beneath the barren and lifeless surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. What manner of organism could possibly live there?

anomaly-life-in-darkness-cat.zh: [from.GetName]被潮汐锁定了，有一半永远处于黑夜之中。红外扫描发现这片漆黑贫瘠的区域竟是某种活跃的有机生态系统所在。
anomaly-life-in-darkness-cat.en: [from.GetName] is tidally locked with one half of the planet existing in a state of permanent darkness. Infrared scans indicate that this lightless and nutrient deficient zone is home to an active organic ecosystem.

anomaly-living-metal-category.zh: 我们发现了一个巨大的撞击坑，这似乎不是自然形成的。
anomaly-living-metal-category.en: A large impact crater has been discovered that does not seem to be a natural occurrence.

anomaly-missing-mass-cat.zh: [from.GetName]的质量读数远低于一颗同等尺寸岩质行星预期范围。建议进一步调查。
anomaly-missing-mass-cat.en: Mass readings for [from.GetName] are well below the expected range for a rocky planet of this size. Further investigation is recommended.

anomaly-molten-base-cat.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]剧热的表面扫描出有节奏的运动。
anomaly-molten-base-cat.en: Sensors pick up rhythmic movement on the hellish surface of [Root.GetName].

anomaly-molten-metal-ocean-cat.zh: 对[from.GetName]地表的初步调查发现这里经常发生一种含有高浓度重金属的超热熔岩海啸。必须通过进一步分析才能完全理解这种现象。
anomaly-molten-metal-ocean-cat.en: Initial surveys of [from.GetName]'s surface have detected frequent tsunamis of superheated lava containing high concentrations of heavy metals. Further analysis will be necessary to fully understand this phenomenon.

anomaly-moon-cat.zh: 这颗卫星有些不太寻常。
anomaly-moon-cat.en: There is something unusual about this moon.

anomaly-mysterious-ringing-category.zh: 科学家在[Planet.GetName]某一地点捕捉到规律性的电波峰，似与信号源从夜到昼的交替时间同步。
anomaly-mysterious-ringing-category.en: Our scientists have detected regular radio wave spikes from a single point on [Planet.GetName]. They appear to coincide with the time at which the source of the signal crosses from night into day.

anomaly-obsidian-planet-cat.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行视觉扫描发现黑曜岩大陆板块覆盖着这颗行星贫瘠的表面，上层大气中残留着大量的硫。

专项地质调查将让我们得到更多结果。
anomaly-obsidian-planet-cat.en:
Visual scans of [from.GetName] show continental sheets of obsidian coating the barren surfaces of the planet, with heavy traces of sulfur lingering in the upper atmosphere.

A more concentrated geological survey will tell us more.

anomaly-optical-phenomena-cat.zh: 对[from.GetName]的影像扫描显示行星表面有极其活跃的光学现象，尽管这些颜色图案的成因在轨道距离上尚未探明。
anomaly-optical-phenomena-cat.en: Our imaging scans of [from.GetName] are returning extremely vibrant optical phenomena across the planet's surface, though the cause of these color patterns remains unclear at an orbital distance.

anomaly-outgassing-category.zh: 对[Planet.GetName]的例行扫描发现大气中存在异常强烈的化学波动。深入调查或能揭示真相。
anomaly-outgassing-category.en: A routine scan of [Planet.GetName] noted unusually strong chemical fluctuations in the atmosphere. A closer survey may explain what is happening here.

anomaly-plasma-trails-cat.zh:
沿[from.GetName]的构造断层线探测到了不稳定的能量波动。

这些波动的根源无法从轨道上加以确定。需要近距离研究才能弄清该现象的源头。
anomaly-plasma-trails-cat.en:
Erratic energy surges are being detected along the tectonic fault lines of [from.GetName].

The origin of these spikes cannot be ascertained from orbit. Closer study will be required to identify the source of this phenomenon.

anomaly-plasma-volcano-cat.zh:
我们目睹了敏感的超热等离子体喷发到[from.GetName]的上层大气中。

大气层中浓厚的火山灰让我们无法从轨道上辨识这些喷射源，但近距离研究似乎存在危险。
anomaly-plasma-volcano-cat.en:
We have visual confirmation of volatile superheated plasma being launched into the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName].

Thick volcanic ash in the atmosphere is preventing us from identifying the source of these projectiles from orbit. Closer study will likely

anomaly-pulsating-object-toxic-cat.zh: 对[this.GetName]的初步扫描发现了一个特殊的空中物体，漂浮在对流层中，随着位置的改变而涨缩。为探明其性质，需要进行进一步的调查。
anomaly-pulsating-object-toxic-cat.en: Initial scans of [this.GetName] have discovered a peculiar airborne object floating through the troposphere, shrinking and swelling in size as it changes positions. Further investigation is necessary in order to classify its nature.

anomaly-radioactive-planet-cat.zh: 我们发现有一颗行星含有大量严重衰变的放射性同位素。建议进行更深入的调查。
anomaly-radioactive-planet-cat.en: We have discovered a planet containing large quantities of heavily decayed radioactive isotopes. Further investigation is warranted.

anomaly-rainbow-rivers-cat.zh:
[from.GetName]的初步扫描发现，遍流行星表面的荧光河不停地在整个光谱中变化。

进一步的研究会加深我们对这个异常自然现象的了解。
anomaly-rainbow-rivers-cat.en:
Preliminary scans of [from.GetName] show fluorescent rivers flowing across the planet's surface that continuously shift through the full range of the color spectrum.

Further study will tell us more about this unusual phenomenon.

anomaly-sea-cat.zh: 一个模糊的身影在[Root.GetName]的大海洋流之下翻腾着。
anomaly-sea-cat.en: Vaguely-defined shapes swirl with the currents in [Root.GetName]'s vast oceans.

anomaly-sea-crystal-cat.zh: 在[Root.GetName]表面的大洋之下，有一个不同寻常的巨大物体正在发出星星点点的光芒。
anomaly-sea-crystal-cat.en: Starlight can be seen glinting off an unusually large object, just under the ocean surface of [Root.GetName].

anomaly-shearing-force-cat.zh:
释放到[from.GetName]大气层中的探测器停止了一切通讯。我们失去了该硬件的行踪。

需要对该行星进行近距离调查才能取回这些数据。
anomaly-shearing-force-cat.en:
Observation probes deployed into the atmosphere of [from.GetName] have ceased all communications. The exact location of our hardware is now unknown.

A closer investigation of the planet is needed to recover the data.

anomaly-singing-planet-cat.zh: 这颗行星发射出怪异的磁力波，与我们目前为止所知的一切均大不相同，几乎可以说它就像想要与我们沟通一般。唯有对这一不同寻常的现象进行调查方才符合逻辑——我们可能遇上了一个行星大小生物形态的绝佳个例。
anomaly-singing-planet-cat.en: This planet emits strange magnetic waves, quite unlike anything we have seen so far, almost as if it is trying to communicate with us. It is only logical to investigate this unusual phenomenon - we may have just encountered an extraordinary example of life on

anomaly-sol-wasteland-category.zh: 这个世界已经在使用核武的战争灰飞烟灭了。
anomaly-sol-wasteland-category.en: This world has been thoroughly ravaged in a nuclear war.

anomaly-solar-uninhabitable-category.zh: 一艘被遗弃的飞船漫无目的地漂浮在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上空。巨大的帆耸立于舰体之上，这表明其动力是太阳能。
anomaly-solar-uninhabitable-category.en: An abandoned ship has been left to drift aimlessly above this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The massive sails protruding from its hull suggest that it relied on solar power to function.

anomaly-spires-of-light-category.zh: 初步扫描显示，一系列高耸发光结构耸立于一片平凡的地貌。其起源和用途仍不明确，但其幽光说示这不仅仅是自然现象。
anomaly-spires-of-light-category.en: Initial scans reveal a series of towering, luminescent structures rising from an otherwise unremarkable landscape. Their origin and purpose remain unclear, but their spectral glow suggests something more than a natural phenomenon.

anomaly-star-resonance-cat.zh: 我们的科学专员发现，在[root.GetName]的日冕附近出现的疑似传感器故障在重启之后仍然留存在。已批准进一步研究。
anomaly-star-resonance-cat.en: Our scientists have discovered what first appeared to be a sensor malfunction near the corona of [root.GetName], however it's still there after rebooting. A closer look is warranted.

anomaly-storms-anom-ants.zh: 宇宙风暴经过后，出现了一颗组成成分极不寻常的彗星。它似乎是由有机材料组成的。我们的[solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切想要进行调查。
anomaly-storms-anom-ants.en: A cosmic storm has left behind a comet of unusual composition. It appears to be made of organic material. Our [solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are keen to investigate.

anomaly-storms-anom-brain.zh: 自从一场虚境风暴肆虐该恒星系后，我们就开始不断收到一些奇怪的信号。然而，当我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]想要回应这些呼叫时，信号又中断了。科学家们建议派出一艘科研船进行调查。
anomaly-storms-anom-brain.en: Ever since a Shroud Storm raged through this system, we've been receiving strange signals. However, as soon as our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] try to answer this cacophony of hails, it dissipates again. They recommend sending a science vessel.

anomaly-storms-anom-polychromatic.zh: 宇宙风暴过境[from.solar_system.GetName]星系时改变了该恒星的外观。在风暴的余波过后，这颗恒星的日冕层呈现出异彩纷呈的漩涡，向四面八方喷射出五光十色的耀斑。这一现象值得进一步分析。
anomaly-storms-anom-polychromatic.en: The passing of a cosmic storm through the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has transformed the visual appearance of the system's star. In the aftermath of the storm, the star's coronal layer presents as a swirl of ever-changing colors, ejecting polychromatic

anomaly-storms-anom-stat.zh: 轨道上的这个物体是途经的宇宙风暴带来的。它看上去像是一座空间站，但是对其结构组成的扫描结果却有点令人费解。我们建议对此开展调查。
anomaly-storms-anom-stat.en: This orbiting object has been left behind by a passing cosmic storm. It looks like a space station but scans of its structural composition is returning most confusing results. We recommend investigating.

anomaly-storms-anom-travellers.zh: 在[from.GetAffectedStormType]的余波中，从[from.solar_system.GetName]星系上侦测到了一个未识别的求助信号。
anomaly-storms-anom-travellers.en: In the aftermath of the [from.GetAffectedStormType] an unidentified distress signal has been detected in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

anomaly-storms-anom-triplets.zh: 一场路过的宇宙风暴致使[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中产生了三颗新的小行星。这些天体容易发生难以解释的方向变化，因此无法预测它们的轨迹。此事需要进一步的研究。
anomaly-storms-anom-triplets.en: A passing cosmic storm deposited three new asteroids in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. These celestial bodies are prone to inexplicable changes of direction, making it impossible to predict their trajectories. Further research is needed.

anomaly-storms-cosmic-sludge.zh:
[from.GetAffectedStormType]的余波中，监测[from.solar_system.GetName]的质量探测器得到了异常读数。

系统性诊断没有发现设备存在技术故障，所以这些读数需要进行进一步调查。
anomaly-storms-cosmic-sludge.en:
Mass sensors monitoring [from.solar_system.GetName] are showing erratic readings in the aftermath of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

System diagnostics show no sign of a technical error with the equipment. These readings require further investigation.

anomaly-storms-shattered-sattelite.zh: 在[from.GetAffectedStormType]的余波中，[from.solar_system.GetName]星系内探测到了一个不明物体。对该碎片的进一步研究可以提供宝贵的洞见。
anomaly-storms-shattered-sattelite.en: In the aftermath of the [from.GetAffectedStormType], an unidentified object has been detected in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Further analysis of this debris could provide valuable insights.

anomaly-strange-signal-category.zh: 尽管[Root.GetName]看上去荒无人烟，但我们的扫描仪却接收了一段被加密的信号，正是从这上面发射出来的。
anomaly-strange-signal-category.en: Although [Root.GetName] appears totally desolate and devoid of life, our scanners have picked up an encrypted signal emanating from it.

anomaly-subglacial-vibrations-cat.zh: [from.GetName]的冰冻荒原之下潜藏着巨大的冰下海洋。在深深的永冻层下探测到的隆隆震动，从本质上无法被归类为地震。
anomaly-subglacial-vibrations-cat.en: Beneath [from.GetName]'s frozen and lifeless surface lies a vast subglacial ocean. Deep, rumbling vibrations have been detected beneath the permafrost that are not registering as seismic in nature.

anomaly-supermassive-giant-cat.zh: [from.GetName]是一颗超大质量气态巨行星，其强大的引力井将数千物体吸引到其轨道上。将其进行分类编目应该会很有价值。
anomaly-supermassive-giant-cat.en: [from.GetName] is a supermassive gas giant whose strong gravity well has swept thousands of objects into its orbit. Cataloging them may prove worthwhile.

anomaly-tectonic-icebreaker-category.zh: 在[Planet.GetName]的风化层中发现异常低温现象，某种过程或物体可能正在导致地表部分区域降温。钻探勘测将揭示更多信息。
anomaly-tectonic-icebreaker-category.en: Strange low-temperature anomalies were detected in the regolith of [Planet.GetName], suggesting that some process or object may be cooling parts of the surface. A drilling expedition would reveal more.

anomaly-temporal-prism-cat.zh: 在[From.GetName]的周边地区探测到异常的时空波动。需要进一步分析。
anomaly-temporal-prism-cat.en: Unusual fluctuations in spacetime have been detected in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. Further analysis is advised.

anomaly-terrestial-telescope-category.zh:
[fleet.GetName]的扫描仪显示[From.GetStarName]恒星系中漂浮着一座被废弃的空间站。

看起来它是被途径的宇宙风暴卷到这里来的。里面没有探测到生命，也没有任何形式的能量信号。空间站两侧则伸出来一对巨大的望远镜。这对光学设备看起来很先进，不过其尺寸相对于空间站而言还是显得太大了。整个空间站的所展现的科技与结构对于我们而言还是比较陌生。

我们可以试着重启这组望远镜，这或许能给我们带来一些有趣的洞见。
anomaly-terrestial-telescope-category.en:
Scans performed by the [fleet.GetName] indicate the presence of a derelict space station in the [From.GetStarName] System.

It looks like it was deposited there by a passing cosmic storm. Life signs return negative, and there are no power signals of any kind.

anomaly-the-lonely-bot-category.zh: 有迹象表明，[Root.GetName]曾是某个古代文明的家园。
anomaly-the-lonely-bot-category.en: [Root.GetName] exhibits signs of once having been home to an ancient civilization.

anomaly-tiyanki-asteroid-cat.zh: 从小行星带取回的岩石样本包含大量的生物组织，这让人始料未及。
anomaly-tiyanki-asteroid-cat.en: Rock samples retrieved from the asteroid belt unexpectedly contain a large amount of biological tissue.

anomaly-tox-planet-cat.zh: 这颗星球上面有人造的建筑，说明上面曾有过一段失落的历史。
anomaly-tox-planet-cat.en: There appears to be deliberately-crafted structures on the planet's surface, pointing toward a past long forgotten.

anomaly-tox-purple-rain-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]充满毒性的生物环境赋予这颗行星一片独特的景貌。
anomaly-tox-purple-rain-cat.en: [Root.GetName]'s toxic biosphere gives the planet a unique color scheme.

anomaly-tox-structures-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]的毒云之下，某种非自然建筑结构伫立在剧毒的地表之上。
anomaly-tox-structures-cat.en: Somewhere beneath [Root.GetName]'s unctuous clouds, unnatural structures silhouette themselves against the toxic surface.

anomaly-trop-biology-cat.zh: 我们从[Root.GetName]上热带森林收集到的初始数据表明，这里有一些异常的东西。
anomaly-trop-biology-cat.en: The initial data gathered from the tropical forests of [Root.GetName] indicate that something is out of the ordinary.

anomaly-trop-conditions-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]上的浓密丛林里似乎隐藏着有趣的东西。
anomaly-trop-conditions-cat.en: [Root.GetName] appears to hold something of interest deep within its dense jungles.

anomaly-trop-pets-cat.zh: [Root.GetName]茂密的热带丛林灌木中检测到了不规则的运动模式。
anomaly-trop-pets-cat.en: Irregular patterns of movement have been detected within the dense tropical undergrowth of [Root.GetName].

anomaly-unique-system-battle-cat.zh: 这是一片古战场。在此处，古老的帝国们为了争夺星海的至上霸权相互碾轧。现在，帝国已然是过往云烟，只剩下这些挂着旗帜的战舰残骸。
anomaly-unique-system-battle-cat.en: A long-forgotten battlefield where ancient empires once fought for supremacy of the galaxy - now all that remains are the vessels of those who fought under their banners.

anomaly-vapor-plumes-cat.zh:
在[from.GetName]的地表上观测到有成千上万的异常蒸汽羽状物升起，延伸到其稀薄大气的顶层。

建议对该现象进行深入调查。
anomaly-vapor-plumes-cat.en:
Thousands of anomalous vapor plumes have been observed rising from the surface of [from.GetName], extending to the upper limits of its thin atmosphere.

Further investigation of this phenomenon is advised.

anomaly-writing-uninhabitable-category.zh: 该星球的地表上有着巨大的裂痕，从其图案判断，不可能是自然形成的。从轨道上看，这些裂痕看起来像是文字。
anomaly-writing-uninhabitable-category.en: There is significant scarring on the surface of this world in a pattern that cannot be natural. From orbit, the massive rifts look almost like writing.

event-action-81.zh: 一支[From.From.GetName]的舰队屠杀了[From.GetName]的居民！在一场毫不留情的大规模轨道轰炸后，地表上的所有人口聚集地都被彻底消灭了。[From.GetPlanetMoon]已经变成了一片充满辐射的废土，几乎无法支持生命。
event-action-81.en: A fleet belonging to the [From.From.GetName] has massacred the population of [From.GetName]! After a massed and unrelenting orbital bombardment campaign, all population centers on the surface have been systematically wiped out, reducing the [From.GetPlanetMoon

event-action-85.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]的管理控制已落入[new_planet_owner.GetName]手里，因为他们控制了[From.GetStarName]星系的恒星基地。
event-action-85.en: We have lost administrative control of [From.GetName] to [new_planet_owner.GetName], who controls the Starbase in the [From.GetStarName] system.

event-ancrel-6499.zh:
随着我们牢牢掌控[planet.GetName]，我们得知我们的军队在战斗中取得了一个名为[this.GetLastReceivedRelic]的无价遗珍的控制权。显然，[victim.GetName]正准备将这个遗珍撤离到安全的地方，但是我们在[planet.GetPlanetMoon]上战线的快速推进使得这个选择不再现实。

遗珍现已被我们安全转移到位于[Root.Capital.GetName]上的中央档案馆。
event-ancrel-6499.en: With [planet.GetName] firmly under our control, we have learned that our forces came into possession of a priceless relic, known as [this.GetLastReceivedRelic], during the fighting. The [victim.GetName] was evidently in the process of evacuating this relic to

event-anomaly-4171.zh:
[From.GetName]上的气体开采设施已经化为一片火海。据报道，那种高度易燃的气体遇到了明火，导致了许多设施的爆炸！经过一连串的连锁反应，几乎炸光了我们侦探到的所有气体矿藏。

不能再犯同样的错误了。
event-anomaly-4171.en: The gas mining facility on [From.GetName] has turned into a burning inferno. The report says that the highly volatile gas was exposed an open flame, causing multiple facilities to explode! This in turn caused a chain reaction and blew up most of the gas caches

event-arkship-1090.zh:
随着方舟舰[Root.GetName]继续漂流，观景台爆发出一阵欢呼。一群年幼的缇扬奇兽从附近经过，它们看起来心情很好，正在嬉戏。

它们以宽大的弧线相互穿梭，庞大的身躯彼此翻滚。透过宽阔的玻璃窗，这一景象令人着迷：巨大的身形漂浮在星辰之间，它们发光的身体闪烁着，仿佛在用只有它们才能理解的语言交流。整个家庭都挤满了甲板观看，暂时放下了他们的烦恼。这对所有年龄段的人来说都是一个真正的奇迹。
event-arkship-1090.en:
As the Arkship [Root.GetName] continues to drift, the observation decks have erupted in delight. A pod of juvenile tiyanki has passed nearby, and they seem to be in a playful mood.

They weave around each other in broad, looping arcs, their vast forms tumbling

event-arkship-1205.zh:
在方舟舰[Root.GetName]储存库的最深处，档案管理员们在被遗忘已久的库存中发现了一个密封的小箱子。里面装有一枚不起眼的微芯片，虽有记录但从未被妥善索引。如果它真的具有什么价值，大概也就不会被遗忘在储存箱里了。

这项技术已严重过时，所使用的数位格式甚至早于方舟舰载系统好几代。一些人推测，它可能源自航行初期，甚至可能追溯到我们的种族还生活在行星表面上的时代。
event-arkship-1205.en: Deep within the Arkship [Root.GetName] storage archives, archivists have uncovered a small sealed case buried among long-forgotten inventory. Inside was a single unremarkable microchip, catalogued but never properly indexed. If it had possessed any real value,

event-astral-planes-6095.zh: 与[FromFromFrom.GetName]的裂隙探球一同从星界裂隙出现的，是一幅引起了我们注意的异常景象：探球的尾迹中跟随着一个休眠的逃生舱。很快，我们就收到了一个简单的求救信号，并附有实时视频。
event-astral-planes-6095.en: Emerging from the Astral Rift alongside the [FromFromFrom.GetName]'s Rift Sphere, an unexpected sight catches our attention: a dormant escape pod trailing in the Sphere's wake. Soon, we receive a simple distress signal, accompanied by a live video feed.

event-bio-3000.zh:
失落帝国碎片通常的不和谐声消失了。三个声音和谐地响起，每一个都充满了愤怒。

愚蠢的[owner.GetSpeciesName]！你们已经进入了最终思维星系。让我们说清楚：这里不是给你们的[owner.GetEyeNamePlural]看的地方。如果继续前进，后果将是难以想象的，你们的痛苦——将无法承受。

你们不会打扰我们 ——它 ——我。
event-bio-3000.en:
The usual dissonance of the Fallen Empire fragments is gone. The three voices harmonize, each one filled with rage.

Senseless [owner.GetSpeciesName]! You have entered the Final Thought system. Let us be clear: this place is not for your [owner.GetEyeNamePlura

event-bio-3200.zh:
你们的生物质派送迟到了。但不...你们并不是[targetrivalname.GetName]。

为什么要打扰我们？

啊，对了。你们将接收一个长期休眠的模式，是一个经过数千年精心保存的基因组。我们一直在等待最佳时机来释放它。你们在[target_planet.GetName]上的殖民地是理想的接收地。它的生物圈很快就会被同化。
event-bio-3200.en:
Your biomass dispatch is late. But no... you are not the [targetrivalname.GetName].

Why did you distract us?

Ah, yes. You are to be the recipient of a long dormant pattern, a genome stored with care for millennia. We have delayed release until the moment was

event-cara-4040.zh: 当[welcome_fleet.GetName]按照原计划进入[pleased_planet.GetName]轨道开展简短的参观的时候，一场自发的友好行动演变成了露天市场和派对，[pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]与[welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]之间建立起了许多羁绊，做成了很多买卖。
event-cara-4040.en: As the [welcome_fleet.GetName] entered the orbit of [pleased_planet.GetName] for what should have been a brief courtesy visit today, a spontaneous outbreak of goodwill turned into a combination of open-air market and party. Many bonds between [pleased_planet.o

event-crime-1000.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]上的犯罪率不断下降，当地政府得以集中精力对付[office_owner.GetName]在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的非法企业。大批人员被逮捕，迫使该犯罪集团的分部被关闭。
event-crime-1000.en: As crime levels continue to drop on [Root.GetName], the local authorities have been able to focus their efforts on thwarting the illegal enterprises operated by the [office_owner.GetName] on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. A large number of arrests have been made, f

event-cstorms-8100.zh: 星尘风暴对[this.GetName]的影响导致了水过滤系统被许多不可溶的矿物泥浆阻塞了。我们必须改建出更强劲的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
event-cstorms-8100.en: The impact of a Stardust Storm on [this.GetName] has left water filtration systems clogged with an insoluble mineral slurry. We must re-engineer a more robust filtration system to address the issue.

event-cyber-1010.zh:
[sky_megacorp.GetName]向我们提供了一个利润丰厚的机遇。他们想为一种叫做“普乐快车”的全新提神饮料打广告。

可以将这种饮料的广告直接投射到我们的公民的视觉植入体中，只要一抬头就能看见。所产生的收入可以用于无数的公众项目。

尽管这种广告具有侵入性，但我们确信这种饮料本身应该是美味无害的。
event-cyber-1010.en:
The [sky_megacorp.GetName] has offered us a lucrative opportunity. They wish to advertise their latest product, an energizing drink called Plasma Quench.

Ads for the drink will be projected straight into our citizens' ocular implants whenever they happen to g

event-cyber-2010.zh:
随着先进义体的出现，我们意识到自己的终极潜力。而到目前为止，我们还只触及了表面。

随着专业知识的积累和技术的进步，我们的社会必将发生变化。对智慧生命的完全整合我们势在必行。

抵抗毫无意义。全星系的心智都会是我们的。
event-cyber-2010.en:
With the advent of advanced cybernetics, we can realize our ultimate potential. Up to now, we have only scratched the surface.

As our expertise increases and technology improves, our society is sure to be transformed. The total assimilation of intelligent lif

event-cyber-655.zh:
义体件工程师为我们想出了一种全新的商业机遇。只要稍微降低植入体的耐用度，我们就可以利用用户替换必要部件的刚需来显著地提升利润。

通过在日常磨损最频繁的部分使用劣质生物合金，植入体会以对消费者伤害最小的方式发生故障，从而制造更换需求。
event-cyber-655.en:
Our cyberware engineers have come to us with an economic opportunity. With only a slight reduction of implant durability, we could generate a substantial increase in profits as users will have to replace essential parts.

By using an inferior bio-alloy in the

event-enclave-2059.zh: 我们同[event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]的合约已经到期，他们的舰队即将离开。我们是否应该联络他们进行合同续约？
event-enclave-2059.en: Our contract with the [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] has ended and their fleet is about to depart. Should we contact them to renew the contract?

event-enclave-23.zh: 我方舰队已经成功瓦解了位于[merc_system.GetName]星系中佣兵们的抵抗，他们的基地也一并四分五裂。随着剩余的[FROM.GetName]相继崩溃，他们的残留舰队也随之解散。尽管部分还活着的舰长们沦落为海盗，但另一些则是宣称他们将计划继续提供一些小型合约服务，像是提供后勤支持或者是保卫空间站。但这样的小事无关紧要，重要的是，佣兵城邦已经不复存在，我们能够从它的残骸中打捞到相当数量的资源。
event-enclave-23.en: Our fleet has overcome the defenses of the mercenaries in [merc_system.GetName], and their station has been blown to pieces. The rest of the [FROM.GetName] collapsed quickly after, and their remaining fleets have disbanded. While some of the surviving captains

event-enclave-370.zh: 我们在[salvager_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻是一次反响斐然的成功。[FROM.GetName]被摧毁，所剩无几的幸存者逃向了深空。由于他们的设施被毁于一旦，他们那可怜巴巴的服务也成为了过去式。星系里再也没有这帮子人的踪影了。
event-enclave-370.en: Our offensive in the [salvager_system.GetName] system was a resounding success. The [FROM.GetName] is destroyed, and the few remaining survivors have scattered to the void. With their facilities in ruin, their petty services are a thing of the past. The galaxy

event-enclave-430.zh: [shroudwalker_system.GetName]恒星系的大胜利！我们的军队快刀斩乱麻地解决了那些所谓的[FROM.GetName]秘术师。尽管成天对知识和力量夸夸其谈，他们对虚境的愚蠢奉献还是没能预先料知到我们的攻击。事实上，我们的军队很轻易地就破坏了设施的机械化防御。然而，在进入之后，他们发现整个太空城邦人去楼空，只有一个孤独的侍僧在一个偏僻的房室里面进行冥想。剩下的人去了哪里，我们无从得知，但是整个星系这下摆脱了这种空洞的教条。
event-enclave-430.en: Victory in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system! Our forces made short work of the so-called mystics of the [FROM.GetName]. For all the grand talk of knowledge and power, their foolish devotion to the Shroud could not provide clairvoyance enough to foresta

event-envoy-events-1001.zh: 似乎有第三方恶意入侵了驻在[Root.Capital.GetName]的[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使，[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果不同于平日宽宏的陈词滥调，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]开始恶毒地羞辱，把众人骂了个遍。[event_envoy.GetHerHis]设备的故障已被及时查明，但在此之前[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]已经被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult
event-envoy-events-1001.en: It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of the [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy to [Root.Capital.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that instead of uttering magnanimous platitudes, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] began spewi

event-envoy-events-5.zh: [envoy_source.GetAdj]特使[event_envoy.GetName]在[Root.Capital.GetName]上代表[envoy_source.GetAdj]利益的方式恼人又令人厌倦。自[event_envoy.GetHerHis]初来这里，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]就始终对[Root.GetGovernmentName]满怀敌意，对我国的政策和行动几乎持续不断地加以反对。[event_envoy.GetSheHe]实在太过烦人，如果能摆脱掉[event_envoy.Get
event-envoy-events-5.en: The [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], has been exasperatingly tiresome in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] efforts to represent [envoy_source.GetAdj] interests in [Root.Capital.GetName]. Right from [event_envoy.GetHerHis] first arrival, [event_envoy.G

event-extreme-frontiers-1430.zh: 我们确认了《邓德里历代志》中所记载的那颗行星——新布拉图雅的存在。它拥有独特而丰富多样的植物生态系统，初步调查发现了数百万不同的本地物种。
event-extreme-frontiers-1430.en: We have confirmed the existence of New Bratulla, the planet described in the Dendritian Chronicles. It possesses a uniquely rich and diverse botanic ecosystem, with initial surveys detecting millions of different native species.

event-fedel-1500.zh:
一个公正的，由科学家和思想家组成的委员会正聚集在我们的联邦内庭。他们想要在我们即将开始的领导力测验中为[root.GetAllianceName]提供学术仲裁。

每个帝国现在可以聚集一支团队来研究这一问题，这一研究的结果将会对我们的联邦产生积极影响。这只团队将会发表他们的结果在公开的讨论区。无论哪篇论文在创新、科学严谨性和连贯性方面得分最高，它的作者帝国都将在下一期获得领导地位。
event-fedel-1500.en:
An impartial committee of scientists and thinkers is gathering within our federation chambers. Its purpose: to serve the [root.GetAllianceName] as academic arbiters during our upcoming leadership contest.

Each empire will now assemble a team of researchers to

event-federations-10010.zh:
随着这些权利在刚刚的[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]议案中通过，我们同时要求工人们承担更多的责任。

我们现在可以鼓励失业工人自行迁移到我们控制的其他拥有足够住房，岗位的宜居星球。
event-federations-10010.en:
Alongside the rights enshrined in recent [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] resolutions, we ask additional responsibilities of our workers.

We can now encourage unemployed workers to voluntarily resettle to other worlds we control that have a

event-fedev-9500.zh:
威震寰宇的主宰已经建成。

这艘行动自如的庞然巨舰将彻底改变进攻作战的范式。它可以在前线建造和维修舰船，并配有足以摧枯拉朽的火力，使我们得以不间断地攻击那些敢与我们作对的人。

如今只有蠢货才会对抗[Owner.GetName]。
event-fedev-9500.en:
The construction of the impressive Juggernaut has been completed.

This mobile behemoth changes the paradigm of offensive warfare entirely. It can construct and repair ships on the frontline, and is equipped with devastating firepower, allowing for a ceaseless

event-fircon-1255.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的居民通过试用富营养肥料提高了他们的农业水平。他们能够收获到更高质量的农作物产品，社会的整体健康也得到改善。

考虑到他们简陋的技术，这种粮食生产的进步是非常显著的。获得化肥样品后，我们就可以在更大范围内复刻这一成就。
event-fircon-1255.en:
The inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have enhanced their agricultural skills through experimentation with nutrient-rich fertilizers. Their harvests are yielding higher quality produce and the health of their society is improving.

Given their rudime

event-fircon-1260.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的定居点一直在经历着农业困境。最近的农作物歉收可能会导致争夺食物的冲突。对于一个年轻的、发展中的社会，这是一个关键时刻。

无论他们是选择在需要的时候团结在一起，还是反目成仇，他们现在的决定对于未来朝着哪个方向发展都会产生很大的影响。

不幸的是，无论采取哪种方式，他们都将进入一个极端困难的时期。
event-fircon-1260.en:
The settlements on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] have been experiencing agricultural difficulties. Recent crop failures could lead to conflicts over food. This is a critical moment in the development of a young society.

Whether they choose to come together in

event-galactic-features-350.zh:
我们遇到了一个环绕着[From.GetName]星系内恒星的巨大环形世界。初步扫描显示这个使用了该恒星系的行星作为原材料的大家伙建立在万古之前。该环形世界有着四个可居住段，每一个看上去都是一个前太空文明的家园。

环形世界和它环绕的恒星之间有个属于某种族的大型宇宙空间站。我们从上面接收到一段讯息。
event-galactic-features-350.en: We have encountered a massive ring world surrounding the star in the [From.GetName] system. Preliminary scans indicate that it was built eons ago using the material of the system's innermost planets. The ring world has four habitable segments, each seemingly h

event-galactic-features-381.zh:
星海共同体的官员就我们最近在[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]星系击杀缇扬奇提出抗议，通知我们我国的行为违反了缇扬奇保护法。结果是，[Root.GetName]将在接下来10年内被视为违反星系法。

我们从缇扬奇尸体上提取的资源被收缴了，而且他们还对我国处以罚金。
event-galactic-features-381.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have protested our recent killing of Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_kill_system.GetName] system, informing us that our actions have violated the Tiyanki Conservation Act. As a consequence, the [Root.GetName] is to be considered i

event-galcom-60.zh:
宇宙的奥秘并非显而易见的。

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已批准使用现实更改物质以增加研究，使我们在数据驱动理论研究所的科研人员可以一探未知的真相。
event-galcom-60.en:
The secrets of this universe are not all that is out there.

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has authorized the use of reality-altering substances to enhance our research, allowing our scientists in Data-Driven Theorem Facility to probe

event-grand-archive-105.zh: 随着最近重力陷阱的发现，现在[root.GetAdjective]科研船可以发射重力陷阱。
event-grand-archive-105.en: Following the recent discovery of Gravity Snares, [root.GetAdjective] science ships are now able to launch Gravity Snares.

event-grand-archive-2040.zh:
这种虚空三头虫的残骸可以收获其具有繁殖能力的生殖腺。

这些器官将极大地扩展我们对这些生物的生物学理解，并帮助我们彻底消灭虚空虫疫。
event-grand-archive-2040.en:
The remains of this Voidworm Troika can be harvested for their fertile reproductive glands.

These organs would greatly expand our understanding of the creatures' biology and assist in eradicating the Voidworm Plague once and for all.

event-grand-archive-9000.zh: 我们的[fromfrom.GetClass][fromfrom.GetName]在[fromfromfrom.GetName]战斗中被[from.GetName]俘虏。他们要求支付赎金以交换[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的性命。
event-grand-archive-9000.en: Our [fromfrom.GetClass] [fromfrom.GetName] has been captured by [from.GetName] during the battle in [fromfromfrom.GetName]. They have demanded ransom in exchange for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] life.

event-mega-200.zh:
层层叠加的都市终于完全覆盖了星球的地表。

自从这一宏大计划开始实施以来仅仅过了数年，但已经很难回想起[Root.GetName]从前的面貌。翠绿的丛林？崎岖的山脉？现在放眼望去，四面八方都是延绵不绝的钢铁。

这里曾经由自然法则任意塑造，而现在则成了由坚定的目的锤炼而成的设计。
event-mega-200.en:
Layers upon layers of urban sprawl eclipse the globe's crust, and it is done.

Scant few years have passed since the start of this grand project, but it is already difficult to recall what the surface of [Root.GetName] was like. Verdant? Rugged? It is all stee

event-nomads-4715.zh:
游牧生活与无尽的漫游带给我们的最大回报之一，就是发现新的天地。即使在漫长的旅途之后，依然存在着未曾见过的风景，不论是绝美的还是令人惶恐的。我们的好奇心总是渴望去发掘这些奇观。

然而，对于我们的方舟来说，每一处新景象不仅仅是供其观赏的奇特事物，更是一次学习新知、反思与成长的机会。
event-nomads-4715.en:
One of the greatest rewards for nomadism and our ceaseless wandering is the discovery of new places. Even after a long time traveling, there remain sights unseen, beautiful or mortifying. Spectacles that our curiosity yearns to discover.

But more than peculia

event-nomads-50.zh: 随着在[root.capital_scope.GetName]上安装了[GetStartingDrive]，我们的工程[GetCrew]已完成对方舟舰上的老化系统的全面检查，以为真正的星际旅行做准备。目前已在舰船各处发现多处故障。
event-nomads-50.en: With the installation of the [GetStartingDrive] aboard the [root.capital_scope.GetName], our engineering [GetCrew] have completed a comprehensive inspection of the Arkship's aging systems in preparation for true interstellar travel. Numerous faults have been i

event-operation-5015.zh: 当特工在稳步进入[from.target.GetName]更加戒备森严的区域时，我们失去了与其的联系。我们搞不好会全部交代在这里。这样的信号中断可能是马虎的[from.target.GetAdj]启动了屏蔽科技，隔断了我们的噪声干涉。
event-operation-5015.en: We are losing contact with our operatives as they enter steadily more secure areas in the [from.target.GetName]. There is a chance we could lose our presence there altogether. These interruptions are likely caused by sloppy [from.target.GetAdj] shielding techn

event-pirate-24.zh: [From.From.GetName]摧毁了位于[From.From.GetStarName]星系的一个海盗空间站，并取回了它的保险模块。
event-pirate-24.en: The [pirate_slayers.GetName] has destroyed a pirate station in the [pirate_slayers.GetStarName] system, and recovered its strong room module.

event-planet-destruction-200.zh:
从[From.From.GetName]发出的耀眼光束逐渐暗淡，[From.GetName]寂静无声。

也许历史会将这次屏蔽，这次将[From.GetName]从大宇宙完全隔离的行为，视作极端且不合理。也许也不会。不管如何，从现在起[From.GetStarName]星系有了一颗行星规模的水晶球。
event-planet-destruction-200.en:
The glittering beam from the [From.From.GetName] fades, and [From.GetName] is silent.

Perhaps history will call the shielding, this complete severing of [From.GetName] from the greater cosmos, extreme and unjustified. Or perhaps not. For now, the [From.GetSta

event-planet-destruction-300.zh:
[From.GetName]地表上的灭杀完成后，[From.From.GetName]上的中子羽流逐渐散去了。扫描显示未发现智慧生命迹象；植被虽被摧毁，但会逐渐恢复的。有些人会称这种彻底消灭智慧生命，只保留无机质的做法为邪恶的战争罪行。

我们将其称为高效。
event-planet-destruction-300.en: The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface. Scans report no signs of sapient life; plant life, while damaged, may recover in time. Some would call the total annihilation of intelligent life, while

event-planet-destruction-700.zh: 随着从[FromFrom.GetName]上下降的水柱消散，[From.GetName]的表面完全改变了。曾经有广阔缺水的大陆，现在只有崭新闪耀着欢迎的微光的蓝色海洋，随时可以居住。
event-planet-destruction-700.en: As the column of water descending from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipates, the surface of [From.GetName] is wholly transformed. Where once there were sprawling continents bereft of water, now there is only the welcoming shimmer of pristine, blue ocean ready to

event-planet-destruction-800.zh: 来自[FromFrom.GetName]的滔天毒流渐渐平息，[From.GetName]上生意盎然的生态系统不复存在，充满毒气的星球中唯有少数几种生命形式能繁衍生息。
event-planet-destruction-800.en: As the awesome stream of venomous substances from the [FromFrom.GetName] subsides, [From.GetName] is transformed from a vibrant ecosystem to a noxious world on which few forms of life can thrive.

event-shroud-1000.zh:
通过召集囚禁的[Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]并迫使其参加科学实验，我们就能显著提高科技进展的速度。

[Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]的总数量：[Owner.GetNbTestSubjects]
建造实验研究所以获取实验对象。
event-shroud-1000.en:
By gathering imprisoned [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] and subjecting them to scientific experiments, we can significantly increase the pace of our technological advancement.

Total number of [Owner.GetTestSubjectPlural]: [Owner.GetNbTestSubjects]
Build Exper

event-shroud-3120.zh:
在虚境内外，我们[GetFeelLoc]到了一种强大的力量共鸣。祂们的影响力弥漫到了整个灵能界。

我们可以光凭自己的行为向其调和靠近，但是还有一种资源可以利用。只要利用泽珞的力量，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]将能直接接触到这些实体。

我们只需要决定好寻求哪一位即可。
event-shroud-3120.en:
Throughout the Shroud, we can [GetFeelLoc] the resonance of vast powers. Their influence permeates the psionic realm.

Our actions alone can attune us closer to them, but there is another recourse. By tapping into the power of zro, our [GetTelepathPlural] can

event-shroud-5010.zh:
在我们之中，有些人暗中操纵着外交事务。现在我们怀疑，他们的触角已不仅仅局限于我们的母星。

尽管我们才刚开始探索星空，却以惊人的速度与其他生命形式建立了联系。这似乎不仅仅是巧合。我们怀疑，这些星际关系源于几个秘密的派系的幕后运作，而这些派系已经深深扎根于我们的社会之中。

也许当我们对这些生物了解更多之后，隐匿于暗影中的势力自会显露真容。
event-shroud-5010.en:
There are those among us who operate behind the curtains of diplomacy. Now we suspect their reach is not limited to our homeworld.

Despite only recently venturing into the stars, we have entered communications with other life forms with remarkable ease. This

event-shroud-505.zh:
[mining_planet.GetName]上有个此前认为已经完全坍塌的富矿的天然洞穴系统被意外地重新发掘出来。

经过谨慎的风险评估，我们确信在扩大开采作业规模后，这些坑道可以产出极大量的矿物。
event-shroud-505.en:
A system of ore-rich natural caverns previously thought to have collapsed entirely, has been fortuitously rediscovered on [mining_planet.GetName].

After a careful hazard assessment, we are confident that these tunnels can support significant mineral exploitat

event-shroud-5051.zh:
我们被骗了。

我们的情报人员截获了来自[from.GetName]的秘密通讯，发现他们密谋将我们拖入代理人战争。

他们极力否认任何牵涉，但我们与他们的关系已经受损。他们的表里不一很快传遍整个星系，严重损害了[from.GetName]的声誉。
event-shroud-5051.en:
We were fooled.

Our intelligence operatives intercepted covert communications from the [from.GetName]. These revealed their plot to plunge us into a proxy war.

They have vehemently denied any involvement, but the damage to our relationship is already done. N

event-shroud-5100.zh:
与一个既无法定义也无法理解的实体间的空灵联系……我们一直都了然于心。

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

在我们刚有历史记录以来，这个神秘的事物便一直存在于此。显然，祂选中了我们……但是，原因不得而知。

我们应该如何描述这种[This.GetSensation]呢？
event-shroud-5100.en:
We have always known it... an ethereal connection with an entity we can neither define nor understand.

[This.GetTheChosenP2]

For as long as we have historical records, this mysterious thing has been there. That it has chosen us is clear... But, for what rema

event-shroud-520.zh:
一个由亚原子元素构成的异常回路已在[physics_planet.GetName]附近自发形成。该量子粒子流每时每刻都在呈现出多种罕见的亚粒子相互作用，能产出令人瞠目结舌的关于量子动力学固有性质的数据。

对该量子场的重点研究将使我们增进对本宇宙基础构建单元的理解。
event-shroud-520.en: An anomalous loop of subatomic elements has spontaneously appeared near [physics_planet.GetName]. This quantum particle stream displays a variety of rare sub-particulate interactions every second, providing astonishing data on the innate nature of quantum dyna

event-shroud-525.zh:
我们的[From.GetResearchers]在[society_planet.GetName]系发现了一处等时信号的集中点。

初步分析表明这些信号是从其他维度传输而来。初步翻译表明这些信息与逻辑原理和哲学困境有关。也许这是一种从我们无法理解的实体中获取知识丰富的尝试。

如果能源源不断地收集这些信号我们就能继续监视他们的发现。
event-shroud-525.en:
Our [From.GetResearchers] have detected a concentration of isochronal signals near [society_planet.GetName].

Initial analysis indicated that these signals have been transmitted from a dimension beyond our own. Early translations suggest that these messages re

event-shroud-535.zh:
[mining_planet.GetName]的地表下地热活动变得非常剧烈。地下熔岩喷流顶穿行星地壳流入一些未开发的矿脉中。

该地质现象使一部分未开发的矿物受到高温，将其中的金属矿脉精炼成为坚固的合金。因此，在该行星上的矿物开采能够产出可用的金属碎片了。
event-shroud-535.en:
Geothermal activity has become extremely volatile deep below the surface of [mining_planet.GetName]. Underground discharges of magma have risen up through the planetary crust into a series of unexcavated ore deposits.

This geological phenomenon has superheate

event-shroud-565.zh: [From.GetName]恒星系内的首要光耀体正在发出非凡的祥光。占星专家对此进行讨论后，我们理解了其能量的盈余将会增强[This.GetName]上各种各样的发电活动。
event-shroud-565.en: The primary luminary in the [From.GetName] system is shining with extraordinary luster. After discussing this phenomenon with astrological specialists, we understand that its excess of energy will enhance all manners of power generation on [This.GetName].

event-shroud-725.zh:
意料之外的气候变化扰乱了我们在[high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]的交通系统。该局面除了导致大规模的延误以外，还造成了许多交通事故，其中一场甚至涉及[This.GetClass][This.GetName]。

不幸的是，其系统损伤过重无法修复。
event-shroud-725.en: Unexpected climatic shifts have disturbed our transit networks on [high_profile_traffic_accident_planet.GetName]. Alongside widespread delays, the conditions have caused a significant number of traffic accidents, one of which involved [This.GetClass] [This.Get

project-gas-giant-bodies-project.zh: 我们在气态巨行星[From.GetName]的轨道上发现了一些大型生物的残骸。我们的科学家希望分析它们以推断它们的起源。
project-gas-giant-bodies-project.en: We have found the dead remains of several large creatures in orbit around the gas giant [From.GetName]. Our scientists would like to study them more closely to determine their origins.

project-inetian-projects-04.zh: 在发现了因内特贸易体的安息之地后，关于他们辽阔帝国仍有许多未解之谜。我们计划再一次进行调查。
project-inetian-projects-04.en: After having discovered the final resting place of the Inetian Traders there is still more to learn about their vast empire. We would like to investigate them one more time.

project-project-adakkaria-secrets-of.zh: 庆典学院还有很多值得我们研究的东西。我们有勇气继续深入探察这些阿达卡利亚人的实验吗？
project-project-adakkaria-secrets-of.en: There is still so much we can learn from Institute of Celebration. Do we dare to engage with these adAkkarian experiments even further?

project-relentless-industrialists-study-.zh: 我们应当学习如何安全地将一个行星辐射化，不给当地人群造成过大的不便。
project-relentless-industrialists-study-.en: We shall study how to safely irradiate a planet, without unduly inconveniencing the local population.

project-retaliatory-genome-mapping.zh: 派遣一艘舰船去外星人的母星，我们将在它们身上收集那些我们认为它们从我们身上搜集了的数据。
project-retaliatory-genome-mapping.en: Sending a ship to the alien homeworld, we will be able to gather the same data on them that we suspect them to have on us.

project-robot-cleaners-project.zh: 在一颗遥远的星球上发现一座了塞满机器人的工厂。如果我们重新激活他们，可能会揭示他们家园的秘密。
project-robot-cleaners-project.en: A facility filled with robots has been found on a distant planet. If we reactivate them, they might reveal the secrets of their home.

project-woodwind-instrument-investigatio.zh: 我们必须找出那个似乎对我们有放松作用的神秘乐器的原始物质。
project-woodwind-instrument-investigatio.en: We must find the source material of the mysterious instrument that appears to have a relaxing effect on us.

situation-situation-terravore-consume-pl.zh: 大啖异星土，饥肠犹未足。
situation-situation-terravore-consume-pl.en: We feast: another world's soil tasted; our hunger yet unsated.

situation-situation-toxify-world.zh: 我们开始了[target.GetName]的不可逆辐照过程，以此促进[target.GetToxifiedResourcesText]的生长并同时将其变为一片剧毒废土。
situation-situation-toxify-world.en: We have begun the irreversible process of irradiating [target.GetName], promoting the growth of [target.GetToxifiedResourcesText] and turning it into a toxic wasteland in the process.

anomaly-tutorial-cat.zh: 在调查母星系时，我们在[From.GetName]上面找到了一些东西，和我们早先从母星上观测的结果间存在一定的偏差。
anomaly-tutorial-cat.en: During the survey of our home system we found something on [From.GetName] that did not match earlier observations made from our homeworld.

chain-amoebas-2-chain.zh: 再消灭4个太空变形虫，以便更好的了解这个种群的生物特性。
chain-amoebas-2-chain.en: Eliminate 4 more Space Amoebas to get a better understanding of their biology.

chain-arkship-diplomatic-envoy-chain.zh: 前往目标帝国的恒星系并进行正式外交接触。
chain-arkship-diplomatic-envoy-chain.en: Travel to the target empire's home system and conduct a formal diplomatic engagement.

chain-cloud-chain.zh:
所有的虚空之云在量子层面上都是相连的；这些散发能源的个体样本很可能就是一个单独的亚空间实体的多个表示形式。

对一个虚空之云进行了仔细研究之后，我们找到了其他可能富含这些云的星系。
chain-cloud-chain.en:
All Void Clouds are entangled with one another on the quantum level; it is possible that the energies animating the individual specimens are nothing but multiple instances of a singular sub-space entity.

Through careful study of one Void Cloud, we have been a

chain-clouds-1-chain.zh: 消灭一个虚空之云来获取它的原始星质。
chain-clouds-1-chain.en: Neutralize a Void Cloud to sift through its primordial star-stuff.

chain-contract-build-waystation-chain.zh: 在此帝国的某个恒星系中建造一座驿站。
chain-contract-build-waystation-chain.en: Build a Waystation in this Empire's system.

chain-contract-clear-blockers-chain.zh: 清理该帝国的殖民地上所有的行星自然障碍。
chain-contract-clear-blockers-chain.en: Clear every Natural Planetary Blockers from this Empire's Colony.

chain-contract-colony-startup-chain.zh: 协助让这个新殖民地设立且高效地运转起来。
chain-contract-colony-startup-chain.en: Help get this new colony up and running efficiently.

chain-contract-deep-scan-chain.zh: 对该系统进行深度扫描，以评估其资源和战略相关性。
chain-contract-deep-scan-chain.en: Complete a Deep Scan of this system to assess its resources and strategic relevance.

chain-contract-destroy-station-heirs-cha.zh: 看来[marauder_country_1.GetName]已在此恒星系建立了一处哨站。我们应该在他们站稳脚跟前将其铲除。
chain-contract-destroy-station-heirs-cha.en: It seems that the [marauder_country_1.GetName] have set up an outpost in this system. We should knock it out before they get a foothold.

chain-contract-diplomatic-support-chain.en: Transport delegates to [from.capital_scope.GetName] in the [from.capital_scope.solar_system.GetName] system.

chain-contract-espionage-support-crew-1-.zh: 船员们对于在这个恒星系遭遇干扰的担忧是合情合理的。侦察卫星能对任何可能打乱我们行程的情况提供提前预警。
chain-contract-espionage-support-crew-1-.en: Concerns about interference in this system are legitimate. A surveillance satellite will give us advance warning of anything that might disrupt our itinerary.

chain-contract-espionage-support-crew-2-.zh: 停靠权和边境通行权可能会在毫无预警的情况下被撤销。一颗监控政府通信的监视卫星将告诉我们，这个帝国的热情好客究竟是真诚的还是有条件的。
chain-contract-espionage-support-crew-2-.en: Docking privileges and border access can be revoked without warning. A surveillance satellite monitoring government communications will tell us whether this empire's hospitality is genuine or conditional.

chain-contract-espionage-support-crew-3-.zh: 我们预定航线上的舰队动向、边界变动与军事集结可能会使飞船受困于敌对星区。侦察卫星将为导航提供足够的预警时间，以便规划备用路线。
chain-contract-espionage-support-crew-3-.en: Fleet movements, border shifts, and military buildups along our projected route could strand the ship in hostile space. A surveillance satellite will give navigation enough lead time to plot alternatives.

chain-contract-espionage-support-crew-4-.zh: 当采购部门了解真实价格时，供应谈判会进展得更加顺利。一颗监控贸易渠道和资源流向的监视卫星，将确保我们的团队在下一个港口不会支付过高的价格。
chain-contract-espionage-support-crew-4-.en: Supply negotiations go better when procurement knows the real prices. A surveillance satellite monitoring trade channels and resource flows will ensure our teams are not overpaying at the next port.

chain-contract-espionage-support-crew-5-.zh: 该地区出现了反游牧情绪的相关报道。侦察卫星将确认这一局势仅仅是空谈，还是正在成为当地的政策。
chain-contract-espionage-support-crew-5-.en: Reports of anti-nomad sentiment have surfaced in this region. A surveillance satellite will confirm whether the talk is just rhetoric or whether it is becoming policy.

chain-contract-espionage-support-passeng.zh: 为了娱乐乘客，我们将在指定的恒星系中部署一颗非功能性的“间谍卫星”。
chain-contract-espionage-support-passeng.en: To entertain the passengers, we'll deploy a non-functional "spy satellite" in the indicated system.

chain-contract-espionage-support-passeng.zh: 乘客们在导游的带领下前往下方的城市游览，船组特工已在预定地点放置了虚假的情报包裹，供他们去发现。
chain-contract-espionage-support-passeng.en: Passengers are taken on guided excursions to the city below, where crew operatives have planted fake intelligence packages at prearranged locations for them to discover.

chain-contract-espionage-support-passeng.zh: 全船各层甲板已通报发生一起模拟的安全事件。乘客们被招募参与一场全船范围的调查游戏，以找出安插在船员中的“外来特工”。
chain-contract-espionage-support-passeng.en: A staged security breach has been announced across all decks. Passengers are recruited to identify planted 'foreign agents' among the crew in a ship-wide investigation game.

chain-contract-espionage-support-passeng.zh: 观景台已被改造为监听站。乘客们驻守在这些站点，破译着船员们从底层甲板秘密发送的、预先编排好的外星信号。
chain-contract-espionage-support-passeng.en: The observation decks have been converted into listening posts. Passengers man the stations, decoding scripted alien transmissions that the crew is secretly broadcasting from below decks.

chain-contract-find-resources-alloys-int.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£alloys£ 合金。
chain-contract-find-resources-alloys-int.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an £alloys£ Alloys cache in this system.

chain-contract-find-resources-energy-int.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£energy£ 能量币。
chain-contract-find-resources-energy-int.en: Our engineers suspect that there is an £energy£ Energy Credits cache in this system.

chain-contract-find-resources-minerals-i.zh: 我们的工程师认为在该恒星系内有藏有一批£minerals£ 矿物。
chain-contract-find-resources-minerals-i.en: Our engineers suspect that there is a £minerals£ Minerals cache in this system.

chain-contract-harvest-alloys-chain.zh: 可以从该恒星系收集高价值的合金。
chain-contract-harvest-alloys-chain.en: Valuable Alloys can be harvested from this system.

chain-contract-harvest-consumer-goods-ch.zh: 收集该恒星系内可用的消费品。
chain-contract-harvest-consumer-goods-ch.en: Collect the Consumer Goods available in this system.

chain-contract-harvest-energy-chain.zh: 采集该恒星系中的可用能量。
chain-contract-harvest-energy-chain.en: Harvest the available Energy in this system.

chain-contract-harvest-exotic-gases-chai.zh: 这里可以找到罕见的异星天然气。应当采集它们。
chain-contract-harvest-exotic-gases-chai.en: Rare Exotic Gases can be found here. They should be harvested.

chain-contract-harvest-minerals-chain.zh: 该恒星系中有可采集的高价值矿物。
chain-contract-harvest-minerals-chain.en: There are valuable Minerals in this system that can be harvested.

chain-contract-harvest-nanites-chain.zh: 这里可以收获纳米机器人。
chain-contract-harvest-nanites-chain.en: There are Nanites here that can be acquired.

chain-contract-harvest-rare-crystals-cha.zh: 该恒星系已探测到稀有水晶。采集它们。
chain-contract-harvest-rare-crystals-cha.en: Rare Crystals have been detected in this system. Harvest them.

chain-contract-harvest-sr-living-metal-c.zh: 根据扫描结果，该恒星系中存在活体金属。
chain-contract-harvest-sr-living-metal-c.en: According to scans, there is Living Metal in this system.

chain-contract-harvest-volatile-motes-ch.zh: 该恒星系中可以找到罕见的易爆微粒。
chain-contract-harvest-volatile-motes-ch.en: Rare Volatile Motes can be found in this system.

chain-contract-host-cfl-tournament-chain.zh: 我们已经购买了下一届“冠军之铸现场秀！”锦标赛的场地权。或许我们可以利用这一点为我们谋取优势。
chain-contract-host-cfl-tournament-chain.en: We have purchased the venue rights for the next Champion's Forge Live! tournament. Perhaps we can use this for our advantage.

chain-contract-intercept-raid-heirs-chai.zh: 我们获得可靠情报，[marauder_country_1.GetName]的掠夺舰队将经过此恒星系。这将是一个埋伏他们的绝佳机会。
chain-contract-intercept-raid-heirs-chai.en: We have good intelligence that the [marauder_country_1.GetName] raiding fleet will be passing through this system. It will be a great opportunity for an ambush.

chain-contract-join-war-chain.en: Join the [From.GetName] in all their wars.

chain-contract-megastructure-support-cha.en: Assist with the construction of a Megastructure.

chain-contract-onboard-energy-resource-c.zh: 开展£physics£ 物理学研究研究以改进该恒星系中现有的£energy£ 能量币来源。
chain-contract-onboard-energy-resource-c.en: Conduct £physics£ Physics Research to improve existing sources of £energy£ Energy Credits in this system.

chain-contract-onboard-engineering-resea.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£engineering£ 工程学研究。
chain-contract-onboard-engineering-resea.en: Conduct £engineering£ Engineering Research aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

chain-contract-onboard-food-resource-cha.zh: 在方舟舰上研究£society£ 社会学研究，以提高该星系中可开发的£food£ 食物储量。
chain-contract-onboard-food-resource-cha.en: Conduct £society£ Society Research aboard an Arkship to improve exploitable deposits of £food£ Food in this system.

chain-contract-onboard-minerals-resource.zh: 在方舟舰上研究£engineering£ 工程学研究，以改善该恒星系现有的£minerals£ 矿物矿脉分布。
chain-contract-onboard-minerals-resource.en: Conduct £engineering£ Engineering Research aboard an Arkship to improve existing £minerals£ Minerals deposits in this system.

chain-contract-onboard-physics-research-.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£physics£ 物理学研究。
chain-contract-onboard-physics-research-.en: Conduct £physics£ Physics Research aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

chain-contract-onboard-society-research-.zh: 代表合约发布方在方舟舰上研究£society£ 社会学研究。
chain-contract-onboard-society-research-.en: Conduct £society£ Society Research aboard an Arkship on behalf of the contract issuer.

chain-contract-pest-control-chain.zh: 该恒星系的太空兽群正给我们带来麻烦。请铲除它们。
chain-contract-pest-control-chain.en: The Space Fauna in this system are causing us problems. Please eradicate them.

chain-contract-prisoner-disposal-chain.zh:
从[fromfrom.GetName]接收罪犯。我们将按认为合适的方式驱逐他们，并可以选择将他们留在船上或送往另一个殖民地。我们不应将他们带回属于[from.GetName]的行星。

在接收囚犯后，选择将他们留在船上，或使用方舟舰指令“移交囚犯”将他们捎到我们选择的殖民地。
chain-contract-prisoner-disposal-chain.en:
Pick up criminals from [fromfrom.GetName]. We are to deport them as we see fit, and can choose to either keep them aboard or drop them off on another colony. We are not supposed to bring them back to a planet owned by [from.GetName].

After collecting the pris

chain-contract-raid-planet-chain.zh: 代表[from.GetName]轰炸行星以积累荒废度。
chain-contract-raid-planet-chain.en: Bombard planets on behalf of [from.GetName] to build up Devastation.

chain-contract-scan-debris-chain.zh: 扫描一场战斗之后留下的残骸。
chain-contract-scan-debris-chain.en: Scan the debris left behind after a battle.

chain-contract-shoreleave-crew-3-chain.zh: 储备即将耗尽。船组小队将前往星球表面寻找备件、原材料，以及飞船制造机在几个周期前就已停止生产的各类补给品。
chain-contract-shoreleave-crew-3-chain.en: Stores are running low. Crew teams will go planetside to source replacement parts, raw materials, and the supplies the ship's fabricators stopped producing cycles ago.

chain-contract-shoreleave-crew-4-chain.zh: 当地工程师已开放他们的设施供考察。他们对常见工程问题的解决方案与我们的模型存在显著差异，而当地人也同样渴望研究方舟舰。
chain-contract-shoreleave-crew-4-chain.en: Local engineers have opened their facilities for inspection. Their solutions to common engineering problems diverge significantly from our own models, and the locals are equally eager to study the Arkship.

chain-contract-shoreleave-passenger-1-ch.zh: 乘客们渴望踏上坚实的土地，去探索下方的外星城市。我们已经安排了由向导带领的进城游览。
chain-contract-shoreleave-passenger-1-ch.en: The passengers are eager to set foot on solid ground and explore the alien city below. We've arranged guided excursions into the city.

chain-contract-shoreleave-passenger-2-ch.zh: 下方星球上的著名餐饮区已同意接待乘客，为他们举办一场由向导带领的当地美食品鉴之旅。
chain-contract-shoreleave-passenger-2-ch.en: The renowned dining districts on the planet below have agreed to host the passengers for a guided tasting tour of local cuisine.

chain-contract-shoreleave-passenger-3-ch.zh: 该星球的首都设有一座享誉星系的博物馆。乘客们一直在请愿，要求安排带有导游的游览活动，以参观其中的纪念碑和历史展品。
chain-contract-shoreleave-passenger-3-ch.en: The planet's capital hosts a museum of galactic renown. Passengers have been petitioning for a guided tour of its monuments and historical exhibits.

chain-contract-shoreleave-passenger-4-ch.zh: 地表上一个庞大的露天市场交易着来自整个星域的商品。乘客们迫不及待地想要去逛一逛并讨价还价。
chain-contract-shoreleave-passenger-4-ch.en: A sprawling open-air market on the surface deals in goods from across the sector. The passengers are eager to browse and haggle.

chain-contract-shoreleave-passenger-5-ch.zh: 下方星球上的自然保护区提供穿越其外星荒野的导览服务。乘客们可以从导览步道上近距离观赏外星动物群。
chain-contract-shoreleave-passenger-5-ch.en: A nature reserve on the planet below offers guided tours through its alien wilderness. Passengers will observe alien fauna from guided walkways.

chain-contract-sightseeing-tour-chain.zh: 带领一群游客进行一场银河观光之旅。
chain-contract-sightseeing-tour-chain.en: Take a group of tourists on a galactic sightseeing tour.

chain-contract-stellar-ignition-chain.zh: 使用方舟舰的恒星引擎将气态巨行星转化为新生恒星，为该恒星系解锁海量资源。
chain-contract-stellar-ignition-chain.en: Use the Arkship's Stellar Engine to transform a gas giant into a newborn star, unlocking vast resources for the system.

chain-contract-suntrip-crew-1-chain.zh: 在主发电机进行计划维护期间，我们需要环绕该星系的恒星运行，并依靠太阳能供电。
chain-contract-suntrip-crew-1-chain.en: We need to orbit this system's star and run on solar power while the main generators undergo scheduled maintenance.

chain-contract-suntrip-crew-2-chain.zh: 外层船体板需要在持续的恒星照射下进行热荷载测试。为确保安全，朝向恒星一侧的所有舷窗都将被遮蔽。
chain-contract-suntrip-crew-2-chain.en: The outer hull plating requires thermal load testing under sustained stellar exposure. All viewports on the starward side will be shuttered for safety.

chain-contract-suntrip-crew-3-chain.zh: 冷却系统需要在热负载下进行一次完整的排空循环。近恒星轨道能让我们高效地冲洗管线，尽管甲板温度会出现波动。
chain-contract-suntrip-crew-3-chain.en: The coolant system needs a full purge cycle under thermal load. Close stellar orbit will let us flush the lines efficiently, though deck temperatures will fluctuate.

chain-contract-suntrip-crew-4-chain.zh: 导航阵列必须在近距离根据实时恒星信号进行校准。此过程将占用娱乐系统的带宽。
chain-contract-suntrip-crew-4-chain.en: Navigation arrays must be calibrated against a live stellar signature at close range. The process will commandeer bandwidth from entertainment systems.

chain-contract-suntrip-crew-5-chain.zh: 水循环系统需要进行一次高强度的紫外线杀菌，此过程只有在近恒星轨道上才能高效完成。疗愈中心与游泳池现已关闭，各层甲板均实行限量供水。
chain-contract-suntrip-crew-5-chain.en: The water recyclers need an intensive UV sterilization run that is only efficient in close stellar orbit. The spa and pool are closed and water is rationed across all decks.

chain-contract-suntrip-passenger-1-chain.zh: 我们将进入轨道，让乘客们沉浸在陌生太阳的光辉之中。
chain-contract-suntrip-passenger-1-chain.en: We'll settle into orbit and let the passengers soak in the light of an unfamiliar sun.

chain-contract-suntrip-passenger-2-chain.zh: 乘客中的业余天文学家发现了该星系中罕见的太阳活动，目前正在请愿要求在驻留轨道期间获得前排的观赏位置。
chain-contract-suntrip-passenger-2-chain.en: Amateur astronomers among the passengers have spotted rare solar activity in this system and are petitioning for a front-row viewing from orbit.

chain-contract-suntrip-passenger-3-chain.zh: 巡游舰正在举办一场围绕该星系恒星的穿梭机比赛。乘客们纷纷下注，挤满了每一个舷窗。
chain-contract-suntrip-passenger-3-chain.en: The cruise is hosting a shuttle race around this system's star. Passengers are placing bets and crowding every viewport.

chain-contract-suntrip-passenger-4-chain.zh: 疗愈中心需要长时间暴露在未经过滤的恒星辐射下，以进行乘客们一直要求的一种奇特的焕新理疗。
chain-contract-suntrip-passenger-4-chain.en: The spa requires prolonged exposure to unfiltered stellar radiation for an exotic rejuvenation treatment the passengers have been requesting.

chain-contract-suntrip-passenger-5-chain.zh: 一场盛大的正式舞会将在观景甲板上举行，沐浴在直射的星光下。这是此次航程中的社交盛事。
chain-contract-suntrip-passenger-5-chain.en: A grand formal ball is to be held on the observation decks, bathed in direct starlight. The social event of the voyage.

chain-crystals-1-chain.zh: 摧毁一个晶态实体来获取矿物质样本。
chain-crystals-1-chain.en: Destroy a Crystalline Entity formation to retrieve a mineral sample.

chain-crystals-2-chain.zh: 摧毁4个晶态实体舰队来进一步获取战斗场景数据。
chain-crystals-2-chain.en: Crush 4 Crystalline Entity fleets to gather further combat scenario data.

chain-cybernetic-creed-chain.zh:
在追寻神圣的召唤时，我们将实现崇高身体与神圣义体技术的融合。没有任何事物能阻挡我们通往启迪之路。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
chain-cybernetic-creed-chain.en:
In pursuing the divine calling, we shall achieve the fusion of the exalted body and sacred cybernetics. Nothing shall hinder our path to enlightenment.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

chain-drones-1-chain.zh: 试图拆解并反向组装一个采矿无人机。
chain-drones-1-chain.en: Disable and attempt to reverse-engineer a Mining Drone.

chain-establish-colony.zh: 为了确保长期生存，[This.GetSpeciesName]物种需要扩张到[This.Capital.GetName]之外的地方去。建立我们的第一个殖民地，并在外星球的地表上插上[This.GetName]的旗帜。
chain-establish-colony.en: The [This.GetSpeciesName] species needs to spread beyond [This.Capital.GetName] to secure its long-term survival. Establish our first colony and plant the banner of the [This.GetName] on the surface of an alien world.

chain-fruitful-partnership-chain.zh: 太空兽群会将我们的种荚带到遥远的土地。只要一抹星光，我们的种子就能绽放为新的殖民地。
chain-fruitful-partnership-chain.en: Spaceborne fauna will carry our Seed Pods to distant lands. With a touch of starlight, our seeds can bloom into a new colony.

chain-holy-war.zh: 领导太空时代的十字军对抗[parameter:heathens.GetName]。
