chain-mineral-planet-chain.zh: 使用古代采矿无人机的评估系统中的技术，我们定位了一些矿产资源丰富的天体。
chain-mineral-planet-chain.en: Using techniques derived from the Ancient Mining Drones' assessment systems, we have pin-pointed a handful of stellar bodies that are likely to be particularly rich in minerals.

chain-msi-chain.zh: 我们已经找到了弥那玛特种实业集团的星系坐标。
chain-msi-chain.en: We have learned the galactic coordinates of Minamar Specialized Industries.

chain-nomads-observation-chain.zh: 在我们境内侦测到奇怪的外星人出现，我们无法与其建立通讯通道。另外因为我们无法翻译他们的语言，目前只能静观其变。
chain-nomads-observation-chain.en: We have detected that the odd aliens, whose communication we cannot tap into, have appeared within our borders. Since it's impossible for us to translate their language we can only wait and see who they are and what they want.

chain-snake-infestation-chain.zh: 有些东西正在破土而出感染我们的殖民地！
chain-snake-infestation-chain.en: Something is burrowing out of the ground and infesting our colony!

chain-survey-home-system.zh: 在动身探索星系之前，我们必须对[home_system.GetName]恒星系进行全面调查。我们必须完全了解自己的“后院”。
chain-survey-home-system.en: Before venturing into the rest of the galaxy, we should conduct a full survey of the [home_system.GetName] system. Our own backyard must not be left unexplored.

chain-test-chain.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上发现了一些神秘现象。
chain-test-chain.en: Some strange occurances have been spotted on [Root.GetName].

chain-test-chain-2.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上发现了一些神秘现象。
chain-test-chain-2.en: Some strange occurances have been spotted on [Root.GetName].

chain-the-synth-queen-war-chain.zh: 塞塔娜的真正目的大白天下了。她癫狂想除一切身体上的苦痛，“上传”所有感性生物的意识，消灭我们所知的一切生命。无论如何，我们必须找到能阻止她疯狂野心的力量。
chain-the-synth-queen-war-chain.en: The true intentions of Cetana are at last made clear. In a monstrous bid to end physical suffering, she plans to 'upload' the consciousness of every sentient being, eradicating life as we know it. Somehow, we must find the strength to thwart her mad ambition.

event-action-102.zh: 在与其前中心失去联络之后，星系商贸团体选择在我们境内设立一座新的空间站。
event-action-102.en: Following loss of contact with their former hub, the galactic merchant community has chosen to establish a new station within our borders.

event-action-105.zh: 通过新的联系，我们已经获得了通过泛星系贸易市场进行资源买卖的权利。这一定会刺激[Root.GetAdj]经济。
event-action-105.en: Through our newly-established contacts, we have gained access to a galactic marketplace for the purchase and sale of resources. This will surely be a great boon to the [Root.GetAdj] economy.

event-action-122.zh: 最后一个[GetPreFTLLower][From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被从他们的母星[From.From.GetName]上被绑架作为奴隶。一些离散的幸存者可能还会在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的野外中徘徊，但是已经不足以维持任何形式的文明了。
event-action-122.en: The last of the [GetPreFTLLower] [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been abducted into slavery from the surface of [From.From.GetName], their homeworld. A few scattered survivors might still be roaming the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s wilderness, but not enough t

event-action-14.zh: 我方军团已成功进入[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]并完成对原始文明的压制。当地居民已放弃一切抵抗，我们已将其文明收入我们帝国管制之下。考虑到其落后的科技水平，要将其转变为[Root.GetAdj]可用的生产力还需要一些时间。
event-action-14.en: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the primitive forces on [conquered_primitive_world.GetName]. The locals have given up all attempts at fighting back and we have now subsumed their civilization into our Empire although, backwards as they are, it

event-action-37.zh: 我们认输，我们屈服了。快把你的舰队调回去吧，嘶嘶嘶
event-action-37.en: We submit, we yield! Recall your fleets and be gone with you, kssk

event-action-38.zh: 是的！我们获胜了，我们是胜利者！如果你嫌自家的生命、钢铁和宝石太多的话，大可再来挑衅我们！
event-action-38.en: Yes! We are victorious, we overcome! Come to us again, if your metal and gems and lives are too many!

event-action-39.zh: 好吧。没有赢家，也没有胜利者。只有失去的生命，和残骸……
event-action-39.en: Very well. No winner, no victor. Only lost lives, lost scrap...

event-action-41.zh: 当你把舰队派往敌方新的领土内时，[From.GetName]战争就发生了。
event-action-41.en: The [From.GetName] began while you had fleets inside your new enemies' borders.

event-action-48.zh: 大势已去。我们……我们提出无条件投降。
event-action-48.en: All is lost. We... we offer our unconditional surrender.

event-action-601.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道轰炸激起了内阁对面临可能要投降的场景时我们该如何应对的讨论。
event-action-601.en: The Orbital Bombardment of [From.GetName] has sparked our Council to discuss how we should respond in the hypothetical scenario of a surrender.

event-action-90.zh: 我们已经重新夺回了对[Root.GetStarName]星系的控制权，在恒星轨道重建了我们的哨站。
event-action-90.en: We have once again gained control of the [Root.GetStarName] system and rebuilt our Outpost in orbit around the star.

event-ancrel-10010.zh: 我们应该把重点放在哪儿？
event-ancrel-10010.en: What aspect shall we focus on?

event-ancrel-10020.zh: 我们应该把重点放在哪儿？
event-ancrel-10020.en: What aspect shall we focus on?

event-ancrel-10030.zh:
[From.Owner.GetName]至伟至耀，巨型艺术设施上鳞次栉比的展位均被无价的文物填满。

异种将仰望我们的造业，甚惶甚恐。
event-ancrel-10030.en:
The greatness of the [From.Owner.GetName] is such that we can line the Exhibition Stations of our Mega Art Installation with priceless artifacts.

Let the xenos look upon our works and despair.

event-ancrel-10040.zh: 我们的科学家开始了一个新的特殊项目，以探索先驱者更深处的秘密。
event-ancrel-10040.en: Our scientists have begun a special project to study the deeper secrets of the precursors.

event-ancrel-2068.zh: 在拆解了C.A.R.E交互界面之后，我们的探险队员有了一个惊人的发现。尽管此人工智能的大多数机械在背水一战之后已经毁于一旦，但是我们的队员成功寻回了一个不同寻常的电脑芯片，在我们的技术员手里，它一定能发挥出不俗的价值。
event-ancrel-2068.en: After disassembling the C.A.R.E Interactive Interface, our expedition crew made an incredible discovery. While most of the AI's machinery was destroyed in the firefight with its last-ditch effort defenses, our crew has managed to recover a remarkable computer

event-anomaly-2574.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽扫描表明这个星球在遥远的过去维持过生命。两极冰盖和[From.GetPlanetMoon]地表下明显蕴藏着冰冻水。干枯的河谷网的存在说明水曾经在星球表面自由流动。

对[From.GetPlanetMoon]环境改造理论上是可行的，但我们目前所拥有的科技并不足以在切合实际的时间内完成这一壮举。
event-anomaly-2574.en: Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that it may once have supported life in the distant past. There are significant deposits of frozen water at the polar ice caps and beneath the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. The existence of valley networks s

event-anomaly-6725.zh: 我们的预防措施和特种设备仍不充分。我们在[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]建立殖民地之后很快就跟地面的团队失去了联络。从落脚点收到的最后一条通讯显示，天空被微小的淹没了前哨的黑色物体遮蔽。
event-anomaly-6725.en: Our precautions and special equipment were not enough. Shortly after establishing a colony on [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName], we lost contact with our teams on the ground. The last communication we received from the settlement showed a sky darkened by small bla

event-anomaly-6830.zh: 在食用了太空生长的水晶糖数年之后，很明显，我们的人民对这一美食的需求愈发旺盛。我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]已经列了一份表，上面是能够建造水晶糖农场的潜在候选地。
event-anomaly-6830.en: After eating space-based crystal sugars for a few years now, it has become apparent that our population would like to see it more readily available. Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] have come up with a list of potential candidates where we could construct more cr

event-apoc-5.zh:
我们在[wormhole_system.GetName]星系的边缘疑似发现了一个天然形成的亚空间现象！该处的时空出现了裂隙，从而产生了一个"虫洞"。据[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，此虫洞也许与星系中的其它虫洞通过亚空间相连。

这也就是说，我们的舰船有可能在数日之内就可以由星系的一端到达另一端，这取决于另外的虫洞的位置。不幸的是这个虫洞和大部分虫洞一样，长时间处于不稳定状态。即使有舰船敢接近，也会瞬间被撕成碎片。
event-apoc-5.en: We have detected what appears to be a naturally occurring subspace phenomenon on the edge of the [wormhole_system.GetName] system! A rift in the very fabric of space-time has formed here, creating a "wormhole" that, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] speculat

event-aquatics-1.zh: 我们来自大洋深处，我们的物种完美地适应了深海环境下的生活。即使已经迈入星空，我们仍然没有忘记本源：水体是，也永远是我们的家园。如今，我们的飞升已经完成了——我们不再需要适应其他环境，而是改造其他的星球使其适应我们的需求。当新一天的黎明到来时，我们清楚再也没有什么东西可以让我们与海洋分离了。
event-aquatics-1.en: We came from the ocean, our species ideally suited to living in the depths of the seas. Even as we take to the stars, we have not abandoned our roots: the water is and shall always be our home. Now, our ascension is complete - no longer shall we adapt ourselve

event-aquatics-4.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽调查表明这颗行星拥有厚重冰层，因此可以转变为一颗怡人的海洋星球。我们只需将行星大幅度加热，并赋予它可以宜居的大气即可。

对这颗[From.GetPlanetMoon]进行环境改造在理论上是可行的，但我们目前所拥有的技术手段还不足以在有实际意义的时间框架内完成这一里程碑式的任务。
event-aquatics-4.en:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed a world with a sufficiently thick layer of ice that it could be restored into a pleasant ocean world, if rendered significantly warmer and bequeathed with a hospitable atmosphere.

Terraforming this [From.GetP

event-arkship-1.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]已在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停留了足够久，以至于新鲜感开始喜忧参半。少数乘客在各个停靠港之间焦躁不安，请求永久下船定居；而下方，当地人则在订票柜台前排队，争抢船上的任何一个铺位，渴望亲身体验宣传册中承诺的种种奇观。
event-arkship-1.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for the novelty to cut both ways. A handful of passengers, restless between ports of call, ask to be set ashore for good; below, locals queue at t

event-arkship-1027.zh: 我们的一艘方舟舰陷入黑暗无助漂流，它的各个系统都被紧急关闭了。只要派遣到位，我们的工程师就可以恢复供电，重新取得控制，使其恢复正常运作。
event-arkship-1027.en: One of our Arkships lies dark and adrift, its systems forced into emergency shutdown. Once brought alongside, our engineering crews can restore power, reassert control, and bring it back into the fold.

event-arkship-1070.zh:
[Root.GetName]方舟舰正以我们祖先难以想象的速度穿越虚空。

早期的几代人曾花费数年甚至一生的时间在遥远的恒星间漂泊，而我们现代的驱动装置只需几天就能让方舟舰在各个星系间穿梭。随着飞船冲入超空间航道网，恒星在我们的传感器中飞速掠过，它们的光线不断发生位移与扭曲。

对于船上的许多人来说，这种经历确实会产生一种奇特的迷失感。一些人开始寻求微小的慰藉，以对抗这种感官冲击；而另一些人则坚持认为，只要给予足够的时间，我们的心智终将学会跟上方舟舰不断加速的旅程。
event-arkship-1070.en:
The Arkship [Root.GetName] now crosses the void at speeds our ancestors could scarcely have imagined.

Where earlier generations spent years, even lifetimes, drifting between distant stars, our modern drives hurl the Arkship from system to system in a matter o

event-arkship-1160.zh:
我们在方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的仪器记录到了来自[solar_system.GetName]星系黑洞的异常辐射。远距离扫描捕捉到一个不明物体正接近奇点。那艘巨大的舰船发出的技术信号远超我们的理解，干扰了我们的读数，导致无法进行精确分析。视觉确认也极其短暂，与其说是实物，倒不如说更像是一场幻觉。

在那艘船进入未知领域的前一刻，我们观察到了一个诡异的景象：船只完好无损地穿过了黑洞，且显然是有意为之。随后，所有信号都消失了。该船是被摧毁了、位移了，还是以某种无法理解的状态幸存下来，仍然不得而知。可以确定的是
event-arkship-1160.en: Our instruments aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] registered anomalous emissions from the black hole in the [solar_system.GetName] system. Long-range scans detected the glimpse of an unidentified object approaching the singularity. Their immense vessel emitted

event-arkship-1165.zh:
在经过[solar_system.GetName]星系内的一颗殖民星球时，我们观察到其背阳面爆发了同步的光束。一开始我们怀疑有动乱爆发，后来被证明这种担忧是多余的。这些爆发的光束是受控的、遍及全球的烟火表演，完全处于非军事参数范围之内。

进一步的分析显示，这场盛景是在刻意与某种天文信号进行对齐。我们可以有把握地得出结论：当地居民正在用光编码信息。我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]记录了这些模式，从而对大规模协作和符号化交流有了更深入的了解。
event-arkship-1165.en: While passing a colonized world in the [solar_system.GetName] system, we observed its nightside erupt in synchronized bursts of light. Initial fears of unrest proved unfounded. The emissions were controlled, planet-wide pyrotechnic displays, well within non-mi

event-arkship-60.zh:
方舟飞船[Root.GetName]正在经历反应堆异常。最初注意到这个问题的是即将入睡的船员，因为引擎声伴着他们入眠。他们报告说是燃料流节奏出现了细微的失真。
我方[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]的调查证实，燃料管道内有异物进入。

幸运的是，我们已提出了几个解决方案。
event-arkship-60.en:
Arkship [Root.GetName] is experiencing reactor irregularities. The issue was first noticed by crew who listen to the engines to fall asleep. They reported a subtle distortion in the fuel flow's rhythm.
 
Investigation by our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] has confi

event-arkship-860.zh:
一个游牧帝国已经突入了我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的空间，尽管我们关闭了国境。我们的敏感器正在密切追踪其动态，他们的存在被视作一种非常招人厌恶的入侵行径。

他们对我们领土边界的无视已经引起了我们的注意，我们对他们的评价也因此降低。
event-arkship-860.en:
A nomadic empire has breached our closed borders in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Although our sensors are actively tracking developments, its presence remains an unwelcome intrusion.

Their disregard for our territorial boundaries has not gone unnot

event-arkship-870.zh:
我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]侦测到游牧的帝国出现。

我们欢迎他们进入我国境内，并对这次相遇可能带来的可能性和机遇充满期待。
event-arkship-870.en:
We have detected the presence of a nomadic empire in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

We welcome them within our borders and remain eager for the possibilities and opportunities this encounter may bring.

event-arkship-880.zh:
我们位于[from.solar_system.GetName]的行踪已被发现，[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]帝国正以日益增长的怀疑监视着我们的一举一动。

经过紧张的外交交涉，他们要求我们离开他们的领土，否则将面临报复。
event-arkship-880.en:
Our presence in [from.solar_system.GetName] has been detected, and the [from.solar_system.Owner.GetName] empire is monitoring our movements with growing suspicion.

Following tense diplomatic exchanges, they have demanded that we depart their territory or face

event-arkship-890.zh:
[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]帝国位于[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的扫描仪并未发现我们的存在。

在隐形场保持激活期间，我们必须避免任何可能导致暴露行踪的行为。
event-arkship-890.en:
The scanners of the [from.solar_system.Owner.GetName] empire in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system have not detected our presence.

While our cloaking field remains active, we must avoid any actions that could risk revealing our presence.

event-arkship-900.zh:
我们的扫描仪侦测到游牧帝国在[From.GetName]星系正在建立一座驿站。虽然此类建筑通常用于采集资源，但其确切用途可能有所不同。

此进展值得关注。
event-arkship-900.en:
Our scanners have detected the construction of a waystation in the [From.GetName] system, established by a nomadic empire. While such structures are often used to harvest resources, their exact purpose can vary.

This development warrants observation.

event-arkship-910.zh:
跨越边境进入[from.solar_system.GetName]星系，我们未曾遭遇任何抵抗，唯有一种比任何扫描仪所能测量的还要深沉的紧张感。

这片空间昭示着有一个早已巅峰不再、却绝非手无寸铁的文明存在。倘若其注意力被吸引到我们身上，我们定会被发现力有不逮。

让审慎指引我们的每一步。这里并非我们的领地。
event-arkship-910.en:
Crossing the border into the [from.solar_system.GetName] system, we encounter no resistance, only a tension deeper than any scan can measure.

This space bears the hallmarks of a civilization long past its zenith, yet far from powerless. Should its attention b

event-astral-planes-1030.zh: 维度锁正在失去稳定。我们需要尽快行动避免它完全松脱。
event-astral-planes-1030.en: This Dimensional Lock is destabilizing. We will need to work quickly to prevent it from completely unraveling.

event-astral-planes-110.zh:
我们已经揭开了关于如何收集储存这种构成我们宇宙边界的星界物质形成的缥缈丝线的秘密。

这种珍贵稀有的资源可以以诸多方式使用，使我们大受裨益。
event-astral-planes-110.en:
We have unlocked the secrets behind gathering and containing the volatile threads of astral material that make up the very border of this universe.

This valuable and rare resource can be applied in various ways that will benefit us greatly.

event-astral-planes-210.zh:
[fromfrom.leader.GetName]从一趟寻找因终末而消失的星系的星界裂隙探险中返回了。他熟悉的许多地方已经完全从本现实中消失了。

他还不确定自己回到的是不是正确的维度，显然是受到了一定的认知冲击。
event-astral-planes-210.en:
[fromfrom.leader.GetName] returned from exploring an Astral Rift to find a galaxy lost to the End. Many of the places they knew have vanished completely from this existence.

They are still uncertain if they returned to the correct dimension at all, and appear

event-bio-185.zh:
我们的物种正站在下一个宏伟前沿的边缘。我们现在必须做出选择。

我们是要拥抱我们的命运，净化我们的基因谱系，将我们的文明提升到基因卓越的新高度？还是要保留我们过去的教训，以当前未经提炼的形态继续前进？
event-bio-185.en:
Our species stands on the edge of its next grand frontier. We must now make a choice.

Will we embrace our destiny, purifying our genetic lineage to elevate our civilization to new heights of genetic excellence? Or will we retain the lessons of our past and co

event-bio-190.zh:
我们的物种已经到达关键时刻。必须做出决定。

我们是要拥抱命运，驾驭克隆的力量，不可逆转地将自身转变为一个复制完美的文明？还是要吸收迄今为止旅程的教训，继续保持我们不必要的差异化？
event-bio-190.en:
Our species has arrived at a crucial moment. A decision must be made.

Shall we embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of cloning, irrevocably transforming ourselves into a civilization of replicated perfection? Or shall we absorb the lessons of our journ

event-bio-195.zh:
我们正处在关键生物前沿的风口浪尖。一个重要的抉择在等待着我们。

我们可以通过驾驭高级生物突变的力量来拥抱我们的命运，通过对我们基因密码的刻意进化来不可逆转地改变我们的文明。或者我们可以保留从过去探索中获得的教训，继续保持我们当前平凡的形态。
event-bio-195.en:
We are on the cusp of a pivotal biological frontier. An important choice awaits.

We can either embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of advanced biological mutation, irrevocably transforming our civilization through the deliberate evolution of our genet

event-bio-3125.zh:
我们注意到你们目前并未参与任何战斗。为什么？年轻的帝国必须战斗，否则就会落后。我们已经为你们选好了对手，[unfortunate_country.GetName]。在十年内击败他们，你们的持续发展就有保障了。

别担心你们之间的停战协定。它已经不存在了。
event-bio-3125.en:
We have noticed that you are not currently engaged in battle. Why? Young empires must fight or fall behind. We have selected an opponent for you, the [unfortunate_country.GetName]. Defeat them within a decade and your continued development will be assured.

An

event-bio-3145.zh:
年轻的[Root.GetName]，我们带来一个警告，以及一个挑战。

虽然掠夺周遭一切的感觉令人陶醉，但要想真正理解战争，你们也必须懂得和平。

花上十年时间好好思考你们已经获得的一切。相信我们：休息一下，否则你们会崩溃的。
event-bio-3145.en:
Young [Root.GetName], we come with a warning, and a challenge.

While it can be intoxicating, grabbing all that is around you, to truly know War you must also know Peace.

Take a decade to reflect on what you have gained. Trust us: rest, or you will break.

event-bio-3215.zh:
生活在你们境内的[boring_species.GetName]物种简单到令人失望，他们的存在仿佛行尸走肉。这种迟钝的生物伤害了我们的集体意志。我们将提供三种不同的方法来纠正这种……失败。

不要让我们感到无聊。
event-bio-3215.en: The [boring_species.GetName] species living within your borders has proven to be disappointingly simple, their existence a hollow echo of potential. Such stagnation offends our collective will. We will grant one of three different methods to rectify this... fa

event-bio-3225.zh: 我们观察到，你们种族中的个别个体发展出了一种我们巨大的基因库中都没有的特殊特质。你要提供给我们的不只是分析报告。我们需要这种[fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName]的活体样品，不要惊慌。不需要一整格[interesting_species.GetName]。只要一只[interesting_species.GetHandName]就能培养一个替代品。
event-bio-3225.en: We have observed that certain of your kind have developed a peculiar trait absent from our vast genetic repository. You will provide us with more than an analysis. We require a living sample of this [fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName].

event-bio-3325.zh:
我们希望你们的诸多缺陷不会妨碍你们理解此事的严重性。你们那优柔寡断的星海共同体提出了一项必须[GetPassFail]的议案。为了帮助你们构建论据，你们可以使用我们优越的知识。如果你们真的具备复杂思维能力的话，请务必注意。

失落帝国切断了与我们的通讯。
event-bio-3325.en: We hope that your many faults don't stop you from understanding the gravity of this situation. Your dithering Galactic Community has proposed a resolution which must [GetPassFail]. To assist in crafting your arguments you may make use of our superior knowledge

event-bio-3405.zh:
为何要与自己过不去？在这星海的大合唱中，你们奏出的是如此刺耳的杂音。我们不过是想让你们与大局和谐。可你们却顽固地坚持着这不谐之音。

记住：我们的交响乐终将响彻星海，有没有你们都一样。
event-bio-3405.en:
Why stand in your own way? In the galactic chorus, yours is a dissonant note. We wish only to bring you into harmony. Yet, you resist, clinging to your discord.

Know this: our symphony will echo through the galaxy, with or without you.

event-cara-4000.zh: 来自[pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName]的报道指出，有一批居民离开了殖民地，选择加入正穿行于我们领地的[pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName]舰队，他们表面上说是为了冒险的梦想，不过是被赤裸裸的利益熏昏了头罢了。
event-cara-4000.en: Reports from [pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName] inform us that a number of inhabitants have left the colony to join the [pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName] fleet passing through our territory, ostensibly drawn by dreams of adventure or the heady aroma of raw mer

event-cara-4010.zh: [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName]传来一条紧急消息，上面说有一批[caravan_pops_join_country.GetName]的原成员目前正打算在这颗星球上寻求政治庇护。当地管理部门决定上报这一情况，让更高阶的官员定夺。
event-cara-4010.en: An urgent missive from [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName] explains that a number of now-former members of the [caravan_pops_join_country.GetName] seek political asylum on the planet. The local administration has seen fit to pass the decision of what to do with

event-cara-4030.zh: 今天在[disgruntled_planet.GetName]爆发了大规模抗议，由于这个星系中[xeno_fleet.GetName]的种种暴行。他们肮脏的存在侵犯到了所有有正义感的[disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]。
event-cara-4030.en: Mass protests erupted on [disgruntled_planet.GetName] today, due to outrage over the [xeno_fleet.GetName] in the system. Their grubby presence offends all right-thinking [disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural].

event-cara-4050.zh: 近期[stealing_fleet.GetName]参观[stolen_from_planet.GetName]之后，人们发现有一部分资源居然莫名其妙消失了。人们怀疑是被[stealing_fleet.GetName]给顺手牵羊了。
event-cara-4050.en: After a recent visit of the [stealing_fleet.GetName] to [stolen_from_planet.GetName] it has been noticed that a number of resources are missing from the central reserve. It is suspected that the [stealing_fleet.GetName] somehow made off with them.

event-colony-160.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]发现了一具庞大的残骸，看上去似乎是一台粒子加速器。它位于一个充满辐射的巨大弹坑中，这意味着这台加速器是[Root.GetPlanetMoon]核战中非常重要的战略目标之一。

我们找到了一些负责这台加速器的科学家所写的日志，尽管这项科技的开发很不完善，但是其中不少研究和公式哪怕对我们的科技标准来说都算是闻所未闻的先进知识，我们的物理学家已经在研究这些数据了。
event-colony-160.en: We have discovered what appears to be the remains of a massive particle accelerator on [Root.GetName]. It was found in a still-radioactive region covered in massive bomb craters, suggesting the accelerator was considered a strategic target of great importance

event-colony-161.zh:
在[Root.GetName]的一场庞大的使用核武的战争中幸存的这些基础设施被证实对我们的殖民者有着极大的好处。曾经在这里居住的外星文明所建造的那些用来连接他们主要居住站的公路，其中一些在今天仍然状态良好足以为我们所用。

我们还能从散布在地表的废墟中回收大量的建筑材料，从而进一步完善我们殖民地的基础设施。
event-colony-161.en: Infrastructure that survived the great nuclear war which ruined [Root.GetName] have proved a great boon to our colonists. The alien civilization that once lived here built highways connecting their major population centers, and some of them are still in good e

event-colony-162.zh:
近日，一个从[Root.GetName]出发的殖民者小队登上了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上一个由原住民留在轨道上的原始空间站。在面向[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的窗口周围，我们发现了许多这个空间站工作人员的干尸。他们意识到在看到下方星球那些翻腾的蘑菇云后他们的命运已经注定了。通过通讯记录表明，这些宇航员一次次徒劳尝试着与地表进行联络，可惜的是他们却在日渐疯狂的尝试中耗尽了他们的补给。

这个空间站目前状况良好，它给我们的工程师展现了一个在行星早期文明中难得一见的空间站计划。工程师从这个空间
event-colony-162.en: A small team from our colony on [Root.GetName] recently boarded a primitive space station that had been left in orbit by the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s original inhabitants. The mummified remains of the station's crew could still be found clustered around viewport

event-colony-163.zh: [Root.GetName]的一些废土区域散发的辐射量要高于我们之前的探测值，一些当地的殖民者都在不同程度上出现了健康状况差、生育率低等现象。现在我们正在逐步从受影响区域疏散人群，但是这么做是需要一定时间的。
event-colony-163.en: The radiation levels in some wasteland regions of [Root.GetName] appear to be greater than our previous scans had indicated. Colonists in several local settlements have complained of poor health, and birth rates are down. We are taking steps to evacuate the af

event-colony-164.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的废土中发现的破败的遗迹似乎从某种程度上影响了在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的殖民者，使他们慢慢向和平主义者靠拢。这次新行动的人员声称他们的生存意义就是为了给后世的人敲响警钟，让他们记住战争的可怕，他们认为必须阻止发生在[Root.GetName]上的事情在其他世界重演。
event-colony-164.en:
The decrepit ruins and desolate wastelands found on [Root.GetName] seem to have prompted many of the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s colonists to adopt some kind of pacifistic philosophy.

Members of this new movement claim that the environment they live in serve as a

event-colony-2001.zh: [Root.GetName]本地的政府失误导致一小群叛军收获了更多支持者，他们反对我们的传统思潮。支持他们的人越来越多，这让他们在该区域获得了更大的权利。这样的支持同时也让他们在获得民众支持上取得了一定成功，他们可以利用这些支持来发展自己的事业。
event-colony-2001.en: Local political drama on [Root.GetName] has resulted in increased support among a small group of rebels, opposed to our underlying ethics. Their increased support have enabled them to gain more power in the region and vote for their own causes with limited suc

event-colony-2025.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上，混居在我们其中的异星人开始惹是生非了。这引起了我们民众的众怒，每天都有越来越多的争斗彰显。如果坐视不理，那些异星人估计会损失惨重。
event-colony-2025.en: The xenos living among us have begun to cause friction on [Root.GetName]. Our own people are furious, resulting in more and more fights breaking out each day. If we idly stand by the xenos might end up losing more than some bodily fluids.

event-colony-2050.zh: 由于重大的记录错误，[Root.GetName]部分区域的基础设施维护与住宅服务已趋于落后。人们正居住在较为恶劣的环境之中，似乎已忍不了太久了。要修复这些问题则会耗费我们的时间与精力。
event-colony-2050.en: Due to a major clerical error parts of [Root.GetName] has fallen behind in infrastructure maintenance and accommodation services. The people live in rather bleak conditions and will not tolerate it for long. Remedying these problems will cost us time and effor

event-colony-3051.zh:
[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士从传送门中带来的恐怖大军击溃了我们的防御，征服了[fromfrom.GetName]！

被强大的异次元实体夺舍后，[doomslayer_knight.GetHimselfHerself]自号为[doomslayer_knight.GetTitle][doomslayer_knight.GetName]，[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]为[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]召唤了一支恶魔军队，并开始征服我们的星
event-colony-3051.en:
The horrors that Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName] led through the portal have breached our defenses and conquered [fromfrom.GetName]!

Possessed by a major dimensional being and now titling [doomslayer_knight.GetHimselfHerself] as [doomslayer_knight.GetTitle

event-country-999.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetStarName]系最近发现了一颗彗星。
在[Root.Capital.GetName]表面清晰可见的这颗彗星在大众心中激起了强烈的反响。

几乎无人能否认，在[GetCycleName]轮回中出现这样的一个天体毫无疑问是[GetCycleAttitude]的原因。
event-country-999.en:
A comet was recently detected in the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system.
Clearly visible from the surface of [Root.Capital.GetName], its appearance was met with an intense reaction from the planet's population.

There is little disagreement that the occurrence

event-crime-1.zh:
[Root.GetName]的失业与贫困率正在以令人诧异的速度攀升着。然而，这一不幸的事况正在被当地的犯罪组织所利用。他们打劫走投无路的平民，也招收穷困潦倒的新人入伙。

作为临时的处理方案，我们可以提升[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的失业补助金。虽然可能会花费大量预算，但可以为我们争取宝贵的时间以制定永久的解决方案，例如创造更多工作岗位，提升失业与贫困民众的生活标准等。

当然我们也可以袖手旁观，但这很可能会造成[Root.GetName]上形成庞大的地下犯罪组织。
event-crime-1.en:
Unemployment and poverty are spreading at an alarming rate on [Root.GetName]. This sorry state of affairs is being exploited by local crime organizations, who find themselves awash with both easy marks and desperate recruits.

As a temporary solution, we could

event-cstorms-1417.zh:
这些海盗的技术完全支持不了它们狂妄的言论。不久之后，他们的舰队成为了星系生态系统的一部分。

我们很快重新与地表的船员们取得联系。他们被吓坏了，但没有受到伤害。

虽然在这里没有发现古代文明的洞见，但这段经历告诉我们以后要提高警惕。探险队领袖未能察觉到眼前的危险——我们以后不能再犯同样的错误。
event-cstorms-1417.en:
These pirates could not back up their cocky speeches with skill. Before long, whatever was left of their fleet became a part of the galactic ecosystem.

We reestablished contact with the crew on the surface soon after. They were rather shaken by the experience

event-cstorms-1700.zh:
据报道，在最近的磁力风暴之后，[this.GetName]出现了不寻常的后遗症。风暴的强大能量场增加了行星熔融核心的磁场波动，导致科技基础设施普遍失灵。

然而，这种情况也提供了一个绝无仅有的资源开采机会。地幔下富含金属的熔岩流被带上了电荷，可以在采矿磁铁的帮助下收获。
event-cstorms-1700.en: Unusual after effects are being reported on [this.GetName] in the wake of the recent Magnetic Storm. The storm's potent energy fields increased magnetic volatility in the planet's molten core, resulting in the widespread failure of technological infrastructure

event-cstorms-1710.zh: 在最近的电力风暴后，[this.GetName]上观察到了一种异常现象。该行星的[GetOceansState]现已充斥着永久性的电流，电流在广阔的水体中循环，对水生生物构成致命威胁。
event-cstorms-1710.en: An unusual phenomenon has been observed on [this.GetName] in the wake of the recent Electric Storm. The planet's [GetOceansState] have been left charged with a perpetual electrical current now circulating in this vast body of water, posing lethal risks for aqu

event-cstorms-1720.zh: 在最近[this.solar_system.GetName]的虚境风暴事件后，[owner.GetColonistPlural]报告称在某个孤立的峡谷中发现了难以解释的神秘现象。幽灵般的蓝色身影短暂出现，似乎无法或不愿与我们的[owner.GetColonistPlural]互动，只是漫无目的地徘徊，随后消失。
event-cstorms-1720.en: Following the recent Shroud Storm in [this.solar_system.GetName], [owner.GetColonistPlural] report inexplicable sightings of ethereal apparitions in an isolated canyon. These ghostly blue figures appear briefly, unable or unwilling to interact with our [owner.

event-cstorms-1730.zh:
最近的[this.GetAffectedStormType]残留的辐射导致[this.GetName]上的地质活动变得异常。

尤其值得注意的是，风暴的影响使得一座活火山不再活跃，将其与地质学上的热点隔离，切断了岩浆供应。

由于冷却的岩浆开拓了新的土地，进一步开发这颗行星的新机遇因这些变化而呈现于我们面前。
event-cstorms-1730.en:
The residual radiation from the recent [this.GetAffectedStormType] has led to erratic geological activity across [this.GetName].

Most notably, the impact of the storm has rendered an active volcano extinct, cutting it off from its geological hotspot and sever

event-cstorms-1740.zh:
一场严重的重力风暴导致了[this.GetName]的地景发生了剧变。这场风暴强劲的重力波动将行星最高的山脉从构造架上剥离，径直提到了星球的上方。

它现在仍然悬浮在上层大气中，由风暴的残余引力作用保持在高空。这一剧变使得地下基岩中以前无法开采的矿物贮藏暴露了出来，也为[owner.GetResearchers]提供了很多可以分析的资料。
event-cstorms-1740.en:
A severe Gravity Storm caused an extraordinary transformation of [this.GetName]'s landscape. The storm's powerful gravitational fluctuations severed the planet's largest mountain range from its tectonic shelf, lifting it vertically above the planet.

It remain

event-cstorms-1750.zh: 近期的[this.GetAffectedStormType]对[this.GetName]的气候产生了意想不到的影响。
event-cstorms-1750.en: The recent [this.GetAffectedStormType] has had an unexpected impact on the climate of [this.GetName].

event-cstorms-1830.zh:
[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们深表同情！我们目睹了一场大风暴在[this.GetName]肆虐。

听到那里遭到的破坏，我们当然感到非常难过。我们哭了，我们真的哭了！所以，请允许我们帮个忙……这是一笔特别的一次性超级交易！

我们可以提供一些小工具，一流的小工具。是我们能给的最好的！有了这些，当下一次风暴来临时，你就能做好准备了。那么我们成交吧？
event-cstorms-1830.en:
Commiserations, [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We chanced to see a big storm wreaking havoc in [this.GetName].

Of course, we were very sad to hear of the damage done there. We cried, indeed we cried! So please, allow us to help... with a special one time super

event-cstorms-500.zh:
在[this.GetAffectedStormType]带来破坏的余波中，我们取得了许多对这些宇宙自然现象的洞见。

通过研究星际气象学，我们可以在未来更好地保护自己。这一全新的研究领域可能将会得出完全驾驭这些风暴的手段。
event-cstorms-500.en:
In the aftermath of the devastation from the [this.GetAffectedStormType], we have gained some unique insight on these galactic phenomena.

By studying astrometeorology, we can better protect ourselves in the future. This new field of research might eventually

event-cstorms-8000.zh: 过境的宇宙风暴留下的不仅仅是毁灭。在[Planet.GetName]上，它还创造了一个全新的地理特征。
event-cstorms-8000.en: A passing cosmic storm has left more than mere devastation in its wake. On [Planet.GetName], it has created an entirely new geographical feature.

event-cstorms-tutorial-1.zh: 我们可以根据自身利益来操控某个宇宙风暴的移动路线。可以将风暴驱斥远离我方恒星系，或是吸引风暴进而利用其正面效果。
event-cstorms-tutorial-1.en: We can manipulate the path of a Cosmic Storm for our own benefit. Either to deflect them away from our systems, or attract them to utilize their positive effects.

event-cyber-1005.zh:
“[Species.GetName]记录再突破”这样的标题在[Owner.GetAdjective]的体育新闻中已经屡见不鲜了。随着[GetAthletePlural]们竞相使用更新、更复杂的改装来超越彼此，运动能力的极限也在不断被突破。

“强化体育”的粉丝们为这些结果欣喜若狂，但越来越多的铁杆爱好者呼吁应该单独设立强化运动员的项目。还有一些人希望限制参加团体比赛的改造人的数量，让纯天然的[GetAthletePlural]在聚光灯下还能占有一席之地。
event-cyber-1005.en: 'Another [Species.GetName] Record Broken' - this headline has become commonplace in [Owner.GetAdjective] sporting life. As [GetAthletePlural] race to outdo one another with newer and more sophisticated modifications, the limits of athletic performance are cons

event-cyber-1030.zh:
有了如此众多能够控制感官和情感体验的植入体，强化改造的个体现在更倾向投身虚拟活动，以此进行娱乐或者逃避现实。虽然忆痕艺术家理论上可以激发出任何情绪，但这种做法却已经出现了一些黑暗的转折。

忆痕俱乐部高价收购那些具有强烈情感体验的自录记忆，例如婚礼、交配仪式、自杀、袭击和谋杀等等。这一做法导致了犯罪率上升，犯罪分子不但会为了记忆犯罪，还会在这些创伤经历后窃取受害者的植入体。

我们应该如何应对与之相关的乱象?
event-cyber-1030.en: With so many implants able to control sensory and emotional experiences, augmented individuals have turned to virtual life events as escapism and entertainment. While engram artists can theoretically stimulate any emotion, the practice has taken a dark turn.

event-cyber-1055.zh:
一位海军军校生泄露了机密信息，其愚蠢之举令人震惊。作为一名网络战斗模拟器的忠实粉丝，这位学员与其他玩家就我们驱逐舰上炮塔的旋转速度发生了争论。

为了支持自己的说法，学员甚至上传了几张我们舰船的机密蓝图，这些文件很快传遍了全星系网络。尽管肇事者已被处理，但由于这一事件，内阁中有声音呼吁全面禁止网络游戏。
event-cyber-1055.en:
In an appalling display of foolishness, a naval cadet has leaked classified information. A dedicated fan of networked combat simulators, the cadet got into an argument with other players about the angular velocity of the turrets on our destroyers.

To bolster

event-cyber-120.zh:
一个研究团队提出了一项新议案，将监管人工智能集成到我们的移动设备中，随后又可以直接整合进义体件中。

这些监管人工智能将会引导我们公民将关注点从无聊的任务转移到更需要脑力的任务上。虽然会因此丧失一部分自主权，但对生产力前所未有的提高将不容忽视。
event-cyber-120.en:
A team of researchers has put forth an innovative proposal to integrate AI supervisors into our mobile devices. Later these could be incorporated directly into cyberware.

The supervisors would redirect the focus of our citizenry away from idle tasks towards m

event-cyber-1205.zh: 最新一代的感官义体件可以让用户屏蔽不必要的感觉。包括不受欢迎的气味、不得体的画面等等，一切都可以被淡化、掩盖，甚至完全从用户的感知中抹去。我们社会中较为保守的团体越来越担心这种审查制度会对我国公民的良知产生影响。
event-cyber-1205.en: The latest generation of sensory cyberware allows user to block out unwanted sensations. From unwelcome smells to unseemly pictures, everything can be toned down, masked, or even entirely erased from the user's perception. There are growing concerns amongst th

event-cyber-1210.zh: 最近，雄心勃勃的企业和地下运动的广告倾向于在用户的义体件中隐秘地植入信息。虚假记忆、选择性荷尔蒙反应和睡眠建议正变得司空见惯。忧心忡忡的政界人士向我们提出了这个关切，并主张禁止这些侵入性信息，或至少加以监管。
event-cyber-1210.en: A recent trend in advertisement for underground movements and ambitious corporations is to implant surreptitious messages in the user cyberware. Fake memories, selective hormonal reactions, and sleep suggestions are becoming commonplace. Concerned political ac

event-cyber-1505.zh: 民主过程是这个社会的基础，显然只有加强这个基础才是明智的选择。新的义体使我们能够对或大或小的所有社会问题进行投票，为个人提供前所未有的表达意见的机会。这带来了难以想象的数据财富和无穷的可能性。
event-cyber-1505.en: The democratic process is what this society has been built on. It only makes sense to strengthen this foundation. Our new cybernetics enable us to cast our vote on all societal matters big or small, affording the individual unprecedented opportunities to expre

event-cyber-1510.zh: 很显然，大众都想要出人头地、与其他人一争高下。我们迎合这种超竞争行为的方式是设立一种游戏化的系统，用社会流动性和小饰品的承诺来换取生产力的提高，也能很好地满足他们的愿望。
event-cyber-1510.en: It has become clear that the population wishes to stand out and joust against one another. Our plans to support this hyper-competitive behavior with a gamified system, which promises social mobility and minor trinkets in exchange for increased productivity, wi

event-cyber-1515.zh:
[Species.GetAdj]民众正在逐渐接受一个可以用强化体以全新的方式表达自我的世界。

但这种宽容只是表象，植入体的内增强监控算法现在正在监视着每一个人，在大脑突触连接的那一刻就能发现不当的想法。
event-cyber-1515.en:
The [Species.GetAdj] people are embracing a world where the augmented can express their identity in brand new ways.

But the leniency is only a facade, as enhanced surveillance algorithms within the implant are now monitoring every individual, detecting dissid

event-cyber-1520.zh:
皇帝下诏要求我们把精力集中在王朝本身。一块特殊的统治芯片会被植入每一位未来的统治者，以记录并转移他们作为[root.GetName]的[root.GetRulerTitle]期间的经验。

随着统治芯片的代代相传，其蕴含的丰富经验将成为我们社会的重要记录。另外，我们也可以利用人民的知识来增益领袖。
event-cyber-1520.en: The imperial seat has decreed our efforts be focused on the dynasty itself. A special RulerChip will be implanted on all future rulers to record and transfer their experiences as the [root.GetRulerTitle] of the [root.GetName]. This relic chip will then be tran

event-cyber-1525.zh:
[Species.GetAdj]焦点小组对他们的新眼部植入物反应积极。我们的分析部门认为，广告效果显著提高，整个产品组合的销售额有望大幅增长。这为即将到来的完整产品发布展示了巨大的潜力。

义体时代已经来临，我们已经做好充分准备以一种全新的企业战略来加以利用。
event-cyber-1525.en: [Species.GetAdj] focus groups are responding positively to the their new ocular implants. Our analytics department suggests a remarkable surge in ad effectiveness and a promising bump in sales throughout our entire portfolio. This showcases immense potential f

event-cyber-160.zh:
一部广受好评的新剧抓住了公众们的集体想象力。

故事发生在一个义体植入体盛行的世界里，讲述一位强化改造的工人遭遇了与改造身体的创伤性分离。故事的悲剧性结局对完全义体化及其对[Owner.Species.GetAdj]身份不可避免的抹除提出了一种几乎不加掩饰的批评。

这部剧的大获成功引发了对义体化倡议的强烈反对，自该剧播出以来，可用测试对象的注册人数骤减了60%。
event-cyber-160.en:
A widely acclaimed new drama has captured the collective imagination of the public.

Set in a world where cybernetic implants are prevalent, the narrative follows an augmented worker experiencing traumatic dissociation from their modified body. The story's tra

event-cyber-210.zh: 记者们揭露了政府正在资助涉及思想监控芯片实验的证据。一旦这些设备开发完成，就可以安装在公民的大脑中，收集详细的安全和人格数据。
event-cyber-210.en: Journalists have uncovered proof of government-funded experiments that involve thought-monitoring microchips. Fully developed, these devices could be installed in the minds of citizens to gather detailed security and personality insights.

event-cyber-220.zh:
我们在神经接口领域取得了显著的突破。大脑信号增幅器可以让用户丝滑但有限地操控一组人工肢体。在未来，这种技术也可以直接整合进义体脑中，而不需要外接设备。

在初步测试阶段，测试对象展现出了更高的敏捷性和精确的物体操纵能力，甚至还有更高的战斗熟练程度。然而，对制造成本的担忧促使人们应定夺这项开创性技术应优先运用于什么人群上。
event-cyber-220.en: A significant breakthrough has been achieved in the field of neural interfaces. A brain signal amplifier could grant users seamless, but limited control over an array of artificial limbs. Later on, this could be integrated directly to a cyberbrain without the

event-cyber-2220.zh: 在组装工蜂的过程中偶尔会有存在缺陷的躯体。通常这些畸形的工蜂都会被处理掉，但多亏了义体植入体，它们仍可以加入到我们的行列中。提高我们的数量是好事，但有缺陷的工蜂需要根据问题的严重程度进行个性化植入。我们的蜂巢会成长得更快，但也会变得更……不完美。
event-cyber-2220.en: Drone assembly occasionally results in defective bodies. Misshapen drones are usually disposed of, but thanks to cybernetic implants, they could be allowed to join our ranks. Improving our numbers is desirable, but faulty drones require personalized implants d

event-cyber-2260.zh:
一小部分受试对象遭受了对强化改造的不良反应。他们的身体排斥植入体，发生了危及生命的并发症。其病因似乎是一种以前未被注意到的遗传缺陷。根据初步计算，这大约会影响5%的工蜂人口。

在确定了问题之后，我们现在可以对工蜂进行筛查加以预防，但不知道该如何处理受影响的人口。
event-cyber-2260.en: A small percentage of our test subjects are suffering adverse reactions to augmentation. Their bodies are rejecting the implants, bringing life-threatening side-effects. The cause seems to be a genetic defect, previously unnoticed. According to preliminary cal

event-cyber-2320.zh:
由单一实体组成的帝国以怀疑的目光注视着我们，恐惧于我们的人口众多。而义体植入体可以让我们的特使具有更独特的面孔和个性，呈现出不那么同质的外表。

这些分裂体的国家终将会感激我们的努力，甚至可能开始……同情我们，把我们看作他们的同类。
event-cyber-2320.en:
Empires composed of singular entities watch us with suspicion, fearing our plurality. With cybernetic implants, we could give our envoys more distinct faces and personalities, presenting a less homogeneous facade.

The disunited would appreciate the effort. Th

event-cyber-2360.zh:
我们蜂巢的义体化正在顺利进行中。我们的一部分人口现在已经搭载了义体植入体，而另一部分则还是完全的生物体。我们从未体在自己的身体上验过这样强烈的差异。工蜂现在可以将自己识别为不同群体的一部分，这种分裂感正在诱发它们的个体意识。

有些工蜂开始向自己身上安装小配件以装饰自己，或在植入体上绘制特殊符号以区分彼此。真是一种有趣但又令人担忧的发展。
event-cyber-2360.en: The cyberization of our Hive is continuing smoothly. Part of our population now carries cybernetic implants, while others are still completely biological. Never before have we experienced such striking differences between our selves. Drones are now able to ide

event-cyber-2420.zh:
义体植入体让死亡这件事变得复杂了起来。

将植入体从死亡的工蜂身上拆下可以让我们进行循环利用，减少浪费。我们的整个废弃物抛弃流程需要进行优化以兼容这一新的步骤；需要花费的资源较多。
event-cyber-2420.en:
Cybernetic implants are complicating the logistic of death.

Stripping deceased drones of their implants would allow us to reuse the technology, reducing waste. Our whole waste disposal process would have to get an overhaul to accommodate this new step; the re

event-cyber-2460.zh:
我们现有的人口正在稳步地进行义体化，但必须为还未出生的人口建立一种流程。

以我们的科技，我们甚至可以在[owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]出生前就安装上义体植入体，从而创造一个真正义体化的物种：这种方案快速、轻松且高效。另一方面，初步研究表明，在极早期安装植入体可能造成精神分裂、精神错乱、震颤和各种发育障碍。
event-cyber-2460.en:
Our existing population is undergoing cyberization at a steady rate, but we must establish a process for those yet to be born.

With our technology, we can fit our [owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] with cybernetic implants before they are even born, creating

event-cyber-260.zh:
一款新型脊柱模块的试验以灾难性的失败告终。植入体电机产生的过大力量导致多名测试对象的脊髓遭受永久性损伤。

这一可怕结果的图片被泄露引起了公众的不适，导致未来实验的志愿者严重短缺。
event-cyber-260.en:
A trial run of a new spinal module has ended in a catastrophic failure. The excess power generated by the implant's motors has resulted in permanent spinal cord injuries for multiple test subjects.

Disturbing images showcasing the horrifying outcome have leak

event-cyber-320.zh:
随着为新生儿安装植入体的全新技术问世，我们突然陷入了僵局。这些开创性的新生儿强化改造拥有永远改变我们与技术的关系的力量，从幼年开始便解放先天的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向前所未有的高度。

然而，如果从这么小的时候就开始依赖于义体强化，可能会导致我们的物种最终失去在自然状态下生存的能力。
event-cyber-320.en: With our newfound capability to insert implants onto newborns, we have suddenly reached an impasse. These pioneering neonatal augmentations possess the power to forever transform our bond with technology, unlocking innate cybernetic potential from an early age

event-cyber-360.zh:
最近，一些个体开始公开表达对接受实验性身体改造的懊悔。将脑干换成机械替代品会导致持久的生存恐惧，一些人将他们的经历描述为无法忍受的痛苦的持续循环。

在不断要求赔偿的情况下，我们不得不澄清我们对国家责任的立场。
event-cyber-360.en: Recently, a number of individuals have begun to publicly express remorse over their decision to undergo experimental body modifications. Exchanging the brainstem for a mechanical substitute has resulted in lasting existential dread, with some describing their

event-cyber-610.zh:
一种非法植入模组正在员工中广为传播，它可以刺激大脑产生任意的神经递质。这将会有广泛的用途，例如灌输强烈的快乐或者增强疼痛耐受性。从这些非法植入物中逆向工程出一个稳定的版本需要大量的投资，而且这种刺激的效果必将逐渐减退。

我们是应该将这种非法植入体重新包装为商业化的版本，还是仅仅对其使用进行规范？
event-cyber-610.en: An underground implant mod is spreading amongst the workforce that stimulates the brain to produce neurotransmitter chemicals at will. This has a wide array of uses from instilling intense pleasure to increasing pain tolerance. Reverse-engineering a stable ver

event-cyber-615.zh:
越来越多的公司要求在工作期间的所有经验必须储存在义体大脑中的特殊区域，在工作以外的时候不得访问。

他们声称，这种功能只会在高度机密的任务中使用，以避免商业窃密。有一些甚至要求雇员在工作中屏蔽个人经验，以避免个人道德对生产力造成干扰。
event-cyber-615.en:
More and more companies require that all experiences during office hours are stored in a cyberbrain memory area inaccessible outside work.

They claim to use this functionality only with highly confidential tasks to prevent corporate espionage. Some even requi

event-cyber-625.zh: 随着义体件在我们的生活中愈发根深蒂固，盈利模式的变化将极大地影响整个社会。近来，植入体制造商将一些基本功能限制在订阅模式中成为了一种潮流。如果忘记付款，义体躯干可能会突然被锁定、视力可能会消失。消费者权益组织正在敦促我们出台措施阻止这种现象。
event-cyber-625.en: With cyberware being so engrained in our lives, changes in monetization models affect our entire society dramatically. The recent trend has implants manufacturers lock essential functionalities behind a subscription model. Miss a payment and suddenly, your cyb

event-cyber-805.zh:
监护人希望能通过幼体大脑中的植入体对他们的孩子进行更多的控制。对运动功能的接管目前仅限于警方使用，但有些人希望把这种权力也授予孩子的监护人。

尽管这很明显违背了身体自主权，但许多其他方式的家长控制已经得到允许。替代方案是允许一些有限的控制，例如让行为不良的孩子减慢速度或降低音量。
event-cyber-805.en:
With brain implants installed in infants, caretakers are asking for more control over their children. The ability to take over motor functions is currently reserved for enforcers, but some want to extend these rights to parental guardians as well.

While this

event-cyber-810.zh:
在义体大脑植入体方面的发展给予了我们一个诱人的机遇。比起又主观又缓慢的教学方法，我们可以将关键的知识直接在大脑之间传输。该过程需要无菌的实验室环境，因此无法进行大规模应用。接收到的信息也会部分覆盖掉接收者的同类别记忆。

最有影响的应用方式包括在科学家之间共享知识。这可以抵消来自义体化过程的一些工程学研究负担，或者将重点放在其他领域。
event-cyber-810.en: The development of the cybernetic brain implants gives us an enticing opportunity. Instead of relying on subjective and slow teaching methods, we could transfer key knowledge directly from one brain to another. This requires sterile laboratory conditions, and

event-cyber-815.zh:
在许多[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]愉快地用现成的义体来强化日常生活和人际关系的同时，越来越多的多配偶家庭转而使用带有定制硬件的私人网络。这些家庭群体选择生活在量身定制的隔离中，以独特的亲密感分享彼此的感受和经历。

有社会福利团体和学者称赞这种现象，认为这种对人际关系和家庭纽带的客订化强化改造可以造福所有人。但也有人对这样的避世隐居产生了担忧，甚至认为这种行为可能导致个体在这种迷你的“爱情完形”中迷失自我。
event-cyber-815.en: Whereas many [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have gladly augmented their everyday lives and relationships using off-the shelf cybernetics, a growing number of multiple-partner households in particular have instead taken to private networks with bespoke hardware. T

event-cyber-840.zh:
我们的民族自古以来都是旅人、牧民和流浪者。有些人的旅行是到达目的地的一种手段，而我们的目的地就是旅行本身。身体强化改造使新的星球更加触手可及，但也使我们能够跟踪到那些太过离经叛道的人。就是说，并非所有人都对这种变化感到满意。

越来越多的人开始篡改自己的植入体，通过脱离网络以保护自己的隐私。目前这仅仅是一个小众趋势，但它可能会带来麻烦。
event-cyber-840.en: Our people have always been travelers. Nomads. Wanderers. While for some traveling is a means to reach a destination, for us the journey is a destination in itself. Body augmentation has made it easier to reach new worlds, but has also allowed us to track thos

event-cybernetics-5048.zh: [Root.GetName]中大部分虚拟人口已经突破我们的防火墙，以一连串的数据和乱码的方式从我们手上逃脱。
event-cybernetics-5048.en: The mostly virtual population of [Root.GetName] has broken through our firewalls and escaped from our grasp in a burst of data and nonsense code.

event-distar-13060.zh:
我们在[wormhole_system.GetName]星系的边缘疑似发现了一个天然形成的亚空间现象！该处的时空出现了裂隙，从而产生了一个"虫洞"。据[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，此虫洞也许与星系中的其它虫洞通过亚空间相连。

这也就是说，我们的舰船有可能在数日之内就可以由星系的一端到达另一端，这取决于另外的虫洞的位置。不幸的是这个虫洞和大部分虫洞一样，长时间处于不稳定状态。即使有舰船敢接近，也会瞬间被撕成碎片。
event-distar-13060.en: We have detected what appears to be a naturally occurring subspace phenomenon on the edge of the [wormhole_system.GetName] system! A rift in the very fabric of space-time has formed here, creating a "wormhole" that, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] speculat

event-distar-13070.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个星门之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
event-distar-13070.en: An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "Gateway" of sorts - part of a theoretical network of simila

event-enclave-2045.zh: 我们收到了来自[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]的一份紧急公报。他们说[khan_country.GetName]提供给了他们一个不容许拒绝的提议。他们唯一的出路是在两个月内找到另外一位雇主。如果没有人雇佣他们，他们将不得不为大汗效力，在别无选择的情况下对我们发动全面战争。
event-enclave-2045.en: We have received an urgent communique from the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]. They say that the [khan_country.GetName] made them an offer they cannot refuse. Their only way out of the deal is to find employment elsewhere within two months. If no one hire

event-enclave-27.zh:
刚刚我们收到了[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]发来的讯息：

[root.GetName]，

我们目前正遭受攻击，必须立刻召回己方武装。根据合约相关条款，[mercenary_fleet.GetName]将即刻停止为您服务。

我们相信，您能够理解当前我方局势之紧迫与召回武装之必要。
event-enclave-27.en:
We have received communication from the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]:

[root.GetName],

We are under attack, and must therefore recall our own forces immediately. In accordance with our contract, the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] will leave your service for

尽管这只生物已被证明会让[event_envoy.GetName]从更为严肃的任务中分心，其他代表却对[Root.GetSpeciesName]心灵中柔软、感
event-envoy-events-15.en: [event_envoy.GetName], our emissary to the Galactic Community, has been spending a disturbing amount of time tending to a strange, small mammalian creature that began following [event_envoy.GetHerHim] around. Presumably a domestic pet that escaped from one of

event-envoy-events-205.en: The [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have brought forward a complaint regarding the conduct of our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation], [event_envoy.GetName]. Apparently [event_envoy.GetHerHis] conduct has so offended the

event-envoy-events-210.zh:
[event_envoy.GetName]，我们派遣到[envoy_country.GetName]的特使，似乎有些被他们同化了。在过去的几个月中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]经常表达对[envoy_country.GetAdj]国家体制的赞美，与[Root.GetGovernmentName]内的僵化和缺乏自由形成了鲜明的对比。

这一发现促使人们动

我方大使团因我们派驻[event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]的使者，[event_envoy.GetName]的工作情况而忧心已经有段日子了。而今曝光的证据表明[event_envoy.GetSheHe]似乎已沦为瘾君子，那是一种源自[provider_country.GetName]的外星药品，已经证明它就[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]而言极具成瘾性。

我们一位特使的私人对话录音的外泄使[offended_party.GetName]怒不可遏。录音中有一段令人遗憾，[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNotCap][event_envoy.GetName]似乎将[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的东道主称为“恶心的[offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]”，看着就很难配得上有情感能力。

随着
event-envoy-events-225.en: The [Root.GetAdj] diplomatic corps has been shaken by the news emerging from the [scandal_empire.GetName]. Our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] [event_envoy.GetName], who had been stationed there, has gotten [event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself] into a serious mess

event-envoy-events-230.zh: 刚一进入[Root.envoy_location_country.GetName]，大使[Root.GetName]就因为一连串数不清的违法行为被逮捕。[Root.envoy_location_country.GetAdj]的公函十分简洁：“我方感谢你方将罪犯转交，正义得以伸张。”

event-envoy-events-3.zh: [event_envoy.GetName]，我们在星海共同体中代表我国利益的使者严重失态，把[council_country.GetAdj]代表错当成了[pathetic_country.GetSpeciesName]。不幸的是，许多旁观者听到了这条牵连甚广的评论，[event_envoy.GetName]如今自然饱受奚落。许多人开始中伤我国外交使团的实力，不过我们对星海最新段子的贡献是确凿无疑的。
event-envoy-events-3.en: [event_envoy.GetName], our emissary representing our interests in the Galactic Community, has committed a major faux pas, mistaking the [council_country.GetAdj] delegate for a [pathetic_country.GetSpeciesName]. Unfortunately, the incriminating remarks were wit

event-envoy-events-4.zh: 尽管我们在星系中算不上真正的超级大国，我们却时常能在星系事务中发挥超过我国权重的实力。这在很大程度上归功于我们使者[event_envoy.GetName]的努力，这名特使在星海共同体中称职地代表了我国利益，连那些强硬反对[Root.GetName]立场的人们也对其高度尊敬。结果是，虽然不是每个人都畏惧我国海军或是渴望能有与我国相匹敌的金库，但他们依然景仰我国外交使团的高超造诣。
event-envoy-events-4.en: Although we are not able to count ourselves among the true superpowers of this galaxy, we have often been able to punch above our weight in galactic affairs. This is largely down to the exertions of our emissary [event_envoy.GetName], who ably represents our i

event-factions-0.zh: 一个新的派系正在[Root.Owner.GetName]的政界中逐渐壮大。他们自称[Root.GetName]。
event-factions-0.en: A new faction has recently been gaining traction in the internal political landscape of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They call themselves the [Root.GetName].

event-fallen-empires-100.zh:
我们并不是[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的[from.GetName]的第一位访客。这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球上所蕴含的待开发资源已经足以引人注目，而我们更是发现了一座停泊于高层轨道的古老且装饰华丽的信标。[from.GetName]显然属于某个远古的太空文明，但我们尚未发现他们在此处有任何的定居或勘探的迹象。

可能的理论有很多，但证据迫使我们考虑存在这么一个古老的文明，崇敬着这个郁郁葱葱的星球。我们只能猜测他们目前的下落——也就是说，假设他们仍然存在。
event-fallen-empires-100.en: We are not the first to visit [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. This [from.GetClassAdj] world is remarkable enough for its abundance of untouched resources, but we also found an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy perched in high

event-fallen-empires-2.zh:
似乎作为我们不仅同[From.GetName]停滞圣权开战，更是随后接受了战败这一事实的惩罚，和平谈判结束之后，[From.GetAdj]特工出现在了[Root.GetRulerTitle][rulername.GetName]身旁。

他们用闻所未闻的武器处决了我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。行凶后他们就消失在虚空之中，就好像从未出现过一样。
event-fallen-empires-2.en:
As if to punish us for not only warring with the Stagnant Ascendancy of the [From.GetName] but for then accepting defeat, [From.GetAdj] agents appeared by [Root.GetRulerTitle] [rulername.GetName]'s side after the peace negotiations concluded.

They dispatched

event-fallen-empires-tasks-1.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have decided to grace your empire with a gift of resources as a token of our esteem. Do not squander our generosity or take our favor for granted.

event-fallen-empires-tasks-21.en: [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We understand that your empire is home to an individual whose brilliant mind transcends the tragic primitiveness of your species. While the talents of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName] are sadly wasted in the [Root

event-fallen-empires-tasks-23.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们了解到，你们的帝国在一个濒危种群的星球找到了一份数据存储。该存储包含了这个种群的大脑扫描结果。虽说你们还过于原始，无法将这数据化为实用，但我们还是要赞美你们为保存这曾经辉煌的文明最后的遗物而做出的努力。为了在我们的濒危种群保护区中留存此种群并加以记录，我们希望你们能将这份数据交给我们，并使用我们的克隆技术复活几个该种群的生物。能不能将这数据与我们分享，方便我们合力完成这种群的遗愿呢？
event-fallen-empires-tasks-23.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We understand that your empire has come into possession of a cache of data containing the brain scans of an extinct species, taken from the very world they once inhabited. Even though your species is still too primitive

event-fallen-empires-tasks-3.zh: 你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们一定已经知道了，我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]致力于研究并保存宇宙中的所有生命形式。我们已经研究了你们的种群，并认为[Root.GetName]最多只能维持几个世纪。为确保极端情况下[Root.GetSpeciesName]的存续，我们希望贵帝国能有一部分人口，加入我们的濒危种群保护区。我们会专门创建一片保护区，完全复制你们种群的自然生存环境，其所有居民也会获得全面的照顾与保护，你也不用担心他们的安
event-fallen-empires-tasks-3.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! As you no doubt know, we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] are dedicated to the study and conservation of all forms of life in the galaxy. We have studied your species and determined that the [Root.GetName] is unli

event-federations-10000.zh:
全[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的工程师们汇聚一堂，对如何更高效地利用我们星球的资源畅所欲言。

殖民地决议丰饶计划现已可用。
event-federations-10000.en:
Engineers from across the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have come together to share ideas on ways to more exploit resources from our worlds.

The Project Cornucopia Colony Decision is now available.

event-federations2-112.zh: 我们已成功消灭联合军事演习中的目标。只能希望我们的盟友也同样勤奋！
event-federations2-112.en: We have successfully eliminated our target in the joint military exercises. We can but hope that our allies have been equally diligent!

event-federations2-20.zh:
当我们的船进入[From.GetName]星系时，显而易见的是有奇怪的事正在发生。这个星系的其中一个星球拥有着引人注目的卫星数量，而这颗星球似乎曾经适宜居住但现在却显示出相当高的辐射读数。另一个星球被完全摧毁了。碎片散落在整个系统中，表明这里曾经生活过的任何文明都在一场激烈的斗争中被毁灭了。

一艘战舰在星系中巡逻。它不响应我们的问询，而且它的航线表明其正在拦截[Root.GetName]。它的武器系统正在充能。
event-federations2-20.en: As our ships enter the [From.GetName] system, it is immediately obvious that something very strange happened here. One of the planets - which boasts an eye-catching distribution of moons - appears to have once been habitable, but initial scans show high levels

event-federations2-701.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古远征队。由于高水平的放射性物质，我们不得不采取预防辐射中毒的措施。然而，一次在考古学家挖掘的地点的泄露似乎造成了严重的恐慌。[Root.Leader.GetName]和[Root.Leader.GetHerHis]的团队不得不暂停挖掘工作，直到辐射恢复到安全水平。
event-federations2-701.en: The archaeological expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] has been forced to take precautions against radiation poisoning due to the high levels of radioactivity on the ruined planet. However, it seems that a leak has caused a significant scare on the site where

event-fedev-499.zh:
让历史铭记这一天，[fed_founder_1.GetName]与[fed_founder_2.GetName]政府签署了一个联邦条约，作为[Root.GetAllianceName]的共同缔造者，他们将携手并肩面对未来。

这个新的星系联合将作为一个光辉的榜样，告诉星系里的其他人，所有的一切都可以通过共同努力来实现。

星际外交的新时代已经开始了!
event-fedev-499.en:
Let history record that on this day, the governments of the [fed_founder_1.GetName] and the [fed_founder_2.GetName] signed a treaty of federation. As founding members of the [Root.GetAllianceName], they will now face the future as firm allies.

This new Galact

event-fircon-10.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]正在从[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]研究对象收集洞见。我们可能会在突破性事件中发现一个新的洞见科技。
event-fircon-10.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are in the process of gathering Insights from our [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] study subjects. We may discover a new Insight Technology during a breakthrough event.

event-fircon-1270.zh:
[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的居民持续地在他们的公共生活空间中创造出原始的、艺术化的代表作品，我们注意到其中有些图像开始显露出我们的轮廓。

现在看来，我们在这颗星球上的所作所为很可能已经引起了注意。
event-fircon-1270.en:
As the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] continue to create crude, artistic representations in their communal living spaces, we have noticed some images have begun to look like us.

It now seems likely that our efforts on the planet have attracted no

event-fircon-1295.zh:
在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上独立出现了多种非语言的沟通体系。由于在图像和象形文字集之间存在冲突，居民们距离形成一种主导语言还有几个世纪。

有趣的是，其中一个书写体系的语法结构与我们的很相似。如果[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的社会采用这个系统，他们在未来可能会在文化上相当具有可塑性……
event-fircon-1295.en:
Multiple non-verbal communication systems have emerged independently on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]. With conflicting sets of imagery and hieroglyphs, the inhabitants are still centuries away from forming a dominant language.

Interestingly, one of the writin

event-fircon-1325.zh: [From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的社会正不断孕育出丰富的文化和对艺术进行深刻鉴赏的风潮。居民们放下了武器，转而使用书写工具。随着这种全新的学习和探索氛围已超脱于冲突之上，我们可能正在见证这个行星上一个黄金时代的到来。
event-fircon-1325.en: Society on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] is blossoming with rich culture and a deep appreciation for art. The inhabitants are putting down their weapons in favor of writing instruments. With this newfound willingness to learn and explore beyond conflict, we cou

event-fircon-2000.zh: 使用隐身[GetIndividualNamePlural]和牵引光束，我们能够成功地收集、分析和研究毫无防备的[pre_ftl_species.GetName]个体，之后再将其送还到自己的居所。不幸的是，牵引光束对于[pre_ftl_species.GetAdj]的生理机能产生了预料之外的效果。在返回家中以后，这些样品开始遭受疖子、疹子以及不受控制地打喷嚏，在回到家中的三个小时之后其外表皮还会发生溶解。这种神秘的溶肤病已经酿成了全国范围内的卫健紧急事件，而验尸报告毫无疑问会揭示外部干预的证据。
event-fircon-2000.en: Using stealthy [GetIndividualNamePlural] and tractor beams, we were able to successfully collect, analyze and study unsuspecting [pre_ftl_species.GetName] individuals and return them to their dwellings. Unfortunately, the tractor beams had an unexpected effect

event-fircon-2010.zh:
从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上收集活体样本的时候发生了事故。由于计算错误，我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]上配备的牵引光束强度不足。不仅没有得到样本，我们只能短暂地让它们悬浮在空中，然后立马掉到地面上。

我们试图收集的鸟类样本发现这样的事故特别好玩。这些胆子很大的样本甚至开始追逐我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]，希望也能被带走，而且完全是出于寻求乐子。
event-fircon-2010.en: An accident occurred while collecting live samples from planet [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Due to a miscalculation, our [GetIndividualNamePlural] were equipped with tractor beams of insufficient strength. Instead of acquiring the specimen, we only managed to lif

event-fircon-2500.zh:
虽然[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的感性个体都从属于一个有机的格式塔意识，但[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]有数个不同的“蜂巢”。这些蜂巢是互相独立的子个体集合体，相互竞争着资源。偶尔，两个群体之间会爆发冲突，有时还会升级为全面战争。我们目前正在目睹一场对蜂巢首都的全力攻击，这场面真是令人毛骨悚然。由于不受移情作用的阻碍，子个体的效率会让任何将军感到自豪。

守军节节败退，但根据我们的估计，它们应该还能坚持几天。

然而就在片刻之后，所有战斗都停止了，守军与对手联
event-fircon-2500.en: While all of the sentient population of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] belongs to an organic gestalt consciousness, the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] is home to several different 'Hives'. These hives are isolated collections of drones and are competing with each

event-fircon-2510.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]最近开始在这颗星球的新地区定居下来。当地的动植物群落起初与定居地区的动植物群落大不相同，但现在已经完全被集体所控制，它们采取了一种激进却有条不紊的方法来调节当地的生态系统。某些动物物种被无情地消灭，用其他物种取而代之，而入侵性植物扼杀了本地树木的生命。当地土著对生态的掌控令人惊叹，但它们在气候异常地区不可避免地遭遇了一些挫折，在这些地区，引进的生命形式无法长期生存。我们相信，它们很快就会找到克服这些障碍的办法，最终
event-fircon-2510.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has recently started settling new regions of the planet. The local flora and fauna, initially vastly different from what can be found in the settled territory, are being completely taken over by the col

event-fircon-2520.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]最近开发了新技术，它们的工业开始疯狂地增长。当地蜂巢的头脑中有了部分自动化的概念，工厂、冶炼厂、装配线和燃料提取器已在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的各地建成。黑烟在天空中飘荡，许多子个体由于接触到有毒的化学物质而开始出现退化的迹象。很快，蜂巢将不得不解决这些问题，然而，不受影响的子个体仍在照常工作。
event-fircon-2520.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has recently developed new technologies, and their industry has started to grow at a frantic pace. Factories, smelters, assembly lines, and fuel extractors have been built across the [pre_ftl_planet.Get

event-fircon-2530.zh: 发生了一系列意外事件，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]似乎被悲伤所笼罩。在一个子个体的死亡之后，我们目睹了整个蜂巢出现了前所未有的工作停顿。我们不清楚这个子个体有什么与众不同之处，但蜂巢似乎正在举行某种仪式，死去的子个体几乎被虔诚地切成碎片，然后这些碎片被送到各个新生子个体的培育所。几分钟后，整个蜂巢又开始运转起来。这非常令人困惑，很像一个具有社会意义或精神意义的事件。
event-fircon-2530.en: In an unexpected turn of events, grief seems to have taken over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. We are witnessing an unprecedented halt in the work of an entire hive, in the aftermath of the death of a singular drone. We are unsure why this drone is different from t

event-fircon-2550.zh:
我们对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的观察在继续，最近我们发现了最初被误认为是失控了的子个体。它们生活在当地蜂巢定居点的外围，似乎已经拥有部分、甚至完全的自主性。它们似乎彻底脱离了集体，有些甚至很享受悠闲的时光，舒适地无所事事。

然而，它们似乎仍然依赖蜂巢获取资源，本质上是与集体进行交易。我们尚不明了为什么蜂巢不认为应该消灭这些失控子个体。
event-fircon-2550.en: Our observation of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] proceeds, and we have recently discovered what we first mistook as rogue drones. These individuals live in the periphery of the local hive settlements, and seem to have acquired partial, if not full autonomy. They se

event-fircon-7500.zh:
今天，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上传来了令人意想不到的消息，一张熟悉的面容向我们问好：那是一张我们自己的脸。

最近，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj]似乎迷上了我们的外表。我们的[Species.GetEarNamePlural]似乎让他们联想到了他们的幼体。事实上，他们形容我们非常“可爱”。一种长着夸张[Species.GetEarNamePlural]的填充玩具在他们的城市里已经成了一等一的抢手货。
event-fircon-7500.en:
Unexpected news from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as a familiar face greets us: our own.

Recently, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj] have become captivated by our form. Something about our [Species.GetEarNamePlural] seems to remind them of their young. In

event-fircon-7505.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上正在发生有趣的社会变革。

由于他们只有我们作为参考，那里的人们开始相信宇宙中的所有生命都像我们一样：互相连接、合而为一。在别无其他参照的情况下，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]急切地希望我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]能进入他们的机构。他们的误解给予我们提升他们文明的良机。然而，如果得知了外面世界的真相（包括非格式塔物种的存在），他们必定会降低对我们的信任。
event-fircon-7505.en:
Intriguing sociological changes are taking place on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

Given they have only ourselves as a reference, the people there have come to believe that all life in the universe must be as we are: connected. One. Without another frame of refere

event-fircon-7510.zh: 我们的科学家十分动摇地离开了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]。我们希望能够促进对蜂巢的教育计划，这一举措取得了成功，我们计划继续教他们一些基本的化学知识。差不多是立刻，他们就推导出了基于这些原理的最具破坏的应用，我们前脚还没离开他们的大气层，后脚他们就开始对邻近的蜂巢发动战争。现在，数以百万计的子个体正在死亡。
event-fircon-7510.en: Our scientists left [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today in a shaken state. After the success of our educational initiative with the hive we wish to promote, we proceeded to teach them some basic chemistry. Almost immediately, they extrapolated the most destructive

event-fircon-8025.zh:
根据我们同[freeport_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的贸易协议，我们在他们的主要定居点附近建造了一个小型太空港。我们的商人不受规定约束，能够赚取巨额利润，但是禁止离开那片特区。

结果是，走私贩和有组织的帮派建立了一个繁荣的黑市经济。到目前为止，[freeport_species.GetAdj]选择睁一只眼闭一只眼，但是如果任由其发展，这个自由港将不可避免地被犯罪给拖垮。
event-fircon-8025.en: Per our trade agreement with the [freeport_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural], we have established a small spaceport near one of their major settlements. Free from regulation, our merchants are reaping massive profits, but are forbidden of leaving the com

event-fircon-8030.zh: 我们在与[sweet_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的经贸往来中向他们出口一种可口的普通美食，至少对于我们来说是这样的。不过，已经被证实的是，这种普通的甜品对于[sweet_species.GetName]来说居然能产生精神方面的影响。它具有高度成瘾性，而且非常危险。无良的商人们以高价大量出口这种商品，以至于许多当地居民陷入昏迷乃至死亡。
event-fircon-8030.en: One of the commodities we have been trading with the [sweet_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] is tasty, but very ordinary food. At least to our species. However, this basic sweetener has proven to be a very powerful psychotrope for the [sweet_species.Get

event-fircon-8035.zh: [landgrab_planet.GetName]传来了令人担忧的经济报告，我们的贸易商正在此地同[landgrab_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]进行贸易。当条约签署的时候，我们采取了一些措施来保障当地人的国家主权，但是我们中的一些人绕过法律，从当地的草场人手中购买了大片的土地。以目前的速率，要不了一代人[landgrab_planet.GetName]就会完全被私人贸易商给买空了。
event-fircon-8035.en: Concerning economic reports from [landgrab_planet.GetName], where our merchants have been trading with the [landgrab_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]. When the deal was signed, measures were put in place to ensure the sovereignty of the locals, but some

event-fircon-8040.zh: 我们同[fruitful_coop_country.GetName]签署的贸易协定带来了累累硕果。双方都遵守协定条款，贸易正在流通。一些商人呼吁在规章制度方面进一步放宽，但总体来说协定给双方都带来了益处。
event-fircon-8040.en: The trade deal we signed with the [fruitful_coop_country.GetName] has proven extremely lucrative. The terms of the deal are being respected and trade is flowing. Some merchants continue to call for more relaxed regulation, but overall the deal has proven benef

event-fircon-8045.zh: 我们自[space_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：肆无忌惮的奴隶贩子伪装成商人，正在滥用我们的贸易协定，降落到该星球上大肆绑架当地人。当一大批[space_slavers_species.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]出现在某个地下奴隶贸易市场上的时候，我们才了解到这一行径。
event-fircon-8045.en: Disturbing reports from the [space_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: posing as merchants, unscrupulous slavers have been abusing our Trade Deal to land on the planet and abduct the local population. We only learned of the practice when a large g

event-fircon-8050.zh:
我们自[preftl_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：在这颗星球的偏远地区，有几个太空旅商，主要是走私贩，连同飞船一起消失了。通过谨慎的调查，我们发现他们被迫在矿井里工作，远离窥探的视线。

令人重视的是，[preftl_slavers_country.GetName]当局并不对此负责，这些事情是由当地的几个军阀和犯罪头子干的，此外所有被绑架的个体都违反了我们同[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]签订的协议。
event-fircon-8050.en: We have received disturbing reports from the [preftl_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: in remote regions of the planet, several spacefaring merchants, mainly smugglers, have disappeared along with their ships. A discreet investigation revealed t

event-fircon-8055.zh:
[preftl_hagglers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]用行动证明了自己是天生的贸易商。我们自己的商人通过艰难的教训认识到当地人是如此有悟性、能说会道，当然他们对此不是很高兴。

另一方面，我们的数名经济学家相信[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的这些行为是可以效仿的。
event-fircon-8055.en:
The [preftl_hagglers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] have proven to be incredibly adept traders. Our own merchants are learning the hard way that the locals are both savvy and persuasive, and they are not happy about it.

On the other hand, several of

event-first-contact-100.zh: 我们破解截获自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力有了回报，我们终于达成了一项突破。尽管对于他们语言的掌握还不够熟练，我们还是设法与这个文明成功地开放了外交通道，后者现在被正式称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。
event-first-contact-100.en: Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we have finally made a breakthrough. While our mastery of their language may not be complete, we have managed to successfully open diplomatic channels with

event-first-contact-103.zh:
我们解码收集自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们似乎完全不具有对于我们[This.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]物种而言自然而然的个体概念。事实上，单个[This.ContactCountry.GetAdj]“[This.ContactCountry.GetIndividualName]”没有自由意志和任何思想，他们不过是“[
event-first-contact-103.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

Remarkably, they appear to c

event-first-contact-104.zh:
我们解码收集自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的努力终见收获，我们终于能够和现在被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]的文明打开外交通讯频道了。

值得注意的是，他们是由一个单一的、强大的人工智能所指挥的全自动机器人文明。我们不知道任何他们创造者的迹象。我们只能假设他们在[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]发生智械危机的时候被清理干净了。
event-first-contact-104.en:
Our efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] have paid off, and we are finally able to open diplomatic channels with the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName].

Remarkably, it turns out tha

event-first-contact-1100.zh: 对于在[contact_country.GetName]中俘获的飞船的研究已经结束。尽管因为没有抓到活口来审讯而使调查充满挑战，但我们快速的进程可能使我们得以和[contact_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]建立通信。我们的[Root.GetResearchers]研究员可以研究他们的科技，这能帮助我们在研究突破上找到全新的思路。
event-first-contact-1100.en: We have concluded our study of the equipment we recently captured from the [contact_country.GetName]. Although investigating it was a challenge without living specimens to interrogate, faster progress could be made once communications were opened with the [con

event-first-contact-1105.zh: 我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]外星人的研究。这些人质相当不愿意同我们合作，不过由于我们已将其开膛破肚，他们的反抗毫无意义。现在我们对他们的[contact_country.GetSpeciesOrganNamePlural]、[contact_country.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]和[contact_country.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]的内部功能以及其他身体部分有了极大的了解，我们的基因学家[Root.GetResear
event-first-contact-1105.en: We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved unwilling to cooperate with us, but this became a moot point as we began to cut them open. We now know a great deal about the internal functions of the

event-first-contact-1110.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。最初这些人质不太愿意与我们合作，但随着时间推移他们在无意中不断地给了我们有关他们语言的线索，一直到我们能够与他们进行基础的语言交流。从那时起，我们就能迅速拼凑有关他们的细节，一旦有一位或是更多的人质愿意合作，我们就能进入他们的电脑系统。

得益于从他们身上收集到的信息，我们能够确认他们来自[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并就其活动和军事实力收集到了相当多的情报。
event-first-contact-1110.en: We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages were initially unwilling to cooperate with us, but over time they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, until we were able to communicate with t

event-first-contact-5000.zh: 我们的传感器检测到[This.ContactCountry.GetName]正在发送不断重复的清晰信号，似乎为我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]编码他们语言的工作提供了绝佳的材料。有了这份天降的幸事，语言学家们心态十分乐观，坚信很快就能有重大的进展。
event-first-contact-5000.en: Our sensors have detected a particularly clear repeating signal from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] that seems to offer our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] excellent material for codifying their language. They are optimistic that we will be able to make some sign

event-first-contact-5005.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]日渐沮丧，因为我们没能提供给他们充分的材料用于解码[This.ContactCountry.GetName]使用的语言，他们的进度十分有限。似乎这些外星人正使出浑身解数，防止不怀好意的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]窃听到他们的信号！
event-first-contact-5005.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are becoming increasingly frustrated at our failure to provide them with sufficient material to make progress on decoding the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. It seems these particular aliens are doing their utm

event-first-contact-5010.zh: 似乎我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]在翻译[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用的语言时遇到了重大挫折。不幸的是，他们认为的语言根本就不是一种语言。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]在[This.Leader.GetHerHis]的报告中指出，在几天内他们从多个角度的探讨，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]最终得到结论，这可能只是种试作音乐……
event-first-contact-5010.en: It seems our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have suffered a major setback in their attempts at codifying the language used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Unfortunately, what they had taken to be their language quite simply was not a language. In [This.Leader

event-first-contact-5015.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。我们对该行为出现了不同意见的分歧：我们是应该把这次冲击视为与外星文明建立更紧密的联系的跳板，或者是被认为一种警告，我们必须确保舰队准备万全，以免为时已晚。
event-first-contact-5015.en: In what comes as a profound shock to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Opinion is divided on whether we should treat this shock as a spr

event-first-contact-5020.zh: 我们已经辨识出了先前我们在[This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName]恒星系扫描的殖民地其实是[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的首都。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]通过调查从扫描中获取的资料发现许多关于他们的有价值的线索。
event-first-contact-5020.en: We have identified the colony we recently scanned in the [This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName] system to be the capital of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have found many valuable clues about them by investigating the

event-first-contact-5025.zh: 我们现在已经有一段时间没有获取到来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的视听资料了。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]发现他们似乎没有什么新的信息值得获取，并担心这条路似乎行不通了。
event-first-contact-5025.en: We have caught neither sight nor sound of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] for some time now. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] find they have little information to go on and worry that the trail may have gone cold.

event-first-contact-5030.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。他们的外表令[This.Owner.GetAdj]的公众感到兴奋，大家已经迫不及待想要和这些外星人进一步接触了。
event-first-contact-5030.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has proven delightful to the [This.Owner.GetAdj] public,

event-first-contact-5035.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。我们中的许多人对它们的外表感到惊悚，并称他们为“令人作呕的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]”。并且，已有许多人要求我们采取措施以应对新的“[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesClass]”威胁……
event-first-contact-5035.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has provoked widespread dismay amongst our populace, who

event-first-contact-5040.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经在大量收集来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信号取得了稳步的进展。然而，随着我们对他们语言的知识储备越来越丰富，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]却越来越感到迷惑。很明显他们不得不对先前工作的翻译进行数次重新评估，因为他们发现先前认定文字的含义事实上极度不准确。似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的整体面貌和我们极度相异——比我们能够想象的差的更多！
event-first-contact-5040.en: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have been making steady progress gathering together a large collection of signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. However, as our knowledge of their language has grown, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have become ever more

event-first-contact-5045.zh: 随着我们收集到更多有关[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的资料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人和我们对于整个星系具有大量相同的看法。
event-first-contact-5045.en: As we have gathered more material on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share much of our outlook on the galaxy as a whole.

event-first-contact-5050.zh: 我们对来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号的语言解析工作遇到了挫折。似乎我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]对翻译中的关键假设已经被证伪。尽管这意味着我们许多的进展不得不被推倒重来，但至少我们未来的努力很可能会被建立在更可靠的基础之上。
event-first-contact-5050.en: Our attempts to decode the language used in the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]  have hit a setback. It seems that a key assumption our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] had been relying on in their translations has been conclusively disproven. While th

event-first-contact-5055.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]最近在解析来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]信号所用的语言取得了明显的进展。很明显他们现在坚信自己已经对该语言的基础有了坚实的把控，并且承诺他们能够很快报道进一步的发现。
event-first-contact-5055.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have recently made significant progress towards decoding the language used in the signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Apparently they now believe themselves to have a solid grasp of its fundamentals and promise that th

event-first-contact-5065.zh: 我们历经艰辛以在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]足够的信息从而让我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]推进进程，但是现在我们的努力终于获得了一个极大的推动：我们的传感器收集到了他们数艘船只之间颇具长度的交流。我们只能猜测是他们的戒备突然松懈了一下，或者是他们的科技并没有我们怀疑的那么先进，他们只是自己觉得通信通道是安全的……
event-first-contact-5065.en: We had struggled to gather enough information on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to have much to go, but now our efforts have received a major boost: our sensors have picked up a lengthy exchange between several of their shi

event-first-contact-5075.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言看似包含了数百万看似冗余的音节，似乎仅仅只是他们古代语言残留下来约定俗成的东西。在翻译的时候，这些不必要的填充性词汇唯一的作用看起来只是用来补充语法的完整性，或者最多有一些微不足道的上下文提示作用。

幸好，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经缩减了他们语言中这些过时的部分，制定出了简化版辞典，这样一来我们就能与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]进行高效的沟通。
event-first-contact-5075.en: The language of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] contains millions of seemingly redundant sounds, apparently dialectic hangovers from their precursor civilizations. When translated, these apparently superfluous filler words seem to serve no purpose other than

event-galactic-features-2.zh:
闯入者！注意：

我们是扎娜姆的守护者。你们在[From.GetName]星系的存在是对我们造物主的羞辱。我们的程序驱使我们将你们摧毁。化作尘埃成为广阔宇宙的一部分吧。
event-galactic-features-2.en:
INTERLOPER! Heed this message:

We are the Guardians of Zanaam. Your presence in the [From.GetName] system is an affront to our Creators. Our programming compels us to destroy you. Make your peace with the universe.

event-galactic-features-360.zh:
在[From.From.From.GetStarName]星系的舰队被全灭后，那里的虚空之云从碎屑中聚集了足够的物质开始进行某种宏观上的有丝分离，也就是无性繁殖。

现在追杀[From.From.From.GetStarName]的虚空之云又多了一个。
event-galactic-features-360.en: Following the destruction of our fleet in the [From.From.From.GetStarName] system, the local Void Cloud appears to have gathered enough material from the debris to undergo what can best be described as a form of mitosis on the macro level - asexual reproductio

event-galactic-features-368.zh:
[tiyanki_system.GetName]主序星旁，四颗于低轨道环绕的气态巨行星被笼罩在等离子场中。充能的等离子场深入气态巨行星大气内部，这种独特的环境是许多太空生物繁殖的温床。

这些生物大都微乎其微，但有一个显著的例外——巨型缇扬奇。这个恒星系一定就是它们起初进化了千百万年的地方，随后它们开始在整个星系中漫游。由于这个恒星系的等离子场性质极为罕见，这里很可能是星系中缇扬奇唯一的繁殖地。
event-galactic-features-368.en: Four gas giants enshrouded by a vast plasma field share a close orbit around the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system's primary. The charged plasma field extends well into the atmospheres of these gas giants, and this unique environment serves as a breeding ground

event-grand-archive-2190.zh:
[from.GetName]正在遭受攻击。

一大群虚空虫正在殖民地轨道上，用寄生囊肿进行轰炸。

每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对我们的殖民者以及所有生命都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫体内有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，在那里它们会本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。

生物分析表明，每窝虚空虫都拥有有限数量的囊肿，它们很可能在囊肿耗尽后离开。但在那之前，我们会遭受严重的人口损失。
event-grand-archive-2190.en:
[from.GetName] is under attack.

A large group of Voidworms is in orbit of the colony, bombarding it with parasitic cysts.

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly not only to our colonists, but all life. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates in

event-grand-archive-3025.zh: 我们摧毁了一只躲在小行星中的巨型生物。收获它的尸体也许对我们很有价值。
event-grand-archive-3025.en: We have destroyed a massive creature hidden inside an asteroid. Harvesting its remains could prove valuable to us.

event-grand-archive-7015.zh:
我们之前研发的虚空诱饵吸引了一群来自其他恒星系的太空鲸鱼，这些恒星系类似[This.Capital.System.GetName]，均含有气态巨行星。

看来我们的设备必须在这些环境中建造才能正常工作。如果我们发现其他野生动物，我们应该也能在它们的自然栖息地附近建造虚空诱饵。
event-grand-archive-7015.en:
The Voidlure we had previously developed attracted a group of space whales native to systems with Gas Giants akin to [This.Capital.System.GetName].

It seems our devices must be built in those environments to work properly. Should we discover other wild fauna,

event-grand-archive-9955.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]成功捕获了第一批野生太空兽群，我们相信只要投入足够的科学资金，就可以克隆出更多这样的生物。
event-grand-archive-9955.en: With our first successful capture of wild Space Fauna in [from.solar_system.GetName], we believe it possible to clone more of these creatures with the proper scientific investment.

event-infernals-30.zh:
[from.GetName]地表崩裂，地壳破碎，难以承受的热浪从地底涌上。转变来得迅猛而彻底：群山崩溃，海洋沸腾，天空余烬弥漫。

曾经繁盛的生物群系已不复存在，唯有极端生命体仍栖息于此。
event-infernals-30.en:
The surface of [from.GetName] has ruptured, its crust fracturing as unbearable heat surged from below. The transformation was swift and absolute: mountains collapsed, oceans boiled, and the sky was a veil of embers.

No trace remains of the planet's once-thriv

event-infernals-3200.zh:
随着[planet.GetName]殖民地的不断扩张，越来越多证据显示有一个使用活体金属的已灭绝文明曾在此活动，尽管至今未发现他们获取这种材料的任何线索。

最近出现了一个答案：一个被力场包裹、闪烁着奇异光芒的球体，从深层核心的熔岩流中缓缓升起。 其最初用途与构造尚不明朗，但在极高温度下，它会持续滴落出活体金属。这一发现虽巧妙地解开了那桩考古谜团，却也让我们面临新的抉择——该如何处置它。
event-infernals-3200.en:
As the colony on [planet.GetName] grew, so too did evidence of an extinct civilization that made use of Living Metal, though there was no trace of where they acquired this material.

An answer has recently surfaced, in the form of a strange shimmering sphere e

event-infernals-36.zh: 尽管对[GetPreFTLLower]文明使用超级武器非常有趣，但这也意味着那里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
event-infernals-36.en: Although using our superweapons against a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization is certainly amusing, it also means that there is now nothing left to observe there...

event-leader-1.zh: [officer.GetName]已被提升至[GetLeaderStatusAdjCap]地位，因在[ship.GetName]最近于[system.GetName]恒星系的交战期间观测到其高度的响应能力。
event-leader-1.en: [officer.GetName] was elevated to [GetLeaderStatusAdjCap] status following observations of their heightened responses during the [ship.GetName]'s recent engagement in the [system.GetName] system.

event-leader-10.zh: 在[system.GetName]星系进行战斗后，[officer.GetName]出现了独特的基因表达。
event-leader-10.en: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].

event-leader-15.en: [officer.GetName] has grown more nimble in the handling of our fleets.

event-leader-17.en: The battle in the [system.GetName] system has caused behavioral anomalies within [officer.GetName] to subside.

event-leader-30.zh: 根据我们最近做出的宣布人工智能非法的政策调整，所有拥有智慧人工智能助手的[Root.GetAdj]科学官都被命令放弃他们的助手并将它们回收利用。
event-leader-30.en: As per our recent policy change outlawing artificial intelligence, any [Root.GetAdj] Scientists in possession of Sapient AI Assistants have been forced to relinquish them for recycling.
