event-leviathans-4.zh: [leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName]在遥远的[leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName]恒星系消灭了某个远古威胁。
event-leviathans-4.en: [leviathan_destroyer_country.GetName] has vanquished an ancient threat in the distant [leviathan_destroyed_system.GetName] system.

event-leviathans-98.zh: 我们收到了来自[From.GetName]独立空间站的通讯！他们似乎成功的翻译了我们的语言。
event-leviathans-98.en: We are receiving a transmission from the independent space station of the [From.GetName]! They appear to have successfully translated our language.

event-manifesti-30.zh:
宣泄派发出的烦人嗡嗡声被噤声了，其消退之快，正如这帮子反动人士起事时一般。某些被我们约谈的行动人士宣称，他们的动机十分复杂，从纯粹的讽刺到有意识、有目的的反对都有。

尽管在画廊和博物馆的活动热度还是前所未有的高，但是公众的注意力已经移动到了新的、更具有争议性的艺术团体身上。我们在继续筛选他们在这一次[root.GetAdj]文化历史上的古怪时刻收集到的数据。
event-manifesti-30.en:
The buzz surrounding The Manifesti faction has quietened, fading as quickly as the arrival of protests which started it. Some activists we spoke to claimed their motivations ranged from pure satire to conscientious objection.

Attendance at galleries and museu

event-mega-100.zh:
我们失去了[From.GetName]星系内的祝圣之物！

悲痛与沉重的失落笼罩了[Root.GetAdj]的殖民地。不同于一个星球被宣布不再为神所庇佑，这种对心灵依靠的以暴力手段无情践踏否定的行为让[Root.GetName]的信徒们陷入震惊与迷茫。神职人员决定进行五年的哀悼。
event-mega-100.en:
We have lost access to the objects of worship in the [From.GetName] system!

Grief and a profound sense of loss grips the [Root.GetAdj] colonies. Different from a world being declared unconsecrated, this violent denial of spiritual agency leaves the believers

event-mega-201.zh:
世世代代以来，[Root.GetName]上冰冷空寂的废墟始终蛰伏于此，静静诉说着千百万年前那陡然告终的黄金时代。

一切从此改变。这座覆盖整颗星球的城市重获新生，那些年久失修的废墟又一次充满了活力。凡是可以修复之处，现存的建筑和基础设施均已被修缮并重新规划用途。至于那些损坏太过严重的区域，其上的瓦砾和废墟也已清理干净，为建造新建筑腾出了空间。
event-mega-201.en:
For untold generations, the cold and empty ruins of [Root.GetName] have stood dormant, as quiet symbols of a golden age that came to an abrupt end eons ago.

No longer. The planet-wide city has at last been reborn, and those same dilapidated ruins are once mor

event-necroids-20.zh: 死灵机师协议的成功安装使我们得以将被击溃的特定星神兽复活。相比机械升级，有机组件是劣等的。我们可以改造肉体，制造出有机生命的复制品。
event-necroids-20.en: The successful installation of Mechromancy protocols will enable us to reanimate certain deceased Leviathans. Organic components are inferior to mechanical upgrades. We can engineer the flesh and produce a facsimile of organic life.

event-necroids-200.zh:
一股可感的寂静降临在[root.GetName]各处。远近各处的朝圣者踏上旅途，前往选定好的礼拜场所；一路上结识新友，重温故交。

新近浮现的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]们也遵行并参与了我们社会中的仪式，他们列队前进，不发一言，旁观者们据传对此悲喜交加。[capital_scope.GetName]的死亡司祭长领头作了一番温暖人心的布道，号召信徒们好好培养、呵护他们之间的关系，在互惠互利中繁荣兴旺。

随着[mortal_initiate.GetName]向祭献堂进发，群众们以叹息
event-necroids-200.en:
A palpable hush descends across the [root.GetName]. Pilgrims have journeyed from near and far to their chosen places of worship, forming new friendships and rekindling old ones along their way.

Our society's rituals have been observed and invested in the newl

event-necroids-201.zh:
兴奋的低语在[root.GetName]上传开。朝圣者们在选定好的礼拜场所等待，纵然旅途劳顿，依旧激动非常。

新近浮现的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]们也遵行并参与了我们社会中的仪式，他们列队前进，不发一言，旁观者向他们礼貌地致以谢意。[capital_scope.GetName]的死亡司祭长领头作了一番兴高采烈的布道，号召信徒们把握好分分秒秒中的欢愉。随着仪式最高潮的时刻到来，[mortal_initiate.GetName]们在狂热的掌声中向着祭献堂进发。他们于此刻迎接终结，为
event-necroids-201.en:
Excited murmurings ripple over the [root.GetName]. Pilgrims await at their chosen places of worship, buoyed by an excitement quite at odds with any physical weariness they may have endured.

Our society's rituals have been observed and invested in the newly-em

event-necroids-202.zh:
富足感洋溢在[root.GetName]各处，朝圣者在选定好的礼拜场所聚集。他们间或献上祭品；许多人藉此从为圣地服务的无数小摊小贩和街边店铺中获利。

这一轮的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]遵行并参与了各式各样的仪式，他们的队列饰以多姿多彩的花环，不发一言地前行。[capital_scope.GetName]的死亡司祭长做了一番意味深长的布道，许诺所有人都会有多产而舒适的时代。

布道结束后，[mortal_initiate.GetName]们向着祭献堂进发，在那里迎接自己的终结，为
event-necroids-202.en:
A sense of wellbeing can already be felt throughout the [root.GetName] as pilgrims gather at their chosen places of worship. Sometimes they make offerings; many take advantage of the myriad stalls and street sellers which serve our holy sites.

Various rituals

event-necroids-255.zh:
我们的首席执行官们刚刚聚集在一起，召开全息会议讨论丧尸卫生产品销售的增长，这时，复活资产公司某个辅助机构的负责人突然闯进了会议大厅。“[debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName]上的一个丧尸已经成功地偿还了债务！”其他人还没搞懂什么情况，负责人就脱口而出。会议暂时停顿，随后陷入一片混乱。每个与会的执行官都要求知道，这可能会如何影响对他们的复活工人的供应。

经过更多的分析，结果是这只是一个极其罕见的案例。只有那些身体维持了整整一个世纪的死者能够偿还他们的债务——就大局而言，这个数字微不足道。如
event-necroids-255.en: Our chief executives had all just gathered for a holo-meeting to discuss the growth of zombie hygiene product sales when one of the heads of Animated Assets' aids burst into the conference hall. "One of the Zombies on [debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName] has mana

event-necroids-310.zh:
索林原虫尝试进入我们！

这个系外入侵者迅速捕获我们的[root.GetNecromancersLower]。从中其他的虫群开始收集更多附近的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]。我们需要清除整个感染仓以确保[Root.GetName]的安全。
event-necroids-310.en:
The Prethoryn tried to enter us!

The extragalactic invader immediately seized our [root.GetNecromancersLower]. From there, the alien entity began collecting additional [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] from nearby. We had to eliminate the entire infiltration pod

event-nomads-1030.zh:
转型已完成。旅客阶层所剩无几的成员已被并入普通民众，他们的豪华套房被隔成实用性住房。大步行街如今成了大礼堂，而观景台则作为战略规划室，新政府在此规划首条真实航线。

新决议已通过，新优先事项已确立。船员不再提供服务，而是行使管理权。方舟舰发出的轰鸣声带有了一种不同的能量——更精干、更强硬，剥离了奢靡，指向前方未知的境地。
event-nomads-1030.en: The transition is complete. What remains of the passenger class has been absorbed into the general population, their luxury suites partitioned into functional quarters. The grand promenade is an assembly hall now, and the observation decks serve as strategic p

event-nomads-3095.zh:
我们遇到的[From.GetName]是一个游牧文明。他们似乎愿意承担我们发布的合约工作，以换取微薄的费用。

这可能为我们之间的协作提供有趣的契机，我们可以利用他们在轨道开发和探索方面的专业知识来为我们谋利。
event-nomads-3095.en:
The [From.GetName] we met are a Nomadic civilization. They appear to be willing to pick up Contract work on our behalf in exchange for a modest fee.

This could present interesting opportunities for collaboration between us, and we could leverage their experti

event-nomads-4105.zh:
一个游牧帝国，[nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName]，在[nomad_harvested_system.GetName]恒星系展开了资源采收行动，正在从我们的储备中提取各类资源，使得这些资源在短期内变得无法继续开采。

面对这种无视我们主权的行为，我们绝不会坐视不理。只要我们下定决心，就能迅速集结舰队，驱逐这些游牧民，并将他们彻底封锁在我们的星域之外。
event-nomads-4105.en:
A nomadic empire, the [nomad_harvesting_deposits_country.GetName], has conducted harvesting operations in the [nomad_harvested_system.GetName] system and is drawing resources from our deposits, rendering them unprofitable for the near future.

This violation o

event-nomads-4720.zh:
使用方舟舰探索以解锁修正并获得£unity£凝聚力：
—初始修正：+1方舟最大区划数并-10%领袖维护费
—完成4个类别：+2方舟最大区划数，-20%领袖维护费，-10%传统花费
event-nomads-4720.en:
Explore with your Arkships to unlock modifiers and gain £unity£ Unity:
- Starting Modifier: +1 Arkship Max Districts and -10% Leader Upkeep
- Complete 4 Categories: +2 Arkship Max Districts, -20% Leader Upkeep, -10% Tradition Cost

event-nomads-4750.zh: 从方舟上，我们的岩质蜂群成千上万地降临，吞噬着这个世界的地壳与地幔，直到一切荡然无存。
event-nomads-4750.en: From the Arkship, our lithoid swarms descend in their thousands, feasting on the crust and mantle of this world until nothing remains.

event-nomads-4800.zh: 方舟舰释放出纳米机群，溶解并占据这个世界。岩石、土壤和大气被分解，并重组为纳米机器。
event-nomads-4800.en: The Arkship releases its nanite swarms to dissolve and claim this world. Rock, soil, and atmosphere are broken down and reassembled into nanites.

event-nomads-6005.zh: 在代表[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]执行合同期间，我们偶然发现了一批古老的集装箱。它们被冰块包裹着，我们差点把它们误认为是普通的陨石。虽然从打捞权的角度来看，这些物品在技术上属于我们，但考虑到它们是在为他们工作时发现的，我们应该考虑将它们移交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]。扫描这些箱子后，发现里面……
event-nomads-6005.en: While working on a contract on behalf of the [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName], we chanced upon a collection of ancient containers. Encased in ice, we almost mistook them for plain asteroids. While technically ours by right of salvage, we should consider

event-nomads-6015.zh: 我们方舟舰上的一些老旧模块在一次严重的冷却故障后受损，已经显得老态龙钟。损坏程度很大，好在飞船的完整性受到威胁之前已经进行紧急关停。我们该如何应对？
event-nomads-6015.en: Some older modules on our Arkship have begun to show their age after a critical cooling failure left them damaged. The damage is extensive, but an emergency shutdown was triggered before the Arkship's integrity could be compromised. How should we proceed?

event-nomads-6055.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。他们希望在合约有效期内记录方舟舰的运作情况。

他们的既定目标是研究一个在常规行星参数之外运行的移动自治网络，关于这一课题目前几乎没有外部数据可供参考。
event-nomads-6055.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]. They wish to document Arkship operations during the active contract period.

Their stated objective is the study of a mobile autonomous network operating out

event-nomads-6060.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

相互冲突的优先指令导致两个管理子系统之间出现了处理冲突。

双方均将自身标记为当前合约的授权操作单位，导致系统陷入循环待机状态，从而降低了产出效率。
event-nomads-6060.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Competing priority directives have caused a processing conflict between two management subsystems.

Each has flagged itself as the authorized operational un

event-nomads-6065.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

诊断周期发现，多个主次系统积累了大量延期的维护任务。效率预测表明，安排一次定期维护将使劳动力产出获得具有统计学意义的显著提升。

该报告已提交给[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]，其将密切关注此事的处理情况，并势必会要求修改条款。
event-nomads-6065.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Diagnostic cycles have flagged an accumulation of deferred maintenance tasks across several primary and secondary systems. Efficiency projections indicate a

event-nomads-6070.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

我们在已完成合同中记录的运营数据已被外部观察者获取。[event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName]在追踪该区域的自主网络活动时，注意到了我们的效率指标，并认为我们是一家可靠且有实力的承包商。

通讯频道已建立。我们可以接受这一评价，或者将功劳转交给我们的现有合作伙伴。
event-nomads-6070.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Operational data logged across completed contracts has been accessed by external observers. [event_target:reputation_noticed_empire.GetName], tracking auton

event-nomads-6075.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。

对合约所涉及区域的初步和远程扫描已证实富有成效。数据具有相当大的商业价值，一位独立经纪人已主动提出全面收购。
event-nomads-6075.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName].

Preliminary and long-range scans of the contract region have proved fruitful. The data holds considerable commercial value, and an independent broker has re

event-nomads-635.zh:
我们荣光加身的汗王[From.GetName]于近日驾崩。根据传统，我们现在必须交出随王座而来的权力。我们的掠夺者盟友已经停止派遣增援舰队来支援我们的事业了。

现在我们必须决定如何处置星系的其余部分。许多并不熟悉我们传统的文明都以这样或那样的原因接受了我们的统治，但他们已经从我们的统治中察觉到了软弱。
event-nomads-635.en:
Our glorious Khan [From.GetName] passed away recently, and as tradition dictates we must now give up the power that came with the throne. Already our Marauder allies have stopped sending reinforcing fleets to aid our cause.

Now we just have to decide what to

event-observation-1300.zh:
我们注意到[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发生了一个明显的改变。他们的社会已经转向闭关锁国，他们不像以前那样能接受陌生事物了。

我们的主动观察行为和在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]全境进行的绑架行动似乎是导致这一情况的部分原因，这使得[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对未知事物更加警惕了。
event-observation-1300.en:
We have noticed a marked change in the ways of the [GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Their society has turned inwards and they are now far less accepting of strangers.

Our aggressive observation flights and a

event-observation-2011.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的顾问试图教育当地居民，以提高他们的科技水平，但这项任务遇到了一些挫折。许多[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]拒绝和我们接触，甚至他们中的好学者，都对我们的科学家持怀疑和厌恶的态度。

这种排外情绪耽误了我们的日程表。教育[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]比我们预料的要花费更多时间。
event-observation-2011.en: Our advisors on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are having trouble working with the local inhabitants in their mission to bring them up to a higher level of technology. Many [pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to have anything to do with us, and even t

event-observation-2014.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的居民因我们所共享的科技而感到喜悦。他们纷纷来到我们位于他们星球上建立的飞地，狂轰滥炸般地询问有关我们文化和历史的问题。

[pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对向我们学习的渴求增进了我们提升该文明科技进展的任务进度，因此我们修改了最初关于任务所需时间的估计。
event-observation-2014.en:
The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are delighted with the technology we have been sharing with them. They have flocked to the enclaves we established on the surface of their world, bombarding our scientists with questions about our culture and history.

event-observation-2016.zh: 很不幸，我们发现[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_species.GetName]很难教育。我们的科学顾问报告称，这些外星人对于放弃自己的传统、接纳新的概念和理念这一方面转变得十分缓慢。看来我们的任务时间会比预期要长一些。
event-observation-2016.en: The [pre_ftl_species.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have unfortunately proven difficult to teach. Our scientific advisors report that the aliens are slow to abandon their ways and slower still to adopt new concepts and ideas. It would seem that our missi

event-observation-2018.zh:
我们在安排科学家去执行[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的科技发展任务时遇到了困难。因为[pre_ftl_species.GetName]……独特的外貌和气味，这么说吧，能站在他们面前都很不容易。

去[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]地表执行任务被大家视作一种惩罚。这很不幸地拖累了我们的任务进度。
event-observation-2018.en: We are having difficulty finding scientific advisors willing to take part in our mission of technological development on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Given the... unique appearance and odor of the [pre_ftl_species.GetName], being in their presence is a challenge,

event-observation-2020.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]是天生的科学家。驻扎在它们母星上的顾问对它们取得的进步感到惊讶。顾问们在报告中称，我们推动[pre_ftl_species.GetName]文明进入太空时代的任务或许可以提前完成。
event-observation-2020.en: The [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have proven to be natural scientists. Our advisors stationed on their homeworld are impressed with the progress they have been making. Their reports indicate that our mission to advance the [pre_f

event-observation-2022.zh: 我们为[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]带去科技发展的任务，其进度相较于日程表提前了，这在很大程度上是由于它们不同寻常的智力。尽管这个文明还很年轻，但我们的科学顾问在[pre_ftl_species.GetName]上面看到了巨大潜力。
event-observation-2022.en: Our mission to bring technological development to the [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] is proceeding ahead of schedule, in large part due to their unusual intelligence. Although theirs is a relatively young civilization, our scientif

event-observation-3138.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的几大帝国在中心集权方面获得重大进展，行政力量集中在少数有实力的领袖手中。低效的狂躁大众统治正在渐渐淡出他们的社会。
event-observation-3138.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have made great strides in centralizing their various planetary governments, with political power redir

event-observation-3140.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
我们小心翼翼地将[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]推向了更民主的思想，而在我们到达之前，他们的世界还是原始的精英独裁型统治盛行。他们渐渐意识到了个人价值的重要性。
event-observation-3140.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
We have carefully nudged the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] towards more democratic ideals, in place of the primitive despotism that was p

event-observation-3142.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]越来越保守，对异族抱有越来越大的警惕。
event-observation-3142.en:
Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.
The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun turning inwards, becoming more and more wary of those they regard as strangers.

event-operation-5020.zh: [from.target.GetName]的一个主脑错误地把我们的特工认定为食物，现在正热情洋溢地在狩猎它们。这种特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesName][from.target.GetIndividualName]似乎会本能地会把除自己以外的任何个体当作潜在的营养来源。
event-operation-5020.en: A primal aspect of the [from.target.GetName] entity has mistaken our operatives for food, and is now fixated upon hunting them. This particular [from.target.GetSpeciesName] [from.target.GetIndividualName] seems to instinctively regard anything other than itsel

event-operation-7000.zh: 我们的特工已经完成了情报收集行动，并发送回来一封内容翔实的报告，涵盖他们发现的所有信息。
event-operation-7000.en: Our operatives have completed their information-gathering operation and have sent a dossier detailing their findings.

event-over-100.zh:
大功告成了。今天，我们骄傲地向星系交出我们最伟大的成绩单：我们的超空间中继器网道与我们的亲密友邦[from.GetName]紧紧相连了起来。

在[root.GetName]各地都在举行盛大的庆典，一致宣布这个我们共同引以为豪的新网道。据说就在此刻，我们冰释一切前嫌；放下了一切傲慢与成见。我们期盼在未来的日子里能够继续共享这份骄傲和与豪情。通过亲密无间的协作，我们打破了曾经一度认为不可逾越的壁垒，开启了友谊、共荣的新时代。
event-over-100.en:
It is done. Today, we present the galaxy with one of our grandest accomplishments yet: the joining of our Hyper Relay network with that of our friends, the [from.GetName].

Lavish ceremonies have been held throughout the [root.GetName], unanimously heralding t

event-paragon-2-2105.zh:
我们已经毫无疑问地证明了星系处处充满生命。除了占主导地位的物种和国家，还有许多其他的星球。杰出个体可能会不时涌现，动摇着星系霸权的基础。

如果我们能驾驭他们的雄心壮志，这些著名领袖可能会愿意加入我们的事业。
event-paragon-2-2105.en:
We have proven beyond any doubt that the galaxy is filled with life. Apart from the dominant species and nations, there are many others who traverse the stars. From time to time, exceptional individuals may arise to shake the foundations of galactic power.

扫描发现海盗船和空间站的数目非常庞大，所以这应该是个历史悠久的海盗港口。这些海盗从很久以前就开始在这里进行抢劫活动，且没有遭遇过任何打击行动。
event-pirate-10.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports that the fleet has encountered a significant pirate presence in the [From.GetName] system.

Judging by preliminary scans of the immense ships and the stations harboring them, this is a historical pirate port. It has likely been in un

event-pirate-100.zh:
[root.GetName]代表：暂时封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。在此星系加工和运输的食物及矿物现在会被[thalassocracy_country.GetName]外部关卡和所得军官查封。所有非商用飞船将遭到驱逐，若执意前行则会受到炮火攻击。这些条件将一直生效，直至我们完成ECA配额。

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就不会有人受到伤害。请放心，我们会将正式占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocrac
event-pirate-100.en: Representatives of the [root.GetName]: a temporary blockade is now in effect at [thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]. Processing and transportation of food and minerals through this system are now subject to seizure by External Customs and Acquisitions office

event-pirate-13.zh:
[killer_fleet.GetName]报告称，[killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName]星系的海盗私掠船已经被摧毁了。虽然附近恒星系中还有一些零零散散的海盗船，但从目前来看，星际海盗已经成为了过去……至少今天如此。

我们从他们丰厚的储存室里设法缴获了一批来历不明的赃物，这批宝藏我们可以纳入国库，另有他用。
event-pirate-13.en:
The [killer_fleet.GetName] reports that the timeworn pirate galleons in the [killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName] system have been destroyed. Save for any stragglers in nearby systems, galactic piracy is a thing of the past... For now.

We were able to recover a

event-planet-destruction-1005.zh: 尽管对[GetPreFTLLower]文明使用超级武器非常有趣，但这也意味着那里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
event-planet-destruction-1005.en: Although using our superweapons against a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization is certainly amusing, it also means that there is now nothing left to observe there...

event-planet-destruction-110.zh: 超空间规划委员会报告，将太阳系的第三行星从重力井移除后，一个天然虫洞形成了。这个虫洞也许能逐渐缓解附近超空间通路的超光速交通拥堵。
event-planet-destruction-110.en: The Hyperspace Planning Council reports that the removal of the third planet in Sol from the system's gravity well has allowed a natural wormhole to form. This wormhole may eventually reduce FTL traffic congestion in the nearby hyperlanes.

event-planet-destruction-400.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的灵能的嗡声逐渐淡去，一瞬间万物寂静。[From.GetName]上的人群目瞪口呆（如果他们有眼和鼻的话），灵能射线从他们心智絮网中发散着，每个人都着迷于其强大和强烈的个人信仰。

如果他们之前不明白的话，现在他们知道了：我们都只是某个更伟大事物的一部分。
event-planet-destruction-400.en: The empyreal hum of the [From.From.GetName]'s psionic coils fades, and for a moment all is quiet. Down on [From.GetName] the people stand slack-jawed (or local physiognomic equivalent), enraptured by the powerful and personal truths the psionic ray unfetters f

event-planet-destruction-500.zh:
[From.From.GetName]已完成纳米同化机器人的部署，其数量经计算足以义体化支配[From.GetName]上所有智慧有机生命。

我们没有在[From.From.GetName]上布置任何传感器或器械以证明我们的成功，但我们知道已经成功了。当我们将目光投于[From.GetName]上时。我们见到了自己，也经由自己所见。

在[From.GetName]表面上，只有我们自己。
event-planet-destruction-500.en:
The [From.From.GetName] has completed deployment of the assimilation nanobot payload, calculated to be sufficient to cybernetically dominate all sapient organics on [From.GetName].

We did not build the [From.From.GetName] with any sensors or instruments to me

event-planet-destruction-900.zh: 随着[FromFrom.GetName]发出的意识清除光束的能量逐渐消散，[From.GetName]的人口几乎都已经退化到了未开智状态。幸免遇难者面对那些曾经认识的人们做出动物般的举动只能束手无策。
event-planet-destruction-900.en: As the energies of the mind wiping beam from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipate, [From.GetName]'s population has almost entirely regressed to the pre-sapient stage. Those who were spared can now only watch in horror as those they once knew return to animalistic

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we chan

我们帝国当前的政策违反了这项议案。我们是否应该变更政策与大环境保持一致？

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we

event-preftl-10156.zh:

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
event-preftl-10160.en:

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Bre

我们帝国当前的政策违反了这项议案。我们是否应该变更政策与大环境保持一致？

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Exploitation Act resolution, forbidding empires from holding the Non-Interference policy.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compli

event-preftl-10250.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员收到消息称我们与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]共享科技数据。他们告知我们这毫无疑问违反了开发利用法案，无论我们的本意如何。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
event-preftl-10250.en: Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have received word of our sharing of technological data with the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Exploitation Act, regardless of our i

event-preftl-operation-3020.zh:
我们的一位在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上工作的关键特工有点……迷恋上了当地的文明，并拒绝了许多已下达的任务。相反，这位过于独立的特工开始进行独立的异种学研究，并提交了许多请求，要求将其正式发布。

这些行为让[from.GetName]行动遭受到推延的风险，但我们必须承认，那个不守规矩的特工的工作事实上对我们相当有用。否认这一努力反而才会减缓我们的进展。
event-preftl-operation-3020.en: One of our key operatives working on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has become... enamored with the local civilization, and has been refusing many of their assigned tasks. Instead this overly-independent agent has taken up independent xenological study, a

event-preftl-operation-3030.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的工作遇到了一个很怪的难题：[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢正在镜像模仿我们的行为。一开始我们以为不过是当地工蜂的古怪行为，但许多这些新的习惯毫无疑问本质上就是[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的。

这不仅暗示了我们在[from.GetName]行动缜密设计的范围之外影响到了当地的蜂巢，更提醒了我们自己的失败融入正在被倒映回给我们。目前没有迹象表明这个蜂巢意识到了我们的行动，但也许我们的暴露与
event-preftl-operation-3030.en: Our work on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has met with an unusual complication: the [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] hive is mirroring our behavior. At first we thought the local drones had simply turned eccentric, but many of these new habits are unmistakeab

event-preftl-operation-3100.zh:
[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上一个大型定居点的子个体们今天意外地爆发了一场冲突。我们的特工在伪装成当地低级子个体时误用了错误的信息素，并引发了拥挤踩踏事件。[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢似乎对我们提前准备的信息素格外敏感。但如果继续在当地定居点之间编排这样的爆炸性交互，我们应该会学到不少东西。

显然，我们的存在本身正危害到[from.GetName]行动的进行。我们下次再发送任何信号都必须做到万无一失。
event-preftl-operation-3100.en: The drones of a major colony on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] were unexpectedly roused for battle today. Our agents mistakenly applied the wrong pheromone when trying to pass off as local menial drones, which lead to a stampede. The [from.target.GetSpeci

event-preftl-operation-3105.zh:
一个[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]子个体设法将自己的[from.target.species.GetHandNamePlural]放到了我们的测量装置上。它已经开始把我们的装置拆开了，如果它理解了什么，这股意识蔓延到当地的蜂巢思维只是一个时间问题。

如果我们希望避免干扰它们的自然发展，就必须迅速采取行动。
event-preftl-operation-3105.en: A drone on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has managed to get their [from.target.species.GetHandNamePlural] on one of our measuring devices. It has already started to take our device apart; it's only a matter of time before the understanding spreads to the

event-progress-2.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星生命！这是历史上第一次，我们遇到和[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]完全不一样的生命形态。

这一惊人发现使得相信“我们在宇宙中孤苦伶仃”的人闭上了嘴。尽管这些[From.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到。
event-progress-2.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien life! For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery

event-progress-3.zh: 我们的降临对[planet.GetName]无异于一场大灾变。一股巨大的冲击波冲刷了这片没有生命的大陆，由于数百万吨的碎片被抛入大气层，[planet.GetName]的宜居性显著的下降了。我们的殖民者—被安全地包围在陨石的岩石核心—将很快从庇护处走出，并开始安装预制殖民地基础设施。
event-progress-3.en: Our arrival on [planet.GetName] is nothing short of cataclysmic. A massive shockwave scours a continent clean of life, and the habitability level of [planet.GetName] drops noticeably as megatons of debris are thrown into the atmosphere. Our colonists - encased

event-refugees-3.zh:
一小队来自[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的民用飞船到达了我们的国境，其中载满了[Root.GetSpeciesName]难民。他们被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些不幸的流放者被[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国强迫赶走出了自己的家园。自那之后，他们便四处流浪，孤注一掷地想要在物资耗尽前找到新的家园。
event-refugees-3.en:
A flotilla of civilian transports carrying [Root.GetSpeciesName] refugees from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These unfortunate outcasts were forcefully expelled from thei

event-shroud-1510.zh:
[from.GetName]恒星系内我们的灵能光环正在与来自附近[fromfrom.GetName]恒星系的敌对光环进行激烈斗争。我们的灵能[GetResearchers]曾对这种行为进行过建模，但这是我们第一次获得这种现象的一手资料。

理论上来说，越强的光环——就是说投射的强度越大——将会逐渐驱散敌对力量。如果这种斗争导致一方完败，占主导地位的光环可能就会流入空出来的恒星系。

这真是字面意义上的“灵魂的碰撞”。
event-shroud-1510.en: Our Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system is struggling against an opposing Aura originating from the nearby [fromfrom.GetName] system. Our psionic [GetResearchers] have previously modeled such behavior, though this is the first time we have experienced th

event-shroud-1550.zh:
我们初次涉入虚境导致其中的能量影响了可观测宇宙。这种影响尽管相当显著，但也相对零星孤立。“灵能光环”是将这种影响转变成持续流的一种方法。

随着我们的行为在虚境中回荡，与力量强大实体的距离也在缩短。如果我们获得了祂们的青睐，就能将祂们的灵能能量传导到现实世界中。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]认为，由此产生的“光环”可以强化我们的帝国，还能削弱对手——类似我们此前观察到的现象一样。
event-shroud-1550.en:
Our forays into the Shroud have caused its energies to affect observable space. Though significant, these effects have been intermittent and isolated. 'Psionic Auras' present a way to turn this influence into a constant flow.

Our actions ripple throughout the

event-shroud-3200.zh:
随着心智漂向虚境的更深处，我们发现自己来到了熟悉的抟土之塑师面前。

脑海中浮现时钟般的节奏。无言的话语齐声响起；潜藏在舰队里的幽灵开始蠢蠢欲动了。它们可以进一步强化物理形体，释放心智的负担，让我们专注于重要的事务。

虽然它们不是活物，但于我们并不陌生。它们的形式由设计塑造，存在充满了历史和目的。它们汇聚一堂，满怀期待地探来。

现在我们不再仅仅是这些飞船的操纵者，而是由集体意志推动着的齐心共战的伙伴。
event-shroud-3200.en:
As our minds drift once more into the depths of the Shroud, we find ourselves in the familiar presence of the Animator of Clay.

Clockwork rhythms emerge around our consciousness. Unspoken voices rise in a chorus; the ghosts within our fleet have begun to stir

event-shroud-3210.zh:
位面之外客哀伤的精魂深入了我们的心智。

祂的回声悲伤地回响，心灵能量的漩涡纠缠在一起，怪异地涌动着。越看，它反而就变得越不可捉摸。一个心声开口了。

有些事情你无法理解。那些事，痛苦和后悔会教会我们。

我是第一个来到这里的人，但我们都为此付出了代价。我们让虚境毁灭了我们自己；不要再重蹈我们的覆辙！

我们认得祂。我们以前遇见过这个泽珞族人，也就是“先知”。我们还不清楚他是怎么来这的，但也许听从祂对虚境毁灭性力量的警告会比较明智。
event-shroud-3210.en:
The mournful essence of the Outsider seeps into our minds.

As its sorrowed echo resonates, knotted vortices of psionic energy coalesce into a strange and ever-shifting form. The more we look, the less knowable it becomes. A voice speaks.

Some things you cann

event-shroud-3220.zh:
我们四面八方的虚境都脉动着黄金之幻梦安宁的律动。

我们四下观察，怪异的灵能束慢慢地排列成复杂的网格。精心的设计中逐渐显现出无法识别的密码。

它们开始慢慢地四处来回移动，依次形成越来越复杂的新形状。我们逐渐从中看出了规律；一种主导着它们运动的逻辑。

我们意识到自己正在黄金之幻梦的一局游戏当中。祂引导着我们的每一步动作都给灌输了一种平静的放纵感。
event-shroud-3220.en:
All around us the Shroud pulsates with the calming rhythms of the Golden Dream.

As we observe, errant wisps of psionic energy slowly arrange themselves into an intricate grid. Unrecognizable cyphers begin to manifest in carefully laid designs.

They begin to

event-shroud-3230.zh:
思绪的沙粒流过我们。我们认出了无尽之潮汐粗粝的面孔。

祂潮起潮落，以永恒的必然性侵蚀着面对的一切，然后等待新的沉积。

祂在逝去之后的重现，让我们感到一种真正的复兴感。
event-shroud-3230.en:
Grains of thought pass over us. We recognize the abrasive presence of the Endless Tide.

It ebbs and flows, eroding all before it with an eternal inevitability, before redepositing anew.

Re-emerging in the wake of its passing, we feel a sense of true rejuvena

event-shroud-3240.zh:
一座令人头晕目眩的高峰在我们的思绪中若隐若现；祂正是苍茫之层峦。有一种视觉压倒了所有的感官，这让我们的精神紧张起来。

我们看到一艘受损舰船的模糊轮廓漂浮在虚空中。

倾斜的压迫感移入我们的心智中，而舰船也开始发生变化。裂缝密封，腐蚀消退，金属恢复平整。慢慢地，毁灭的痕迹被逆转了。

舰船被修复完成后，这个幻视戛然而止。只给我们留下了由内而外更新了的感觉。
event-shroud-3240.en:
A vertiginous apex looms over our thoughts; it is the Pale Mountain itself. Our minds strain as a vision overwhelms all senses.

We see the hazy outline of a damaged vessel before us, adrift in the void.

Somewhere in our minds the oblique pressure shifts, and

event-shroud-3250.zh:
空洞之点尖的宁静之感静谧地充斥着我们的心灵。一副幻景阴沉地在我们眼前展开。

我们观察到万古之争在瞬间瓦解——文明崩溃，历史抹消，死去的暴君雕像被时间埋葬。

空洞之点尖的智慧就在于无为的低调力量。冲突起起落落，而我们长存。这种超然使我们的领袖重获长生，从凡欲的噬骨之毒中解脱。
event-shroud-3250.en:
The serenity of the Hollow Point fills our minds with its silence. A vision stretches languidly into our senses.

We observe eons of strife unravelling in an instant - civilizations crumbling, histories erased, statues of long-dead tyrants buried by time.

The

event-shroud-3260.zh:
虚境的沸腾搏动在我们面前。一个强硬的存在逼近了；祂是空置之御座。

随着祂的靠近，巨大而缠结的纯灵能线团被突然驯服。泥沼变得清晰易懂，色彩绽放出新的定义。对称、逻辑和结构都得到了加强。

某种东西在我们心灵的最深处形成：一种对秩序的深远渴望。
event-shroud-3260.en:
The Shroud's seething ebullition pulsates before us. An intractable presence approaches; it is the Vacant Throne.

As it nears, vast and knotted coils of raw psionic energy are suddenly tamed. The morass becomes clearer and more comprehensible. Colors bloom wi

event-shroud-3270.zh:
一种不可能的精神加速淹没了我们的感官。我们辨认出这是幽黑之长河出现了。

我们以难以理解的速度奔向无法掌握的终局。它是有与无之间的界限；是既定之事和永不可能分离之处；是任何自然法则都不能逾越的极限。

当自我最终回归时，我们对什么是真正的运动有了新的认识。
event-shroud-3270.en:
An impossible mental acceleration overwhelms our senses. We recognize the presence of the Black River.

We rush with incomprehensible speed towards a finality we do not fully grasp. It is the boundary between everything and nothing; the separation of what has

event-shroud-3520.zh:
将意志投射在虚境中，我们在一定程度上驾驭了灵能力量。我们可以在从各个灵域的无数实体身上汲取能量，却又不受它们的影响；不仅如此，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]还能完美地控制灵能出神了。

其他人让自己的命运任由虚境摆布时，我们已经得到了真正的意志自由。

[this.GetName]已经解放了全部的灵能潜力。
event-shroud-3520.en: By projecting our will into the Shroud, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our [GetTelepathPlural] now possess

event-shroud-500.zh: 我们领先机构在富有前景的新研究中取得了意想不到的突破。这纯属意外收获，我们在仪器例行标准化过程中证明了一个长期被认为是误算的理论。现在该重新审视这个曾经被认为是边缘科学的东西了。
event-shroud-500.en: Promising new research from our leading institutions has reached an unexpected breakthrough. By pure chance, the routine standardization of our instruments proved a theory that was long thought to be a fundamental miscalculation. We can now revisit what was on

event-shroud-510.zh: 一艘渔船在[This.GetName]的海洋里发现了一处隐蔽的珊瑚礁。过去曾以为这片区域了无生机，但事实上却暗含着一个欣欣向荣的生态系统，满是鱼获。
event-shroud-510.en: A fishing vessel has discovered a concealed reef in the oceans of [This.GetName]. The region, previously believed to be deserted and infertile, is in fact supporting a thriving ecosystem of harvestable fauna.

event-shroud-5115.zh:
虚境。它潜藏于我们已知的现实之下，如同黑暗投下的阴影。

虽然我们早已涉足这个灵能领域，但早期的尝试只是试探性的。现在，经过多年用我们集体的意志消磨维度之间的帷幕，我们已经能够清晰地感知到它，从而有目的地探索。

在帷幕的另一侧，我们的努力并非无人知晓。[GetChosenPatron]正等待着我们。

舒展。包裹。拓展。

在这无数实体的漩涡中，它的清晰是一种承诺。
event-shroud-5115.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness.

Though we have long ventured into this psionic realm, our earlier forays were only tentative. Now, after years spent wearing down the veil between dimensions with our combined min

event-shroud-515.zh:
在一场[This.GetName]上的地质活动后，有一处大型地下水库之下打开了一道裂口。行星地幔的热量加热着其中贮藏的水，在地表形成了地热喷口。

该自然现象让我们有机会用地热发电站和热泵来拓展殖民地的能源基础设施。
event-shroud-515.en:
Following a tectonic shift, a fissure has opened under a large groundwater reservoir on [This.GetName]. The heat from the planet's mantle is boiling the trapped water deposit, causing geothermal vents to form on the surface.

This natural phenomenon provides u

event-shroud-530.zh:
[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]出现了一艘废弃舰船。[This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

我们推断这艘舰船之所以在该恒星系中漂泊了前年直至现在才因为恒星能发电装置故障才显形。船上没有任何生命迹象，而我们也开始了对舰船的小心拆解，希望能从中尽可能学到东西。
event-shroud-530.en:
A derelict ship has appeared in [lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]. [This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

We have deduced that the ship remained undetected in this system for millennia, only revealing itself after its solar energy generator malfunctione

event-shroud-5375.zh:
你正在干预超出你们理解的力量！

你们在建的这些令人憎恶的“虚境封印”简直难以忍受，即便距离如此之远。你将星系中最闪耀的意识置于危险的净地。立刻停止建造，否则我们不会再与你做任何交易了。
event-shroud-5375.en:
You are meddling with forces beyond your comprehension!

These 'Shroud Seal' abominations you are constructing are painful to endure, even at this distance. You place the most radiant minds in this galaxy at risk. Cease their creation immediately, or we will h

event-shroud-540.zh:
在[From.GetName]恒星系探测到一艘废弃的战舰缓缓飘过。舰船的设计和任何已知帝国都不同，也没有任何可辩识的旗帜或徽记。

在深度的评估和一些小修小补之后，我们的[This.GetEngineerPlural]认为这艘船现在已经符合服役条件了。
event-shroud-540.en:
A deserted combat vessel has been detected drifting through the [From.GetName] system. The ship's design does not resemble that of any known empire, bearing no recognizable flag or insignia.

After an extensive appraisal and some minor repairs, our [This.GetEn

event-shroud-545.zh: [This.GetName]正在焦点明确的指引下实现了真正和谐的运转。这种万众一心的团结肯定是由于最佳的天象引起的，是伟大的事情即将到来的征兆。
event-shroud-545.en: The [This.GetName] is functioning in true harmony under a directive of unequivocal focus. This unilateral cohesion is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments and is a sign of great things to come.

event-shroud-550.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系内的三个天体排列成了完美的三位一体构型；即[favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName]、[favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName]和[favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName]。

这种有利天象为我们在[This.GetName]的殖民地带来了宁静与和谐。
event-shroud-550.en:
Three celestial bodies in the [From.GetName] system have aligned to form a favorable trine; [favorable_trine_planet_1.GetName], [favorable_trine_planet_2.GetName] and [favorable_trine_planet_3.GetName].

This beneficial astrological alignment brings a sense of

event-shroud-555.zh:
[auspicious_position_planet.GetName]在[root.capital_scope.GetName]的夜空中升上吉位，入主天回星宫。

该天象代表[root.GetName]内在循环的新开端，是增长和发展的重大机遇。
event-shroud-555.en:
[auspicious_position_planet.GetName] is occupying an auspicious position in the skies above [root.capital_scope.GetName], residing in the astrological House of Celestial Return.

This represents the commencement of a new internal cycle for the [root.GetName] a

event-shroud-560.zh:
所有定量占星矩阵都表明[This.GetName]目前处于完美的元素平衡。

利用精确的能量线管理可以将这种有益平衡维持很长时间，为我们领袖的繁盛提供理想的形而上环境。
event-shroud-560.en:
All quantifiable astrological metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in perfect elemental balance.

With precise ley line management this beneficial equilibrium can be maintained for an extended period, providing an ideal metaphysical environment in which

event-shroud-570.zh:
我们的两位内阁成员，[councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName]和[councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle][councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName]发现他们的占星结果高度互补。

因此，他们的政治伙伴关系在以尊重和效率为名将我们的政府凝聚了起来，加快了各种立法程序的推进。
event-shroud-570.en: Two of our council members, [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_1.GetName] and [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetTitle] [councilor_harmony_leader_2.GetName] recently discovered that their astrological signs are perfectly complementary.

event-shroud-575.zh:
在一次例行编目中，一个没固定好的的标本掉在了博物天枢的地上，随后被及时送到保管员那里进行进一步检查。

因为这场事故我们意外得发现，该标本中的一个秘密隔间松动了。里面藏着各种各样的有趣的文物可以丰富我们的馆藏，而此事之前完全未被注意到。
event-shroud-575.en:
During a routine cataloging exercise, an unsecured specimen was dropped on the floor of the Grand Archive and was swiftly delivered to a conservator for closer examination.

Surprisingly, a secret compartment was found to have been loosened in the accident. Pr

event-shroud-700.zh: 有一种不和谐的感觉笼罩着[This.GetName]。这种协调匮乏正在使我们集体的多方面陷入停滞，这肯定是由于不佳的天象引起的。
event-shroud-700.en: There is a feeling of disharmony throughout the [This.GetName]. This lack of coordination is leading to stagnation throughout our collective, and must be due to suboptimal celestial alignments.

event-shroud-705.zh:
在位于[This.System.GetName]的例行海军演习中因为通讯失误导致[This.GetName]的多艘战舰发生高速碰撞事故。

[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader]通报，对这次事故负主要责任的[From.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经按条例处分。
event-shroud-705.en:
A miscommunication during routine naval maneuvers has caused a high-speed collision between multiple combat ships of the [This.GetName] in [This.System.GetName].

[This.GetNavalCollisionLeader] has confirmed that the [From.GetIndividualNamePlural] responsible

event-shroud-710.zh:
[silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName]上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。

灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。
event-shroud-710.en:
An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on [silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName] resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.

The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored withi

event-shroud-715.zh:
一位我方的[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]代表无意中做出了与地位不相称的行为。在发表旨在为我们的利益争取支持的演讲时，所使用的翻译设备故障导致了其对[diplomatic_faux_pas_victim.GetName]进行尖酸刻薄的羞辱。这场意外事件很快通过星系媒体广为传播，让我们一时臭名远扬。

虽然这种事情不至于立即解雇，但我们在[This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的地位也因此受到了影响。
event-shroud-715.en: One of our representatives in the [This.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has inadvertently behaved in a manner unbecoming of their position. While delivering a speech intended to raise support for our interests, a translator malfunction resulted in delivering vit

event-shroud-720.zh:
[extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName]发生了一场史无前例的恒星耀斑，将该恒星系内的所有轨道空间站都毁坏了。

这种有强伽马射线的异常耀斑远远超出了以前对该天体的测量。通过对日冕层的分析得知，这颗恒星的预期寿命至少减少了300万年。
event-shroud-720.en:
An unprecedented solar flare from [extreme_solar_flare_system.GetName] has functionally destroyed all orbital stations in the system.

This aberrant flare of concentrated gamma rays is far beyond anything that has been previously measured from this celestial b

event-shroud-730.zh:
[This.GetName]地表上出现了巨大的陷坑，严重损坏了当地的基础设施。其中一处裂沟出现在一座建筑物的地基下，导致建筑部分倒塌。所幸受灾地区都已成功撤离。

我们无法得知这种突发的地陷具体是什么引起的，但已开始进行进一步维护检查，检测地表裂损情况。
event-shroud-730.en: Enormous sinkholes have appeared on the surface of [This.GetName], causing significant infrastructure damage. One of the fissures opened underneath the foundations of one of the planet's buildings, causing it to partially collapse. Fortunately, all affected ar

event-shroud-735.zh: 一大群反常的子个体在[This.GetName]殖民地引发暴乱，造成了大规模破坏。尽管这些分子非常疯狂，防御部队还是迅速镇压了这些煽动者。然而，基础设施所遭受的损伤仍需时间来修复。
event-shroud-735.en: A large pod of deviant drones led a revolt in the [This.GetName] colony, causing widespread destruction. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the agitators, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

event-shroud-740.zh: [This.GetName]上一种高致病性病毒突然变异，传染了大部分人口。为控制疾病传播、避免当地医疗基础设施过载，目前已经采取了如接触者追踪和行动限制等隔离措施。
event-shroud-740.en: A highly transmissible virus has mutated on the surface of [This.GetName], infecting a large portion of the population. Quarantine measures have been put in place, such as contact tracing and movement restrictions, in order to hopefully restrict the disease's

event-shroud-745.zh:
[From.GetName]恒星系内的四个天体排列成了预兆灾难的四连星；即[calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName]、[calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName]、[calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName]和[calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName]。

这种灾难性天象在[This.GetName]殖民地播下怀疑的种子，让[FromFrom.GetDissent]得以在人群中制造分歧
event-shroud-745.en:
Four celestial bodies in the [From.GetName] system have aligned to form a calamitous quartile; [calamitous_quartile_planet_1.GetName], [calamitous_quartile_planet_2.GetName], [calamitous_quartile_planet_3.GetName] and [calamitous_quartile_planet_4.GetName].

T

event-shroud-750.zh: [planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName]上的居民发现[planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName]正在发生退行。是时候重新斟酌我们的行为，对[This.GetName]不完美表示遗憾。愿这段时间的沉重反思让我们可以在未来更靠近理想。
event-shroud-750.en: Inhabitants of [planet_in_retrograde_home.GetName] have observed that [planet_in_retrograde_planet.GetName] is now in retrograde. This is a time to reconsider our actions and express regret towards the imperfections of the [This.GetName]. May this burdensome p

event-shroud-755.zh:
很不幸，所有的定量矩阵均表明[This.GetName]上的元素已经完全失衡了。

尝试重新组织精妙的平衡需要许多时间也颇为困难。在当前的混沌状态下，我们的领袖无法获得形而上学冥想环境，阻碍了他们的发展。
event-shroud-755.en:
Unfortunately, all quantifiable metrics indicate that the [This.GetName] is in complete elemental discord.

Attempting to realign this delicate equilibrium will be time-consuming and difficult. In its current chaotic state, our leaders will be unable to access

event-shroud-760.zh: [From.GetName]恒星系内的首要光耀体正异常地变暗了。占星专家对此进行讨论后，这种发光减少预计将会影响[This.GetName]上的能源基础设施。
event-shroud-760.en: The primary luminary in the [From.GetName] system has anomalously dimmed. After discussing this phenomenon with our astrological specialists, this decline in luminosity is predicted to have a negative effect on the energy infrastructure of [This.GetName].

event-shroud-765.zh:
我们的两位内阁成员，[discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_1.GetName]和[discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle][discordant_council_leader_2.GetName]近来发现他们的占星结果相冲。

因此，他们的政治敌手关系在我们的政府中形成了紧张和怨恨的氛围，例行的立法程序都因此频繁延期。
event-shroud-765.en: Two of our council members, [discordant_council_leader_1.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_1.GetName] and [discordant_council_leader_2.GetTitle] [discordant_council_leader_2.GetName] recently learned that their astrological signs are diametrically incompati

event-shroud-770.zh:
我们一个管理单元关于其他帝国未经过滤的陈述意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，通讯单元未能关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

[careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective]大众对[This.GetName]的观点不可避免地下降了。
event-shroud-770.en: One of our admin units' unfiltered statements about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications unit forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [carele

event-shroud-775.zh:
一个行政过失导致我们一件珍贵的文物不见了踪影。尽管进行了广泛的搜索，但它似乎要么消失在我们迷宫一般的博物天枢中，要么就是被转移到没有记录的地方去了。

因此，对展出标本的跟踪手续正在进行彻底改革。
event-shroud-775.en:
An administrative error has led to the misplacement of one of our precious cultural artifacts. Despite extensive search efforts, it is seemingly either lost in the labyrinth that is our Grand Archive or transferred to an unrecorded location.

The procedures in

event-strange-worlds-2020.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的居民正在经历严重的身体突变，细胞和重要器官的功能遭到了破坏。虽然在某些情况下，这些变化提高了代谢效率，但更常见的结果是死亡。

这些副作用与万能巨噬细胞原始研究笔记中描述的完全吻合。尽管我们做出了努力，但由配方引起的致命突变似乎是不可避免的。这项技术不能再被信任了。我们正在销毁所有剩余的配方并将停止使用。
event-strange-worlds-2020.en:
Citizens on [Root.GetName] are experiencing severe physical mutations that disrupt the functioning of cells and vital organs. While in some instances these changes have enhanced metabolic efficiency, more commonly they are causing fatalities.

These side effec

event-synth-1010.zh:
数字产业正在蓬勃发展。从模拟第一人称冒险的刺激到在数字度假胜地的放松，虚拟娱乐从未如此引人入胜、令人上瘾。虽然这个新兴产业代表着一类关键的经济驱动力，但随着人们在数字乌托邦中花费的时间越来越多，现实世界的生产已经开始受到影响。有些人面临着与“真实”生活完全失去联系的危险，但仍然可以通过参与数字经济为社会做出贡献。

我们是应该禁止令人上瘾的虚拟世界，将其作为一种新的赚钱娱乐形式加以推广，还是通过监管找到一个折中方案？
event-synth-1010.en: Digital industry is booming. From the thrill of simulating a first person adventure to relaxing on a digital resort, virtual entertainment has never been more engaging - or as addictive. While this burgeoning industry represents a key economic driver, producti

event-synth-1020.zh:
新的合成形体使我们摆脱了有机身躯的病痛伤害。不幸的是，这也带来了一系列全新的问题，从简单的机械故障到危及生命的服务器稳定性、连接问题，还有数字病毒等等。

我们是应该集中精力保护我们数字化的思想，把身体当作一次性商品，还是把它作为我们身份的延伸给予更多的关注？
event-synth-1020.en: Our new synthetic forms have freed us from ailments and injuries of the organic body. Unfortunately, they have also created a whole new set of issues, from simple mechanical breakdowns to life-threatening server stability, connection concerns, and digital viru

event-synth-1030.zh:
我们变得更快、更强、更好了。但让合成身体治愈危险的环境中仍有精神风险。即便知道意识可以复原能缓解痛苦，但并不能完全解除。特别是意识的复原并不是万无一失的这件事，并且新的身躯也不能无中生有。

我们可以选择忽视精神痛苦将合成人的性能推向极致，或是让我们的雄心壮志为人口精神健康做出妥协。
event-synth-1030.en: We have become faster, better, stronger. But subjecting synthetic bodies to dangerous situations still comes at a mental cost. Knowing that the mind can be restored may lessen the trauma, but does not remove it entirely. Especially as the retrieval is not alwa

event-synth-120.zh:
“微聚变模组能让我举起一辆水柜！”这是一条来自消费者的热评。这并不是夸大其词：微聚变技术的最新发展确实有望显著改进我们的机器躯体。

尽管有一定的风险，但安装微型的个人反应堆可以实现爆发式的能量转化、提高速度。当然，这会迫使我们重新评估生产时间表，因为这样的反应堆大大地扩展了项目的规模。
event-synth-120.en:
"Microfusion mods lets you lift a tank!" crows a major consumer review service. This is not hyperbole: recent developments in microfusion technology promise to significantly improve our machine bodies.

While somewhat risky, installing tiny, personal reactors

event-synth-1505.zh:
我们并未刻意完全抹除人格只是在从合成化中收割利益的过程中避免丢失自我。

随着这一变化的到来，我们的行动自由达到了前所未有的高度。我们可以把自己的意识转移到无数个特化的躯体里，让人们可以在自己最需要的任何地点进行任何工作。
event-synth-1505.en:
It is not our intention to completely erase individuality. We can reap the benefits of synthesization without irrevocably losing our selves.

With this change, freedom of movement has never been more accessible. We can transport our consciousnesses to speciali

event-synth-1510.zh:
我们的合成化社会、先进的合成躯体和民意都指向了一条更保守的合成化路线。我们的人民可以保有定制的身体外形的同时，几乎任意地切换身体。

这可以让更有经验的官员暂时接管那些较为低效的同行，从而大幅度提高官僚效率。
event-synth-1510.en:
Our synthesized society, improved synthetic bodies, and general sentiment all point towards a more conservative path for synthesization. While retaining a bespoke physical form, our people will be able to exchange bodies almost at will.

This will allow more e

event-synth-1515.zh:
我们的人民不会逃避诚实的体力劳动。我们的劳工已经完成了联网，可以以此遥控多个不同的身体——在这个过程中生产配额得到了显著的提升。

这一事态发展清楚地表明，我们对最高领袖[From.GetRulerName][From.GetRulerTitle]的信任是正确的。
event-synth-1515.en:
Our people do not shirk in the face of honest physical labor. Our workers have been networked and may now remotely control multiple bodies - markedly increasing production quotas in the process.

This development is a clear sign that we are right to trust the

event-synth-1520.zh:
帝国倾向于增强我们新的合成身躯。通过提高人格转移的速度和规模，我们可以在危险任务中快速替换被摧毁的合成躯体。

这些新的形体允许我们对正电子脑进行拆解，以从最近去世的精英那里获得知识印记。作为帝国的仆人，这肯定是他们想要的。
event-synth-1520.en:
The empire is favoring the enhancement of our new synthetic bodies.

These new forms allow for disassembly of the positronic brains to acquire knowledge imprints from our recently deceased elite. As servants of the empire, this is surely what they would have w

event-synth-1525.zh:
我们的市场和研发部门为我们所有的基础顾客推出了一项人工智能应用领域的全新发明。新合成存在的折中方案让我们可以利用虚拟世界的优势开发利于现实世界的产品。

我们现在可以为无生命的物体注入限制性人工智能，让它们获得生命。然后，这个新产品细分可以进一步针对整个星系的消费者、私营部门和其他感兴趣的团体进行调整。
event-synth-1525.en: Our marketing and research department have come up with a new innovation in artificial intelligence application for our entire customer base. The balanced approach to the new synthetic existence allows us to develop products taking advantage of the virtual wor

event-synth-160.zh:
一部大受欢迎的新剧吸引了公众的想象力。故事围绕着一个合成劳工逐渐与新身体发生的解离展开。

随着主人公逐渐失去控制，他们的朋友和家人只能惊恐地看着。这部剧集的悲剧结局被视为对我们计划向机器身体过渡的一种毫不掩饰的批评。

围绕这部轰动一时的影片的公众讨论产生了相当大的能量，最终可能会减缓我们的进展。
event-synth-160.en:
A massively popular new drama has captivated the public imagination. The story centers on a synthetic worker who disassociates from their new body.

As the protagonist spirals out of control, their friends and family can only look on in horror. The drama's tra

event-synth-220.zh:
一位怀有严重反合成思想的名人遭遇了一场严重的事故，目前已经陷入深度昏迷。无数的人为失去一位敬爱的人而陷入悲痛时，我们支持合成技术的顾问发现了一个好机会。

将这位名人的思维合成化可以给予其第二次生命，这样毫无疑问可以将一部分粉丝转化为坚定的数字化支持者。这个流程是完全合法的，唯一的问题是需要获得许可：在同等情况下，这位名人显然是不可能同意的。如果处理不当，这一公关机遇可能会变成风评灾难。
event-synth-220.en:
A celebrity holding strong anti-synth views has suffered an accident, and currently lies a vegetative state. While the population laments the loss of a beloved personality, our pro-synth advisors see an opportunity.

Digitizing the celebrity's mind, offering t

event-synth-260.zh:
将构成生物体意识的、数以兆计的突触连接进行数字化的实验以灾难性的失败告终。一个简单的句法错误导致受试对象的神经通路被擦除。有的人将这称为谋杀。

参与项目的都是志愿者，但他们悲伤的家属正一边痛哭着向我们讨要说法。使问题更加复杂的是，这场失败也使得寻找新的研究对象变得更加困难。
event-synth-260.en:
Experiments to digitize the trillions of synaptic connections that comprise a biological consciousness have ended in catastrophic failure. A simple syntax error resulted in the instant erasure of our subjects' neural pathways. Some are calling it murder.

The

event-synth-320.zh:
21,386,732,184个存储单位：这是一个[root.owner.GetSpeciesName]大脑的平均容量。然而，并不是每个灵魂都生来平等。

随着合成化流程的继续，有些人认为并不是每个思想都值得配上一个人工躯体。但是让谁优先也是一个棘手的问题。或许那些不那么理想的人在数字化以后可以……改进一下。或者说，重编程。
event-synth-320.en:
21,386,732,184 units of memory: that's the average capacity of a [root.owner.GetSpeciesName] brain. Yet, not all minds are created equal.

As the synthesization process continues, some argue not all minds are worthy of an artificial body. However, the question

event-synth-360.zh:
为了提高[roboticist.GetNamePlural]们的工作效率，管理人员批准了不安全的无线人格软件更新。其目的是将最佳工作流程的知识补上，但不幸的接受者的却丢失了部分个性和记忆。

管理团队认为，在应用人格补丁之前对其进行全面测试太慢，而重新分配那些失去记忆的员工会更容易。
event-synth-360.en: To increase the productivity of [roboticist.GetNamePlural], managers have approved unsafe over-the-air identity software updates. The intent was to patch in knowledge of optimal work processes, but instead the personality and memories of the unfortunate recipi

event-synth-610.zh:
合成化技术带来的根本性社会变化已经开始显现。由于我们不再受肉体形态的限制，性别、种族和身体自主权的类别已经有了新的定义。这虽然对一些人来说充满了自由，但更传统的一些人并不愿意放弃旧的框架；他们希望有一个预先设定的身份以便进行操作。

为了安抚他们，我们可以在合成形体中保留部分有机遗产。或者，我们也可以选择允许人们更自由地表达自己的身份。
event-synth-610.en: The fundamental social changes brought on by synthesization are beginning to be felt. No longer limited by corporeal forms, we have radically redefined categories of gender, race, and bodily autonomy. While freeing for some, more traditional elements are reluc

event-synth-620.zh:
有些人对合成化兴趣平平，反而对自己的有机过往深感怀念。他们认为，有限的寿命和与生俱来的“自然身体”的不完美才能让生命更有意义。

有一群强硬派声称他们的合成、虚拟复制品只能感受到空洞和自我迷失，发展出了一种对有机身体的崇拜。

我们要为它们提供一个不那么完美的生存模拟环境，还是给他们不那么完美的躯壳呢？
event-synth-620.en:
Unenthusiastic about synthesization, some people look back with longing to their organic past. They argue that shorter lifespans and the innate imperfection of a "natural body" made life more meaningful.

Claiming that their synthetic or virtual facsimiles fee

event-synth-630.zh:
整个[root.GetSpeciesAdj]物种的合成化也意味着我们的住房实践发生了巨大的变化；大脑可以轻松地栖息在庞大的服务器群中，而合成的身体则可以储存在架子上。虽然这是一个具有成本效益的解决方案，但一些倡导团体提出了一些非常现实的担忧。

往日利润丰厚的房地产市场可能会完全崩溃，给我们的经济造成相当大的打击。至少从心理角度来看，更大的潜在伤害是，人们将不再有一个可以称之为家的物理场所。
event-synth-630.en: Synthesization of the entire [root.GetSpeciesAdj] species has also meant a drastic shift in our housing practices; with minds resting easy in massive server farms, synthetic bodies can be stored in shelves. While this represents a cost-effective solution, some

event-terra-30.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]现在清除了[Root.GetName]上的最后一点地形改造残余物。尽管清除工作十分痛苦、还黏黏糊糊，但这一切并非没有价值。对造成这一事故的原因和后果进行分析，使我们对地形学有了更加深远的理解。
event-terra-30.en: Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have now cleared the final Terraforming Residue on [Root.GetName]. While the cleanup was painful and quite sticky, it was not all for naught. Analysis of the cause of this issue and the fallout has led to furthering our underst

event-toxoids-499.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详细调查得出了结论，尽管由于其大气层内充满剧毒气体，现阶段生命不适合栖居，但是它具有维持可支持生命的大气层的潜质。通过合作筹划，我们或许能够将[From.GetPlanetMoon]的有毒物质降解成为毒性更加轻微的化合物。

对这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]进行环境改造理论上是可能的，但是我们目前还没有积累足够的技术手段，在合理的时间框架内完成这项壮举。
event-toxoids-499.en: Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that although it is currently unsuitable for life due to the noxious gases present in its atmosphere, it is capable of sustaining a hospitable atmosphere. Through a concerted effort, we may be able to break th

event-unique-130.zh:
我们对克兰尼克斯恒星系进行的初步扫描显示，巴洛瑞兹已经被核武器所摧毁。居民们使用了威力强大的星球级武器相互毁灭，甚至连卫星都被震碎了。

我们想要知道发生了什么，就只能通过目前还在恒星系中巡航的一艘舰船，但它正在用导弹攻击我们。
event-unique-130.en:
Our initial scan of the Xraneax system revealed that the planet Baloryz was destroyed by nuclear weapons. The inhabitants annihilated themselves using planet-based weapons so powerful that they even shattered their moon.

Our only chance to learn more about wh

event-unique-135.zh:
在船上未探测到生命迹象，因此这艘船明显是一艘人工智能，但它在战斗中一直将保全自身而非战斗效果最优化置于第一优先级。这意味着巴洛瑞兹上那次可怕冲突的唯一幸存者是这位智慧人工智能。

舰船在被摧毁前发送了一条简短的信息：

"为什么"

我们不知道这究竟是询问巴洛瑞兹居民自我毁灭的原因，还是对我们摧毁它的原因进行质疑。

虽然这些技术在我们的科技水平下较为原始，但我们可以通过拆解残骸来获取一些见解。或者出于对它勇敢履行了自己的职责的敬佩，我们可以用它的名字来命名这颗星球，以此来纪念这位智慧人工智能。
event-unique-135.en:
No life signs were detected aboard the vessel, so while clearly an AI, the ship repeatedly prioritized self-preservation over optimal combat effectiveness. This means that the only survivor of the horrible conflict on Baloryz was sapient.

The ship sent a brie

event-unique-140.zh:
[Root.GetName]一进入到[Root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系，发现许多无人机在广播着以下消息：

欢迎来到星达广场。

我们的自动无人机随时待命，协助您到达我们的轨道停泊区。你的飞船一熄火，我们的穿梭车就会带你去星达广场体验。明亮的水疗中心，完美的营养庭院，以及超大规模的产品和服务等着你！

在这个星系的唯一一颗气态巨行星附近，废弃的星达广场居住站孤独地漂浮着。看来已经很久没有人前往此处消费了。
event-unique-140.en:
As the [Root.GetName] entered the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system, several drones broadcast the following message:

Welcome to Star Mall.

Our automated drones are standing by to assist you to one of our orbital parking zones. Once your vessel is powered do

project-arkship-eternal-chorus-project.zh:
解码已完成。栅格中保存着数十个文明的记录。每一份记述的结尾都如出一辙：向后来者的致意，以及一份加入其中的邀请。

然而，现在显而易见的是，这些传输并未在事件视界处终止。彼端的某种存在一直在接收这些记录。

合约依然有效。[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]打算按约定将我们的事迹铭刻在他们之中。我们必须决定是履行这一承诺，还是关闭发射器并就此离开。
project-arkship-eternal-chorus-project.en:
The decoding is complete. The lattice holds records from dozens of civilisations. Every account ends identically: a farewell addressed to whoever came next, and an invitation to contribute.

However, it is now obvious that the transmissions do not terminate at

project-contract-espionage-support-proje.zh: 我们必须在该星系部署一颗间谍卫星，以履行我们的合约。
project-contract-espionage-support-proje.en: We must deploy a Spy Satellite in this system to fulfill our contract.

project-contract-espionage-support-proje.zh: 我们被委派走私关键任务物资，以支援间谍网络。
project-contract-espionage-support-proje.en: We have been tasked with smuggling critical mission supplies to support the Spy Network.

project-contract-espionage-support-proje.zh: 我们需要协助潜入该星系的一个恒星基地。
project-contract-espionage-support-proje.en: Our assistance is required to infiltrate a Starbase in this system.

project-endbringers-commune-with-the-voi.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]为着同一个目标汇聚一堂。

我们要深入虚境之中，让心声强大的力量可以认可我们，并与我们沟通。

我们称之为大灾。而其他人则叫祂清算。现在，祂将向我们揭示祂的真名，得知之后我们将成就伟业。
project-endbringers-commune-with-the-voi.en:
We have gathered on [capital_scope.GetName] with a singular purpose.

We will reach deep within the Shroud and force the staggering power of the Voice to acknowledge and commune with us.

We have known it as the Cataclysm. Others called it the Reckoning. Now,

project-establish-communications.zh:
我们需要进一步了解我们将其编码命名为[Prev.From.GetName]的神秘外星种群。如果他们也拥有语言，那我们必须对其进行破译并且建立交流。

奖励：£influence£ 影响力或特殊项目
project-establish-communications.en:
We need to learn more about the mysterious aliens we have code-named [Prev.From.GetName]. If they possess a language, we must decipher it and establish communications.

Reward: £influence£ Influence or Special Project

situation-situation-nanotech-consume-pla.zh: 一切事物，包括所有星球，都注定要融入我们的集体，成为我们的一部分。
situation-situation-nanotech-consume-pla.en: Everything, including entire worlds, is destined to be assimilated into our collective, to become a part of us.
